verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Had there been angels walking the earth, well settled, We would have surely sent down for them an angel from heaven as a messenger.”

verses.text: Say, "Sufficient is Allah as Witness between me and you. Indeed he is ever, concerning His servants, Acquainted and Seeing."
verses.translation: Say, “Sufficient is Allah as a Witness between me and you. He is certainly All-Knowing, All-Seeing of His servants.”

verses.text: And whoever Allah guides - he is the [rightly] guided; and whoever He sends astray - you will never find for them protectors besides Him, and We will gather them on the Day of Resurrection [fallen] on their faces - blind, dumb and deaf. Their refuge is Hell; every time it subsides We increase them in blazing fire.
verses.translation: Whoever Allah guides is truly guided. And whoever He leaves to stray, you will find no guardians for them besides Him. And We will drag them on their faces on the Day of Judgment—deaf, dumb, and blind. Hell will be their home. Whenever it dies down, We will flare it up for them

verses.text: That is their recompense because they disbelieved in Our verses and said, "When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected [in] a new creation?"
verses.translation: That is their reward for rejecting Our signs and asking ˹mockingly˺, “When we are reduced to bones and ashes, will we really be raised as a new creation?”

verses.text: Do they not see that Allah , who created the heavens and earth, is [the one] Able to create the likes of them? And He has appointed for them a term, about which there is no doubt. But the wrongdoers refuse [anything] except disbelief.
verses.translation: Have they not realized that Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth, can ˹easily˺ re-create them? He has ˹already˺ set for them a time, about which there is no doubt. But the wrongdoers persist in denial

verses.text: Say [to them], "If you possessed the depositories of the mercy of my Lord, then you would withhold out of fear of spending." And ever has man been stingy.
verses.translation: Say ˹to them, O Prophet˺, “Even if you were to possess the ˹infinite˺ treasuries of my Lord’s mercy, then you would certainly withhold ˹them˺, fearing they would run out—for humankind is ever stingy!”

verses.text: And We had certainly given Moses nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel [about] when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, "Indeed I think, O Moses, that you are affected by magic."
verses.translation: We surely gave Moses nine clear signs. ˹You, O Prophet, can˺ ask the Children of Israel. When Moses came to them, Pharaoh said to him, “I really think that you, O Moses, are bewitched.”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "You have already known that none has sent down these [signs] except the Lord of the heavens and the earth as evidence, and indeed I think, O Pharaoh, that you are destroyed."
verses.translation: Moses replied, “You know well that none has sent these ˹signs˺ down except the Lord of the heavens and the earth as insights. And I really think that you, O Pharaoh, are doomed.”

verses.text: So he intended to drive them from the land, but We drowned him and those with him all together.
verses.translation: So Pharaoh wanted to scare the Israelites out of the land ˹of Egypt˺, but We drowned him and all of those with him

verses.text: And We said after Pharaoh to the Children of Israel, "Dwell in the land, and when there comes the promise of the Hereafter, We will bring you forth in [one] gathering."
verses.translation: And We said to the Children of Israel after Pharaoh, “Reside in the land, but when the promise of the Hereafter comes to pass, We will bring you all together.”

verses.text: And with the truth We have sent the Qur'an down, and with the truth it has descended. And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
verses.translation: We have sent down the Quran in truth, and with the truth it has come down. We have sent you ˹O Prophet˺ only as a deliverer of good news and a warner

verses.text: And [it is] a Qur'an which We have separated [by intervals] that you might recite it to the people over a prolonged period. And We have sent it down progressively.
verses.translation: ˹It is˺ a Quran We have revealed in stages so that you may recite it to people at a deliberate pace. And We have sent it down in successive revelations

verses.text: Say, "Believe in it or do not believe. Indeed, those who were given knowledge before it - when it is recited to them, they fall upon their faces in prostration,
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Believe in this ˹Quran˺, or do not. Indeed, when it is recited to those who were gifted with knowledge before it ˹was revealed˺, they fall upon their faces in prostration

verses.text: And they say, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, the promise of our Lord has been fulfilled."
verses.translation: and say, ‘Glory be to our Lord! Surely the promise of our Lord has been fulfilled.’

verses.text: And they fall upon their faces weeping, and the Qur'an increases them in humble submission.
verses.translation: And they fall down upon their faces weeping, and it increases them in humility.”

verses.text: Say, "Call upon Allah or call upon the Most Merciful. Whichever [name] you call - to Him belong the best names." And do not recite [too] loudly in your prayer or [too] quietly but seek between that an [intermediate] way.
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Call upon Allah or call upon the Most Compassionate—whichever you call, He has the Most Beautiful Names.” Do not recite your prayers too loudly or silently, but seek a way between

verses.text: And say, "Praise to Allah , who has not taken a son and has had no partner in [His] dominion and has no [need of a] protector out of weakness; and glorify Him with [great] glorification."
verses.translation: And say, “All praise is for Allah, Who has never had ˹any˺ offspring; nor does He have a partner in ˹governing˺ the kingdom; nor is He pathetic, needing a protector. And revere Him immensely.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: [All] praise is [due] to Allah , who has sent down upon His Servant the Book and has not made therein any deviance.
verses.translation: All praise is for Allah Who has revealed the Book to His servant, allowing no crookedness in it

verses.text: [He has made it] straight, to warn of severe punishment from Him and to give good tidings to the believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a good reward
verses.translation: ˹making it˺ perfectly upright, to warn ˹the disbelievers˺ of a severe torment from Him; to give good news to the believers—who do good—that they will have a fine reward

verses.text: In which they will remain forever
verses.translation: in which they will remain forever

verses.text: And to warn those who say, " Allah has taken a son."
verses.translation: and to warn those who claim, “Allah has offspring.”

verses.text: They have no knowledge of it, nor had their fathers. Grave is the word that comes out of their mouths; they speak not except a lie.
verses.translation: They have no knowledge of this, nor did their forefathers. What a terrible claim that comes out of their mouths! They say nothing but lies

verses.text: Then perhaps you would kill yourself through grief over them, [O Muhammad], if they do not believe in this message, [and] out of sorrow.
verses.translation: Now, perhaps you ˹O Prophet˺ will grieve yourself to death over their denial, if they ˹continue to˺ disbelieve in this message

verses.text: Indeed, We have made that which is on the earth adornment for it that We may test them [as to] which of them is best in deed.
verses.translation: We have indeed made whatever is on earth as an adornment for it, in order to test which of them is best in deeds

verses.text: And indeed, We will make that which is upon it [into] a barren ground.
verses.translation: And We will certainly reduce whatever is on it to barren ground

verses.text: Or have you thought that the companions of the cave and the inscription were, among Our signs, a wonder?
verses.translation: Have you ˹O Prophet˺ thought that the people of the cave and the plaque were ˹the only˺ wonders of Our signs

verses.text: [Mention] when the youths retreated to the cave and said, "Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance."
verses.translation: ˹Remember˺ when those youths took refuge in the cave, and said, “Our Lord! Grant us mercy from Yourself and guide us rightly through our ordeal.”

verses.text: So We cast [a cover of sleep] over their ears within the cave for a number of years.
verses.translation: So We caused them to fall into a dead sleep in the cave for many years

verses.text: Then We awakened them that We might show which of the two factions was most precise in calculating what [extent] they had remained in time.
verses.translation: then We raised them so We may show which of the two groups would make a better estimation of the length of their stay

verses.text: It is We who relate to you, [O Muhammad], their story in truth. Indeed, they were youths who believed in their Lord, and We increased them in guidance.
verses.translation: We relate to you ˹O Prophet˺ their story in truth. They were youths who truly believed in their Lord, and We increased them in guidance

verses.text: And We made firm their hearts when they stood up and said, "Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. Never will we invoke besides Him any deity. We would have certainly spoken, then, an excessive transgression.
verses.translation: And We strengthened their hearts when they stood up and declared, “Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. We will never call upon any god besides Him, or we would truly be uttering an outrageous lie.”

verses.text: These, our people, have taken besides Him deities. Why do they not bring for [worship of] them a clear authority? And who is more unjust than one who invents about Allah a lie?"
verses.translation: ˹Then they said to one another,˺ “These people of ours have taken gods besides Him. Why do they not produce a clear proof of them? Who then does more wrong than those who fabricate lies against Allah

verses.text: [The youths said to one another], "And when you have withdrawn from them and that which they worship other than Allah , retreat to the cave. Your Lord will spread out for you of His mercy and will prepare for you from your affair facility."
verses.translation: Since you have distanced yourselves from them and what they worship besides Allah, take refuge in the cave. Your Lord will extend His mercy to you and accommodate you in your ordeal.”

verses.text: And [had you been present], you would see the sun when it rose, inclining away from their cave on the right, and when it set, passing away from them on the left, while they were [laying] within an open space thereof. That was from the signs of Allah . He whom Allah guides is the [rightly] guided, but he whom He leaves astray - never will you find for him a protecting guide.
verses.translation: And you would have seen the sun, as it rose, inclining away from their cave to the right, and as it set, declining away from them to the left, while they lay in its open space. That is one of the signs of Allah. Whoever Allah guides is truly guided. But whoever He leaves to stray, you will never find for them a guiding mentor

verses.text: And you would think them awake, while they were asleep. And We turned them to the right and to the left, while their dog stretched his forelegs at the entrance. If you had looked at them, you would have turned from them in flight and been filled by them with terror.
verses.translation: And you would have thought they were awake, though they were asleep. We turned them over, to the right and left, while their dog stretched his forelegs at the entrance. Had you looked at them, you would have certainly fled away from them, filled with horror

verses.text: And similarly, We awakened them that they might question one another. Said a speaker from among them, "How long have you remained [here]?" They said, "We have remained a day or part of a day." They said, "Your Lord is most knowing of how long you remained. So send one of you with this silver coin of yours to the city and let him look to which is the best of food and bring you provision from it and let him be cautious. And let no one be aware of you.
verses.translation: And so We awakened them so that they might question one another. One of them exclaimed, “How long have you remained ˹asleep˺?” Some replied, “Perhaps a day, or part of a day.” They said ˹to one another˺, “Your Lord knows best how long you have remained. So send one of you with these silver coins of yours to the city, and let him find which food is the purest, and then bring you provisions from it. Let him be ˹exceptionally˺ cautious, and do not let him give you away

verses.text: Indeed, if they come to know of you, they will stone you or return you to their religion. And never would you succeed, then - ever."
verses.translation: For, indeed, if they find out about you, they will stone you ˹to death˺, or force you back into their faith, and then you will never succeed.”

verses.text: And similarly, We caused them to be found that they [who found them] would know that the promise of Allah is truth and that of the Hour there is no doubt. [That was] when they disputed among themselves about their affair and [then] said, "Construct over them a structure. Their Lord is most knowing about them." Said those who prevailed in the matter, "We will surely take [for ourselves] over them a masjid."
verses.translation: That is how We caused them to be discovered so that their people might know that Allah’s promise ˹of resurrection˺ is true and that there is no doubt about the Hour. When the people disputed with each other about the case of the youth ˹after their death˺, some proposed, “Build a structure around them. Their Lord knows best about them.” Those who prevailed in the matter said, “We will surely build a place of worship over them.”

verses.text: They will say there were three, the fourth of them being their dog; and they will say there were five, the sixth of them being their dog - guessing at the unseen; and they will say there were seven, and the eighth of them was their dog. Say, [O Muhammad], "My Lord is most knowing of their number. None knows them except a few. So do not argue about them except with an obvious argument and do not inquire about them among [the speculators] from anyone."
verses.translation: Some will say, “They were three, their dog was the fourth,” while others will say, “They were five, their dog was the sixth,” ˹only˺ guessing blindly. And others will say, “They were seven and their dog was the eighth.” Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “My Lord knows best their ˹exact˺ number. Only a few people know as well.” So do not argue about them except with sure knowledge, nor consult any of those ˹who debate˺ about them

verses.text: And never say of anything, "Indeed, I will do that tomorrow,"
verses.translation: And never say of anything, “I will definitely do this tomorrow,”

verses.text: Except [when adding], "If Allah wills." And remember your Lord when you forget [it] and say, "Perhaps my Lord will guide me to what is nearer than this to right conduct."
verses.translation: without adding, “if Allah so wills!” But if you forget, then remember your Lord, and say, “I trust my Lord will guide me to what is more right than this.”

verses.text: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine.
verses.translation: They had remained in their cave for three hundred years, adding nine

verses.text: Say, " Allah is most knowing of how long they remained. He has [knowledge of] the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. How Seeing is He and how Hearing! They have not besides Him any protector, and He shares not His legislation with anyone."
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Allah knows best how long they stayed. With Him ˹alone˺ is ˹the knowledge of˺ the unseen of the heavens and the earth. How perfectly He hears and sees! They have no guardian besides Him, and He shares His command with none.”

verses.text: And recite, [O Muhammad], what has been revealed to you of the Book of your Lord. There is no changer of His words, and never will you find in other than Him a refuge.
verses.translation: Recite what has been revealed to you from the Book of your Lord. None can change His Words, nor can you find any refuge besides Him

verses.text: And keep yourself patient [by being] with those who call upon their Lord in the morning and the evening, seeking His countenance. And let not your eyes pass beyond them, desiring adornments of the worldly life, and do not obey one whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance and who follows his desire and whose affair is ever [in] neglect.
verses.translation: And patiently stick with those who call upon their Lord morning and evening, seeking His pleasure. Do not let your eyes look beyond them, desiring the luxuries of this worldly life. And do not obey those whose hearts We have made heedless of Our remembrance, who follow ˹only˺ their desires and whose state is ˹total˺ loss

verses.text: And say, "The truth is from your Lord, so whoever wills - let him believe; and whoever wills - let him disbelieve." Indeed, We have prepared for the wrongdoers a fire whose walls will surround them. And if they call for relief, they will be relieved with water like murky oil, which scalds [their] faces. Wretched is the drink, and evil is the resting place.
verses.translation: And say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “˹This is˺ the truth from your Lord. Whoever wills let them believe, and whoever wills let them disbelieve.” Surely We have prepared for the wrongdoers a Fire whose walls will ˹completely˺ surround them. When they cry for aid, they will be aided with water like molten metal, which will burn ˹their˺ faces. What a horrible drink! And what a terrible place to rest

verses.text: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - indeed, We will not allow to be lost the reward of any who did well in deeds.
verses.translation: As for those who believe and do good, We certainly never deny the reward of those who are best in deeds

verses.text: Those will have gardens of perpetual residence; beneath them rivers will flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and will wear green garments of fine silk and brocade, reclining therein on adorned couches. Excellent is the reward, and good is the resting place.
verses.translation: It is they who will have the Gardens of Eternity, with rivers flowing under their feet. There they will be adorned with bracelets of gold, and wear green garments of fine silk and rich brocade, reclining there on ˹canopied˺ couches. What a marvellous reward! And what a fabulous place to rest

verses.text: And present to them an example of two men: We granted to one of them two gardens of grapevines, and We bordered them with palm trees and placed between them [fields of] crops.
verses.translation: Give them ˹O Prophet˺ an example of two men. To ˹the disbelieving˺ one We gave two gardens of grapevines, which We surrounded with palm trees and placed ˹various˺ crops in between

verses.text: Each of the two gardens produced its fruit and did not fall short thereof in anything. And We caused to gush forth within them a river.
verses.translation: Each garden yielded ˹all˺ its produce, never falling short. And We caused a river to flow between them

verses.text: And he had fruit, so he said to his companion while he was conversing with him, "I am greater than you in wealth and mightier in [numbers of] men."
verses.translation: And he had other resources ˹as well˺. So he boasted to a ˹poor˺ companion of his, while conversing with him, “I am greater than you in wealth and superior in manpower.”

verses.text: And he entered his garden while he was unjust to himself. He said, "I do not think that this will perish - ever.
verses.translation: And he entered his property, while wronging his soul, saying, “I do not think this will ever perish

verses.text: And I do not think the Hour will occur. And even if I should be brought back to my Lord, I will surely find better than this as a return."
verses.translation: nor do I think the Hour will ˹ever˺ come. And if in fact I am returned to my Lord, I will definitely get a far better outcome than ˹all˺ this.”

verses.text: His companion said to him while he was conversing with him, "Have you disbelieved in He who created you from dust and then from a sperm-drop and then proportioned you [as] a man?
verses.translation: His ˹believing˺ companion replied, while conversing with him, “Do you disbelieve in the One Who created you from dust, then ˹developed you˺ from a sperm-drop, then formed you into a man

verses.text: But as for me, He is Allah , my Lord, and I do not associate with my Lord anyone.
verses.translation: But as for me: He is Allah, my Lord, and I will never associate anyone with my Lord ˹in worship˺

verses.text: And why did you, when you entered your garden, not say, 'What Allah willed [has occurred]; there is no power except in Allah '? Although you see me less than you in wealth and children,
verses.translation: If only you had said, upon entering your property, ‘This is what Allah has willed! There is no power except with Allah!’ Even though you see me inferior to you in wealth and offspring

verses.text: It may be that my Lord will give me [something] better than your garden and will send upon it a calamity from the sky, and it will become a smooth, dusty ground,
verses.translation: perhaps my Lord will grant me ˹something˺ better than your garden, and send down upon your garden a thunderbolt from the sky, turning it into a barren waste

verses.text: Or its water will become sunken [into the earth], so you would never be able to seek it."
verses.translation: Or its water may sink ˹into the earth˺, and then you will never be able to seek it out.”

verses.text: And his fruits were encompassed [by ruin], so he began to turn his hands about [in dismay] over what he had spent on it, while it had collapsed upon its trellises, and said, "Oh, I wish I had not associated with my Lord anyone."
verses.translation: And so all his produce was ˹totally˺ ruined, so he started to wring his hands for all he had spent on it, while it had collapsed on its trellises. He cried, “Alas! I wish I had never associated anyone with my Lord ˹in worship˺!”

verses.text: And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allah , nor could he defend himself.
verses.translation: And he had no manpower to help him against Allah, nor could he ˹even˺ help himself

verses.text: There the authority is [completely] for Allah , the Truth. He is best in reward and best in outcome.
verses.translation: At this time, support comes ˹only˺ from Allah—the True ˹Lord˺. He is best in reward and best in outcome

verses.text: And present to them the example of the life of this world, [its being] like rain which We send down from the sky, and the vegetation of the earth mingles with it and [then] it becomes dry remnants, scattered by the winds. And Allah is ever, over all things, Perfect in Ability.
verses.translation: And give them a parable of this worldly life. ˹It is˺ like the plants of the earth, thriving when sustained by the rain We send down from the sky. Then they ˹soon˺ turn into chaff scattered by the wind. And Allah is fully capable of ˹doing˺ all things

verses.text: Wealth and children are [but] adornment of the worldly life. But the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for [one's] hope.
verses.translation: Wealth and children are the adornment of this worldly life, but the everlasting good deeds are far better with your Lord in reward and in hope

verses.text: And [warn of] the Day when We will remove the mountains and you will see the earth prominent, and We will gather them and not leave behind from them anyone.
verses.translation: ˹Beware of˺ the Day We will blow the mountains away, and you will see the earth laid bare. And We will gather all ˹humankind˺, leaving none behind

verses.text: And they will be presented before your Lord in rows, [and He will say], "You have certainly come to Us just as We created you the first time. But you claimed that We would never make for you an appointment."
verses.translation: They will be presented before your Lord in rows, ˹and the deniers will be told,˺ “You have surely returned to Us ˹all alone˺ as We created you the first time, although you ˹always˺ claimed that We would never appoint a time for your return.”

verses.text: And the record [of deeds] will be placed [open], and you will see the criminals fearful of that within it, and they will say, "Oh, woe to us! What is this book that leaves nothing small or great except that it has enumerated it?" And they will find what they did present [before them]. And your Lord does injustice to no one.
verses.translation: And the record ˹of deeds˺ will be laid ˹open˺, and you will see the wicked in fear of what is ˹written˺ in it. They will cry, “Woe to us! What kind of record is this that does not leave any sin, small or large, unlisted?” They will find whatever they did present ˹before them˺. And your Lord will never wrong anyone

verses.text: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except for Iblees. He was of the jinn and departed from the command of his Lord. Then will you take him and his descendants as allies other than Me while they are enemies to you? Wretched it is for the wrongdoers as an exchange.
verses.translation: And ˹remember˺ when We said to the angels, “Prostrate before Adam,” so they all did—but not Iblîs, who was one of the jinn, but he rebelled against the command of his Lord. Would you then take him and his descendants as patrons instead of Me, although they are your enemy? What an evil alternative for the wrongdoers ˹to choose˺

verses.text: I did not make them witness to the creation of the heavens and the earth or to the creation of themselves, and I would not have taken the misguiders as assistants.
verses.translation: I never called them to witness the creation of the heavens and the earth or ˹even˺ their own creation, nor would I take the misleaders as helpers

verses.text: And [warn of] the Day when He will say, "Call 'My partners' whom you claimed," and they will invoke them, but they will not respond to them. And We will put between them [a valley of] destruction.
verses.translation: And ˹beware of˺ the Day He will say, “Call upon those you claimed were My associate-gods.” So they will call them, but will receive no response. And We will make them ˹all˺ share in the same doom

verses.text: And the criminals will see the Fire and will be certain that they are to fall therein. And they will not find from it a way elsewhere.
verses.translation: The wicked will see the Fire and realize that they are bound to fall into it, and will find no way to avoid it

verses.text: And We have certainly diversified in this Qur'an for the people from every [kind of] example; but man has ever been, most of anything, [prone to] dispute.
verses.translation: We have surely set forth in this Quran every ˹kind of˺ lesson for people, but humankind is the most argumentative of all beings

verses.text: And nothing has prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them and from asking forgiveness of their Lord except that there [must] befall them the [accustomed] precedent of the former peoples or that the punishment should come [directly] before them.
verses.translation: And nothing prevents people from believing when guidance comes to them and from seeking their Lord’s forgiveness except ˹their demand˺ to meet the same fate of earlier deniers or that the torment would confront them face to face

verses.text: And We send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. And those who disbelieve dispute by [using] falsehood to [attempt to] invalidate thereby the truth and have taken My verses, and that of which they are warned, in ridicule.
verses.translation: We do not send the messengers except as deliverers of good news and warners. But the disbelievers argue in falsehood, ˹hoping˺ to discredit the truth with it, and make a mockery of My revelations and warnings

verses.text: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord but turns away from them and forgets what his hands have put forth? Indeed, We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And if you invite them to guidance - they will never be guided, then - ever.
verses.translation: And who does more wrong than those who, when reminded of their Lord’s revelations, turn away from them and forget what their own hands have done? We have certainly cast veils over their hearts—leaving them unable to comprehend this ˹Quran˺—and deafness in their ears. And if you ˹O Prophet˺ invite them to ˹true˺ guidance, they will never be ˹rightly˺ guided

verses.text: And your Lord is the Forgiving, full of mercy. If He were to impose blame upon them for what they earned, He would have hastened for them the punishment. Rather, for them is an appointment from which they will never find an escape.
verses.translation: Your Lord is the All-Forgiving, Full of Mercy. If He were to seize them ˹immediately˺ for what they commit, He would have certainly hastened their punishment. But they have an appointed time, from which they will find no refuge

verses.text: And those cities - We destroyed them when they wronged, and We made for their destruction an appointed time.
verses.translation: Those ˹are the˺ societies We destroyed when they persisted in wrong, and We had set a time for their destruction

verses.text: And [mention] when Moses said to his servant, "I will not cease [traveling] until I reach the junction of the two seas or continue for a long period."
verses.translation: And ˹remember˺ when Moses said to his young assistant, “I will never give up until I reach the junction of the two seas, even if I travel for ages.”

verses.text: But when they reached the junction between them, they forgot their fish, and it took its course into the sea, slipping away.
verses.translation: But when they ˹finally˺ reached the point where the seas met, they forgot their ˹salted˺ fish, and it made its way into the sea, slipping away ˹wondrously˺

verses.text: So when they had passed beyond it, [Moses] said to his boy, "Bring us our morning meal. We have certainly suffered in this, our journey, [much] fatigue."
verses.translation: When they had passed further, he said to his assistant, “Bring us our meal! We have certainly been exhausted by today’s journey.”

verses.text: He said, "Did you see when we retired to the rock? Indeed, I forgot [there] the fish. And none made me forget it except Satan - that I should mention it. And it took its course into the sea amazingly".
verses.translation: He replied, “Do you remember when we rested by the rock? ˹That is when˺ I forgot the fish. None made me forget to mention this except Satan. And the fish made its way into the sea miraculously.”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "That is what we were seeking." So they returned, following their footprints.
verses.translation: Moses responded, “That is ˹exactly˺ what we were looking for.” So they returned, retracing their footsteps

verses.text: And they found a servant from among Our servants to whom we had given mercy from us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge.
verses.translation: There they found a servant of Ours, to whom We had granted mercy from Us and enlightened with knowledge of Our Own

verses.text: Moses said to him, "May I follow you on [the condition] that you teach me from what you have been taught of sound judgement?"
verses.translation: Moses said to him, “May I follow you, provided that you teach me some of the right guidance you have been taught?”

verses.text: He said, "Indeed, with me you will never be able to have patience.
verses.translation: He said, “You certainly cannot be patient ˹enough˺ with me

verses.text: And how can you have patience for what you do not encompass in knowledge?"
verses.translation: And how can you be patient with what is beyond your ˹realm of˺ knowledge?”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "You will find me, if Allah wills, patient, and I will not disobey you in [any] order."
verses.translation: Moses assured ˹him˺, “You will find me patient, Allah willing, and I will not disobey any of your orders.”

verses.text: He said, "Then if you follow me, do not ask me about anything until I make to you about it mention."
verses.translation: He responded, “Then if you follow me, do not question me about anything until I ˹myself˺ clarify it for you.”

verses.text: So they set out, until when they had embarked on the ship, al-Khidh r tore it open. [Moses] said, "Have you torn it open to drown its people? You have certainly done a grave thing."
verses.translation: So they set out, but after they had boarded a ship, the man made a hole in it. Moses protested, “Have you done this to drown its people? You have certainly done a terrible thing!”

verses.text: [Al-Khidh r] said, "Did I not say that with me you would never be able to have patience?"
verses.translation: He replied, “Did I not say that you cannot have patience with me?”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "Do not blame me for what I forgot and do not cover me in my matter with difficulty."
verses.translation: Moses pleaded, “Excuse me for forgetting, and do not be hard on me.”

verses.text: So they set out, until when they met a boy, al-Khidh r killed him. [Moses] said, "Have you killed a pure soul for other than [having killed] a soul? You have certainly done a deplorable thing."
verses.translation: So they proceeded until they came across a boy, and the man killed him. Moses protested, “Have you killed an innocent soul, who killed no one? You have certainly done a horrible thing.”

verses.text: [Al-Khidh r] said, "Did I not tell you that with me you would never be able to have patience?"
verses.translation: He answered, “Did I not tell you that you cannot have patience with me?”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "If I should ask you about anything after this, then do not keep me as a companion. You have obtained from me an excuse."
verses.translation: Moses replied, “If I ever question you about anything after this, then do not keep me in your company, for by then I would have given you enough of an excuse.”

verses.text: So they set out, until when they came to the people of a town, they asked its people for food, but they refused to offer them hospitality. And they found therein a wall about to collapse, so al-Khidh r restored it. [Moses] said, "If you wished, you could have taken for it a payment."
verses.translation: So they moved on until they came to the people of a town. They asked them for food, but the people refused to give them hospitality. There they found a wall ready to collapse, so the man set it right. Moses protested, “If you wanted, you could have demanded a fee for this.”

verses.text: [Al-Khidh r] said, "This is parting between me and you. I will inform you of the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience.
verses.translation: He replied, “This is the parting of our ways. I will explain to you what you could not bear patiently

verses.text: As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working at sea. So I intended to cause defect in it as there was after them a king who seized every [good] ship by force.
verses.translation: “As for the ship, it belonged to some poor people, working at sea. So I intended to damage it, for there was a ˹tyrant˺ king ahead of them who seizes every ˹good˺ ship by force

verses.text: And as for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared that he would overburden them by transgression and disbelief.
verses.translation: “And as for the boy, his parents were ˹true˺ believers, and we feared that he would pressure them into defiance and disbelief

verses.text: So we intended that their Lord should substitute for them one better than him in purity and nearer to mercy.
verses.translation: So we hoped that their Lord would give them another, more virtuous and caring in his place

verses.text: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure for them, and their father had been righteous. So your Lord intended that they reach maturity and extract their treasure, as a mercy from your Lord. And I did it not of my own accord. That is the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience."
verses.translation: “And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and under the wall was a treasure that belonged to them, and their father had been a righteous man. So your Lord willed that these children should come of age and retrieve their treasure, as a mercy from your Lord. I did not do it ˹all˺ on my own. This is the explanation of what you could not bear patiently.”

verses.text: And they ask you, [O Muhammad], about Dhul-Qarnayn. Say, "I will recite to you about him a report."
verses.translation: They ask you ˹O Prophet˺ about Ⱬul-Qarnain. Say, “I will relate to you something of his narrative.”

verses.text: Indeed We established him upon the earth, and We gave him to everything a way.
verses.translation: Surely We established him in the land, and gave him the means to all things

verses.text: So he followed a way
verses.translation: So he travelled a course

verses.text: Until, when he reached the setting of the sun, he found it [as if] setting in a spring of dark mud, and he found near it a people. Allah said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, either you punish [them] or else adopt among them [a way of] goodness."
verses.translation: until he reached the setting ˹point˺ of the sun, which appeared to him to be setting in a spring of murky water, where he found some people. We said, “O Ⱬul-Qarnain! Either punish them or treat them kindly.”

verses.text: He said, "As for one who wrongs, we will punish him. Then he will be returned to his Lord, and He will punish him with a terrible punishment.
verses.translation: He responded, “Whoever does wrong will be punished by us, then will be returned to their Lord, Who will punish them with a horrible torment

verses.text: But as for one who believes and does righteousness, he will have a reward of Paradise, and we will speak to him from our command with ease."
verses.translation: As for those who believe and do good, they will have the finest reward, and we will assign them easy commands.”

verses.text: Then he followed a way
verses.translation: Then he travelled a ˹different˺ course

verses.text: Until, when he came to the rising of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had not made against it any shield.
verses.translation: until he reached the rising ˹point˺ of the sun. He found it rising on a people for whom We had provided no shelter from it

verses.text: Thus. And We had encompassed [all] that he had in knowledge.
verses.translation: So it was. And We truly had full knowledge of him

verses.text: Then he followed a way
verses.translation: Then he travelled a ˹third˺ course

verses.text: Until, when he reached [a pass] between two mountains, he found beside them a people who could hardly understand [his] speech.
verses.translation: until he reached ˹a pass˺ between two mountains. He found in front of them a people who could hardly understand ˹his˺ language

verses.text: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?"
verses.translation: They pleaded, “O Ⱬul-Qarnain! Surely Gog and Magog are spreading corruption throughout the land. Should we pay you tribute, provided that you build a wall between us and them?”

verses.text: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength; I will make between you and them a dam.
verses.translation: He responded, “What my Lord has provided for me is far better. But assist me with resources, and I will build a barrier between you and them

verses.text: Bring me sheets of iron" - until, when he had leveled [them] between the two mountain walls, he said, "Blow [with bellows]," until when he had made it [like] fire, he said, "Bring me, that I may pour over it molten copper."
verses.translation: Bring me blocks of iron!” Then, when he had filled up ˹the gap˺ between the two mountains, he ordered, “Blow!” When the iron became red hot, he said, “Bring me molten copper to pour over it.”

verses.text: So Gog and Magog were unable to pass over it, nor were they able [to effect] in it any penetration.
verses.translation: And so the enemies could neither scale nor tunnel through it

verses.text: [Dhul-Qarnayn] said, "This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord comes, He will make it level, and ever is the promise of my Lord true."
verses.translation: He declared, “This is a mercy from my Lord. But when the promise of my Lord comes to pass, He will level it to the ground. And my Lord’s promise is ever true.”

verses.text: And We will leave them that day surging over each other, and [then] the Horn will be blown, and We will assemble them in [one] assembly.
verses.translation: On that Day, We will let them surge ˹like waves˺ over one another. Later, the Trumpet will be blown, and We will gather all ˹people˺ together

verses.text: And We will present Hell that Day to the Disbelievers, on display -
verses.translation: On that Day We will display Hell clearly for the disbelievers

verses.text: Those whose eyes had been within a cover [removed] from My remembrance, and they were not able to hear.
verses.translation: those who turned a blind eye to My Reminder and could not stand listening ˹to it˺

verses.text: Then do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants instead of Me as allies? Indeed, We have prepared Hell for the disbelievers as a lodging.
verses.translation: Do the disbelievers think they can ˹simply˺ take My servants as lords instead of Me? We have surely prepared Hell as an accommodation for the disbelievers

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "Shall we [believers] inform you of the greatest losers as to [their] deeds?
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Shall we inform you of who will lose the most deeds

verses.text: [They are] those whose effort is lost in worldly life, while they think that they are doing well in work."
verses.translation: ˹They are˺ those whose efforts are in vain in this worldly life, while they think they are doing good!”

verses.text: Those are the ones who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord and in [their] meeting Him, so their deeds have become worthless; and We will not assign to them on the Day of Resurrection any importance.
verses.translation: It is they who reject the signs of their Lord and their meeting with Him, rendering their deeds void, so We will not give their deeds any weight on Judgment Day

verses.text: That is their recompense - Hell - for what they denied and [because] they took My signs and My messengers in ridicule.
verses.translation: That is their reward: Hell, for their disbelief and mockery of My signs and messengers

verses.text: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - they will have the Gardens of Paradise as a lodging,
verses.translation: Indeed, those who believe and do good will have the Gardens of Paradise as an accommodation

verses.text: Wherein they abide eternally. They will not desire from it any transfer.
verses.translation: where they will be forever, never desiring anywhere else

verses.text: Say, "If the sea were ink for [writing] the words of my Lord, the sea would be exhausted before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even if We brought the like of it as a supplement."
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “If the ocean were ink for ˹writing˺ the Words of my Lord, it would certainly run out before the Words of my Lord were finished, even if We refilled it with its equal.”

verses.text: Say, "I am only a man like you, to whom has been revealed that your god is one God. So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone."
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I am only a man like you, ˹but˺ it has been revealed to me that your God is only One God. So whoever hopes for the meeting with their Lord, let them do good deeds and associate none in the worship of their Lord.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Kaf, Ha, Ya, 'Ayn, Sad.
verses.translation: Kãf-Ha-Ya-’Aĩn- Ṣãd

verses.text: [This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah
verses.translation: ˹This is˺ a reminder of your Lord’s mercy to His servant Zachariah

verses.text: When he called to his Lord a private supplication.
verses.translation: when he cried out to his Lord privately

verses.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy.
verses.translation: saying, “My Lord! Surely my bones have become brittle, and grey hair has spread across my head, but I have never been disappointed in my prayer to You, my Lord

verses.text: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir
verses.translation: And I am concerned about ˹the faith of˺ my relatives after me, since my wife is barren. So grant me, by Your grace, an heir

verses.text: Who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]."
verses.translation: who will inherit ˹prophethood˺ from me and the family of Jacob, and make him, O Lord, pleasing ˹to You˺!”

verses.text: [He was told], "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name."
verses.translation: ˹The angels announced,˺ “O Zachariah! Indeed, We give you the good news of ˹the birth of˺ a son, whose name will be John—a name We have not given to anyone before.”

verses.text: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?"
verses.translation: He wondered, “My Lord! How can I have a son when my wife is barren, and I have become extremely old?”

verses.text: [An angel] said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing.' "
verses.translation: An angel replied, “So will it be! Your Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me, just as I created you before, when you were nothing!’”

verses.text: [Zechariah] said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound."
verses.translation: Zachariah said, “My Lord! Grant me a sign.” He responded, “Your sign is that you will not ˹be able to˺ speak to people for three nights, despite being healthy.”

verses.text: So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [ Allah ] in the morning and afternoon.
verses.translation: So he came out to his people from the sanctuary, signalling to them to glorify ˹Allah˺ morning and evening

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "O John, take the Scripture with determination." And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy
verses.translation: ˹It was later said,˺ “O John! Hold firmly to the Scriptures.” And We granted him wisdom while ˹he was still˺ a child

verses.text: And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allah
verses.translation: as well as purity and compassion from Us. And he was God-fearing

verses.text: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.
verses.translation: and kind to his parents. He was neither arrogant nor disobedient

verses.text: And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive.
verses.translation: Peace be upon him the day he was born, and the day of his death, and the day he will be raised back to life

verses.text: And mention, [O Muhammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.
verses.translation: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Mary when she withdrew from her family to a place in the east

verses.text: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel, and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.
verses.translation: screening herself off from them. Then We sent to her Our angel, ˹Gabriel,˺ appearing before her as a man, perfectly formed

verses.text: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allah ."
verses.translation: She appealed, “I truly seek refuge in the Most Compassionate from you! ˹So leave me alone˺ if you are God-fearing.”

verses.text: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy."
verses.translation: He responded, “I am only a messenger from your Lord, ˹sent˺ to bless you with a pure son.”

verses.text: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?"
verses.translation: She wondered, “How can I have a son when no man has ever touched me, nor am I unchaste?”

verses.text: He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed.' "
verses.translation: He replied, “So will it be! Your Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me. And so will We make him a sign for humanity and a mercy from Us.’ It is a matter ˹already˺ decreed.”

verses.text: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.
verses.translation: So she conceived him and withdrew with him to a remote place

verses.text: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."
verses.translation: Then the pains of labour drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She cried, “Alas! I wish I had died before this, and was a thing long forgotten!”

verses.text: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.
verses.translation: So a voice reassured her from below her, “Do not grieve! Your Lord has provided a stream at your feet

verses.text: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.
verses.translation: And shake the trunk of this palm tree towards you, it will drop fresh, ripe dates upon you

verses.text: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.' "
verses.translation: So eat and drink, and put your heart at ease. But if you see any of the people, say, ‘I have vowed silence to the Most Compassionate, so I am not talking to anyone today.’”

verses.text: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.
verses.translation: Then she returned to her people, carrying him. They said ˹in shock˺, “O Mary! You have certainly done a horrible thing

verses.text: O sister of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."
verses.translation: O sister of Aaron! Your father was not an indecent man, nor was your mother unchaste.”

verses.text: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"
verses.translation: So she pointed to the baby. They exclaimed, “How can we talk to someone who is an infant in the cradle?”

verses.text: [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allah . He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.
verses.translation: ˹Jesus˺ declared, “I am truly a servant of Allah. He has destined me to be given the Scripture and to be a prophet

verses.text: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I remain alive
verses.translation: He has made me a blessing wherever I go, and bid me to establish prayer and give alms-tax as long as I live

verses.text: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.
verses.translation: and to be kind to my mother. He has not made me arrogant or defiant

verses.text: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive."
verses.translation: Peace be upon me the day I was born, the day I die, and the day I will be raised back to life!”

verses.text: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.
verses.translation: That is Jesus, son of Mary. ˹And this is˺ a word of truth, about which they dispute

verses.text: It is not [befitting] for Allah to take a son; exalted is He! When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.
verses.translation: It is not for Allah to take a son! Glory be to Him. When He decrees a matter, He simply tells it, “Be!” And it is

verses.text: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path."
verses.translation: ˹Jesus also declared,˺ “Surely Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him ˹alone˺. This is the Straight Path.”

verses.text: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.
verses.translation: Yet their ˹various˺ groups have differed among themselves ˹about him˺, so woe to the disbelievers when they face a tremendous Day

verses.text: How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error.
verses.translation: How clearly will they hear and see on the Day they will come to Us! But today the wrongdoers are clearly astray

verses.text: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded; and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe.
verses.translation: And warn them ˹O Prophet˺ of the Day of Regret, when all matters will be settled, while they are ˹engrossed˺ in heedlessness and disbelief

verses.text: Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned.
verses.translation: Indeed, it is We Who will succeed the earth and whoever is on it. And to Us they will ˹all˺ be returned

verses.text: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
verses.translation: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Abraham. He was surely a man of truth and a prophet

verses.text: [Mention] when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all?
verses.translation: ˹Remember˺ when he said to his father, “O dear father! Why do you worship what can neither hear nor see, nor benefit you at all

verses.text: O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path.
verses.translation: O dear father! I have certainly received some knowledge which you have not received, so follow me and I will guide you to the Straight Path

verses.text: O my father, do not worship Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient.
verses.translation: O dear father! Do not worship Satan. Surely Satan is ever rebellious against the Most Compassionate

verses.text: O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire]."
verses.translation: O dear father! I truly fear that you will be touched by a torment from the Most Compassionate, and become Satan’s companion ˹in Hell˺.”

verses.text: [His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time."
verses.translation: He threatened, “How dare you reject my idols, O Abraham! If you do not desist, I will certainly stone you ˹to death˺. So be gone from me for a long time!”

verses.text: [Abraham] said, "Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me.
verses.translation: Abraham responded, “Peace be upon you! I will pray to my Lord for your forgiveness. He has truly been Most Gracious to me

verses.text: And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allah and will invoke my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy."
verses.translation: As I distance myself from ˹all of˺ you and from whatever you invoke besides Allah, I will ˹continue to˺ call upon my Lord ˹alone˺, trusting that I will never be disappointed in invoking my Lord.”

verses.text: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allah , We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet.
verses.translation: So after he had left them and what they worshipped besides Allah, We granted him Isaac and Jacob, and made each of them a prophet

verses.text: And We gave them of Our mercy, and we made for them a reputation of high honor.
verses.translation: We showered them with Our mercy, and blessed them with honourable mention

verses.text: And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
verses.translation: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Moses. He was truly a chosen man, and was a messenger and a prophet

verses.text: And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].
verses.translation: We called him from the right side of Mount Ṭûr, and drew him near, speaking ˹with him˺ directly

verses.text: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet.
verses.translation: And We appointed for him—out of Our grace—his brother, Aaron, as a prophet

verses.text: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
verses.translation: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Ishmael. He was truly a man of his word, and was a messenger and a prophet

verses.text: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakah and was to his Lord pleasing.
verses.translation: He used to urge his people to pray and give alms-tax. And his Lord was well pleased with him

verses.text: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
verses.translation: And mention in the Book ˹O Prophet, the story of˺ Enoch. He was surely a man of truth and a prophet

verses.text: And We raised him to a high station.
verses.translation: And We elevated him to an honourable status

verses.text: Those were the ones upon whom Allah bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.
verses.translation: Those were ˹some of˺ the prophets who Allah has blessed from among the descendants of Adam, and of those We carried with Noah ˹in the Ark˺, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and of those We ˹rightly˺ guided and chose. Whenever the revelations of the Most Compassionate were recited to them, they fell down, prostrating and weeping

verses.text: But there came after them successors who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil -
verses.translation: But they were succeeded by generations who neglected prayer and followed their lusts and so will soon face the evil consequences

verses.text: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all.
verses.translation: As for those who repent, believe, and do good, it is they who will be admitted into Paradise, never being denied any reward

verses.text: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been coming.
verses.translation: ˹They will be in˺ the Gardens of Eternity, promised in trust by the Most Compassionate to His servants. Surely His promise will be fulfilled

verses.text: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.
verses.translation: There they will never hear any idle talk—only ˹greetings of˺ peace. And there they will have their provisions morning and evening

verses.text: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allah .
verses.translation: That is Paradise, which We will grant to whoever is devout among Our servants

verses.text: [Gabriel said], "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful -
verses.translation: “We only descend by the command of your Lord. To Him belongs whatever is before us, and whatever is behind us, and everything in between. And your Lord is never forgetful

verses.text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?"
verses.translation: ˹He is the˺ Lord of the heavens, and the earth, and everything in between. So worship Him ˹alone˺, and be steadfast in His worship. Do you know of anyone equal to Him ˹in His attributes˺?”

verses.text: And the disbeliever says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?"
verses.translation: Yet ˹some˺ people ask ˹mockingly˺, “After I die, will I really be raised to life again?”

verses.text: Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?
verses.translation: Do ˹such˺ people not remember that We created them before, when they were nothing

verses.text: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.
verses.translation: By your Lord ˹O Prophet˺! We will surely gather them along with the devils, and then set them around Hell on their knees

verses.text: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence.
verses.translation: Then We will certainly begin by dragging out of every group the ones most defiant to the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.
verses.translation: And We truly know best who is most deserving of burning in it

verses.text: And there is none of you except he will come to it. This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed.
verses.translation: There is none of you who will not pass over it. ˹This is˺ a decree your Lord must fulfil

verses.text: Then We will save those who feared Allah and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees.
verses.translation: Then We will deliver those who were devout, leaving the wrongdoers there on their knees

verses.text: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?"
verses.translation: When Our clear revelations are recited to them, the disbelievers ask the believers ˹mockingly˺, “Which of the two of us is better in status and superior in assembly?”

verses.text: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?
verses.translation: ˹Imagine, O Prophet˺ how many peoples We have destroyed before them, who were far better in luxury and splendour

verses.text: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers."
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Whoever is ˹entrenched˺ in misguidance, the Most Compassionate will allow them plenty of time, until—behold!—they face what they are threatened with: either the torment or the Hour. Only then will they realize who is worse in position and inferior in manpower.”

verses.text: And Allah increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse.
verses.translation: And Allah increases in guidance those who are ˹rightly˺ guided. And the everlasting good deeds are far better with your Lord in reward and in outcome

verses.text: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]?"
verses.translation: Have you seen ˹O Prophet˺ the one who rejects Our revelations yet boasts, “I will definitely be granted ˹plenty of˺ wealth and children ˹if there is an afterlife˺.”

verses.text: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?
verses.translation: Has he looked into the unseen or taken a pledge from the Most Compassionate

verses.text: No! We will record what he says and extend for him from the punishment extensively.
verses.translation: Not at all! We certainly record whatever he claims and will increase his punishment extensively

verses.text: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to Us alone.
verses.translation: And We will inherit what he boasts of, and he will come before Us all by himself

verses.text: And they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor.
verses.translation: They have taken other gods, instead of Allah, seeking strength ˹and protection˺ through them

verses.text: No! Those "gods" will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].
verses.translation: But no! Those ˹gods˺ will deny their worship and turn against them

verses.text: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them to [evil] with [constant] incitement?
verses.translation: Do you ˹O Prophet˺ not see that We have sent the devils against the disbelievers, constantly inciting them

verses.text: So be not impatient over them. We only count out to them a [limited] number.
verses.translation: So do not be in haste against them, for indeed We are ˹closely˺ counting down their days

verses.text: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation
verses.translation: ˹Watch for˺ the Day We will gather the righteous before the Most Compassionate as an honoured delegation

verses.text: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst
verses.translation: and drive the wicked to Hell like a thirsty herd

verses.text: None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.
verses.translation: None will have the right to intercede, except those who have taken a covenant from the Most Compassionate

verses.text: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son."
verses.translation: They say, “The Most Compassionate has offspring.”

verses.text: You have done an atrocious thing.
verses.translation: You have certainly made an outrageous claim

verses.text: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation
verses.translation: by which the heavens are about to burst, the earth to split apart, and the mountains to crumble to pieces

verses.text: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son.
verses.translation: in protest of attributing children to the Most Compassionate

verses.text: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son.
verses.translation: It does not befit ˹the majesty of˺ the Most Compassionate to have children

verses.text: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.
verses.translation: There is none in the heavens or the earth who will not return to the Most Compassionate in full submission

verses.text: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.
verses.translation: Indeed, He fully knows them and has counted them precisely

verses.text: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.
verses.translation: And each of them will return to Him on the Day of Judgment all alone

verses.text: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.
verses.translation: As for those who believe and do good, the Most Compassionate will ˹certainly˺ bless them with ˹genuine˺ love

verses.text: So, [O Muhammad], We have only made Qur'an easy in the Arabic language that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.
verses.translation: Indeed, We have made this ˹Quran˺ easy in your own language ˹O Prophet˺ so with it you may give good news to the righteous and warn those who are contentious

verses.text: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound?
verses.translation: ˹Imagine˺ how many peoples We have destroyed before them! Do you ˹still˺ see any of them, or ˹even˺ hear from them the slightest sound

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Ta, Ha.
verses.translation: Ṭâ-Hâ

verses.text: We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed
verses.translation: We have not revealed the Quran to you ˹O Prophet˺ to cause you distress

verses.text: But only as a reminder for those who fear [ Allah ] -
verses.translation: but as a reminder to those in awe ˹of Allah˺

verses.text: A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens,
verses.translation: ˹It is˺ a revelation from the One Who created the earth and the high heavens—

verses.text: The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established.
verses.translation: the Most Compassionate, ˹Who is˺ established on the Throne

verses.text: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.
verses.translation: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth and whatever is in between and whatever is underground

verses.text: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.
verses.translation: Whether you speak openly ˹or not˺, He certainly knows what is secret and what is even more hidden

verses.text: Allah - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names.
verses.translation: Allah—there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. He has the Most Beautiful Names

verses.text: And has the story of Moses reached you? -
verses.translation: Has the story of Moses reached you ˹O Prophet˺

verses.text: When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance."
verses.translation: When he saw a fire, he said to his family, “Wait here, ˹for˺ I have spotted a fire. Perhaps I can bring you a torch from it, or find some guidance at the fire.”

verses.text: And when he came to it, he was called, "O Moses,
verses.translation: But when he approached it, he was called, “O Moses

verses.text: Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa.
verses.translation: It is truly I. I am your Lord! So take off your sandals, for you are in the sacred valley of Ṭuwa

verses.text: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you].
verses.translation: I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed

verses.text: Indeed, I am Allah . There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.
verses.translation: ‘It is truly I. I am Allah! There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Me. So worship Me ˹alone˺, and establish prayer for My remembrance

verses.text: Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives.
verses.translation: The Hour is sure to come. My Will is to keep it hidden, so that every soul may be rewarded according to their efforts

verses.text: So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish.
verses.translation: So do not let those who disbelieve in it and follow their desires distract you from it, or you will be doomed.’”

verses.text: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?"
verses.translation: ˹Allah added,˺ “And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?”

verses.text: He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses."
verses.translation: He replied, “It is my staff! I lean on it, and with it I beat down ˹branches˺ for my sheep, and have other uses for it.”

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "Throw it down, O Moses."
verses.translation: Allah said, “Throw it down, O Moses!”

verses.text: So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly.
verses.translation: So he did, then—behold!—it became a serpent, slithering

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition.
verses.translation: Allah said, “Take it, and have no fear. We will return it to its former state

verses.text: And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign,
verses.translation: And put your hand under your armpit, it will come out ˹shining˺ white, unblemished, as another sign

verses.text: That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs.
verses.translation: so that We may show you some of Our greatest signs

verses.text: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed."
verses.translation: Go to Pharaoh, for he has truly transgressed ˹all bounds˺.”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance]
verses.translation: Moses prayed, “My Lord! Uplift my heart for me

verses.text: And ease for me my task
verses.translation: and make my task easy

verses.text: And untie the knot from my tongue
verses.translation: and remove the impediment from my tongue

verses.text: That they may understand my speech.
verses.translation: so people may understand my speech

verses.text: And appoint for me a minister from my family -
verses.translation: and grant me a helper from my family

verses.text: Aaron, my brother.
verses.translation: Aaron, my brother

verses.text: Increase through him my strength
verses.translation: Strengthen me through him

verses.text: And let him share my task
verses.translation: and let him share my task

verses.text: That we may exalt You much
verses.translation: so that we may glorify You much

verses.text: And remember You much.
verses.translation: and remember You much

verses.text: Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing."
verses.translation: for truly You have ˹always˺ been overseeing us.”

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses.
verses.translation: Allah responded, “All that you requested has been granted, O Moses

verses.text: And We had already conferred favor upon you another time,
verses.translation: And surely We had shown You favour before

verses.text: When We inspired to your mother what We inspired,
verses.translation: when We inspired your mother with this

verses.text: [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.' And I bestowed upon you love from Me that you would be brought up under My eye.
verses.translation: ‘Put him into a chest, then put it into the river. The river will wash it ashore, and he will be taken by ˹Pharaoh,˺ an enemy of Mine and his.’ And I blessed you with lovability from Me ˹O Moses˺ so that you would be brought up under My ˹watchful˺ Eye

verses.text: [And We favored you] when your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?' So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve. And you killed someone, but We saved you from retaliation and tried you with a [severe] trial. And you remained [some] years among the people of Madyan. Then you came [here] at the decreed time, O Moses.
verses.translation: ˹Remember˺ when your sister came along and proposed, ‘Shall I direct you to someone who will nurse him?’ So We reunited you with your mother so that her heart would be put at ease, and she would not grieve. ˹Later˺ you killed a man ˹by mistake˺, but We saved you from sorrow, as well as other tests We put you through. Then you stayed for a number of years among the people of Midian. Then you came here as pre-destined, O Moses

verses.text: And I produced you for Myself.
verses.translation: And I have selected you for My service

verses.text: Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance.
verses.translation: Go forth, you and your brother, with My signs and never falter in remembering Me

verses.text: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
verses.translation: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh, for he has truly transgressed ˹all bounds˺

verses.text: And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [ Allah ]."
verses.translation: Speak to him gently, so perhaps he may be mindful ˹of Me˺ or fearful ˹of My punishment˺.”

verses.text: They said, "Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress."
verses.translation: They both pleaded, “Our Lord! We fear that he may be quick to harm us or act tyrannically.”

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.
verses.translation: Allah reassured ˹them˺, “Have no fear! I am with you, hearing and seeing

verses.text: So go to him and say, 'Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord, so send with us the Children of Israel and do not torment them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And peace will be upon he who follows the guidance.
verses.translation: So go to him and say, ‘Indeed we are both messengers from your Lord, so let the Children of Israel go with us, and do not oppress them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And salvation will be for whoever follows the ˹right˺ guidance

verses.text: Indeed, it has been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies and turns away.' "
verses.translation: It has indeed been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies ˹the truth˺ and turns away.’”

verses.text: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?"
verses.translation: Pharaoh asked, “Who then is the Lord of you two, O Moses?”

verses.text: He said, "Our Lord is He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]."
