verses.translation: He answered, “Our Lord is the One Who has given everything its ˹distinctive˺ form, then guided ˹it˺.”

verses.text: [Pharaoh] said, "Then what is the case of the former generations?"
verses.translation: Pharaoh asked, “And what about previous peoples?”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord neither errs nor forgets."
verses.translation: He replied, “That knowledge is with my Lord in a Record. My Lord neither falters nor forgets ˹anything˺.”

verses.text: [It is He] who has made for you the earth as a bed [spread out] and inserted therein for you roadways and sent down from the sky, rain and produced thereby categories of various plants.
verses.translation: ˹He is the One˺ Who has laid out the earth for ˹all of˺ you, and set in it pathways for you, and sends down rain from the sky, causing various types of plants to grow

verses.text: Eat [therefrom] and pasture your livestock. Indeed, in that are signs for those of intelligence.
verses.translation: ˹so˺ eat and graze your cattle. Surely in this are signs for people of sound judgment

verses.text: From the earth We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will extract you another time.
verses.translation: From the earth We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will bring you back again

verses.text: And We certainly showed Pharaoh Our signs - all of them - but he denied and refused.
verses.translation: And We certainly showed Pharaoh all of Our signs, but he denied them and refused ˹to believe˺

verses.text: He said, "Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?
verses.translation: He said, “Have you come to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses

verses.text: Then we will surely bring you magic like it, so make between us and you an appointment, which we will not fail to keep and neither will you, in a place assigned."
verses.translation: We can surely meet you with similar magic. So set for us an appointment that neither of us will fail to keep, in a central place.”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "Your appointment is on the day of the festival when the people assemble at mid-morning."
verses.translation: Moses said, “Your appointment is on the Day of the Festival, and let the people be gathered mid-morning.”

verses.text: So Pharaoh went away, put together his plan, and then came [to Moses].
verses.translation: Pharaoh then withdrew, orchestrated his scheme, then returned

verses.text: Moses said to the magicians summoned by Pharaoh, "Woe to you! Do not invent a lie against Allah or He will exterminate you with a punishment; and he has failed who invents [such falsehood]."
verses.translation: Moses warned the magicians, “Woe to you! Do not fabricate a lie against Allah, or He will wipe you out with a torment. Whoever fabricates ˹lies˺ is bound to fail.”

verses.text: So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation.
verses.translation: So the magicians disputed the matter among themselves, conversing privately

verses.text: They said, "Indeed, these are two magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your most exemplary way.
verses.translation: They concluded, “These two are only magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic, and do away with your most cherished traditions

verses.text: So resolve upon your plan and then come [forward] in line. And he has succeeded today who overcomes."
verses.translation: So orchestrate your plan, then come forward in ˹perfect˺ ranks. And whoever prevails today will certainly be successful.”

verses.text: They said, "O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw."
verses.translation: They said, “O Moses! Either you cast, or let us be the first to cast.”

verses.text: He said, "Rather, you throw." And suddenly their ropes and staffs seemed to him from their magic that they were moving [like snakes].
verses.translation: Moses responded, “No, you go first.” And suddenly their ropes and staffs appeared to him—by their magic—to be slithering

verses.text: And he sensed within himself apprehension, did Moses.
verses.translation: So Moses concealed fear within himself

verses.text: Allah said, "Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior.
verses.translation: We reassured ˹him˺, “Do not fear! It is certainly you who will prevail

verses.text: And throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow up what they have crafted. What they have crafted is but the trick of a magician, and the magician will not succeed wherever he is."
verses.translation: Cast what is in your right hand, and it will swallow up what they have made, for what they have made is no more than a magic trick. And magicians can never succeed wherever they go.”

verses.text: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses."
verses.translation: So the magicians fell down in prostration, declaring, “We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.”

verses.text: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic. So I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and you will surely know which of us is more severe in [giving] punishment and more enduring."
verses.translation: Pharaoh threatened, “How dare you believe in him before I give you permission? He must be your master who taught you magic. I will certainly cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, and crucify you on the trunks of palm trees. You will really see whose punishment is more severe and more lasting.”

verses.text: They said, "Never will we prefer you over what has come to us of clear proofs and [over] He who created us. So decree whatever you are to decree. You can only decree for this worldly life.
verses.translation: They responded, “By the One Who created us! We will never prefer you over the clear proofs that have come to us. So do whatever you want! Your authority only covers the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world

verses.text: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord that He may forgive us our sins and what you compelled us [to do] of magic. And Allah is better and more enduring."
verses.translation: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord so He may forgive our sins and that magic you have forced us to practice. And Allah is far superior ˹in reward˺ and more lasting ˹in punishment˺.”

verses.text: Indeed, whoever comes to his Lord as a criminal - indeed, for him is Hell; he will neither die therein nor live.
verses.translation: Whoever comes to their Lord as an evildoer will certainly have Hell, where they can neither live nor die

verses.text: But whoever comes to Him as a believer having done righteous deeds - for those will be the highest degrees [in position]:
verses.translation: But whoever comes to Him as a believer, having done good, they will have the highest ranks

verses.text: Gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. And that is the reward of one who purifies himself.
verses.translation: the Gardens of Eternity, under which rivers flow, where they will stay forever. That is the reward of those who purify themselves

verses.text: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]."
verses.translation: And We surely inspired Moses, ˹saying,˺ “Leave with My servants ˹at night˺ and strike a dry passage for them across the sea. Have no fear of being overtaken, nor be concerned ˹of drowning˺.”

verses.text: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them,
verses.translation: Then Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers—but how overwhelming were the waters that submerged them

verses.text: And Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide [them].
verses.translation: And ˹so˺ Pharaoh led his people astray, and did not guide ˹them rightly˺

verses.text: O Children of Israel, We delivered you from your enemy, and We made an appointment with you at the right side of the mount, and We sent down to you manna and quails,
verses.translation: O Children of Israel! We saved you from your enemy, and made an appointment with you on the right side of Mount Ṭûr, and sent down to you manna and quails

verses.text: [Saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you and do not transgress [or oppress others] therein, lest My anger should descend upon you. And he upon whom My anger descends has certainly fallen."
verses.translation: ˹saying,˺ “Eat from the good things We have provided for you, but do not transgress in them, or My wrath will befall you. And whoever My wrath befalls is certainly doomed

verses.text: But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance.
verses.translation: But I am truly Most Forgiving to whoever repents, believes, and does good, then persists on ˹true˺ guidance.”

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "And what made you hasten from your people, O Moses?"
verses.translation: ˹Allah asked,˺ “Why have you come with such haste ahead of your people, O Moses?”

verses.text: He said, "They are close upon my tracks, and I hastened to You, my Lord, that You be pleased."
verses.translation: He replied, “They are close on my tracks. And I have hastened to You, my Lord, so You will be pleased.”

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Samiri has led them astray."
verses.translation: Allah responded, “We have indeed tested your people in your absence, and the Sâmiri has led them astray.”

verses.text: So Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved. He said, "O my people, did your Lord not make you a good promise? Then, was the time [of its fulfillment] too long for you, or did you wish that wrath from your Lord descend upon you, so you broke your promise [of obedience] to me?"
verses.translation: So Moses returned to his people, furious and sorrowful. He said, “O my people! Had your Lord not made you a good promise? Has my absence been too long for you? Or have you wished for wrath from your Lord to befall you, so you broke your promise to me?”

verses.text: They said, "We did not break our promise to you by our will, but we were made to carry burdens from the ornaments of the people [of Pharaoh], so we threw them [into the fire], and thus did the Samiri throw."
verses.translation: They argued, “We did not break our promise to you of our own free will, but we were made to carry the burden of the people’s ˹golden˺ jewellery, then we threw it ˹into the fire˺, and so did the Sâmiri.”

verses.text: And he extracted for them [the statue of] a calf which had a lowing sound, and they said, "This is your god and the god of Moses, but he forgot."
verses.translation: Then he moulded for them an idol of a calf that made a lowing sound. They said, “This is your god and the god of Moses, but Moses forgot ˹where it was˺!”

verses.text: Did they not see that it could not return to them any speech and that it did not possess for them any harm or benefit?
verses.translation: Did they not see that it did not respond to them, nor could it protect or benefit them

verses.text: And Aaron had already told them before [the return of Moses], "O my people, you are only being tested by it, and indeed, your Lord is the Most Merciful, so follow me and obey my order."
verses.translation: Aaron had already warned them beforehand, “O my people! You are only being tested by this, for indeed your ˹one true˺ Lord is the Most Compassionate. So follow me and obey my orders.”

verses.text: They said, "We will never cease being devoted to the calf until Moses returns to us."
verses.translation: They replied, “We will not cease to worship it until Moses returns to us.”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "O Aaron, what prevented you, when you saw them going astray,
verses.translation: Moses scolded ˹his brother˺, “O Aaron! What prevented you, when you saw them going astray

verses.text: From following me? Then have you disobeyed my order?"
verses.translation: from following after me? How could you disobey my orders?”

verses.text: [Aaron] said, "O son of my mother, do not seize [me] by my beard or by my head. Indeed, I feared that you would say, 'You caused division among the Children of Israel, and you did not observe [or await] my word.' "
verses.translation: Aaron pleaded, “O son of my mother! Do not seize me by my beard or ˹the hair of˺ my head. I really feared that you would say, ‘You have caused division among the Children of Israel, and did not observe my word.’”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "And what is your case, O Samiri?"
verses.translation: Moses then asked, “What did you think you were doing, O Sâmiri?”

verses.text: He said, "I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful [of dust] from the track of the messenger and threw it, and thus did my soul entice me."
verses.translation: He said, “I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful ˹of dust˺ from the hoof-prints of ˹the horse of˺ the messenger-angel ˹Gabriel˺ then cast it ˹on the moulded calf˺. This is what my lower-self tempted me into.”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it into the sea with a blast.
verses.translation: Moses said, “Go away then! And for ˹the rest of your˺ life you will surely be crying, ‘Do not touch ˹me˺!’ Then you will certainly have a fate that you cannot escape. Now look at your god to which you have been devoted: we will burn it up, then scatter it in the sea completely.”

verses.text: Your god is only Allah , except for whom there is no deity. He has encompassed all things in knowledge."
verses.translation: ˹Then Moses addressed his people,˺ “Your only god is Allah, there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. He encompasses everything in ˹His˺ knowledge.”

verses.text: Thus, [O Muhammad], We relate to you from the news of what has preceded. And We have certainly given you from Us the Qur'an.
verses.translation: This is how We relate to you ˹O Prophet˺ some of the stories of the past. And We have certainly granted you a Reminder from Us

verses.text: Whoever turns away from it - then indeed, he will bear on the Day of Resurrection a burden,
verses.translation: Whoever turns away from it will surely bear the burden ˹of sin˺ on the Day of Judgment

verses.text: [Abiding] eternally therein, and evil it is for them on the Day of Resurrection as a load -
verses.translation: suffering its consequences forever. What an evil burden they will carry on Judgment Day

verses.text: The Day the Horn will be blown. And We will gather the criminals, that Day, blue-eyed.
verses.translation: ˹Beware of˺ the Day the Trumpet will be blown, and We will gather the wicked on that Day blue-faced ˹from horror and thirst˺

verses.text: They will murmur among themselves, "You remained not but ten [days in the world]."
verses.translation: They will whisper among themselves, “You stayed no more than ten days ˹on the earth˺.”

verses.text: We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner will say, "You remained not but one day."
verses.translation: We know best what they will say—the most reasonable of them will say, “You stayed no more than a day.”

verses.text: And they ask you about the mountains, so say, "My Lord will blow them away with a blast.
verses.translation: And ˹if˺ they ask you ˹O Prophet˺ about the mountains, ˹then˺ say, “My Lord will wipe them out completely

verses.text: And He will leave the earth a level plain;
verses.translation: leaving the earth level and bare

verses.text: You will not see therein a depression or an elevation."
verses.translation: with neither depressions nor elevations to be seen.”

verses.text: That Day, everyone will follow [the call of] the Caller [with] no deviation therefrom, and [all] voices will be stilled before the Most Merciful, so you will not hear except a whisper [of footsteps].
verses.translation: On that Day all will follow the caller ˹for assembly˺, ˹and˺ none will dare to deviate. All voices will be hushed before the Most Compassionate. Only whispers will be heard

verses.text: That Day, no intercession will benefit except [that of] one to whom the Most Merciful has given permission and has accepted his word.
verses.translation: On that Day no intercession will be of any benefit, except by those granted permission by the Most Compassionate and whose words are agreeable to Him

verses.text: Allah knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, but they do not encompass it in knowledge.
verses.translation: He ˹fully˺ knows what is ahead of them and what is behind them, but they cannot encompass Him in ˹their˺ knowledge

verses.text: And [all] faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. And he will have failed who carries injustice.
verses.translation: And all faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, All-Sustaining. And those burdened with wrongdoing will be in loss

verses.text: But he who does of righteous deeds while he is a believer - he will neither fear injustice nor deprivation.
verses.translation: But whoever does good and is a believer will have no fear of being wronged or denied ˹their reward˺

verses.text: And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'an and have diversified therein the warnings that perhaps they will avoid [sin] or it would cause them remembrance.
verses.translation: And so We have sent it down as an Arabic Quran and varied the warnings in it, so perhaps they will shun evil or it may cause them to be mindful

verses.text: So high [above all] is Allah , the Sovereign, the Truth. And, [O Muhammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the Qur'an before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge."
verses.translation: Exalted is Allah, the True King! Do not rush to recite ˹a revelation of˺ the Quran ˹O Prophet˺ before it is ˹properly˺ conveyed to you, and pray, “My Lord! Increase me in knowledge.”

verses.text: And We had already taken a promise from Adam before, but he forgot; and We found not in him determination.
verses.translation: And indeed, We once made a covenant with Adam, but he forgot, and ˹so˺ We did not find determination in him

verses.text: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except Iblees; he refused.
verses.translation: And ˹remember˺ when We said to the angels, “Prostrate before Adam,” so they all did—but not Iblîs, who refused ˹arrogantly˺

verses.text: So We said, "O Adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your wife. Then let him not remove you from Paradise so you would suffer.
verses.translation: So We cautioned, “O Adam! This is surely an enemy to you and to your wife. So do not let him drive you both out of Paradise, for you ˹O Adam˺ would then suffer ˹hardship˺

verses.text: Indeed, it is [promised] for you not to be hungry therein or be unclothed.
verses.translation: Here it is guaranteed that you will never go hungry or unclothed

verses.text: And indeed, you will not be thirsty therein or be hot from the sun."
verses.translation: nor will you ˹ever˺ suffer from thirst or ˹the sun’s˺ heat.”

verses.text: Then Satan whispered to him; he said, "O Adam, shall I direct you to the tree of eternity and possession that will not deteriorate?"
verses.translation: But Satan whispered to him, saying, “O Adam! Shall I show you the Tree of Immortality and a kingdom that does not fade away?”

verses.text: And Adam and his wife ate of it, and their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And Adam disobeyed his Lord and erred.
verses.translation: So they both ate from the tree and then their nakedness was exposed to them, prompting them to cover themselves with leaves from Paradise. So Adam disobeyed his Lord, and ˹so˺ lost his way

verses.text: Then his Lord chose him and turned to him in forgiveness and guided [him].
verses.translation: Then his Lord chose him ˹for His grace˺, accepted his repentance, and guided him ˹rightly˺

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "Descend from Paradise - all, [your descendants] being enemies to one another. And if there should come to you guidance from Me - then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the Hereafter].
verses.translation: Allah said, “Descend, both of you, from here together ˹with Satan˺ as enemies to each other. Then when guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray ˹in this life˺ nor suffer ˹in the next˺

verses.text: And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed life, and We will gather him on the Day of Resurrection blind."
verses.translation: But whoever turns away from My Reminder will certainly have a miserable life, then We will raise them up blind on the Day of Judgment.”

verses.text: He will say, "My Lord, why have you raised me blind while I was [once] seeing?"
verses.translation: They will cry, “My Lord! Why have you raised me up blind, although I used to see?”

verses.text: [ Allah ] will say, "Thus did Our signs come to you, and you forgot them; and thus will you this Day be forgotten."
verses.translation: Allah will respond, “It is so, just as Our revelations came to you and you neglected them, so Today you are neglected.”

verses.text: And thus do We recompense he who transgressed and did not believe in the signs of his Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more enduring.
verses.translation: This is how We reward whoever transgresses and does not believe in the revelations of their Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is far more severe and more lasting

verses.text: Then, has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them as they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence.
verses.translation: Is it not yet clear to them how many peoples We destroyed before them, whose ruins they still pass by? Surely in this are signs for people of sound judgment

verses.text: And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, punishment would have been an obligation [due immediately], and [if not for] a specified term [decreed].
verses.translation: Had it not been for a prior decree from your Lord ˹O Prophet˺ and a term already set, their ˹instant˺ doom would have been inevitable

verses.text: So be patient over what they say and exalt [ Allah ] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting; and during periods of the night [exalt Him] and at the ends of the day, that you may be satisfied.
verses.translation: So be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say. And glorify the praises of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset, and glorify Him in the hours of the night and at both ends of the day, so that you may be pleased ˹with the reward˺

verses.text: And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life by which We test them. And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring.
verses.translation: Do not let your eyes crave what We have allowed some of the disbelievers to enjoy; the ˹fleeting˺ splendour of this worldly life, which We test them with. But your Lord’s provision ˹in the Hereafter˺ is far better and more lasting

verses.text: And enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein. We ask you not for provision; We provide for you, and the [best] outcome is for [those of] righteousness.
verses.translation: Bid your people to pray, and be diligent in ˹observing˺ it. We do not ask you to provide. It is We Who provide for you. And the ultimate outcome is ˹only˺ for ˹the people of˺ righteousness

verses.text: And they say, "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has there not come to them evidence of what was in the former scriptures?
verses.translation: They demand, “If only he could bring us a sign from his Lord!” Have they not ˹already˺ received a confirmation of what is in earlier Scriptures

verses.text: And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before him, they would have said, "Our Lord, why did You not send to us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses before we were humiliated and disgraced?"
verses.translation: Had We destroyed them with a torment before this ˹Prophet came˺, they would have surely argued, “Our Lord! If only You had sent us a messenger, we would have followed Your revelations before being humiliated and put to shame.”

verses.text: Say, "Each [of us] is waiting; so wait. For you will know who are the companions of the sound path and who is guided."
verses.translation: Say ˹to them, O Prophet˺, “Each ˹of us˺ is waiting, so keep waiting! You will soon know who is on the Straight Path and is ˹rightly˺ guided.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.
verses.translation: ˹The time of˺ people’s judgment has drawn near, yet they are heedlessly turning away

verses.text: No mention comes to them anew from their Lord except that they listen to it while they are at play
verses.translation: Whatever new reminder comes to them from their Lord, they only listen to it jokingly

verses.text: With their hearts distracted. And those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "Is this [Prophet] except a human being like you? So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"
verses.translation: with their hearts ˹totally˺ distracted. The evildoers would converse secretly, ˹saying,˺ “Is this ˹one˺ not human like yourselves? Would you fall for ˹this˺ witchcraft, even though you can ˹clearly˺ see?”

verses.text: The Prophet said, "My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing."
verses.translation: The Prophet responded, “My Lord ˹fully˺ knows every word spoken in the heavens and the earth. For He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.”

verses.text: But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."
verses.translation: Yet they say, “This ˹Quran˺ is a set of confused dreams! No, he has fabricated it! No, he must be a poet! So let him bring us a ˹tangible˺ sign like those ˹prophets˺ sent before.”

verses.text: Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them, so will they believe?
verses.translation: Not a ˹single˺ society We destroyed before them ever believed ˹after receiving the signs˺. Will these ˹pagans˺ then believe

verses.text: And We sent not before you, [O Muhammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message if you do not know.
verses.translation: We did not send ˹messengers˺ before you ˹O Prophet˺ except mere men inspired by Us. If you ˹polytheists˺ do not know ˹this already˺, then ask those who have knowledge ˹of the Scriptures˺

verses.text: And We did not make the prophets forms not eating food, nor were they immortal [on earth].
verses.translation: We did not give those messengers ˹supernatural˺ bodies that did not need food, nor were they immortal

verses.text: Then We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors.
verses.translation: Then We fulfilled Our promise to them, saving them along with whoever We willed and destroying the transgressors

verses.text: We have certainly sent down to you a Book in which is your mention. Then will you not reason?
verses.translation: We have surely revealed to you a Book, in which there is glory for you. Will you not then understand

verses.text: And how many a city which was unjust have We shattered and produced after it another people.
verses.translation: ˹Imagine˺ how many societies of wrongdoers We have destroyed, raising up other people after them

verses.text: And when its inhabitants perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it.
verses.translation: When the wrongdoers sensed ˹the arrival of˺ Our torment, they started to run away from their cities

verses.text: [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."
verses.translation: ˹They were told,˺ “Do not run away! Return to your luxuries and your homes, so you may be questioned ˹about your fate˺.”

verses.text: They said, "O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
verses.translation: They cried, “Woe to us! We have surely been wrongdoers.”

verses.text: And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].
verses.translation: They kept repeating their cry until We mowed them down, ˹leaving them˺ lifeless

verses.text: And We did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play.
verses.translation: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything in between for sport

verses.text: Had We intended to take a diversion, We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so.
verses.translation: Had We intended to take ˹some˺ amusement, We could have found it in Our presence, if that had been Our Will

verses.text: Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it, and thereupon it departs. And for you is destruction from that which you describe.
verses.translation: In fact, We hurl the truth against falsehood, leaving it crushed, and it quickly vanishes. And woe be to you for what you claim

verses.text: To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those near Him are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, nor do they tire.
verses.translation: To Him belong all those in the heavens and the earth. And those nearest to Him are not too proud to worship Him, nor do they tire

verses.text: They exalt [Him] night and day [and] do not slacken.
verses.translation: They glorify ˹Him˺ day and night, never wavering

verses.text: Or have men taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?
verses.translation: Or have they taken gods from the earth, who can raise the dead

verses.text: Had there been within the heavens and earth gods besides Allah , they both would have been ruined. So exalted is Allah , Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
verses.translation: Had there been other gods besides Allah in the heavens or the earth, both ˹realms˺ would have surely been corrupted. So Glorified is Allah, Lord of the Throne, far above what they claim

verses.text: He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.
verses.translation: He cannot be questioned about what He does, but they will ˹all˺ be questioned

verses.text: Or have they taken gods besides Him? Say, [O Muhammad], "Produce your proof. This [Qur'an] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me." But most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away.
verses.translation: Or have they taken other gods besides Him? Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Show ˹me˺ your proof. Here is ˹the Quran,˺ the Reminder for those with me; along with ˹earlier Scriptures,˺ the Reminder for those before me.” But most of them do not know the truth, so they turn away

verses.text: And We sent not before you any messenger except that We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."
verses.translation: We never sent a messenger before you ˹O Prophet˺ without revealing to him: “There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Me, so worship Me ˹alone˺.”

verses.text: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they are [but] honored servants.
verses.translation: And they say, “The Most Compassionate has offspring!” Glory be to Him! In fact, those ˹angels˺ are only ˹His˺ honoured servants

verses.text: They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command.
verses.translation: who do not speak until He has spoken, ˹only˺ acting at His command

verses.text: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves. And they, from fear of Him, are apprehensive.
verses.translation: He ˹fully˺ knows what is ahead of them and what is behind them. They do not intercede except for whom He approves, and they tremble in awe of Him

verses.text: And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him"- that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.
verses.translation: Whoever of them were to say, “I am a god besides Him,” they would be rewarded with Hell by Us. This is how We reward the wrongdoers

verses.text: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?
verses.translation: Do the disbelievers not realize that the heavens and earth were ˹once˺ one mass then We split them apart? And We created from water every living thing. Will they not then believe

verses.text: And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided.
verses.translation: And We have placed firm mountains upon the earth so it does not shake with them, and made in it broad pathways so they may find their way

verses.text: And We made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs, are turning away.
verses.translation: And We have made the sky a well-protected canopy, still they turn away from its signs

verses.text: And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming.
verses.translation: And He is the One Who created the day and the night, the sun and the moon—each travelling in an orbit

verses.text: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?
verses.translation: We have not granted immortality to any human before you ˹O Prophet˺: so if you die, will they live forever

verses.text: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.
verses.translation: Every soul will taste death. And We test you ˹O humanity˺ with good and evil as a trial, then to Us you will ˹all˺ be returned

verses.text: And when those who disbelieve see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one who insults your gods?" And they are, at the mention of the Most Merciful, disbelievers.
verses.translation: When the disbelievers see you ˹O Prophet˺, they only make fun of you, ˹saying,˺ “Is this the one who speaks ˹ill˺ of your gods?” while they disbelieve at the mention of the Most Compassionate

verses.text: Man was created of haste. I will show you My signs, so do not impatiently urge Me.
verses.translation: Humankind is made of haste. I will soon show you My signs, so do not ask Me to hasten them

verses.text: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
verses.translation: They ask ˹the believers˺, “When will this threat come to pass if what you say is true?”

verses.text: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided...
verses.translation: If only the disbelievers knew that a time will come when they will not be able to keep the Fire off their faces or backs, nor will they be helped

verses.text: Rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved.
verses.translation: In fact, the Hour will take them by surprise, leaving them stunned. So they will not be able to avert it, nor will it be delayed from them

verses.text: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
verses.translation: ˹Other˺ messengers had already been ridiculed before you ˹O Prophet˺, but those who mocked them were overtaken by what they used to ridicule

verses.text: Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.
verses.translation: Ask ˹them, O Prophet,˺ “Who can defend you by day or by night against the Most Compassionate?” Still they turn away from the remembrance of their Lord

verses.text: Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
verses.translation: Or do they have gods—other than Us—that can protect them? They cannot ˹even˺ protect themselves, nor will they be aided against Us

verses.text: But, [on the contrary], We have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. Then do they not see that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? So it is they who will overcome?
verses.translation: In fact, We have allowed enjoyment for these ˹Meccans˺ and their forefathers for such a long time ˹that they took it for granted˺. Do they not see that We gradually reduce ˹their˺ land from its borders? Is it they who will then prevail

verses.text: Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I warn you only by revelation.” But the deaf cannot hear the call when they are warned

verses.text: And if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, "O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers."
verses.translation: If they were touched by even a breath of your Lord’s torment, they would certainly cry, “Woe to us! We have really been wrongdoers.”

verses.text: And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. And if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as accountant.
verses.translation: We will set up the scales of justice on the Day of Judgment, so no soul will be wronged in the least. And ˹even˺ if a deed is the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as a ˹vigilant˺ Reckoner

verses.text: And We had already given Moses and Aaron the criterion and a light and a reminder for the righteous
verses.translation: Indeed, We granted Moses and Aaron the standard ˹to distinguish between right and wrong˺—a light and a reminder for the righteous

verses.text: Who fear their Lord unseen, while they are of the Hour apprehensive.
verses.translation: who are in awe of their Lord without seeing Him, and are fearful of the Hour

verses.text: And this [Qur'an] is a blessed message which We have sent down. Then are you with it unacquainted?
verses.translation: And this ˹Quran˺ is a blessed reminder which We have revealed. Will you ˹pagans˺ then deny it

verses.text: And We had certainly given Abraham his sound judgement before, and We were of him well-Knowing
verses.translation: And indeed, We had granted Abraham sound judgment early on, for We knew him well ˹to be worthy of it˺

verses.text: When he said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoted?"
verses.translation: ˹Remember˺ when he questioned his father and his people, “What are these statues to which you are so devoted?”

verses.text: They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them."
verses.translation: They replied, “We found our forefathers worshipping them.”

verses.text: He said, "You were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error."
verses.translation: He responded, “Indeed, you and your forefathers have been clearly astray.”

verses.text: They said, "Have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest?"
verses.translation: They asked, “Have you come to us with the truth, or is this a joke?”

verses.text: He said, "[No], rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth who created them, and I, to that, am of those who testify.
verses.translation: He replied, “In fact, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them ˹both˺. And to that I bear witness.”

verses.text: And [I swear] by Allah , I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away."
verses.translation: ˹Then he said to himself,˺ “By Allah! I will surely plot against your idols after you have turned your backs and gone away.”

verses.text: So he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question].
verses.translation: So he smashed them into pieces, except the biggest of them, so they might turn to it ˹for answers˺

verses.text: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? Indeed, he is of the wrongdoers."
verses.translation: They protested, “Who dared do this to our gods? It must be an evildoer!”

verses.text: They said, "We heard a young man mention them who is called Abraham."
verses.translation: Some said, “We heard a young man, called Abraham, speaking ˹ill˺ of them.”

verses.text: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify."
verses.translation: They demanded, “Bring him before the eyes of the people, so that they may witness ˹his trial˺.”

verses.text: They said, "Have you done this to our gods, O Abraham?"
verses.translation: They asked, “Was it you who did this to our gods, O Abraham?”

verses.text: He said, "Rather, this - the largest of them - did it, so ask them, if they should [be able to] speak."
verses.translation: He replied ˹sarcastically˺, “No, this one—the biggest of them—did it! So ask them, if they can talk!”

verses.text: So they returned to [blaming] themselves and said [to each other], "Indeed, you are the wrongdoers."
verses.translation: So they came back to their senses, saying ˹to one another˺, “You yourselves are truly the wrongdoers!”

verses.text: Then they reversed themselves, [saying], "You have already known that these do not speak!"
verses.translation: Then they ˹quickly˺ regressed to their ˹original˺ mind-set, ˹arguing,˺ “You already know that those ˹idols˺ cannot talk.”

verses.text: He said, "Then do you worship instead of Allah that which does not benefit you at all or harm you?
verses.translation: He rebuked ˹them˺, “Do you then worship—instead of Allah—what can neither benefit nor harm you in any way

verses.text: Uff to you and to what you worship instead of Allah . Then will you not use reason?"
verses.translation: Shame on you and whatever you worship instead of Allah! Do you not have any sense?”

verses.text: They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act."
verses.translation: They concluded, “Burn him up to avenge your gods, if you must act.”

verses.text: Allah said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham."
verses.translation: We ordered, “O fire! Be cool and safe for Abraham!”

verses.text: And they intended for him harm, but We made them the greatest losers.
verses.translation: They had sought to harm him, but We made them the worst losers

verses.text: And We delivered him and Lot to the land which We had blessed for the worlds.
verses.translation: Then We delivered him, along with Lot, to the land We had showered with blessings for all people

verses.text: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous.
verses.translation: And We blessed him with Isaac ˹as a son˺ and Jacob ˹as a grandson˺, as an additional favour—making all of them righteous

verses.text: And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakah; and they were worshippers of Us.
verses.translation: We ˹also˺ made them leaders, guiding by Our command, and inspired them to do good deeds, establish prayer, and pay alms-tax. And they were devoted to Our worship

verses.text: And to Lot We gave judgement and knowledge, and We saved him from the city that was committing wicked deeds. Indeed, they were a people of evil, defiantly disobedient.
verses.translation: And to Lot We gave wisdom and knowledge, and delivered him from the society engrossed in shameful practices. They were certainly an evil, rebellious people

verses.text: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous.
verses.translation: And We admitted him into Our mercy, ˹for˺ he was truly one of the righteous

verses.text: And [mention] Noah, when he called [to Allah ] before [that time], so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the great flood.
verses.translation: And ˹remember˺ when Noah had cried out to Us earlier, so We responded to him and delivered him and his family from the great distress

verses.text: And We saved him from the people who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a people of evil, so We drowned them, all together.
verses.translation: And We made him prevail over those who had rejected Our signs. They were truly an evil people, so We drowned them all

verses.text: And [mention] David and Solomon, when they judged concerning the field - when the sheep of a people overran it [at night], and We were witness to their judgement.
verses.translation: And ˹remember˺ when David and Solomon passed judgment regarding the crops ruined ˹at night˺ by someone’s sheep, and We were witness to their judgments

verses.text: And We gave understanding of the case to Solomon, and to each [of them] We gave judgement and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains to exalt [Us], along with David and [also] the birds. And We were doing [that].
verses.translation: We guided ˹young˺ Solomon to a fairer settlement, and granted each of them wisdom and knowledge. We subjected the mountains as well as the birds to hymn ˹Our praises˺ along with David. It is We Who did ˹it all˺

verses.text: And We taught him the fashioning of coats of armor to protect you from your [enemy in] battle. So will you then be grateful?
verses.translation: We taught him the art of making body armour to protect you in battle. Will you then be grateful

verses.text: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing.
verses.translation: And to Solomon We subjected the raging winds, blowing by his command to the land We had showered with blessings. It is We Who know everything

verses.text: And of the devils were those who dived for him and did work other than that. And We were of them a guardian.
verses.translation: And ˹We subjected˺ some jinn that dived for him, and performed other duties. It is We Who kept them in check

verses.text: And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and you are the Most Merciful of the merciful."
verses.translation: And ˹remember˺ when Job cried out to his Lord, “I have been touched with adversity, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.”

verses.text: So We responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. And We gave him [back] his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers [of Allah ].
verses.translation: So We answered his prayer and removed his adversity, and gave him back his family, twice as many, as a mercy from Us and a lesson for the ˹devoted˺ worshippers

verses.text: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient.
verses.translation: And ˹remember˺ Ishmael, Enoch, and Ⱬul-Kifl. They were all steadfast

verses.text: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous.
verses.translation: We admitted them into Our mercy, for they were truly of the righteous

verses.text: And [mention] the man of the fish, when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. And he called out within the darknesses, "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers."
verses.translation: And ˹remember˺ when the Man of the Whale stormed off ˹from his city˺ in a rage, thinking We would not restrain him. Then in the ˹veils of˺ darkness he cried out, “There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except You. Glory be to You! I have certainly done wrong.”

verses.text: So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers.
verses.translation: So We answered his prayer and rescued him from anguish. And so do We save the ˹true˺ believers

verses.text: And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while you are the best of inheritors."
verses.translation: And ˹remember˺ when Zachariah cried out to his Lord, “My Lord! Do not leave me childless, though You are the Best of Successors.”

verses.text: So We responded to him, and We gave to him John, and amended for him his wife. Indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate Us in hope and fear, and they were to Us humbly submissive.
verses.translation: So We answered his prayer, granted him John, and made his wife fertile. Indeed, they used to race in doing good, and call upon Us with hope and fear, totally humbling themselves before Us

verses.text: And [mention] the one who guarded her chastity, so We blew into her [garment] through Our angel [Gabriel], and We made her and her son a sign for the worlds.
verses.translation: And ˹remember˺ the one who guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her through Our angel, ˹Gabriel,˺ making her and her son a sign for all peoples

verses.text: Indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me.
verses.translation: ˹O prophets!˺ Indeed, this religion of yours is ˹only˺ one, and I am your Lord, so worship Me ˹alone˺

verses.text: And [yet] they divided their affair among themselves, [but] all to Us will return.
verses.translation: Yet the people have divided it into sects. But to Us they will all return

verses.text: So whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort, and indeed We, of it, are recorders.
verses.translation: So whoever does good and is a believer will never be denied ˹the reward for˺ their striving, for We are recording it all

verses.text: And there is prohibition upon [the people of] a city which We have destroyed that they will [ever] return
verses.translation: It is impossible for a society which We have destroyed to ever rise again

verses.text: Until when [the dam of] Gog and Magog has been opened and they, from every elevation, descend
verses.translation: until ˹after˺ Gog and Magog have broken loose ˹from the barrier˺, swarming down from every hill

verses.text: And [when] the true promise has approached; then suddenly the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring [in horror, while they say], "O woe to us; we had been unmindful of this; rather, we were wrongdoers."
verses.translation: ushering in the True Promise. Then—behold!—the disbelievers will stare ˹in horror, crying,˺ “Oh, woe to us! We have truly been heedless of this. In fact, we have been wrongdoers.”

verses.text: Indeed, you [disbelievers] and what you worship other than Allah are the firewood of Hell. You will be coming to [enter] it.
verses.translation: Certainly you ˹disbelievers˺ and whatever you worship instead of Allah will be the fuel of Hell. You are ˹all˺ bound to enter it

verses.text: Had these [false deities] been [actual] gods, they would not have come to it, but all are eternal therein.
verses.translation: Had those idols been ˹true˺ gods, they would not have entered it. And they will be there forever

verses.text: For them therein is heavy sighing, and they therein will not hear.
verses.translation: In it they will groan, and will not be able to hear

verses.text: Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from Us - they are from it far removed.
verses.translation: Surely those for whom We have destined the finest reward will be kept far away from Hell

verses.text: They will not hear its sound, while they are, in that which their souls desire, abiding eternally.
verses.translation: not even hearing the slightest hissing from it. And they will delight forever in what their souls desire

verses.text: They will not be grieved by the greatest terror, and the angels will meet them, [saying], "This is your Day which you have been promised" -
verses.translation: The Supreme Horror ˹of that Day˺ will not disturb them, and the angels will greet them, ˹saying,˺ “This is your Day, which you have been promised.”

verses.text: The Day when We will fold the heaven like the folding of a [written] sheet for the records. As We began the first creation, We will repeat it. [That is] a promise binding upon Us. Indeed, We will do it.
verses.translation: On that Day We will roll up the heavens like a scroll of writings. Just as We produced the first creation, ˹so˺ shall We reproduce it. That is a promise binding on Us. We truly uphold ˹Our promises˺

verses.text: And We have already written in the book [of Psalms] after the [previous] mention that the land [of Paradise] is inherited by My righteous servants.
verses.translation: Surely, following the ˹heavenly˺ Record, We decreed in the Scriptures: “My righteous servants shall inherit the land.”

verses.text: Indeed, in this [Qur'an] is notification for a worshipping people.
verses.translation: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is sufficient ˹as a reminder˺ for those devoted to worship

verses.text: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds.
verses.translation: We have sent you ˹O Prophet˺ only as a mercy for the whole world

verses.text: Say, "It is only revealed to me that your god is but one God; so will you be Muslims [in submission to Him]?"
verses.translation: Say, “What has been revealed to me is this: ‘Your God is only One God.’ Will you then submit?”

verses.text: But if they turn away, then say, "I have announced to [all of] you equally. And I know not whether near or far is that which you are promised.
verses.translation: If they turn away, then say, “I have warned you all equally. I do not know if what you are threatened with is near or far

verses.text: Indeed, He knows what is declared of speech, and He knows what you conceal.
verses.translation: Allah surely knows what you say openly and whatever you hide

verses.text: And I know not; perhaps it is a trial for you and enjoyment for a time."
verses.translation: I do not know if this ˹delay˺ is possibly a test for you and an enjoyment for a while.”

verses.text: [The Prophet] has said, "My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe."
verses.translation: ˹In the end,˺ the Prophet said, “My Lord! Judge ˹between us˺ in truth. And our Lord is the Most Compassionate, Whose help is sought against what you claim.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: O mankind, fear your Lord. Indeed, the convulsion of the [final] Hour is a terrible thing.
verses.translation: O humanity! Fear your Lord, for the ˹violent˺ quaking at the Hour is surely a dreadful thing

verses.text: On the Day you see it every nursing mother will be distracted from that [child] she was nursing, and every pregnant woman will abort her pregnancy, and you will see the people [appearing] intoxicated while they are not intoxicated; but the punishment of Allah is severe.
verses.translation: The Day you see it, every nursing mother will abandon what she is nursing, and every pregnant woman will deliver her burden ˹prematurely˺. And you will see people ˹as if they were˺ drunk, though they will not be drunk; but the torment of Allah is ˹terribly˺ severe

verses.text: And of the people is he who disputes about Allah without knowledge and follows every rebellious devil.
verses.translation: ˹Still˺ there are some who dispute about Allah without knowledge, and follow every rebellious devil

verses.text: It has been decreed for every devil that whoever turns to him - he will misguide him and will lead him to the punishment of the Blaze.
verses.translation: It has been decreed for such devils that whoever takes them as a guide will be misguided and led by them into the torment of the Blaze

verses.text: O People, if you should be in doubt about the Resurrection, then [consider that] indeed, We created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot, and then from a lump of flesh, formed and unformed - that We may show you. And We settle in the wombs whom We will for a specified term, then We bring you out as a child, and then [We develop you] that you may reach your [time of] maturity. And among you is he who is taken in [early] death, and among you is he who is returned to the most decrepit [old] age so that he knows, after [once having] knowledge, nothing. And you see the earth barren, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and swells and grows [something] of every beautiful kind.
verses.translation: O humanity! If you are in doubt about the Resurrection, then ˹know that˺ We did create you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then ˹developed you into˺ a clinging clot ˹of blood˺, then a lump of flesh—fully formed or unformed—in order to demonstrate ˹Our power˺ to you. ˹Then˺ We settle whatever ˹embryo˺ We will in the womb for an appointed term, then bring you forth as infants, so that you may reach your prime. Some of you ˹may˺ die ˹young˺, while others are left to reach the most feeble stage of life so that they may know nothing after having known much. And you see the earth lifeless, but as soon as We send down rain upon it, it begins to stir ˹to life˺ and swell, producing every type of pleasant plant

verses.text: That is because Allah is the Truth and because He gives life to the dead and because He is over all things competent
verses.translation: That is because Allah ˹alone˺ is the Truth, He ˹alone˺ gives life to the dead, and He ˹alone˺ is Most Capable of everything

verses.text: And [that they may know] that the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - and that Allah will resurrect those in the graves.
verses.translation: And certainly the Hour is coming, there is no doubt about it. And Allah will surely resurrect those in the graves

verses.text: And of the people is he who disputes about Allah without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening book [from Him],
verses.translation: ˹Still˺ there are some who dispute about Allah without knowledge, guidance, or an enlightening scripture

verses.text: Twisting his neck [in arrogance] to mislead [people] from the way of Allah . For him in the world is disgrace, and We will make him taste on the Day of Resurrection the punishment of the Burning Fire [while it is said],
verses.translation: turning away ˹in pride˺ to lead ˹others˺ astray from Allah’s Way. They will suffer disgrace in this world, and on the Day of Judgment We will make them taste the torment of burning

verses.text: "That is for what your hands have put forth and because Allah is not ever unjust to [His] servants."
verses.translation: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is ˹the reward˺ for what your hands have done. And Allah is never unjust to ˹His˺ creation.”

verses.text: And of the people is he who worships Allah on an edge. If he is touched by good, he is reassured by it; but if he is struck by trial, he turns on his face [to the other direction]. He has lost [this] world and the Hereafter. That is what is the manifest loss.
verses.translation: And there are some who worship Allah on the verge ˹of faith˺: if they are blessed with something good, they are content with it; but if they are afflicted with a trial, they relapse ˹into disbelief˺, losing this world and the Hereafter. That is ˹truly˺ the clearest loss

verses.text: He invokes instead of Allah that which neither harms him nor benefits him. That is what is the extreme error.
verses.translation: They call besides Allah what can neither harm nor benefit them. That is ˹truly˺ the farthest one can stray

verses.text: He invokes one whose harm is closer than his benefit - how wretched the protector and how wretched the associate.
verses.translation: They invoke those whose worship leads to harm, not benefit. What an evil patron and what an evil associate

verses.text: Indeed, Allah will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. Indeed, Allah does what He intends.
verses.translation: Indeed, Allah will admit those who believe and do good into Gardens, under which rivers flow. Surely Allah does what He wills

verses.text: Whoever should think that Allah will not support [Prophet Muhammad] in this world and the Hereafter - let him extend a rope to the ceiling, then cut off [his breath], and let him see: will his effort remove that which enrages [him]?
verses.translation: Whoever thinks that Allah will not help His Prophet in this world and the Hereafter, let them stretch out a rope to the ceiling and strangle themselves, then let them see if this plan will do away with ˹the cause of˺ their rage

verses.text: And thus have We sent the Qur'an down as verses of clear evidence and because Allah guides whom He intends.
verses.translation: And so We revealed this ˹Quran˺ as clear verses. And Allah certainly guides whoever He wills

verses.text: Indeed, those who have believed and those who were Jews and the Sabeans and the Christians and the Magians and those who associated with Allah - Allah will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allah is, over all things, Witness.
verses.translation: Indeed, the believers, Jews, Sabians, Christians, Magi, and the polytheists—Allah will judge between them ˹all˺ on Judgment Day. Surely Allah is a Witness over all things

verses.text: Do you not see that to Allah prostrates whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth and the sun, the moon, the stars, the mountains, the trees, the moving creatures and many of the people? But upon many the punishment has been justified. And he whom Allah humiliates - for him there is no bestower of honor. Indeed, Allah does what He wills.
verses.translation: Do you not see that to Allah bow down ˹in submission˺ all those in the heavens and all those on the earth, as well as the sun, the moon, the stars, the mountains, the trees, and ˹all˺ living beings, as well as many humans, while many are deserving of punishment. And whoever Allah disgraces, none can honour. Surely Allah does what He wills

verses.text: These are two adversaries who have disputed over their Lord. But those who disbelieved will have cut out for them garments of fire. Poured upon their heads will be scalding water
verses.translation: These are two opposing groups that disagree about their Lord: as for the disbelievers, garments of Fire will be cut out for them and boiling water will be poured over their heads

verses.text: By which is melted that within their bellies and [their] skins.
verses.translation: melting whatever is in their bellies, along with their skin

verses.text: And for [striking] them are maces of iron.
verses.translation: And awaiting them are maces of iron

verses.text: Every time they want to get out of Hellfire from anguish, they will be returned to it, and [it will be said], "Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire!"
verses.translation: Whenever they try to escape from Hell—out of anguish—they will be forced back into it, ˹and will be told,˺ “Taste the torment of burning!”

verses.text: Indeed, Allah will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearl, and their garments therein will be silk.
verses.translation: ˹But˺ Allah will surely admit those who believe and do good into Gardens, under which rivers flow, where they will be adorned with bracelets of gold and pearls, and their clothing will be silk

verses.text: And they had been guided [in worldly life] to good speech, and they were guided to the path of the Praiseworthy.
verses.translation: for they have been guided to the best of speech, and they have been guided to the Commendable Path

verses.text: Indeed, those who have disbelieved and avert [people] from the way of Allah and [from] al-Masjid al-Haram, which We made for the people - equal are the resident therein and one from outside; and [also] whoever intends [a deed] therein of deviation [in religion] or wrongdoing - We will make him taste of a painful punishment.
verses.translation: Indeed, those who persist in disbelief and hinder ˹others˺ from the Way of Allah and from the Sacred Mosque—which We have appointed for all people, residents and visitors alike—along with whoever intends to deviate by doing wrong in it, We will cause them to taste a painful punishment

verses.text: And [mention, O Muhammad], when We designated for Abraham the site of the House, [saying], "Do not associate anything with Me and purify My House for those who perform Tawaf and those who stand [in prayer] and those who bow and prostrate.
verses.translation: And ˹remember˺ when We assigned to Abraham the site of the House, ˹saying,˺ “Do not associate anything with Me ˹in worship˺ and purify My House for those who circle ˹the Ka’bah˺, stand ˹in prayer˺, and bow and prostrate themselves

verses.text: And proclaim to the people the Hajj [pilgrimage]; they will come to you on foot and on every lean camel; they will come from every distant pass -
verses.translation: Call ˹all˺ people to the pilgrimage. They will come to you on foot and on every lean camel from every distant path

verses.text: That they may witness benefits for themselves and mention the name of Allah on known days over what He has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. So eat of them and feed the miserable and poor.
verses.translation: so they may obtain the benefits ˹in store˺ for them, and pronounce the Name of Allah on appointed days over the sacrificial animals He has provided for them. So eat from their meat and feed the desperately poor

verses.text: Then let them end their untidiness and fulfill their vows and perform Tawaf around the ancient House."
verses.translation: Then let them groom themselves, fulfil their vows, and circle the Ancient House.”

verses.text: That [has been commanded], and whoever honors the sacred ordinances of Allah - it is best for him in the sight of his Lord. And permitted to you are the grazing livestock, except what is recited to you. So avoid the uncleanliness of idols and avoid false statement,
verses.translation: That is so. And whoever honours the rituals of Allah, it is best for them in the sight of their Lord. The ˹meat of˺ cattle has been made lawful for you, except what has ˹already˺ been recited to you. So shun the impurity of idolatry, and shun words of falsehood

verses.text: Inclining [only] to Allah , not associating [anything] with Him. And he who associates with Allah - it is as though he had fallen from the sky and was snatched by the birds or the wind carried him down into a remote place.
verses.translation: Be upright ˹in devotion˺ to Allah, associating none with Him ˹in worship˺. For whoever associates ˹others˺ with Allah is like someone who has fallen from the sky and is either snatched away by birds or swept by the wind to a remote place

verses.text: That [is so]. And whoever honors the symbols of Allah - indeed, it is from the piety of hearts.
verses.translation: That is so. And whoever honours the symbols of Allah, it is certainly out of the piety of the heart

verses.text: For you the animals marked for sacrifice are benefits for a specified term; then their place of sacrifice is at the ancient House.
verses.translation: You may benefit from sacrificial animals for an appointed term, then their place of sacrifice is at the Ancient House

verses.text: And for all religion We have appointed a rite [of sacrifice] that they may mention the name of Allah over what He has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. For your god is one God, so to Him submit. And, [O Muhammad], give good tidings to the humble [before their Lord]
verses.translation: For every community We appointed a rite of sacrifice so that they may pronounce the Name of Allah over the sacrificial animals He has provided for them. For your God is only One God, so submit yourselves to Him ˹alone˺. And give good news ˹O Prophet˺ to the humble

verses.text: Who, when Allah is mentioned, their hearts are fearful, and [to] the patient over what has afflicted them, and the establishers of prayer and those who spend from what We have provided them.
verses.translation: those whose hearts tremble at the remembrance of Allah, who patiently endure whatever may befall them, and who establish prayer and donate from what We have provided for them

verses.text: And the camels and cattle We have appointed for you as among the symbols of Allah ; for you therein is good. So mention the name of Allah upon them when lined up [for sacrifice]; and when they are [lifeless] on their sides, then eat from them and feed the needy and the beggar. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may be grateful.
verses.translation: We have made sacrificial camels ˹and cattle˺ among the symbols of Allah, in which there is ˹much˺ good for you. So pronounce the Name of Allah over them when they are lined up ˹for sacrifice˺. Once they have fallen ˹lifeless˺ on their sides, you may eat from their meat, and feed the needy—those who do not beg, and those who do. In this way We have subjected these ˹animals˺ to you so that you may be grateful

verses.text: Their meat will not reach Allah , nor will their blood, but what reaches Him is piety from you. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may glorify Allah for that [to] which He has guided you; and give good tidings to the doers of good.
verses.translation: Neither their meat nor blood reaches Allah. Rather, it is your piety that reaches Him. This is how He has subjected them to you so that you may proclaim the greatness of Allah for what He has guided you to, and give good news to the good-doers

verses.text: Indeed, Allah defends those who have believed. Indeed, Allah does not like everyone treacherous and ungrateful.
verses.translation: Indeed, Allah defends those who believe. Surely Allah does not like whoever is deceitful, ungrateful

verses.text: Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. And indeed, Allah is competent to give them victory.
verses.translation: Permission ˹to fight back˺ is ˹hereby˺ granted to those being fought, for they have been wronged. And Allah is truly Most Capable of helping them ˹prevail˺

verses.text: [They are] those who have been evicted from their homes without right - only because they say, "Our Lord is Allah ." And were it not that Allah checks the people, some by means of others, there would have been demolished monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques in which the name of Allah is much mentioned. And Allah will surely support those who support Him. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
verses.translation: ˹They are˺ those who have been expelled from their homes for no reason other than proclaiming: “Our Lord is Allah.” Had Allah not repelled ˹the aggression of˺ some people by means of others, destruction would have surely claimed monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques in which Allah’s Name is often mentioned. Allah will certainly help those who stand up for Him. Allah is truly All-Powerful, Almighty

verses.text: [And they are] those who, if We give them authority in the land, establish prayer and give zakah and enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong. And to Allah belongs the outcome of [all] matters.
verses.translation: ˹They are˺ those who, if established in the land by Us, would perform prayer, pay alms-tax, encourage what is good, and forbid what is evil. And with Allah rests the outcome of all affairs

verses.text: And if they deny you, [O Muhammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and 'Aad and Thamud deny [their prophets],
verses.translation: If they deny you ˹O Prophet˺, so did the people of Noah before them, as well as ˹the tribes of˺ ’Ȃd and Thamûd

verses.text: And the people of Abraham and the people of Lot
verses.translation: the people of Abraham, the people of Lot

verses.text: And the inhabitants of Madyan. And Moses was denied, so I prolonged enjoyment for the disbelievers; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
verses.translation: and the residents of Midian. And Moses was denied ˹too˺. But I delayed ˹the fate of˺ the disbelievers ˹until their appointed time˺ then seized them. And how severe was My response

verses.text: And how many a city did We destroy while it was committing wrong - so it is [now] fallen into ruin - and [how many] an abandoned well and [how many] a lofty palace.
verses.translation: Many are the societies We have destroyed for persisting in wrongdoing, leaving them in total ruin. ˹Many are˺ also the abandoned wells and lofty palaces

verses.text: So have they not traveled through the earth and have hearts by which to reason and ears by which to hear? For indeed, it is not eyes that are blinded, but blinded are the hearts which are within the breasts.
verses.translation: Have they not travelled throughout the land so their hearts may reason, and their ears may listen? Indeed, it is not the eyes that are blind, but it is the hearts in the chests that grow blind

verses.text: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. But Allah will never fail in His promise. And indeed, a day with your Lord is like a thousand years of those which you count.
verses.translation: They challenge you ˹O Prophet˺ to hasten the torment. And Allah will never fail in His promise. But a day with your Lord is indeed like a thousand years by your counting

verses.text: And for how many a city did I prolong enjoyment while it was committing wrong. Then I seized it, and to Me is the [final] destination.
verses.translation: Many are the societies whose end We delayed while they did wrong, then seized them. And to Me is the final return

verses.text: Say, "O people, I am only to you a clear warner."
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “O humanity! I am only sent to you with a clear warning

verses.text: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - for them is forgiveness and noble provision.
verses.translation: So those who believe and do good will have forgiveness and an honourable provision

verses.text: But the ones who strove against Our verses, [seeking] to cause failure - those are the companions of Hellfire.
verses.translation: But those who strive to discredit Our revelations, they will be the residents of the Hellfire.”

verses.text: And We did not send before you any messenger or prophet except that when he spoke [or recited], Satan threw into it [some misunderstanding]. But Allah abolishes that which Satan throws in; then Allah makes precise His verses. And Allah is Knowing and Wise.
verses.translation: Whenever We sent a messenger or a prophet before you ˹O Prophet˺ and he recited ˹Our revelations˺, Satan would influence ˹people’s understanding of˺ his recitation. But ˹eventually˺ Allah would eliminate Satan’s influence. Then Allah would ˹firmly˺ establish His revelations. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise

verses.text: [That is] so He may make what Satan throws in a trial for those within whose hearts is disease and those hard of heart. And indeed, the wrongdoers are in extreme dissension.
verses.translation: All that so He may make Satan’s influence a trial for those ˹hypocrites˺ whose hearts are sick and those ˹disbelievers˺ whose hearts are hardened. Surely the wrongdoers are totally engrossed in opposition

verses.text: And so those who were given knowledge may know that it is the truth from your Lord and [therefore] believe in it, and their hearts humbly submit to it. And indeed is Allah the Guide of those who have believed to a straight path.
verses.translation: ˹This is˺ also so that those gifted with knowledge would know that this ˹revelation˺ is the truth from your Lord, so they have faith in it, and so their hearts would submit humbly to it. And Allah surely guides the believers to the Straight Path

verses.text: But those who disbelieve will not cease to be in doubt of it until the Hour comes upon them unexpectedly or there comes to them the punishment of a barren Day.
verses.translation: Yet the disbelievers will persist in doubt about this ˹revelation˺ until the Hour takes them by surprise, or the torment of a terminating Day comes to them

verses.text: [All] sovereignty that Day is for Allah ; He will judge between them. So they who believed and did righteous deeds will be in the Gardens of Pleasure.
verses.translation: All authority on that Day is for Allah ˹alone˺. He will judge between them. So those who believe and do good will be in the Gardens of Bliss

verses.text: And they who disbelieved and denied Our signs - for those there will be a humiliating punishment.
verses.translation: But those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, it is they who will suffer a humiliating punishment

verses.text: And those who emigrated for the cause of Allah and then were killed or died - Allah will surely provide for them a good provision. And indeed, it is Allah who is the best of providers.
verses.translation: As for those who emigrate in the cause of Allah and then are martyred or die, Allah will indeed grant them a good provision. Surely Allah is the Best Provider

verses.text: He will surely cause them to enter an entrance with which they will be pleased, and indeed, Allah is Knowing and Forbearing.
verses.translation: He will certainly admit them into a place they will be pleased with. For Allah is truly All-Knowing, Most Forbearing

verses.text: That [is so]. And whoever responds [to injustice] with the equivalent of that with which he was harmed and then is tyrannized - Allah will surely aid him. Indeed, Allah is Pardoning and Forgiving.
verses.translation: That is so. And whoever retaliates in equivalence to the injury they have received, and then are wronged ˹again˺, Allah will certainly help them. Surely Allah is Ever-Pardoning, All-Forgiving

verses.text: That is because Allah causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and because Allah is Hearing and Seeing.
verses.translation: That is because Allah causes the night to merge into the day, and the day into the night. Indeed, Allah is All-Hearing, All-Seeing

verses.text: That is because Allah is the Truth, and that which they call upon other than Him is falsehood, and because Allah is the Most High, the Grand.
verses.translation: That is because Allah ˹alone˺ is the Truth and what they invoke besides Him is falsehood, and Allah ˹alone˺ is truly the Most High, All-Great
