verses.translation: And He is the One Who creates human beings from a ˹humble˺ liquid, then establishes for them bonds of kinship and marriage. For your Lord is Most Capable

verses.text: But they worship rather than Allah that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan].
verses.translation: Yet they worship besides Allah what can neither benefit nor harm them. And the disbeliever always collaborates against their Lord

verses.text: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
verses.translation: And We have sent you ˹O Prophet˺ only as a deliverer of good news and a warner

verses.text: Say, "I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way."
verses.translation: Say, “I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺, but whoever wishes, let them pursue the Way to their Lord.”

verses.text: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [ Allah ] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, Acquainted -
verses.translation: Put your trust in the Ever-Living, Who never dies, and glorify His praises. Sufficient is He as All-Aware of the sins of His servants

verses.text: He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed.
verses.translation: ˹He is˺ the One Who created the heavens and the earth and everything in between in six Days, then established Himself on the Throne. ˹He is˺ the Most Compassionate! Ask ˹none other than˺ the All-Knowledgeable about Himself

verses.text: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate to the Most Merciful," they say, "And what is the Most Merciful? Should we prostrate to that which you order us?" And it increases them in aversion.
verses.translation: When it is said to them, “Prostrate to the Most Compassionate,” they ask ˹in disgust˺, “What is ‘the Most Compassionate’? Will we prostrate to whatever you order us to?” And it only drives them farther away

verses.text: Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon.
verses.translation: Blessed is the One Who has placed constellations in the sky, as well as a ˹radiant˺ lamp and a luminous moon

verses.text: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.
verses.translation: And He is the One Who causes the day and the night to alternate, ˹as a sign˺ for whoever desires to be mindful or to be grateful

verses.text: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,
verses.translation: The ˹true˺ servants of the Most Compassionate are those who walk on the earth humbly, and when the foolish address them ˹improperly˺, they only respond with peace

verses.text: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]
verses.translation: ˹They are˺ those who spend ˹a good portion of˺ the night, prostrating themselves and standing before their Lord

verses.text: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;
verses.translation: ˹They are˺ those who pray, “Our Lord! Keep the punishment of Hell away from us, for its punishment is indeed unrelenting

verses.text: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."
verses.translation: It is certainly an evil place to settle and reside.”

verses.text: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate
verses.translation: ˹They are˺ those who spend neither wastefully nor stingily, but moderately in between

verses.text: And those who do not invoke with Allah another deity or kill the soul which Allah has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.
verses.translation: ˹They are˺ those who do not invoke any other god besides Allah, nor take a ˹human˺ life—made sacred by Allah—except with ˹legal˺ right, nor commit fornication. And whoever does ˹any of˺ this will face the penalty

verses.text: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -
verses.translation: Their punishment will be multiplied on the Day of Judgment, and they will remain in it forever, in disgrace

verses.text: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allah will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.translation: As for those who repent, believe, and do good deeds, they are the ones whose evil deeds Allah will change into good deeds. For Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful

verses.text: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allah with [accepted] repentance.
verses.translation: And whoever repents and does good has truly turned to Allah properly

verses.text: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.
verses.translation: ˹They are˺ those who do not bear false witness, and when they come across falsehood, they pass ˹it˺ by with dignity

verses.text: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.
verses.translation: ˹They are˺ those who, when reminded of the revelation of their Lord, do not turn a blind eye or a deaf ear to it

verses.text: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous."
verses.translation: ˹They are˺ those who pray, “Our Lord! Bless us with ˹pious˺ spouses and offspring who will be the joy of our hearts, and make us models for the righteous.”

verses.text: Those will be awarded the Chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace.
verses.translation: It is they who will be rewarded with ˹elevated˺ mansions ˹in Paradise˺ for their perseverance, and will be received with salutations and ˹greetings of˺ peace

verses.text: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.
verses.translation: staying there forever. What an excellent place to settle and reside

verses.text: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?" For you [disbelievers] have denied, so your denial is going to be adherent.
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “You ˹all˺ would not ˹even˺ matter to my Lord were it not for your faith ˹in Him˺. But now you ˹disbelievers˺ have denied ˹the truth˺, so the torment is bound to come.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Ta, Seen, Meem.
verses.translation: Ṭâ-Sĩn-Mĩm

verses.text: These are the verses of the clear Book.
verses.translation: These are the verses of the clear Book

verses.text: Perhaps, [O Muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.
verses.translation: Perhaps you ˹O Prophet˺ will grieve yourself to death over their disbelief

verses.text: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.
verses.translation: If We willed, We could send down upon them a ˹compelling˺ sign from the heavens, leaving their necks bent in ˹utter˺ submission to it

verses.text: And no revelation comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.
verses.translation: Whatever new reminder comes to them from the Most Compassionate, they always turn away from it

verses.text: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.
verses.translation: They have certainly denied ˹the truth˺, so they will soon face the consequences of their ridicule

verses.text: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?
verses.translation: Have they failed to look at the earth, ˹to see˺ how many types of fine plants We have caused to grow in it

verses.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.translation: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe

verses.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.translation: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful

verses.text: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -
verses.translation: ˹Remember˺ when your Lord called out to Moses, “Go to the wrongdoing people—

verses.text: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allah ?"
verses.translation: the people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear ˹Allah˺?”

verses.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me
verses.translation: He replied, “My Lord! I fear that they will reject me

verses.text: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.
verses.translation: And ˹so˺ my heart will be broken and my tongue will be tied. So send Aaron along ˹as a messenger˺

verses.text: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."
verses.translation: Also, they have a charge against me, so I fear they may kill me.”

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.
verses.translation: Allah responded, “Certainly not! So go, both of you, with Our signs. We will be with you, listening

verses.text: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,
verses.translation: Go to Pharaoh and say, ‘We are messengers from the Lord of all worlds

verses.text: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"
verses.translation: ˹commanded to say:˺ ‘Let the Children of Israel go with us.’’”

verses.text: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?
verses.translation: Pharaoh protested, “Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you stayed several years of your life in our care

verses.text: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."
verses.translation: Then you did what you did, being ˹utterly˺ ungrateful!”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray.
verses.translation: Moses replied, “I did it then, lacking guidance

verses.text: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and prophethood and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.
verses.translation: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and made me one of the messengers

verses.text: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
verses.translation: How can that be a ‘favour,’ of which you remind me, when ˹it was only because˺ you ˹have˺ enslaved the Children of Israel?”

verses.text: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"
verses.translation: Pharaoh asked, “And what is ‘the Lord of all worlds’?”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."
verses.translation: Moses replied, “˹He is˺ the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, if only you had sure faith.”

verses.text: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"
verses.translation: Pharaoh said to those around him, “Did you hear ˹what he said˺?”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."
verses.translation: Moses added, “˹He is˺ your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.”

verses.text: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."
verses.translation: Pharaoh said ˹mockingly˺, “Your messenger, who has been sent to you, must be insane.”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."
verses.translation: Moses responded: “˹He is˺ the Lord of the east and west, and everything in between, if only you had any sense.”

verses.text: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."
verses.translation: Pharaoh threatened, “If you take any other god besides me, I will certainly have you imprisoned.”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you proof manifest?"
verses.translation: Moses responded, “Even if I bring you a clear proof?”

verses.text: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."
verses.translation: Pharaoh demanded, “Bring it then, if what you say is true.”

verses.text: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.
verses.translation: So he threw down his staff and—behold!—it became a real snake

verses.text: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.
verses.translation: Then he drew his hand ˹out of his collar˺ and it was ˹shining˺ white for all to see

verses.text: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.
verses.translation: Pharaoh said to the chiefs around him, “He is indeed a skilled magician

verses.text: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"
verses.translation: who seeks to drive you from your land by his magic. So what do you propose?”

verses.text: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
verses.translation: They replied, “Let him and his brother wait and dispatch mobilizers to all cities

verses.text: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."
verses.translation: to bring you every skilled magician.”

verses.text: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.
verses.translation: So the magicians were assembled at the set time on the appointed day

verses.text: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate
verses.translation: And the people were asked, “Will you join the gathering

verses.text: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"
verses.translation: so that we may follow the magicians if they prevail?”

verses.text: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"
verses.translation: When the magicians came, they asked Pharaoh, “Shall we have a ˹suitable˺ reward if we prevail?”

verses.text: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."
verses.translation: He replied, “Yes, and you will then certainly be among those closest to me.”

verses.text: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."
verses.translation: Moses said to them, “Cast whatever you wish to cast.”

verses.text: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."
verses.translation: So they cast down their ropes and staffs, saying, “By Pharaoh’s might, it is we who will surely prevail.”

verses.text: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.
verses.translation: Then Moses threw down his staff, and—behold!—it devoured the objects of their illusion

verses.text: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah ].
verses.translation: So the magicians fell down, prostrating

verses.text: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
verses.translation: They declared, “We ˹now˺ believe in the Lord of all worlds—

verses.text: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
verses.translation: the Lord of Moses and Aaron.”

verses.text: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed Moses before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."
verses.translation: Pharaoh threatened, “How dare you believe in him before I give you permission? He must be your master who taught you magic, but soon you will see. I will certainly cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, then crucify you all.”

verses.text: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.
verses.translation: They responded, “˹That would be˺ no harm! Surely to our Lord we will ˹all˺ return

verses.text: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."
verses.translation: We really hope that our Lord will forgive our sins, as we are the first to believe.”

verses.text: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."
verses.translation: And We inspired Moses, ˹saying,˺ “Leave with My servants at night, for you will surely be pursued.”

verses.text: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers
verses.translation: Then Pharaoh sent mobilizers to all cities

verses.text: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,
verses.translation: ˹and said,˺ “These ˹outcasts˺ are just a handful of people

verses.text: And indeed, they are enraging us,
verses.translation: who have really enraged us

verses.text: And indeed, we are a cautious society... "
verses.translation: but we are all on the alert.”

verses.text: So We removed them from gardens and springs
verses.translation: So We lured the tyrants out of ˹their˺ gardens, springs

verses.text: And treasures and honorable station -
verses.translation: treasures, and splendid residences

verses.text: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.
verses.translation: So it was. And We awarded it ˹all˺ to the Children of Israel

verses.text: So they pursued them at sunrise.
verses.translation: And so they pursued them at sunrise

verses.text: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"
verses.translation: When the two groups came face to face, the companions of Moses cried out, “We are overtaken for sure.”

verses.text: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."
verses.translation: Moses reassured ˹them˺, “Absolutely not! My Lord is certainly with me—He will guide me.”

verses.text: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.
verses.translation: So We inspired Moses: “Strike the sea with your staff,” and the sea was split, each part was like a huge mountain

verses.text: And We advanced thereto the pursuers.
verses.translation: We drew the pursuers to that place

verses.text: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.
verses.translation: and delivered Moses and those with him all together

verses.text: Then We drowned the others.
verses.translation: Then We drowned the others

verses.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.translation: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe

verses.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.translation: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful

verses.text: And recite to them the news of Abraham,
verses.translation: Relate to them ˹O Prophet˺ the story of Abraham

verses.text: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"
verses.translation: when he questioned his father and his people, “What is that you worship ˹besides Allah˺?”

verses.text: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."
verses.translation: They replied, “We worship idols, to which we are fully devoted.”

verses.text: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?
verses.translation: Abraham asked, “Can they hear you when you call upon them

verses.text: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"
verses.translation: Or can they benefit or harm you?”

verses.text: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."
verses.translation: They replied, “No! But we found our forefathers doing the same.”

verses.text: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,
verses.translation: Abraham responded, “Have you ˹really˺ considered what you have been worshipping—

verses.text: You and your ancient forefathers?
verses.translation: you and your ancestors

verses.text: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,
verses.translation: They are ˹all˺ enemies to me, except the Lord of all worlds

verses.text: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.
verses.translation: ˹He is˺ the One Who created me, and He ˹alone˺ guides me

verses.text: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.
verses.translation: ˹He is˺ the One Who provides me with food and drink

verses.text: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
verses.translation: And He ˹alone˺ heals me when I am sick

verses.text: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life
verses.translation: And He ˹is the One Who˺ will cause me to die, and then bring me back to life

verses.text: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."
verses.translation: And He is ˹the One˺ Who, I hope, will forgive my flaws on Judgment Day.”

verses.text: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.
verses.translation: “My Lord! Grant me wisdom, and join me with the righteous

verses.text: And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations.
verses.translation: Bless me with honourable mention among later generations

verses.text: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.
verses.translation: Make me one of those awarded the Garden of Bliss

verses.text: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.
verses.translation: Forgive my father, for he is certainly one of the misguided

verses.text: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -
verses.translation: And do not disgrace me on the Day all will be resurrected—

verses.text: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children
verses.translation: the Day when neither wealth nor children will be of any benefit

verses.text: But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart."
verses.translation: Only those who come before Allah with a pure heart ˹will be saved˺.”

verses.text: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.
verses.translation: ˹On that Day˺ Paradise will be brought near to the God-fearing

verses.text: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,
verses.translation: and the Hellfire will be displayed to the deviant

verses.text: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship
verses.translation: And it will be said to them, “Where are those you used to worship

verses.text: Other than Allah ? Can they help you or help themselves?"
verses.translation: besides Allah? Can they help you or even help themselves?”

verses.text: So they will be overturned into Hellfire, they and the deviators
verses.translation: Then the idols will be hurled headlong into Hell, along with the deviant

verses.text: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.
verses.translation: and the soldiers of Iblîs, all together

verses.text: They will say while they dispute therein,
verses.translation: There the deviant will cry while disputing with their idols

verses.text: "By Allah , we were indeed in manifest error
verses.translation: “By Allah! We were clearly mistaken

verses.text: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: when we made you equal to the Lord of all worlds

verses.text: And no one misguided us except the criminals.
verses.translation: And none led us astray other than the wicked

verses.text: So now we have no intercessors
verses.translation: Now we have none to intercede for us

verses.text: And not a devoted friend.
verses.translation: nor a close friend

verses.text: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers... "
verses.translation: If only we could have a second chance, then we would be believers.”

verses.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.translation: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe

verses.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.translation: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful

verses.text: The people of Noah denied the messengers
verses.translation: The people of Noah rejected the messengers

verses.text: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allah ?
verses.translation: when their brother Noah said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺

verses.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
verses.translation: I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you

verses.text: So fear Allah and obey me.
verses.translation: So fear Allah, and obey me

verses.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds

verses.text: So fear Allah and obey me."
verses.translation: So fear Allah, and obey me.”

verses.text: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"
verses.translation: They argued, “How can we believe in you, when you are followed ˹only˺ by the lowest of the low?”

verses.text: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?
verses.translation: He responded, “And what knowledge do I have of what they do

verses.text: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.
verses.translation: Their judgment is with my Lord, if you had any sense

verses.text: And I am not one to drive away the believers.
verses.translation: I am not going to expel the believers

verses.text: I am only a clear warner."
verses.translation: I am only sent with a clear warning.”

verses.text: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."
verses.translation: They threatened, “If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be stoned ˹to death˺.”

verses.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.
verses.translation: Noah prayed, “My Lord! My people have truly rejected me

verses.text: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."
verses.translation: So judge between me and them decisively, and save me and the believers with me.”

verses.text: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
verses.translation: So We saved him and those with him in the fully loaded Ark

verses.text: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.
verses.translation: Then afterwards We drowned the rest

verses.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.translation: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe

verses.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.translation: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful

verses.text: 'Aad denied the messengers
verses.translation: The people of ’Âd rejected the messengers

verses.text: When their brother Hud said to them, "Will you not fear Allah ?
verses.translation: when their brother Hûd said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺

verses.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
verses.translation: I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you

verses.text: So fear Allah and obey me.
verses.translation: So fear Allah, and obey me

verses.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds

verses.text: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves,
verses.translation: ˹Why˺ do you build a landmark on every high place in vanity

verses.text: And take for yourselves palaces and fortresses that you might abide eternally?
verses.translation: and construct castles, as if you are going to live forever

verses.text: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.
verses.translation: and act so viciously when you attack ˹others˺

verses.text: So fear Allah and obey me.
verses.translation: So fear Allah, and obey me

verses.text: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,
verses.translation: Fear the One Who has provided you with ˹the good˺ things you know

verses.text: Provided you with grazing livestock and children
verses.translation: He provided you with cattle, and children

verses.text: And gardens and springs.
verses.translation: and gardens, and springs

verses.text: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
verses.translation: I truly fear for you the torment of a tremendous day.”

verses.text: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.
verses.translation: They responded, “It is all the same to us whether you warn ˹us˺ or not

verses.text: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,
verses.translation: This is simply the tradition of our predecessors

verses.text: And we are not to be punished."
verses.translation: And we will never be punished.”

verses.text: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.translation: So they rejected him, and ˹so˺ We destroyed them. Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe

verses.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.translation: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful

verses.text: Thamud denied the messengers
verses.translation: The people of Thamûd rejected the messengers

verses.text: When their brother Salih said to them, "Will you not fear Allah ?
verses.translation: when their brother Ṣâliḥ said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺

verses.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
verses.translation: I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you

verses.text: So fear Allah and obey me.
verses.translation: So fear Allah, and obey me

verses.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds

verses.text: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],
verses.translation: Do you think you will be ˹forever˺ left secure in what you have here

verses.text: Within gardens and springs
verses.translation: amid gardens and springs

verses.text: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?
verses.translation: and ˹various˺ crops, and palm trees ˹loaded˺ with tender fruit

verses.text: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.
verses.translation: to carve homes in the mountains with great skill

verses.text: So fear Allah and obey me.
verses.translation: So fear Allah, and obey me

verses.text: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,
verses.translation: And do not follow the command of the transgressors

verses.text: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."
verses.translation: who spread corruption throughout the land, never setting things right.”

verses.text: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
verses.translation: They replied, “You are simply bewitched

verses.text: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."
verses.translation: You are only a human being like us, so bring forth a sign if what you say is true.”

verses.text: He said, "This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.
verses.translation: Ṣâliḥ said, “Here is a camel. She will have her turn to drink as you have yours, each on an appointed day

verses.text: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."
verses.translation: And do not ever touch her with harm, or you will be overtaken by the torment of a tremendous day.”

verses.text: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.
verses.translation: But they killed her, becoming regretful

verses.text: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.translation: So the punishment overtook them. Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe

verses.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.translation: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful

verses.text: The people of Lot denied the messengers
verses.translation: The people of Lot rejected the messengers

verses.text: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allah ?
verses.translation: when their brother Lot said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺

verses.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
verses.translation: I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you

verses.text: So fear Allah and obey me.
verses.translation: So fear Allah, and obey me

verses.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds

verses.text: Do you approach males among the worlds
verses.translation: Why do you ˹men˺ lust after fellow men

verses.text: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."
verses.translation: leaving the wives that your Lord has created for you? In fact, you are a transgressing people.”

verses.text: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."
verses.translation: They threatened, “If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be expelled.”

verses.text: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].
verses.translation: Lot responded, “I am truly one of those who despise your ˹shameful˺ practice

verses.text: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do."
verses.translation: My Lord! Save me and my family from ˹the consequences of˺ what they do.”

verses.text: So We saved him and his family, all,
verses.translation: So We saved him and all of his family

verses.text: Except an old woman among those who remained behind.
verses.translation: except an old woman, who was one of the doomed

verses.text: Then We destroyed the others.
verses.translation: Then We utterly destroyed the rest

verses.text: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
verses.translation: pouring upon them a rain ˹of brimstone˺. How evil was the rain of those who had been warned

verses.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.translation: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe

verses.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.translation: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful

verses.text: The companions of the thicket denied the messengers
verses.translation: The residents of the Forest rejected the messengers

verses.text: When Shu'ayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allah ?
verses.translation: when Shu’aib said to them, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺

verses.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
verses.translation: I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you

verses.text: So fear Allah and obey me.
verses.translation: So fear Allah, and obey me

verses.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹message˺. My reward is only from the Lord of all worlds

verses.text: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.
verses.translation: Give full measure, and cause no loss ˹to others˺

verses.text: And weigh with an even balance.
verses.translation: Weigh with an even balance

verses.text: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.
verses.translation: and do not defraud people of their property. Nor go about spreading corruption in the land

verses.text: And fear He who created you and the former creation."
verses.translation: And fear the One Who created you and ˹all˺ earlier peoples.”

verses.text: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
verses.translation: They replied, “You are simply bewitched

verses.text: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.
verses.translation: Also, you are only a human being like us, and we think you are indeed a liar

verses.text: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."
verses.translation: So cause ˹deadly˺ pieces of the sky to fall upon us, if what you say is true.”

verses.text: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."
verses.translation: Shu’aib responded, “My Lord knows best whatever you do.”

verses.text: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.
verses.translation: So they rejected him, and ˹so˺ were overtaken by the torment of the day of the ˹deadly˺ cloud. That was really a torment of a tremendous day

verses.text: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
verses.translation: Surely in this is a sign. Yet most of them would not believe

verses.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.translation: And your Lord is certainly the Almighty, Most Merciful

verses.text: And indeed, the Qur'an is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: This is certainly a revelation from the Lord of all worlds

verses.text: The Trustworthy Spirit has brought it down
verses.translation: which the trustworthy spirit ˹Gabriel˺ brought down

verses.text: Upon your heart, [O Muhammad] - that you may be of the warners -
verses.translation: into your heart ˹O Prophet˺—so that you may be one of the warners—

verses.text: In a clear Arabic language.
verses.translation: in a clear Arabic tongue

verses.text: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.
verses.translation: And it has indeed been ˹foretold˺ in the Scriptures of those before

verses.text: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?
verses.translation: Was it not sufficient proof for the deniers that it has been recognized by the knowledgeable among the Children of Israel

verses.text: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners
verses.translation: Had We revealed it to a non-Arab

verses.text: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it.
verses.translation: who would then recite it to the deniers ˹in fluent Arabic˺, still they would not have believed in it

verses.text: Thus have We inserted disbelief into the hearts of the criminals.
verses.translation: This is how We allow denial ˹to steep˺ into the hearts of the wicked

verses.text: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.
verses.translation: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment

verses.text: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.
verses.translation: which will take them by surprise when they least expect ˹it˺

verses.text: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"
verses.translation: Then they will cry, “Can we be allowed more time?”

verses.text: So for Our punishment are they impatient?
verses.translation: Do they ˹really˺ seek to hasten Our torment

verses.text: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
verses.translation: Imagine ˹O Prophet˺ if We allowed them enjoyment for years

verses.text: And then there came to them that which they were promised?
verses.translation: then there came to them what they had been threatened with

verses.text: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.
verses.translation: would that enjoyment be of any benefit to them ˹at all˺

verses.text: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners
verses.translation: We have never destroyed a society without warners

verses.text: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.
verses.translation: to remind ˹them˺, for We would never wrong ˹anyone˺

verses.text: And the devils have not brought the revelation down.
verses.translation: It was not the devils who brought this ˹Quran˺ down

verses.text: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.
verses.translation: it is not for them ˹to do so˺, nor can they

verses.text: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.
verses.translation: for they are strictly barred from ˹even˺ overhearing ˹it˺

verses.text: So do not invoke with Allah another deity and [thus] be among the punished.
verses.translation: So do not ever call upon any other god besides Allah, or you will be one of the punished

verses.text: And warn, [O Muhammad], your closest kindred.
verses.translation: And warn ˹all, starting with˺ your closest relatives

verses.text: And lower your wing to those who follow you of the believers.
verses.translation: and be gracious to the believers who follow you

verses.text: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."
verses.translation: But if they disobey you, say, “I am certainly free of what you do.”

verses.text: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
verses.translation: Put your trust in the Almighty, Most Merciful

verses.text: Who sees you when you arise
verses.translation: Who sees you when you rise ˹for prayer at night˺

verses.text: And your movement among those who prostrate.
verses.translation: as well as your movements ˹in prayer˺ along with ˹fellow˺ worshippers

verses.text: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
verses.translation: He ˹alone˺ is indeed the All-Hearing, All-Knowing

verses.text: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
verses.translation: Shall I inform you of whom the devils ˹actually˺ descend upon

verses.text: They descend upon every sinful liar.
verses.translation: They descend upon every sinful liar

verses.text: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.
verses.translation: who gives an ˹attentive˺ ear ˹to half-truths˺, mostly passing on sheer lies

verses.text: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;
verses.translation: As for poets, they are followed ˹merely˺ by deviants

verses.text: Do you not see that in every valley they roam
verses.translation: Do you not see how they rant in every field

verses.text: And that they say what they do not do? -
verses.translation: only saying what they never do

verses.text: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
verses.translation: Except those who believe, do good, remember Allah often, and ˹poetically˺ avenge ˹the believers˺ after being wrongfully slandered. The wrongdoers will come to know what ˹evil˺ end they will meet

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Ta, Seen. These are the verses of the Qur'an and a clear Book
verses.translation: Ṭâ-Sĩn. These are the verses of the Quran; the clear Book

verses.text: As guidance and good tidings for the believers
verses.translation: ˹It is˺ a guide and good news for the believers

verses.text: Who establish prayer and give zakah, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].
verses.translation: ˹those˺ who establish prayer, pay alms-tax, and have sure faith in the Hereafter

verses.text: Indeed, for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made pleasing to them their deeds, so they wander blindly.
verses.translation: As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have certainly made their ˹evil˺ deeds appealing to them, so they wander blindly

verses.text: Those are the ones for whom there will be the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers.
verses.translation: It is they who will suffer a dreadful torment, and in the Hereafter they will ˹truly˺ be the greatest losers

verses.text: And indeed, [O Muhammad], you receive the Qur'an from one Wise and Knowing.
verses.translation: And indeed, you ˹O Prophet˺ are receiving the Quran from the One ˹Who is˺ All-Wise, All-Knowing

verses.text: [Mention] when Moses said to his family, "Indeed, I have perceived a fire. I will bring you from there information or will bring you a burning torch that you may warm yourselves."
verses.translation: ˹Remember˺ when Moses said to his family, “I have spotted a fire. I will either bring you some directions from there, or a burning torch so you may warm yourselves.”

verses.text: But when he came to it, he was called, "Blessed is whoever is at the fire and whoever is around it. And exalted is Allah , Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: But when he came to it, he was called ˹by Allah˺, “Blessed is the one at the fire, and whoever is around it! Glory be to Allah, the Lord of all worlds

verses.text: O Moses, indeed it is I - Allah , the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
verses.translation: O Moses! It is truly I. I am Allah—the Almighty, All-Wise

verses.text: And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it were a snake, he turned in flight and did not return. [ Allah said], "O Moses, fear not. Indeed, in My presence the messengers do not fear.
verses.translation: Now, throw down your staff!” But when he saw it slithering like a snake, he ran away without looking back. ˹Allah reassured him,˺ “O Moses! Do not be afraid! Messengers should have no fear in My presence

verses.text: Otherwise, he who wrongs, then substitutes good after evil - indeed, I am Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.translation: ˹Fear is˺ only for those who do wrong. But if they later mend ˹their˺ evil ˹ways˺ with good, then I am certainly All-Forgiving, Most Merciful

verses.text: And put your hand into the opening of your garment [at the breast]; it will come out white without disease. [These are] among the nine signs [you will take] to Pharaoh and his people. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."
verses.translation: Now put your hand through ˹the opening of˺ your collar, it will come out ˹shining˺ white, unblemished. ˹These are two˺ of nine signs for Pharaoh and his people. They have truly been a rebellious people.”

verses.text: But when there came to them Our visible signs, they said, "This is obvious magic."
verses.translation: But when Our enlightening signs came to them, they said, “This is pure magic.”

verses.text: And they rejected them, while their [inner] selves were convinced thereof, out of injustice and haughtiness. So see how was the end of the corrupters.
verses.translation: And, although their hearts were convinced the signs were true, they still denied them wrongfully and arrogantly. See then what was the end of the corruptors

verses.text: And We had certainly given to David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, "Praise [is due] to Allah , who has favored us over many of His believing servants."
verses.translation: Indeed, We granted knowledge to David and Solomon. And they said ˹in acknowledgment˺, “All praise is for Allah Who has privileged us over many of His faithful servants.”

verses.text: And Solomon inherited David. He said, "O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. Indeed, this is evident bounty."
verses.translation: And David was succeeded by Solomon, who said, “O people! We have been taught the language of birds, and been given everything ˹we need˺. This is indeed a great privilege.”

verses.text: And gathered for Solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows.
verses.translation: Solomon’s forces of jinn, humans, and birds were rallied for him, perfectly organized

verses.text: Until, when they came upon the valley of the ants, an ant said, "O ants, enter your dwellings that you not be crushed by Solomon and his soldiers while they perceive not."
verses.translation: And when they came across a valley of ants, an ant warned, “O ants! Go quickly into your homes so Solomon and his armies do not crush you, unknowingly.”

verses.text: So [Solomon] smiled, amused at her speech, and said, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants."
verses.translation: So Solomon smiled in amusement at her words, and prayed, “My Lord! Inspire me to ˹always˺ be thankful for Your favours which You have blessed me and my parents with, and to do good deeds that please you. Admit me, by Your mercy, into ˹the company of˺ Your righteous servants.”

verses.text: And he took attendance of the birds and said, "Why do I not see the hoopoe - or is he among the absent?
verses.translation: ˹One day˺ he inspected the birds, and wondered, “Why is it that I cannot see the hoopoe? Or could he be absent

verses.text: I will surely punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings me clear authorization."
verses.translation: I will surely subject him to a severe punishment, or ˹even˺ slaughter him, unless he brings me a compelling excuse.”

verses.text: But the hoopoe stayed not long and said, "I have encompassed [in knowledge] that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news.
verses.translation: It was not long before the bird came and said, “I have found out something you do not know. I have just come to you from Sheba with sure news

verses.text: Indeed, I found [there] a woman ruling them, and she has been given of all things, and she has a great throne.
verses.translation: Indeed, I found a woman ruling over them, who has been given everything ˹she needs˺, and who has a magnificent throne

verses.text: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allah , and Satan has made their deeds pleasing to them and averted them from [His] way, so they are not guided,
verses.translation: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allah. For Satan has made their deeds appealing to them—hindering them from the ˹Right˺ Way and leaving them unguided—

verses.text: [And] so they do not prostrate to Allah , who brings forth what is hidden within the heavens and the earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare -
verses.translation: so they do not prostrate to Allah, Who brings forth what is hidden in the heavens and the earth, and knows what you ˹all˺ conceal and what you reveal

verses.text: Allah - there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Great Throne."
verses.translation: ˹He is˺ Allah! There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him, the Lord of the Mighty Throne.”

verses.text: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars.
verses.translation: Solomon said, “We will see whether you are telling the truth or lying

verses.text: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then leave them and see what [answer] they will return."
verses.translation: Go with this letter of mine and deliver it to them, then stand aside and see how they will respond.”

verses.text: She said, "O eminent ones, indeed, to me has been delivered a noble letter.
verses.translation: The Queen ˹later˺ announced, “O chiefs! Indeed, a noble letter has been delivered to me

verses.text: Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it reads: 'In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,
verses.translation: It is from Solomon, and it reads: ‘In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful

verses.text: Be not haughty with me but come to me in submission [as Muslims].' "
verses.translation: Do not be arrogant with me, but come to me, fully submitting ˹to Allah˺.’”

verses.text: She said, "O eminent ones, advise me in my affair. I would not decide a matter until you witness [for] me."
verses.translation: She said, “O chiefs! Advise me in this matter of mine, for I would never make any decision without you.”

verses.text: They said, "We are men of strength and of great military might, but the command is yours, so see what you will command."
verses.translation: They responded, “We are a people of strength and great ˹military˺ might, but the decision is yours, so decide what you will command.”

verses.text: She said, "Indeed kings - when they enter a city, they ruin it and render the honored of its people humbled. And thus do they do.
verses.translation: She reasoned, “Indeed, when kings invade a land, they ruin it and debase its nobles. They really do so

verses.text: But indeed, I will send to them a gift and see with what [reply] the messengers will return."
verses.translation: But I will certainly send him a gift, and see what ˹response˺ my envoys will return with.”

verses.text: So when they came to Solomon, he said, "Do you provide me with wealth? But what Allah has given me is better than what He has given you. Rather, it is you who rejoice in your gift.
verses.translation: When the chief-envoy came to him, Solomon said, “Do you offer me wealth? What Allah has granted me is far greater than what He has granted you. No! It is you who rejoice in ˹receiving˺ gifts

verses.text: Return to them, for we will surely come to them with soldiers that they will be powerless to encounter, and we will surely expel them therefrom in humiliation, and they will be debased."
verses.translation: Go back to them, for we will certainly mobilize against them forces which they can never resist, and we will drive them out from there in disgrace, fully humbled.”

verses.text: [Solomon] said, "O assembly [of jinn], which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?"
verses.translation: Solomon asked, “O chiefs! Which of you can bring me her throne before they come to me in ˹full˺ submission?”

verses.text: A powerful one from among the jinn said, "I will bring it to you before you rise from your place, and indeed, I am for this [task] strong and trustworthy."
verses.translation: One mighty jinn responded, “I can bring it to you before you rise from this council of yours. And I am quite strong and trustworthy for this ˹task˺.”

verses.text: Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous."
verses.translation: But the one who had knowledge of the Scripture said, “I can bring it to you in the blink of an eye.” So when Solomon saw it placed before him, he exclaimed, “This is by the grace of my Lord to test me whether I am grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful, it is only for their own good. But whoever is ungrateful, surely my Lord is Self-Sufficient, Most Generous.”

verses.text: He said, "Disguise for her her throne; we will see whether she will be guided [to truth] or will be of those who is not guided."
verses.translation: ˹Then˺ Solomon said, “Disguise her throne for her so we may see whether she will recognize ˹it˺ or she will not be able to.”

verses.text: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allah ].
verses.translation: So when she arrived, it was said ˹to her˺, “Is your throne like this?” She replied, “It looks to be the same. We have ˹already˺ received knowledge ˹of Solomon’s prophethood˺ before this ˹miracle˺, and have submitted ˹to Allah˺.”

verses.text: And that which she was worshipping other than Allah had averted her [from submission to Him]. Indeed, she was from a disbelieving people."
verses.translation: But she had been hindered by what she used to worship instead of Allah, for she was indeed from a disbelieving people

verses.text: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah , Lord of the worlds."
verses.translation: Then she was told, “Enter the palace.” But when she saw the hall, she thought it was a body of water, so she bared her legs. Solomon said. “It is just a palace paved with crystal.” ˹At last˺ she declared, “My Lord! I have certainly wronged my soul. Now I ˹fully˺ submit myself along with Solomon to Allah, the Lord of all worlds.”

verses.text: And We had certainly sent to Thamud their brother Salih, [saying], "Worship Allah ," and at once they were two parties conflicting.
verses.translation: And We certainly sent to the people of Thamûd their brother Ṣâliḥ, proclaiming, “Worship Allah,” but they suddenly split into two opposing groups

verses.text: He said, "O my people, why are you impatient for evil instead of good? Why do you not seek forgiveness of Allah that you may receive mercy?"
verses.translation: He urged ˹the disbelieving group˺, “O my people! Why do you ˹seek to˺ hasten the torment rather than grace? If only you sought Allah’s forgiveness so you may be shown mercy!”

verses.text: They said, "We consider you a bad omen, you and those with you." He said, "Your omen is with Allah . Rather, you are a people being tested."
verses.translation: They replied, “You and your followers are a bad omen for us.” He responded, “Your omens are destined by Allah. In fact, you are ˹only˺ a people being tested.”

verses.text: And there were in the city nine family heads causing corruption in the land and not amending [its affairs].
verses.translation: And there were in the city nine ˹elite˺ men who spread corruption in the land, never doing what is right

verses.text: They said, "Take a mutual oath by Allah that we will kill him by night, he and his family. Then we will say to his executor, 'We did not witness the destruction of his family, and indeed, we are truthful.' "
verses.translation: They vowed, “Let us swear by Allah that we will take him and his family down by night. Then we will certainly say to his ˹closest˺ heirs, ‘We did not witness the murder of his family. We are definitely telling the truth.’”

verses.text: And they planned a plan, and We planned a plan, while they perceived not.
verses.translation: And ˹so˺ they made a plan, but We too made a plan, while they were unaware

verses.text: Then look how was the outcome of their plan - that We destroyed them and their people, all.
verses.translation: See then what the consequences of their plan were: We ˹utterly˺ destroyed them and their people all together

verses.text: So those are their houses, desolate because of the wrong they had done. Indeed in that is a sign for people who know.
verses.translation: So their homes are there, ˹but completely˺ ruined because of their wrongdoing. Surely in this is a lesson for people of knowledge

verses.text: And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allah .
verses.translation: And We delivered those who were faithful and were mindful ˹of Allah˺

verses.text: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Do you commit immorality while you are seeing?
verses.translation: And ˹remember˺ Lot, when he rebuked ˹the men of˺ his people, “Do you commit that shameful deed while you can see ˹one another˺

verses.text: Do you indeed approach men with desire instead of women? Rather, you are a people behaving ignorantly."
verses.translation: Do you really lust after men instead of women? In fact, you are ˹only˺ a people acting ignorantly.”

verses.text: But the answer of his people was not except that they said, "Expel the family of Lot from your city. Indeed, they are people who keep themselves pure."
verses.translation: But his people’s only response was to say, “Expel Lot’s followers from your land! They are a people who wish to remain chaste!”

verses.text: So We saved him and his family, except for his wife; We destined her to be of those who remained behind.
verses.translation: So We delivered him and his family, except his wife. We had destined her to be one of the doomed

verses.text: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
verses.translation: And We poured upon them a rain ˹of brimstone˺. How evil was the rain of those who had been warned

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "Praise be to Allah , and peace upon His servants whom He has chosen. Is Allah better or what they associate with Him?"
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Praise be to Allah, and peace be upon the servants He has chosen.” ˹Ask the disbelievers,˺ “Which is better: Allah or whatever ˹gods˺ they associate ˹with Him˺?”

verses.text: [More precisely], is He [not best] who created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you rain from the sky, causing to grow thereby gardens of joyful beauty which you could not [otherwise] have grown the trees thereof? Is there a deity with Allah ? [No], but they are a people who ascribe equals [to Him].
verses.translation: Or ˹ask them,˺ “Who created the heavens and the earth, and sends down rain for you from the sky, by which We cause delightful gardens to grow? You could never cause their trees to grow. Was it another god besides Allah?” Absolutely not! But they are a people who set up equals ˹to Allah˺

verses.text: Is He [not best] who made the earth a stable ground and placed within it rivers and made for it firmly set mountains and placed between the two seas a barrier? Is there a deity with Allah ? [No], but most of them do not know.
verses.translation: Or ˹ask them,˺ “Who made the earth a place of settlement, caused rivers to flow through it, placed firm mountains upon it, and set a barrier between ˹fresh and salt˺ bodies of water? Was it another god besides Allah?” Absolutely not! But most of them do not know

verses.text: Is He [not best] who responds to the desperate one when he calls upon Him and removes evil and makes you inheritors of the earth? Is there a deity with Allah ? Little do you remember.
verses.translation: Or ˹ask them,˺ “Who responds to the distressed when they cry to Him, relieving ˹their˺ affliction, and ˹Who˺ makes you successors in the earth? Is it another god besides Allah? Yet you are hardly mindful!”

verses.text: Is He [not best] who guides you through the darknesses of the land and sea and who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy? Is there a deity with Allah ? High is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.
verses.translation: Or ˹ask them,˺ “Who guides you in the darkness of the land and sea, and sends the winds ushering in His mercy? Is it another god besides Allah? Exalted is Allah above what they associate ˹with Him˺

verses.text: Is He [not best] who begins creation and then repeats it and who provides for you from the heaven and earth? Is there a deity with Allah ? Say, "Produce your proof, if you should be truthful."
verses.translation: Or ˹ask them,˺ “Who originates the creation then resurrects it, and gives you provisions from the heavens and the earth? Is it another god besides Allah?” Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Show ˹me˺ your proof, if what you say is true.”

verses.text: Say, "None in the heavens and earth knows the unseen except Allah , and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected."
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “None in the heavens and the earth has knowledge of the unseen except Allah. Nor do they know when they will be resurrected

verses.text: Rather, their knowledge is arrested concerning the Hereafter. Rather, they are in doubt about it. Rather, they are, concerning it, blind.
verses.translation: No! Their knowledge of the Hereafter amounts to ignorance. In fact, they are in doubt about it. In truth, they are ˹totally˺ blind to it

verses.text: And those who disbelieve say, "When we have become dust as well as our forefathers, will we indeed be brought out [of the graves]?
verses.translation: The disbelievers ask, “When we and our fathers are reduced to dust, will we really be brought forth ˹alive˺

verses.text: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before. This is not but legends of the former peoples."
verses.translation: We have already been promised this, as well as our forefathers earlier. This is nothing but ancient fables!”

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "Travel through the land and observe how was the end of the criminals."
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Travel throughout the land and see the fate of the wicked.”

verses.text: And grieve not over them or be in distress from what they conspire.
verses.translation: Do not grieve for them, nor be distressed by their schemes

verses.text: And they say, "When is [the fulfillment of] this promise, if you should be truthful?"
verses.translation: They ask ˹the believers˺, “When will this threat come to pass, if what you say is true?”

verses.text: Say, "Perhaps it is close behind you - some of that for which you are impatient.
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Perhaps some of what you seek to hasten is close at hand.”

verses.text: And indeed, your Lord is full of bounty for the people, but most of them do not show gratitude."
verses.translation: Surely your Lord is ever Bountiful to humanity, but most of them are ungrateful

verses.text: And indeed, your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare.
verses.translation: And surely your Lord knows what their hearts conceal and what they reveal

verses.text: And there is nothing concealed within the heaven and the earth except that it is in a clear Register.
verses.translation: For there is nothing hidden in the heavens or the earth without being ˹written˺ in a perfect Record

verses.text: Indeed, this Qur'an relates to the Children of Israel most of that over which they disagree.
verses.translation: Indeed, this Quran clarifies for the Children of Israel most of what they differ over

verses.text: And indeed, it is guidance and mercy for the believers.
verses.translation: And it is truly a guide and mercy for the believers

verses.text: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them by His [wise] judgement. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
verses.translation: Your Lord will certainly judge between them by His justice, for He is the Almighty, All-Knowing

verses.text: So rely upon Allah ; indeed, you are upon the clear truth.
verses.translation: So put your trust in Allah, for you are surely upon the ˹Path of˺ clear truth

verses.text: Indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they have turned their backs retreating.
verses.translation: You certainly cannot make the dead hear ˹the truth˺. Nor can you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs and walk away

verses.text: And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [submitting to Allah ].
verses.translation: Nor can you lead the blind out of their misguidance. You can make none hear ˹the truth˺ except those who believe in Our revelations, ˹fully˺ submitting ˹to Allah˺

verses.text: And when the word befalls them, We will bring forth for them a creature from the earth speaking to them, [saying] that the people were, of Our verses, not certain [in faith].
verses.translation: And when the decree ˹of the Hour˺ comes to pass against them, We will bring forth for them a beast from the earth, telling them that the people had no sure faith in Our revelations

verses.text: And [warn of] the Day when We will gather from every nation a company of those who deny Our signs, and they will be [driven] in rows
verses.translation: ˹Watch for˺ the Day We will gather from every faith-community a group of those who denied Our revelations, and they will be driven in ranks

verses.text: Until, when they arrive [at the place of Judgement], He will say, "Did you deny My signs while you encompassed them not in knowledge, or what [was it that] you were doing?"
verses.translation: When they ˹finally˺ come before their Lord, He will ask ˹them˺, “Did you deny My revelations without ˹even˺ comprehending them? Or what ˹exactly˺ did you do?”

verses.text: And the decree will befall them for the wrong they did, and they will not [be able to] speak.
verses.translation: And the decree ˹of torment˺ will be justified against them for their wrongdoing, leaving them speechless

verses.text: Do they not see that We made the night that they may rest therein and the day giving sight? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
verses.translation: Do they not see that We made the night for them to rest in and the day bright? Surely in this are signs for those who believe

verses.text: And [warn of] the Day the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will be terrified except whom Allah wills. And all will come to Him humbled.
verses.translation: And ˹beware of˺ the Day the Trumpet will be blown, and all those in the heavens and all those on the earth will be horrified ˹to the point of death˺, except those Allah wills ˹to spare˺. And all will come before Him, fully humbled

verses.text: And you see the mountains, thinking them rigid, while they will pass as the passing of clouds. [It is] the work of Allah , who perfected all things. Indeed, He is Acquainted with that which you do.
verses.translation: Now you see the mountains, thinking they are firmly fixed, but they are travelling ˹just˺ like clouds. ˹That is˺ the design of Allah, Who has perfected everything. Surely He is All-Aware of what you do

verses.text: Whoever comes [at Judgement] with a good deed will have better than it, and they, from the terror of that Day, will be safe.
verses.translation: Whoever comes with a good deed will be rewarded with what is better, and they will be secure from the horror on that Day

verses.text: And whoever comes with an evil deed - their faces will be overturned into the Fire, [and it will be said], "Are you recompensed except for what you used to do?"
verses.translation: And whoever comes with an evil deed will be hurled face-first into the Fire. Are you rewarded except for what you used to do

verses.text: [Say, O Muhammad], "I have only been commanded to worship the Lord of this city, who made it sacred and to whom [belongs] all things. And I am commanded to be of the Muslims [those who submit to Allah ]
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I have only been commanded to worship the Lord of this city ˹of Mecca˺, Who has made it sacred, and to Him belongs everything. And I am commanded to be one of those who ˹fully˺ submit ˹to Him˺

verses.text: And to recite the Qur'an." And whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] himself; and whoever strays - say, "I am only [one] of the warners."
verses.translation: and to recite the Quran.” Then whoever chooses to be guided, it is only for their own good. But whoever chooses to stray, say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I am only a warner.”

verses.text: And say, "[All] praise is [due] to Allah . He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them. And your Lord is not unaware of what you do."
verses.translation: And say, “All praise is for Allah! He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them. And your Lord is never unaware of what you do.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Ta, Seen, Meem.
verses.translation: Ṭâ-Sĩn-Mĩm

verses.text: These are the verses of the clear Book.
verses.translation: These are the verses of the clear Book

verses.text: We recite to you from the news of Moses and Pharaoh in truth for a people who believe.
verses.translation: We narrate to you ˹O Prophet˺ part of the story of Moses and Pharaoh in truth for people who believe

verses.text: Indeed, Pharaoh exalted himself in the land and made its people into factions, oppressing a sector among them, slaughtering their [newborn] sons and keeping their females alive. Indeed, he was of the corrupters.
verses.translation: Indeed, Pharaoh ˹arrogantly˺ elevated himself in the land and divided its people into ˹subservient˺ groups, one of which he persecuted, slaughtering their sons and keeping their women. He was truly one of the corruptors

verses.text: And We wanted to confer favor upon those who were oppressed in the land and make them leaders and make them inheritors
verses.translation: But it was Our Will to favour those who were oppressed in the land, making them models ˹of faith˺ as well as successors

verses.text: And establish them in the land and show Pharaoh and [his minister] Haman and their soldiers through them that which they had feared.
verses.translation: and to establish them in the land; and through them show Pharaoh, Hamân, and their soldiers ˹the fulfilment of˺ what they feared

verses.text: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers."
verses.translation: We inspired the mother of Moses: “Nurse him, but when you fear for him, put him then into the river, and do not fear or grieve. We will certainly return him to you, and make him one of the messengers.”

verses.text: And the family of Pharaoh picked him up [out of the river] so that he would become to them an enemy and a [cause of] grief. Indeed, Pharaoh and Haman and their soldiers were deliberate sinners.
verses.translation: And ˹it so happened that˺ Pharaoh’s people picked him up, only to become their enemy and source of grief. Surely Pharaoh, Hamân, and their soldiers were sinful

verses.text: And the wife of Pharaoh said, "[He will be] a comfort of the eye for me and for you. Do not kill him; perhaps he may benefit us, or we may adopt him as a son." And they perceived not.
verses.translation: Pharaoh’s wife said ˹to him˺, “˹This baby is˺ a source of joy for me and you. Do not kill him. Perhaps he may be useful to us or we may adopt him as a son.” They were unaware ˹of what was to come˺

verses.text: And the heart of Moses' mother became empty [of all else]. She was about to disclose [the matter concerning] him had We not bound fast her heart that she would be of the believers.
verses.translation: And the heart of Moses’ mother ached so much that she almost gave away his identity, had We not reassured her heart in order for her to have faith ˹in Allah’s promise˺

verses.text: And she said to his sister, "Follow him"; so she watched him from a distance while they perceived not.
verses.translation: And she said to his sister, “Keep track of him!” So she watched him from a distance, while they were unaware

verses.text: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?"
verses.translation: And We had caused him to refuse all wet-nurses at first, so his sister suggested, “Shall I direct you to a family who will bring him up for you and take good care of him?”

verses.text: So We restored him to his mother that she might be content and not grieve and that she would know that the promise of Allah is true. But most of the people do not know.
verses.translation: This is how We returned him to his mother so that her heart would be put at ease, and not grieve, and that she would know that Allah’s promise is ˹always˺ true. But most people do not know

verses.text: And when he attained his full strength and was [mentally] mature, We bestowed upon him judgement and knowledge. And thus do We reward the doers of good.
verses.translation: And when he reached full strength and maturity, We gave him wisdom and knowledge. This is how We reward the good-doers

verses.text: And he entered the city at a time of inattention by its people and found therein two men fighting: one from his faction and one from among his enemy. And the one from his faction called for help to him against the one from his enemy, so Moses struck him and [unintentionally] killed him. [Moses] said, "This is from the work of Satan. Indeed, he is a manifest, misleading enemy."
verses.translation: ˹One day˺ he entered the city unnoticed by its people. There he found two men fighting: one of his own people, and the other of his enemies. The man from his people called to him for help against his foe. So Moses punched him, causing his death. Moses cried, “This is from Satan’s handiwork. He is certainly a sworn, misleading enemy.”

verses.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me," and He forgave him. Indeed, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
verses.translation: He pleaded, “My Lord! I have definitely wronged my soul, so forgive me.” So He forgave him, ˹for˺ He is indeed the All-Forgiving, Most Merciful

verses.text: He said, "My Lord, for the favor You bestowed upon me, I will never be an assistant to the criminals."
verses.translation: Moses pledged, “My Lord! For all Your favours upon me, I will never side with the wicked.”

verses.text: And he became inside the city fearful and anticipating [exposure], when suddenly the one who sought his help the previous day cried out to him [once again]. Moses said to him, "Indeed, you are an evident, [persistent] deviator."
verses.translation: And so Moses became fearful, watching out in the city, when suddenly the one who sought his help the day before cried out to him again for help. Moses rebuked him, “Indeed, you are clearly a trouble-maker.”

verses.text: And when he wanted to strike the one who was an enemy to both of them, he said, "O Moses, do you intend to kill me as you killed someone yesterday? You only want to be a tyrant in the land and do not want to be of the amenders."
verses.translation: Then when Moses was about to lay his hands on their foe, the enemy said, “O Moses! Do you intend to kill me as you killed a man yesterday? You only want to be a tyrant in the land. You do not intend to make peace!”

verses.text: And a man came from the farthest end of the city, running. He said, "O Moses, indeed the eminent ones are conferring over you [intending] to kill you, so leave [the city]; indeed, I am to you of the sincere advisors."
verses.translation: And there came a man, rushing from the farthest end of the city. He said, “O Moses! The chiefs are actually conspiring against you to put you to death, so leave ˹the city˺. I really advise you ˹to do so˺.”

verses.text: So he left it, fearful and anticipating [apprehension]. He said, "My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people."
verses.translation: So Moses left the city in a state of fear and caution, praying, “My Lord! Deliver me from the wrongdoing people.”

verses.text: And when he directed himself toward Madyan, he said, "Perhaps my Lord will guide me to the sound way."
verses.translation: And as he made his way towards Midian, he said, “I trust my Lord will guide me to the right way.”
