verses.text: Say, "Have you considered your 'partners' whom you invoke besides Allah ? Show me what they have created from the earth, or have they partnership [with Him] in the heavens? Or have We given them a book so they are [standing] on evidence therefrom? [No], rather, the wrongdoers do not promise each other except delusion."
verses.translation: Ask ˹them, O Prophet˺, “Have you considered your associate-gods which you invoke besides Allah? Show me what they have created on earth! Or do they have a share in ˹the creation of˺ the heavens? Or have We given the polytheists a Book, which serves as a clear proof for them? In fact, the wrongdoers promise each other nothing but delusion.”

verses.text: Indeed, Allah holds the heavens and the earth, lest they cease. And if they should cease, no one could hold them [in place] after Him. Indeed, He is Forbearing and Forgiving.
verses.translation: Indeed, Allah ˹alone˺ keeps the heavens and the earth from falling apart. If they were to fall apart, none but Him could hold them up. He is truly Most Forbearing, All-Forgiving

verses.text: And they swore by Allah their strongest oaths that if a warner came to them, they would be more guided than [any] one of the [previous] nations. But when a warner came to them, it did not increase them except in aversion.
verses.translation: They swore by Allah their most solemn oaths that if a warner were to come to them, they would certainly be better guided than any other community. Yet when a warner did come to them, it only drove them farther away—

verses.text: [Due to] arrogance in the land and plotting of evil; but the evil plot does not encompass except its own people. Then do they await except the way of the former peoples? But you will never find in the way of Allah any change, and you will never find in the way of Allah any alteration.
verses.translation: behaving arrogantly in the land and plotting evil. But evil plotting only backfires on those who plot. Are they awaiting anything but the fate of those ˹destroyed˺ before? You will find no change in the way of Allah, nor will you find it diverted ˹to someone else˺

verses.text: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? And they were greater than them in power. But Allah is not to be caused failure by anything in the heavens or on the earth. Indeed, He is ever Knowing and Competent.
verses.translation: Have they not travelled throughout the land to see what was the end of those ˹destroyed˺ before them? They were far superior in might. But there is nothing that can escape Allah in the heavens or the earth. He is certainly All-Knowing, Most Capable

verses.text: And if Allah were to impose blame on the people for what they have earned, He would not leave upon the earth any creature. But He defers them for a specified term. And when their time comes, then indeed Allah has ever been, of His servants, Seeing.
verses.translation: If Allah were to punish people ˹immediately˺ for what they have committed, He would not have left a single living being on earth. But He delays them for an appointed term. And when their time arrives, then surely Allah is All-Seeing of His servants

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Ya, Seen.
verses.translation: Yâ-Sĩn

verses.text: By the wise Qur'an.
verses.translation: By the Quran, rich in wisdom

verses.text: Indeed you, [O Muhammad], are from among the messengers,
verses.translation: You ˹O Prophet˺ are truly one of the messengers

verses.text: On a straight path.
verses.translation: upon the Straight Path

verses.text: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
verses.translation: ˹This is˺ a revelation from the Almighty, Most Merciful

verses.text: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.
verses.translation: so that you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, and so are heedless

verses.text: Already the word has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.
verses.translation: The decree ˹of torment˺ has already been justified against most of them, for they will never believe

verses.text: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.
verses.translation: ˹It is as if˺ We have put shackles around their necks up to their chins, so their heads are forced up

verses.text: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.
verses.translation: and have placed a barrier before them and a barrier behind them and covered them ˹all˺ up, so they fail to see ˹the truth˺

verses.text: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.
verses.translation: It is the same whether you warn them or not—they will never believe

verses.text: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.
verses.translation: You can only warn those who follow the Reminder and are in awe of the Most Compassionate without seeing Him. So give them good news of forgiveness and an honourable reward

verses.text: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.
verses.translation: It is certainly We Who resurrect the dead, and write what they send forth and what they leave behind. Everything is listed by Us in a perfect Record

verses.text: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -
verses.translation: Give them an example ˹O Prophet˺ of the residents of a town, when the messengers came to them

verses.text: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened them with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."
verses.translation: We sent them two messengers, but they rejected both. So We reinforced ˹the two˺ with a third, and they declared, “We have indeed been sent to you ˹as messengers˺.”

verses.text: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."
verses.translation: The people replied, “You are only humans like us, and the Most Compassionate has not revealed anything. You are simply lying!”

verses.text: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,
verses.translation: The messengers responded, “Our Lord knows that we have truly been sent to you

verses.text: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."
verses.translation: And our duty is only to deliver ˹the message˺ clearly.”

verses.text: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."
verses.translation: The people replied, “We definitely see you as a bad omen for us. If you do not desist, we will certainly stone you ˹to death˺ and you will be touched with a painful punishment from us.”

verses.text: They said, "Your omen is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."
verses.translation: The messengers said, “Your bad omen lies within yourselves. Are you saying this because you are reminded ˹of the truth˺? In fact, you are a transgressing people.”

verses.text: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.
verses.translation: Then from the farthest end of the city a man came, rushing. He advised, “O my people! Follow the messengers

verses.text: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.
verses.translation: Follow those who ask no reward of you, and are ˹rightly˺ guided

verses.text: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?
verses.translation: And why should I not worship the One Who has originated me, and to Whom you will be returned

verses.text: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?
verses.translation: How could I take besides Him other gods whose intercession would not be of any benefit to me, nor could they save me if the Most Compassionate intended to harm me

verses.text: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.
verses.translation: Indeed, I would then be clearly astray

verses.text: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."
verses.translation: I do believe in your Lord, so listen to me.”

verses.text: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know
verses.translation: ˹But they killed him, then˺ he was told ˹by the angels˺, “Enter Paradise!” He said, “If only my people knew

verses.text: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."
verses.translation: of how my Lord has forgiven me, and made me one of the honourable.”

verses.text: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.
verses.translation: We did not send any soldiers from the heavens against his people after his death, nor did We need to

verses.text: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished.
verses.translation: All it took was one ˹mighty˺ blast, and they were extinguished at once

verses.text: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.
verses.translation: Oh pity, such beings! No messenger ever came to them without being mocked

verses.text: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return?
verses.translation: Have the deniers not considered how many peoples We destroyed before them who never came back to life again

verses.text: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.
verses.translation: Yet they will all be brought before Us

verses.text: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.
verses.translation: There is a sign for them in the dead earth: We give it life, producing grain from it for them to eat

verses.text: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -
verses.translation: And We have placed in it gardens of palm trees and grapevines, and caused springs to gush forth in it

verses.text: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful?
verses.translation: so that they may eat from its fruit, which they had no hand in making. Will they not then give thanks

verses.text: Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.
verses.translation: Glory be to the One Who created all ˹things in˺ pairs—˹be it˺ what the earth produces, their genders, or what they do not know

verses.text: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it [the light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.
verses.translation: There is also a sign for them in the night: We strip from it daylight, then—behold!—they are in darkness

verses.text: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
verses.translation: The sun travels for its fixed term. That is the design of the Almighty, All-Knowing

verses.text: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.
verses.translation: As for the moon, We have ordained ˹precise˺ phases for it, until it ends up like an old, curved palm stalk

verses.text: It is not allowable for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.
verses.translation: It is not for the sun to catch up with the moon, nor does the night outrun the day. Each is travelling in an orbit of their own

verses.text: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship.
verses.translation: Another sign for them is that We carried their ancestors ˹with Noah˺ in the fully loaded Ark

verses.text: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.
verses.translation: and created for them similar things to ride in

verses.text: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved
verses.translation: If We willed, We could drown them: then no one would respond to their cries, nor would they be rescued—

verses.text: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.
verses.translation: except by mercy from Us, allowing them enjoyment for a ˹little˺ while

verses.text: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy... "
verses.translation: ˹Still they turn away˺ when it is said to them, “Beware of what is ahead of you ˹in the Hereafter˺ and what is behind you ˹of destroyed nations˺ so you may be shown mercy.”

verses.text: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.
verses.translation: Whenever a sign comes to them from their Lord, they turn away from it

verses.text: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."
verses.translation: And when it is said to them, “Donate from what Allah has provided for you,” the disbelievers say to the believers, “Why should we feed those whom Allah could have fed if He wanted to? You are clearly astray!”

verses.text: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
verses.translation: And they ask ˹the believers˺, “When will this threat come to pass, if what you say is true?”

verses.text: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing.
verses.translation: They must be awaiting a single Blast, which will seize them while they are ˹entrenched˺ in ˹worldly˺ disputes

verses.text: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.
verses.translation: Then they will not be able to make a ˹last˺ will, nor can they return to their own people

verses.text: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.
verses.translation: The Trumpet will be blown ˹a second time˺, then—behold!—they will rush from the graves to their Lord

verses.text: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."
verses.translation: They will cry, “Woe to us! Who has raised us up from our place of rest? This must be what the Most Compassionate warned us of; the messengers told the truth!”

verses.text: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.
verses.translation: It will only take one Blast, then at once they will all be brought before Us

verses.text: So today no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.
verses.translation: On that Day no soul will be wronged in the least, nor will you be rewarded except for what you used to do

verses.text: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -
verses.translation: Indeed, on that Day the residents of Paradise will be busy enjoying themselves

verses.text: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.
verses.translation: They and their spouses will be in ˹cool˺ shade, reclining on ˹canopied˺ couches

verses.text: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]
verses.translation: There they will have fruits and whatever they desire

verses.text: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.
verses.translation: And “Peace!” will be ˹their˺ greeting from the Merciful Lord

verses.text: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.
verses.translation: ˹Then the disbelievers will be told,˺ “Step away ˹from the believers˺ this Day, O wicked ones

verses.text: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -
verses.translation: Did I not command you, O Children of Adam, not to follow Satan, for he is truly your sworn enemy

verses.text: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.
verses.translation: but to worship Me ˹alone˺? This is the Straight Path

verses.text: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?
verses.translation: Yet he already misled great multitudes of you. Did you not have any sense

verses.text: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.
verses.translation: This is the Hell you were warned of

verses.text: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."
verses.translation: Burn in it Today for your disbelief.”

verses.text: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.
verses.translation: On this Day We will seal their mouths, their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify to what they used to commit

verses.text: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?
verses.translation: Had We willed, We could have easily blinded their eyes, so they would struggle to find their way. How then could they see

verses.text: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.
verses.translation: And had We willed, We could have transfigured them on the spot, so they could neither progress forward nor turn back

verses.text: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand?
verses.translation: And whoever We grant a long life, We reverse them in development. Will they not then understand

verses.text: And We did not give Prophet Muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur'an
verses.translation: We have not taught him poetry, nor is it fitting for him. This ˹Book˺ is only a Reminder and a clear Quran

verses.text: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers.
verses.translation: to warn whoever is ˹truly˺ alive and fulfil the decree ˹of torment˺ against the disbelievers

verses.text: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?
verses.translation: Do they not see that We singlehandedly created for them, among other things, cattle which are under their control

verses.text: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.
verses.translation: And We have subjected these ˹animals˺ to them, so they may ride some and eat others

verses.text: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?
verses.translation: And they derive from them other benefits and drinks. Will they not then give thanks

verses.text: But they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.
verses.translation: Still they have taken other gods besides Allah, hoping to be helped ˹by them˺

verses.text: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.
verses.translation: They cannot help the pagans, even though they serve the idols as dedicated guards

verses.text: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.
verses.translation: So do not let their words grieve you ˹O Prophet˺. Indeed, We ˹fully˺ know what they conceal and what they reveal

verses.text: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?
verses.translation: Do people not see that We have created them from a sperm-drop, then—behold!—they openly challenge ˹Us˺

verses.text: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"
verses.translation: And they argue with Us—forgetting they were created—saying, “Who will give life to decayed bones?”

verses.text: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “They will be revived by the One Who produced them the first time, for He has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of every created being

verses.text: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.
verses.translation: ˹He is the One˺ Who gives you fire from green trees, and—behold!—you kindle ˹fire˺ from them

verses.text: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.
verses.translation: Can the One Who created the heavens and the earth not ˹easily˺ resurrect these ˹deniers˺?” Yes ˹He can˺! For He is the Master Creator, All-Knowing

verses.text: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.
verses.translation: All it takes, when He wills something ˹to be˺, is simply to say to it: “Be!” And it is

verses.text: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
verses.translation: So glory be to the One in Whose Hands is the authority over all things, and to Whom ˹alone˺ you will ˹all˺ be returned

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: By those [angels] lined up in rows
verses.translation: By those ˹angels˺ lined up in ranks

verses.text: And those who drive [the clouds]
verses.translation: and those who diligently drive ˹the clouds˺

verses.text: And those who recite the message,
verses.translation: and those who recite the Reminder

verses.text: Indeed, your God is One,
verses.translation: Surely your God is One

verses.text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.
verses.translation: ˹He is˺ the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, and the Lord of all points of sunrise

verses.text: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
verses.translation: Indeed, We have adorned the lowest heaven with the stars for decoration

verses.text: And as protection against every rebellious devil
verses.translation: and ˹for˺ protection from every rebellious devil

verses.text: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,
verses.translation: They cannot listen to the highest assembly ˹of angels˺ for they are pelted from every side

verses.text: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,
verses.translation: ˹fiercely˺ driven away. And they will suffer an everlasting torment

verses.text: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].
verses.translation: But whoever manages to stealthily eavesdrop is ˹instantly˺ pursued by a piercing flare

verses.text: Then inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created men from sticky clay.
verses.translation: So ask them ˹O Prophet˺, which is harder to create: them or other marvels of Our creation? Indeed, We created them from a sticky clay

verses.text: But you wonder, while they mock,
verses.translation: In fact, you are astonished ˹by their denial˺, while they ridicule ˹you˺

verses.text: And when they are reminded, they remember not.
verses.translation: When they are reminded, they are never mindful

verses.text: And when they see a sign, they ridicule
verses.translation: And whenever they see a sign, they make fun of it

verses.text: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.
verses.translation: saying, “This is nothing but pure magic

verses.text: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
verses.translation: When we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be resurrected

verses.text: And our forefathers [as well]?"
verses.translation: And our forefathers as well?”

verses.text: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."
verses.translation: Say, “Yes! And you will be fully humbled.”

verses.text: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.
verses.translation: It will only take one Blast, then at once they will see ˹it all˺

verses.text: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."
verses.translation: They will cry, “Oh, woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment!”

verses.text: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."
verses.translation: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision which you used to deny.”

verses.text: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship
verses.translation: ˹Allah will say to the angels,˺ “Gather ˹all˺ the wrongdoers along with their peers, and whatever they used to worship

verses.text: Other than Allah , and guide them to the path of Hellfire
verses.translation: instead of Allah, then lead them ˹all˺ to the path of Hell

verses.text: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."
verses.translation: And detain them, for they must be questioned.”

verses.text: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"
verses.translation: ˹Then they will be asked,˺ “What is the matter with you that you can no longer help each other?”

verses.text: But they, that Day, are in surrender.
verses.translation: In fact, on that Day they will be ˹fully˺ submissive

verses.text: And they will approach one another blaming each other.
verses.translation: They will turn on each other, throwing blame

verses.text: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."
verses.translation: The misled will say, “It was you who deluded us away from what is right.”

verses.text: The oppressors will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,
verses.translation: The misleaders will reply, “No! You disbelieved on your own

verses.text: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.
verses.translation: We had no authority over you. In fact, you yourselves were a transgressing people

verses.text: So the word of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].
verses.translation: The decree of our Lord has come to pass against us ˹all˺: we will certainly taste ˹the punishment˺

verses.text: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."
verses.translation: We caused you to deviate, for we ourselves were deviant.”

verses.text: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.
verses.translation: Surely on that Day they will ˹all˺ share in the punishment

verses.text: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.
verses.translation: That is certainly how We deal with the wicked

verses.text: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allah ," were arrogant
verses.translation: For whenever it was said to them ˹in the world˺, “There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Allah,” they acted arrogantly

verses.text: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"
verses.translation: and argued, “Should we really abandon our gods for a mad poet?”

verses.text: Rather, the Prophet has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.
verses.translation: In fact, he came with the truth, confirming ˹earlier˺ messengers

verses.text: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,
verses.translation: You will certainly taste the painful torment

verses.text: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -
verses.translation: and will only be rewarded for what you used to do

verses.text: But not the chosen servants of Allah .
verses.translation: But not the chosen servants of Allah

verses.text: Those will have a provision determined -
verses.translation: They will have a known provision

verses.text: Fruits; and they will be honored
verses.translation: fruits ˹of every type˺. And they will be honoured

verses.text: In gardens of pleasure
verses.translation: in the Gardens of Bliss

verses.text: On thrones facing one another.
verses.translation: facing each other on thrones

verses.text: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,
verses.translation: A drink ˹of pure wine˺ will be passed around to them from a flowing stream

verses.text: White and delicious to the drinkers;
verses.translation: crystal-white, delicious to drink

verses.text: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.
verses.translation: It will neither harm ˹them˺, nor will they be intoxicated by it

verses.text: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,
verses.translation: And with them will be maidens of modest gaze and gorgeous eyes

verses.text: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.
verses.translation: as if they were pristine pearls

verses.text: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
verses.translation: Then they will turn to one another inquisitively

verses.text: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth]
verses.translation: One of them will say, “I once had a companion ˹in the world˺

verses.text: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe
verses.translation: who used to ask ˹me˺, ‘Do you actually believe ˹in resurrection˺

verses.text: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"
verses.translation: When we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be brought to judgment?’”

verses.text: He will say, "Would you [care to] look?"
verses.translation: He will ˹then˺ ask, “Would you care to see ˹his fate˺?”

verses.text: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.
verses.translation: Then he ˹and the others˺ will look and spot him in the midst of the Hellfire

verses.text: He will say, "By Allah , you almost ruined me.
verses.translation: He will ˹then˺ say, “By Allah! You nearly ruined me

verses.text: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].
verses.translation: Had it not been for the grace of my Lord, I ˹too˺ would have certainly been among those brought ˹to Hell˺.”

verses.text: Then, are we not to die
verses.translation: ˹Then he will ask his fellow believers,˺ “Can you imagine that we will never die

verses.text: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"
verses.translation: except our first death, nor be punished ˹like the others˺?”

verses.text: Indeed, this is the great attainment.
verses.translation: This is truly the ultimate triumph

verses.text: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.
verses.translation: For such ˹honour˺ all should strive

verses.text: Is Paradise a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqum?
verses.translation: Is this ˹bliss˺ a better accommodation or the tree of Zaqqûm

verses.text: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.
verses.translation: We have surely made it a test for the wrongdoers

verses.text: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,
verses.translation: Indeed, it is a tree that grows in the depths of Hell

verses.text: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.
verses.translation: bearing fruit like devils’ heads

verses.text: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.
verses.translation: The evildoers will certainly ˹be left to˺ eat from it, filling up their bellies with it

verses.text: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.
verses.translation: Then on top of that they will be given a blend of boiling drink

verses.text: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.
verses.translation: Then they will ultimately return to ˹their place in˺ Hell

verses.text: Indeed they found their fathers astray.
verses.translation: Indeed, they found their forefathers astray

verses.text: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.
verses.translation: so they rushed in their footsteps

verses.text: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,
verses.translation: And surely most of the earlier generations had strayed before them

verses.text: And We had already sent among them warners.
verses.translation: although We had certainly sent warners among them

verses.text: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -
verses.translation: See then what was the end of those who had been warned

verses.text: But not the chosen servants of Allah .
verses.translation: But not the chosen servants of Allah

verses.text: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.
verses.translation: Indeed, Noah cried out to Us, and how excellent are We in responding

verses.text: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.
verses.translation: We delivered him and his family from the great distress

verses.text: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
verses.translation: and made his descendants the sole survivors

verses.text: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
verses.translation: And We blessed him ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations

verses.text: "Peace upon Noah among the worlds."
verses.translation: “Peace be upon Noah among all peoples.”

verses.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.translation: Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers

verses.text: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
verses.translation: ˹For˺ he was truly one of Our faithful servants

verses.text: Then We drowned the disbelievers.
verses.translation: Then We drowned the others

verses.text: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,
verses.translation: And indeed, one of those who followed his way was Abraham

verses.text: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart
verses.translation: ˹Remember˺ when he came to his Lord with a pure heart

verses.text: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?
verses.translation: and said to his father and his people, “What are you worshipping

verses.text: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allah you desire?
verses.translation: Is it false gods that you desire instead of Allah

verses.text: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"
verses.translation: What then do you expect from the Lord of all worlds?”

verses.text: And he cast a look at the stars
verses.translation: He later looked up to the stars ˹in contemplation˺

verses.text: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."
verses.translation: then said, “I am really sick.”

verses.text: So they turned away from him, departing.
verses.translation: So they turned their backs on him and went away

verses.text: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?
verses.translation: Then he ˹stealthily˺ advanced towards their gods, and said ˹mockingly˺, “Will you not eat ˹your offerings˺

verses.text: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?"
verses.translation: What is wrong with you that you cannot speak?”

verses.text: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.
verses.translation: Then he swiftly turned on them, striking ˹them˺ with his right hand

verses.text: Then the people came toward him, hastening.
verses.translation: Later, his people came rushing towards him ˹furiously˺

verses.text: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,
verses.translation: He argued, “How can you worship what you carve ˹with your own hands˺

verses.text: While Allah created you and that which you do?"
verses.translation: when it is Allah Who created you and whatever you do?”

verses.text: They said, "Construct for him a furnace and throw him into the burning fire."
verses.translation: They said ˹to one another˺, “Build him a furnace and cast him into the blazing fire.”

verses.text: And they intended for him a plan, but We made them the most debased.
verses.translation: And so they sought to harm him, but We made them inferior

verses.text: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.
verses.translation: He later said, “I am leaving ˹in obedience˺ to my Lord. He will guide me

verses.text: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."
verses.translation: My Lord! Bless me with righteous offspring.”

verses.text: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.
verses.translation: So We gave him good news of a forbearing son

verses.text: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast."
verses.translation: Then when the boy reached the age to work with him, Abraham said, “O my dear son! I have seen in a dream that I ˹must˺ sacrifice you. So tell me what you think.” He replied, “O my dear father! Do as you are commanded. Allah willing, you will find me steadfast.”

verses.text: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,
verses.translation: Then when they submitted ˹to Allah’s Will˺, and Abraham laid him on the side of his forehead ˹for sacrifice˺

verses.text: We called to him, "O Abraham,
verses.translation: We called out to him, “O Abraham

verses.text: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.translation: You have already fulfilled the vision.” Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers

verses.text: Indeed, this was the clear trial.
verses.translation: That was truly a revealing test

verses.text: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,
verses.translation: And We ransomed his son with a great sacrifice

verses.text: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
verses.translation: and blessed Abraham ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations

verses.text: "Peace upon Abraham."
verses.translation: “Peace be upon Abraham.”

verses.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.translation: This is how We reward the good-doers

verses.text: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
verses.translation: He was truly one of Our faithful servants

verses.text: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.
verses.translation: We ˹later˺ gave him good news of Isaac—a prophet, and one of the righteous

verses.text: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself.
verses.translation: We blessed him and Isaac as well. Some of their descendants did good, while others clearly wronged themselves

verses.text: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.
verses.translation: And We certainly showed favour to Moses and Aaron

verses.text: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,
verses.translation: and delivered them and their people from the great distress

verses.text: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.
verses.translation: We helped them so it was they who prevailed

verses.text: And We gave them the explicit Scripture,
verses.translation: We gave them the clear Scripture

verses.text: And We guided them on the straight path.
verses.translation: and guided them to the Straight Path

verses.text: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:
verses.translation: And We blessed them ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations

verses.text: "Peace upon Moses and Aaron."
verses.translation: “Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.”

verses.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.translation: Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers

verses.text: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.
verses.translation: They were truly ˹two˺ of Our faithful servants

verses.text: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,
verses.translation: And Elias was indeed one of the messengers

verses.text: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allah ?
verses.translation: ˹Remember˺ when he said to his people, “Will you not fear ˹Allah˺

verses.text: Do you call upon Ba'l and leave the best of creators -
verses.translation: Do you call upon ˹the idol of˺ Ba’l and abandon the Best of Creators—

verses.text: Allah , your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"
verses.translation: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?”

verses.text: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],
verses.translation: But they rejected him, so they will certainly be brought ˹for punishment˺

verses.text: Except the chosen servants of Allah .
verses.translation: But not the chosen servants of Allah

verses.text: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
verses.translation: We blessed him ˹with honourable mention˺ among later generations

verses.text: "Peace upon Elias."
verses.translation: “Peace be upon Elias.”

verses.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.translation: Indeed, this is how We reward the good-doers

verses.text: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
verses.translation: He was truly one of Our faithful servants

verses.text: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.
verses.translation: And Lot was indeed one of the messengers

verses.text: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,
verses.translation: ˹Remember˺ when We delivered him and all of his family

verses.text: Except his wife among those who remained [with the evildoers].
verses.translation: except an old woman, who was one of the doomed

verses.text: Then We destroyed the others.
verses.translation: Then We ˹utterly˺ destroyed the rest

verses.text: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning
verses.translation: You ˹Meccans˺ certainly pass by their ruins day

verses.text: And at night. Then will you not use reason?
verses.translation: and night. Will you not then understand

verses.text: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.
verses.translation: And Jonah was indeed one of the messengers

verses.text: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.
verses.translation: ˹Remember˺ when he fled to the overloaded ship

verses.text: And he drew lots and was among the losers.
verses.translation: Then ˹to save it from sinking,˺ he drew straws ˹with other passengers˺. He lost ˹and was thrown overboard˺

verses.text: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.
verses.translation: Then the whale engulfed him while he was blameworthy

verses.text: And had he not been of those who exalt Allah ,
verses.translation: Had he not ˹constantly˺ glorified ˹Allah˺

verses.text: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.
verses.translation: he would have certainly remained in its belly until the Day of Resurrection

verses.text: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.
verses.translation: But We cast him onto the open ˹shore˺, ˹totally˺ worn out

verses.text: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.
verses.translation: and caused a squash plant to grow over him

verses.text: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.
verses.translation: We ˹later˺ sent him ˹back˺ to ˹his city of˺ at least one hundred thousand people

verses.text: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.
verses.translation: who then believed ˹in him˺, so We allowed them enjoyment for a while

verses.text: So inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?
verses.translation: Ask them ˹O Prophet˺ if your Lord has daughters, while the pagans ˹prefer to˺ have sons

verses.text: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"
verses.translation: Or ˹ask them˺ if We created the angels as females right before their eyes

verses.text: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,
verses.translation: Indeed, it is one of their ˹outrageous˺ fabrications to say

verses.text: " Allah has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.
verses.translation: “Allah has children.” They are simply liars

verses.text: Has He chosen daughters over sons?
verses.translation: Has He chosen daughters over sons

verses.text: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?
verses.translation: What is the matter with you? How do you judge

verses.text: Then will you not be reminded?
verses.translation: Will you not then be mindful

verses.text: Or do you have a clear authority?
verses.translation: Or do you have ˹any˺ compelling proof

verses.text: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.
verses.translation: Then bring ˹us˺ your scripture, if what you say is true

verses.text: And they have claimed between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought to [punishment].
verses.translation: They have also established a ˹marital˺ relationship between Him and the jinn. Yet the jinn ˹themselves˺ know well that such people will certainly be brought ˹for punishment˺

verses.text: Exalted is Allah above what they describe,
verses.translation: Glorified is Allah far above what they claim

verses.text: Except the chosen servants of Allah [who do not share in that sin].
verses.translation: But not the chosen servants of Allah

verses.text: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,
verses.translation: Surely you ˹pagans˺ and whatever ˹idols˺ you worship

verses.text: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
verses.translation: can never lure ˹anyone˺ away from Him

verses.text: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.
verses.translation: except those ˹destined˺ to burn in Hell

verses.text: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.
verses.translation: ˹The angels respond,˺ “There is not one of us without an assigned station ˹of worship˺

verses.text: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].
verses.translation: We are indeed the ones lined up in ranks ˹for Allah˺

verses.text: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allah ."
verses.translation: And we are indeed the ones ˹constantly˺ glorifying ˹His praise˺.”

verses.text: And indeed, the disbelievers used to say,
verses.translation: They certainly used to say

verses.text: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,
verses.translation: “If only we had a Reminder like ˹those of˺ earlier peoples

verses.text: We would have been the chosen servants of Allah ."
verses.translation: we would have truly been Allah’s devoted servants.”

verses.text: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know.
verses.translation: But ˹now˺ they reject it, so they will soon know

verses.text: And Our word has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,
verses.translation: Our Word has already gone forth to Our servants, the messengers

verses.text: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory
verses.translation: that they would surely be helped

verses.text: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers will be those who overcome.
verses.translation: and that Our forces will certainly prevail

verses.text: So, [O Muhammad], leave them for a time.
verses.translation: So turn away from the deniers for a while ˹O Prophet˺

verses.text: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.
verses.translation: You will see ˹what will happen to˺ them, and they too will see

verses.text: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?
verses.translation: Do they ˹really˺ wish to hasten Our punishment

verses.text: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.
verses.translation: Yet when it descends upon them: how evil will that morning be for those who had been warned

verses.text: And leave them for a time.
verses.translation: And turn away from them for a while

verses.text: And see, for they are going to see.
verses.translation: You will see, and they too will see

verses.text: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.
verses.translation: Glorified is your Lord—the Lord of Honour and Power—above what they claim

verses.text: And peace upon the messengers.
verses.translation: Peace be upon the messengers

verses.text: And praise to Allah , Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: And praise be to Allah—Lord of all worlds

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Sad. By the Qur'an containing reminder...
verses.translation: Ṣãd. By the Quran, full of reminders

verses.text: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.
verses.translation: ˹This is the truth,˺ yet the disbelievers are ˹entrenched˺ in arrogance and opposition

verses.text: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.
verses.translation: ˹Imagine˺ how many peoples We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was too late to escape

verses.text: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.
verses.translation: Now, the pagans are astonished that a warner has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, “This is a magician, a total liar

verses.text: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."
verses.translation: Has he reduced ˹all˺ the gods to One God? Indeed, this is something totally astonishing.”

verses.text: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.
verses.translation: The chiefs among them went forth saying, “Carry on, and stand firm in devotion to your gods. Certainly this is just a scheme ˹for power˺

verses.text: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.
verses.translation: We have never heard of this in the previous faith. This is nothing but a fabrication

verses.text: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
verses.translation: Has the Reminder been revealed ˹only˺ to him out of ˹all of˺ us?” In fact, they are ˹only˺ in doubt of My ˹revealed˺ Reminder. In fact, ˹they do so because˺ they have not yet tasted My punishment

verses.text: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?
verses.translation: Or ˹is it because˺ they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord—the Almighty, the Giver ˹of all bounties˺

verses.text: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.
verses.translation: Or ˹is it because˺ the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and everything in between belongs to them? Let them then climb their way ˹to heaven, if their claim is true˺

verses.text: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].
verses.translation: This is just another ˹enemy˺ force bound for defeat out there

verses.text: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,
verses.translation: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth˺, as did ’Âd, Pharaoh of the mighty structures

verses.text: And [the tribe of] Thamud and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket. Those are the companies.
verses.translation: Thamûd, the people of Lot, and the residents of the Forest. These were ˹all˺ enemy forces

verses.text: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.
verses.translation: Each rejected their messenger, so My punishment was justified

verses.text: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.
verses.translation: These ˹pagans˺ are awaiting nothing but a single Blast that cannot be stopped

verses.text: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account"
verses.translation: They say ˹mockingly˺, “Our Lord! Hasten for us our share ˹of the punishment˺ before the Day of Reckoning.”

verses.text: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allah ].
verses.translation: Be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say. And remember Our servant, David, the man of strength. Indeed, he ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺

verses.text: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [ Allah ] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.
verses.translation: We truly subjected the mountains to hymn ˹Our praises˺ along with him in the evening and after sunrise

verses.text: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].
verses.translation: And ˹We subjected˺ the birds, flocking together. All turned to him ˹echoing his hymns˺

verses.text: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.
verses.translation: We strengthened his kingship, and gave him wisdom and sound judgment

verses.text: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -
verses.translation: Has the story of the two plaintiffs, who scaled the ˹wall of David’s˺ sanctuary, reached you ˹O Prophet˺

verses.text: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.
verses.translation: When they came into David’s presence, he was startled by them. They said, “Have no fear. ˹We are merely˺ two in a dispute: one of us has wronged the other. So judge between us with truth—do not go beyond ˹it˺—and guide us to the right way

verses.text: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."
verses.translation: This is my brother. He has ninety-nine sheep while I have ˹only˺ one. ˹Still˺ he asked me to give it up to him, overwhelming me with ˹his˺ argument.”

verses.text: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah ].
verses.translation: David ˹eventually˺ ruled, “He has definitely wronged you in demanding ˹to add˺ your sheep to his. And certainly many partners wrong each other, except those who believe and do good—but how few are they!” Then David realized that We had tested him so he asked for his Lord’s forgiveness, fell down in prostration, and turned ˹to Him in repentance˺

verses.text: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
verses.translation: So We forgave that for him. And he will indeed have ˹a status of˺ closeness to Us and an honourable destination

verses.text: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah ." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.
verses.translation: ˹We instructed him:˺ “O David! We have surely made you an authority in the land, so judge between people with truth. And do not follow ˹your˺ desires or they will lead you astray from Allah’s Way. Surely those who go astray from Allah’s Way will suffer a severe punishment for neglecting the Day of Reckoning.”

verses.text: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.
verses.translation: We have not created the heavens and earth and everything in between without purpose—as the disbelievers think. So woe to the disbelievers because of the Fire

verses.text: Or should we treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allah like the wicked?
verses.translation: Or should We treat those who believe and do good like those who make mischief throughout the land? Or should We treat the righteous like the wicked

verses.text: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.
verses.translation: ˹This is˺ a blessed Book which We have revealed to you ˹O Prophet˺ so that they may contemplate its verses, and people of reason may be mindful

verses.text: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah ].
verses.translation: And We blessed David with Solomon—what an excellent servant ˹he was˺! Indeed, he ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺

verses.text: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.
verses.translation: ˹Remember˺ when the well-trained, swift horses were paraded before him in the evening

verses.text: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."
verses.translation: He then proclaimed, “I am truly in love with ˹these˺ fine things out of remembrance for Allah,” until they went out of sight

verses.text: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.
verses.translation: ˹He ordered,˺ “Bring them back to me!” Then he began to rub down their legs and necks

verses.text: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.
verses.translation: And indeed, We tested Solomon, placing a ˹deformed˺ body on his throne, then he turned ˹to Allah in repentance˺

verses.text: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."
verses.translation: He prayed, “My Lord! Forgive me, and grant me an authority that will never be matched by anyone after me. You are indeed the Giver ˹of all bounties˺.”

verses.text: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,
verses.translation: So We subjected to him the wind, blowing gently at his command to wherever he pleased

verses.text: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver
verses.translation: And ˹We subjected to him˺ every builder and diver of the jinn

verses.text: And others bound together in shackles.
verses.translation: and others bound together in chains

verses.text: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."
verses.translation: ˹Allah said,˺ “This is Our gift, so give or withhold ˹as you wish˺, never to be called to account.”

verses.text: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
verses.translation: And he will indeed have ˹a status of˺ closeness to Us and an honourable destination

verses.text: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."
verses.translation: And remember Our servant Job, when he cried out to his Lord, “Satan has afflicted me with distress and suffering.”

verses.text: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for] a cool bath and drink."
verses.translation: ˹We responded,˺ “Stomp your foot: ˹now˺ here is a cool ˹and refreshing˺ spring for washing and drinking.”

verses.text: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.
verses.translation: And We gave him back his family, twice as many, as a mercy from Us and a lesson for people of reason

verses.text: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah ].
verses.translation: ˹And We said to him,˺ “Take in your hand a bundle of grass, and strike ˹your wife˺ with it, and do not break your oath.” We truly found him patient. What an excellent servant ˹he was˺! Indeed, he ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺

verses.text: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.
verses.translation: And remember Our servants: Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—the men of strength and insight

verses.text: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].
verses.translation: We truly chose them for the honour of proclaiming the Hereafter

verses.text: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.
verses.translation: And in Our sight they are truly among the chosen and the finest

verses.text: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.
verses.translation: Also remember Ishmael, Elisha, and Ⱬul-Kifl. All are among the best

verses.text: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return
verses.translation: This is ˹all˺ a reminder. And the righteous will certainly have an honourable destination

verses.text: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.
verses.translation: the Gardens of Eternity, whose gates will be open for them

verses.text: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.
verses.translation: There they will recline, calling for abundant fruit and drink

verses.text: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.
verses.translation: And with them will be maidens of modest gaze and equal age

verses.text: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.
verses.translation: This is what you are promised for the Day of Reckoning

verses.text: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.
verses.translation: This is indeed Our provision that will never end

verses.text: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -
verses.translation: That is that. And the transgressors will certainly have the worst destination

verses.text: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.
verses.translation: Hell, where they will burn. What an evil place to rest

verses.text: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.
verses.translation: Let them then taste this: boiling water and ˹oozing˺ pus

verses.text: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.
verses.translation: and other torments of the same sort

verses.text: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."
verses.translation: ˹The misleaders will say to one another,˺ “Here is a crowd ˹of followers˺ being thrown in with us. They are not welcome, ˹for˺ they ˹too˺ will burn in the Fire.”

verses.text: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."
verses.translation: The followers will respond, “No! You are not welcome! You brought this upon us. What an evil place for settlement!”

verses.text: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."
verses.translation: Adding, “Our Lord! Whoever brought this upon us, double their punishment in the Fire.”

verses.text: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?
verses.translation: The tyrants will ask ˹one another˺, “But why do we not see those we considered to be lowly

verses.text: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"
verses.translation: Were we wrong in mocking them ˹in the world˺? Or do our eyes ˹just˺ fail to see them ˹in the Fire˺?”

verses.text: Indeed, that is truth - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.
verses.translation: This dispute between the residents of the Fire will certainly come to pass

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allah , the One, the Prevailing.
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I am only a warner. And there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Allah—the One, the Supreme

verses.text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver."
verses.translation: ˹He is the˺ Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between—the Almighty, Most Forgiving.”

verses.text: Say, "It is great news
verses.translation: Say, “This ˹Quran˺ is momentous news

verses.text: From which you turn away.
verses.translation: from which you ˹pagans˺ are turning away.”

verses.text: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].
verses.translation: ˹And say,˺ “I had no knowledge of the highest assembly ˹in heaven˺ when they differed ˹concerning Adam˺

verses.text: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."
verses.translation: What is revealed to me is that I am only sent with a clear warning.”

verses.text: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.
verses.translation: ˹Remember, O Prophet˺ when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from clay

verses.text: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
verses.translation: So when I have fashioned him and had a spirit of My Own ˹creation˺ breathed into him, fall down in prostration to him.”

verses.text: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely.
verses.translation: So the angels prostrated all together—

verses.text: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.
verses.translation: but not Iblîs, who acted arrogantly, becoming unfaithful

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"
verses.translation: Allah asked, “O Iblîs! What prevented you from prostrating to what I created with My Own Hands? Did you ˹just˺ become proud? Or have you always been arrogant?”

verses.text: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."
verses.translation: He replied, “I am better than he is: You created me from fire and him from clay.”

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "Then get out of Paradise, for indeed, you are expelled.
verses.translation: Allah commanded, “Then get out of Paradise, for you are truly cursed

verses.text: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."
verses.translation: And surely upon you is My condemnation until the Day of Judgment.”

verses.text: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
verses.translation: Satan appealed, “My Lord! Then delay my end until the Day of their resurrection.”

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
verses.translation: Allah said, “You will be delayed

verses.text: Until the Day of the time well-known."
verses.translation: until the appointed Day.”

verses.text: [Iblees] said, "By your might, I will surely mislead them all
verses.translation: Satan said, “By Your Glory! I will certainly mislead them all

verses.text: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
verses.translation: except Your chosen servants among them.”

verses.text: [ Allah ] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -
verses.translation: Allah concluded, “The truth is—and I ˹only˺ say the truth—

verses.text: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."
verses.translation: I will surely fill up Hell with you and whoever follows you from among them, all together.”

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not ask you for the Qur'an any payment, and I am not of the pretentious
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I do not ask you for any reward for this ˹Quran˺, nor do I pretend to be someone I am not

verses.text: It is but a reminder to the worlds.
verses.translation: It is only a reminder to the whole world

verses.text: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
verses.translation: And you will certainly know its truth before long.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: The revelation of the Qur'an is from Allah , the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.translation: The revelation of this Book is from Allah—the Almighty, All-Wise

verses.text: Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book, [O Muhammad], in truth. So worship Allah , [being] sincere to Him in religion.
verses.translation: Indeed, We have sent down the Book to you ˹O Prophet˺ in truth, so worship Allah ˹alone˺, being sincerely devoted to Him

verses.text: Unquestionably, for Allah is the pure religion. And those who take protectors besides Him [say], "We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to Allah in position." Indeed, Allah will judge between them concerning that over which they differ. Indeed, Allah does not guide he who is a liar and [confirmed] disbeliever.
verses.translation: Indeed, sincere devotion is due ˹only˺ to Allah. As for those who take other lords besides Him, ˹saying,˺ “We worship them only so they may bring us closer to Allah,” surely Allah will judge between all regarding what they differed about. Allah certainly does not guide whoever persists in lying and disbelief

verses.text: If Allah had intended to take a son, He could have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed. Exalted is He; He is Allah , the One, the Prevailing.
verses.translation: Had it been Allah’s Will to have offspring, He could have chosen whatever He willed of His creation. Glory be to Him! He is Allah—the One, the Supreme

verses.text: He created the heavens and earth in truth. He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. Unquestionably, He is the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.
verses.translation: He created the heavens and the earth for a purpose. He wraps the night around the day, and wraps the day around the night. And He has subjected the sun and the moon, each orbiting for an appointed term. He is truly the Almighty, Most Forgiving

verses.text: He created you from one soul. Then He made from it its mate, and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses. That is Allah , your Lord; to Him belongs dominion. There is no deity except Him, so how are you averted?
verses.translation: He created you ˹all˺ from a single soul, then from it He made its mate. And He produced for you four pairs of cattle. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers ˹in stages˺, one development after another, in three layers of darkness. That is Allah—your Lord! All authority belongs to Him. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. How can you then be turned away

verses.text: If you disbelieve - indeed, Allah is Free from need of you. And He does not approve for His servants disbelief. And if you are grateful, He approves it for you; and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you about what you used to do. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
verses.translation: If you disbelieve, then ˹know that˺ Allah is truly not in need of you, nor does He approve of disbelief from His servants. But if you become grateful ˹through faith˺, He will appreciate that from you. No soul burdened with sin will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you of what you used to do. He certainly knows best what is ˹hidden˺ in the heart

verses.text: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon his Lord, turning to Him [alone]; then when He bestows on him a favor from Himself, he forgets Him whom he called upon before, and he attributes to Allah equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief for a little; indeed, you are of the companions of the Fire."
verses.translation: When one is touched with hardship, they cry out to their Lord, turning to Him ˹alone˺. But as soon as He showers them with blessings from Him, they ˹totally˺ forget the One they had cried to earlier, and set up equals to Allah to mislead ˹others˺ from His Way. Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Enjoy your disbelief for a little while! You will certainly be one of the inmates of the Fire.”

verses.text: Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, [like one who does not]? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding.
verses.translation: ˹Are they better˺ or those who worship ˹their Lord˺ devoutly in the hours of the night, prostrating and standing, fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of their Lord? Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Are those who know equal to those who do not know?” None will be mindful ˹of this˺ except people of reason

verses.text: Say, "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allah is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account."
verses.translation: Say ˹O Prophet, that Allah says˺, “O My servants who believe! Be mindful of your Lord. Those who do good in this world will have a good reward. And Allah’s earth is spacious. Only those who endure patiently will be given their reward without limit.”

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to worship Allah , [being] sincere to Him in religion.
verses.translation: Say, “I am commanded to worship Allah, being sincerely devoted to Him ˹alone˺

verses.text: And I have been commanded to be the first [among you] of the Muslims."
verses.translation: And I am commanded to be the first of those who submit ˹to His Will˺.”

verses.text: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."
verses.translation: Say, “I truly fear—if I were to disobey my Lord—the torment of a tremendous Day.”

verses.text: Say, " Allah [alone] do I worship, sincere to Him in my religion,
verses.translation: Say, “It is ˹only˺ Allah that I worship, being sincere in my devotion to Him

verses.text: So worship what you will besides Him." Say, "Indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, that is the manifest loss."
verses.translation: Worship then whatever ˹gods˺ you want instead of Him.” Say, “The ˹true˺ losers are those who will lose themselves and their families on Judgment Day. That is indeed the clearest loss.”

verses.text: They will have canopies of fire above them and below them, canopies. By that Allah threatens His servants. O My servants, then fear Me.
verses.translation: They will have layers of fire above and below them. That is what Allah warns His servants with. So fear Me, O My servants

verses.text: But those who have avoided Taghut, lest they worship it, and turned back to Allah - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants
verses.translation: And those who shun the worship of false gods, turning to Allah ˹alone˺, will have good news. So give good news to My servants ˹O Prophet˺—

verses.text: Who listen to speech and follow the best of it. Those are the ones Allah has guided, and those are people of understanding.
verses.translation: those who listen to what is said and follow the best of it. These are the ones ˹rightly˺ guided by Allah, and these are ˹truly˺ the people of reason

verses.text: Then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment [to be guided]? Then, can you save one who is in the Fire?
verses.translation: What about those against whom the decree of torment has been justified? Is it you ˹O Prophet˺ who will then save those bound for the Fire

verses.text: But those who have feared their Lord - for them are chambers, above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow. [This is] the promise of Allah . Allah does not fail in [His] promise.
verses.translation: But those mindful of their Lord will have ˹elevated˺ mansions, built one above the other, under which rivers flow. ˹That is˺ the promise of Allah. ˹And˺ Allah never fails in ˹His˺ promise

verses.text: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs [and rivers] in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them [scattered] debris. Indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding.
verses.translation: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky—channelling it through streams in the earth—then produces with it crops of various colours, then they dry up and you see them wither, and then He reduces them to chaff? Surely in this is a reminder for people of reason

verses.text: So is one whose breast Allah has expanded to [accept] Islam and he is upon a light from his Lord [like one whose heart rejects it]? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allah . Those are in manifest error.
verses.translation: Can ˹the misguided be like˺ those whose hearts Allah has opened to Islam, so they are enlightened by their Lord? So woe to those whose hearts are hardened at the remembrance of Allah! It is they who are clearly astray

verses.text: Allah has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance of Allah . That is the guidance of Allah by which He guides whom He wills. And one whom Allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
verses.translation: ˹It is˺ Allah ˹Who˺ has sent down the best message—a Book of perfect consistency and repeated lessons—which causes the skin ˹and hearts˺ of those who fear their Lord to tremble, then their skin and hearts soften at the mention of ˹the mercy of˺ Allah. That is the guidance of Allah, through which He guides whoever He wills. But whoever Allah leaves to stray will be left with no guide
