verses.translation: Whatever affliction befalls you is because of what your own hands have committed. And He pardons much

verses.text: And you will not cause failure [to Allah ] upon the earth. And you have not besides Allah any protector or helper.
verses.translation: You can never escape ˹Him˺ on earth, nor do you have any protector or helper besides Allah

verses.text: And of His signs are the ships in the sea, like mountains.
verses.translation: And among His signs are the ships like mountains ˹sailing˺ in the sea

verses.text: If He willed, He could still the wind, and they would remain motionless on its surface. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
verses.translation: If He wills, He can calm the wind, leaving the ships motionless on the water. Surely in this are signs for whoever is steadfast, grateful

verses.text: Or He could destroy them for what they earned; but He pardons much.
verses.translation: Or He can wreck the ships for what the people have committed—though He forgives much—

verses.text: And [that is so] those who dispute concerning Our signs may know that for them there is no place of escape.
verses.translation: so those who dispute about Our signs may know that they have no refuge

verses.text: So whatever thing you have been given - it is but [for] enjoyment of the worldly life. But what is with Allah is better and more lasting for those who have believed and upon their Lord rely
verses.translation: Whatever ˹pleasure˺ you have been given is ˹no more than a fleeting˺ enjoyment of this worldly life. But what is with Allah is far better and more lasting for those who believe and put their trust in their Lord

verses.text: And those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive,
verses.translation: who avoid major sins and shameful deeds, and forgive when angered

verses.text: And those who have responded to their lord and established prayer and whose affair is [determined by] consultation among themselves, and from what We have provided them, they spend.
verses.translation: who respond to their Lord, establish prayer, conduct their affairs by mutual consultation, and donate from what We have provided for them

verses.text: And those who, when tyranny strikes them, they defend themselves,
verses.translation: and who enforce justice when wronged

verses.text: And the retribution for an evil act is an evil one like it, but whoever pardons and makes reconciliation - his reward is [due] from Allah . Indeed, He does not like wrongdoers.
verses.translation: The reward of an evil deed is its equivalent. But whoever pardons and seeks reconciliation, then their reward is with Allah. He certainly does not like the wrongdoers

verses.text: And whoever avenges himself after having been wronged - those have not upon them any cause [for blame].
verses.translation: There is no blame on those who enforce justice after being wronged

verses.text: The cause is only against the ones who wrong the people and tyrannize upon the earth without right. Those will have a painful punishment.
verses.translation: Blame is only on those who wrong people and transgress in the land unjustly. It is they who will suffer a painful punishment

verses.text: And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [requiring] determination.
verses.translation: And whoever endures patiently and forgives—surely this is a resolve to aspire to

verses.text: And he whom Allah sends astray - for him there is no protector beyond Him. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they see the punishment, saying, "Is there for return [to the former world] any way?"
verses.translation: And whoever Allah leaves to stray will have no guide after Him. You will see the wrongdoers, when they face the torment, pleading, “Is there any way back ˹to the world˺?”

verses.text: And you will see them being exposed to the Fire, humbled from humiliation, looking from [behind] a covert glance. And those who had believed will say, "Indeed, the [true] losers are the ones who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, the wrongdoers are in an enduring punishment."
verses.translation: And you will see them exposed to the Fire, fully humbled out of disgrace, stealing glances ˹at it˺. And the believers will say, “The ˹true˺ losers are those who have lost themselves and their families on Judgment Day.” The wrongdoers will certainly be in everlasting torment

verses.text: And there will not be for them any allies to aid them other than Allah . And whoever Allah sends astray - for him there is no way.
verses.translation: They will have no protectors to help them against Allah. And whoever Allah leaves to stray, for them there is no way

verses.text: Respond to your Lord before a Day comes from Allah of which there is no repelling. No refuge will you have that day, nor for you will there be any denial.
verses.translation: Respond to your Lord before the coming of a Day from Allah that cannot be averted. There will be no refuge for you then, nor ˹grounds for˺ denial ˹of sins˺

verses.text: But if they turn away - then We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], over them as a guardian; upon you is only [the duty of] notification. And indeed, when We let man taste mercy from us, he rejoices in it; but if evil afflicts him for what his hands have put forth, then indeed, man is ungrateful.
verses.translation: But if they turn away, We have not sent you ˹O Prophet˺ as a keeper over them. Your duty is only to deliver ˹the message˺. And indeed, when We let someone taste a mercy from Us, they become prideful ˹because˺ of it. But when afflicted with evil because of what their hands have done, then one becomes totally ungrateful

verses.text: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates what he wills. He gives to whom He wills female [children], and He gives to whom He wills males.
verses.translation: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He creates whatever He wills. He blesses whoever He wills with daughters, and blesses whoever He wills with sons

verses.text: Or He makes them [both] males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent.
verses.translation: or grants both, sons and daughters, ˹to whoever He wills˺, and leaves whoever He wills infertile. He is indeed All-Knowing, Most Capable

verses.text: And it is not for any human being that Allah should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger to reveal, by His permission, what He wills. Indeed, He is Most High and Wise.
verses.translation: It is not ˹possible˺ for a human being to have Allah communicate with them, except through inspiration, or from behind a veil, or by sending a messenger-angel to reveal whatever He wills by His permission. He is surely Most High, All-Wise

verses.text: And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command. You did not know what is the Book or [what is] faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, [O Muhammad], you guide to a straight path -
verses.translation: And so We have sent to you ˹O Prophet˺ a revelation by Our command. You did not know of ˹this˺ Book and faith ˹before˺. But We have made it a light, by which We guide whoever We will of Our servants. And you are truly leading ˹all˺ to the Straight Path—

verses.text: The path of Allah , to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Unquestionably, to Allah do [all] matters evolve.
verses.translation: the Path of Allah, to Whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Surely to Allah all matters will return ˹for judgment˺

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Ha, Meem.
verses.translation: Ḥâ-Mĩm

verses.text: By the clear Book,
verses.translation: By the clear Book

verses.text: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur'an that you might understand.
verses.translation: Certainly, We have made it a Quran in Arabic so perhaps you will understand

verses.text: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.
verses.translation: And indeed, it is—in the Master Record with Us—highly esteemed, rich in wisdom

verses.text: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?
verses.translation: Should We then turn the ˹Quranic˺ Reminder away from you ˹simply˺ because you have been a transgressing people

verses.text: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples,
verses.translation: ˹Imagine˺ how many prophets We sent to those ˹destroyed˺ before

verses.text: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.
verses.translation: But no prophet ever came to them without being mocked

verses.text: And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.
verses.translation: So We destroyed those who were far mightier than these ˹Meccans˺. The examples of ˹their˺ predecessors have ˹already˺ been related

verses.text: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing."
verses.translation: If you ask them ˹O Prophet˺ who created the heavens and the earth, they will certainly say, “The Almighty, All-Knowing did.”

verses.text: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided
verses.translation: ˹He is the One˺ Who has laid out the earth for you, and set in it pathways for you so that you may find your way

verses.text: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -
verses.translation: And ˹He is the One˺ Who sends down rain from the sky in perfect measure, with which We give life to a lifeless land. And so will you be brought forth ˹from the grave˺

verses.text: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount.
verses.translation: And ˹He is the One˺ Who created all ˹things in˺ pairs, and made for you ships and animals to ride

verses.text: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say. "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.
verses.translation: so that you may sit firmly on their backs, and remember your Lord’s blessings once you are settled on them, saying, “Glory be to the One Who has subjected these for us, for we could have never done so ˹on our own˺

verses.text: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."
verses.translation: And surely to our Lord we will ˹all˺ return.”

verses.text: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion. Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.
verses.translation: Still the pagans have made some of His creation out to be a part of Him. Indeed, humankind is clearly ungrateful

verses.text: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?
verses.translation: Has He taken ˹angels as His˺ daughters from what He created, and favoured you ˹O pagans˺ with sons

verses.text: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
verses.translation: Whenever one of them is given the good news of what they attribute to the Most Compassionate, his face grows gloomy, as he suppresses his rage

verses.text: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allah ]?
verses.translation: ˹Do they attribute to Him˺ those who are brought up in fineries and are not commanding in disputes

verses.text: And they have made the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.
verses.translation: Still they have labelled the angels, who are servants of the Most Compassionate, as female. Did they witness their creation? Their statement will be recorded, and they will be questioned

verses.text: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but falsifying.
verses.translation: And they argue, “Had the Most Compassionate willed, we would have never worshipped them.” They have no knowledge ˹in support˺ of this ˹claim˺. They do nothing but lie

verses.text: Or have We given them a book before the Qur'an to which they are adhering?
verses.translation: Or have We given them a Book ˹for proof˺, before this ˹Quran˺, to which they are holding firm

verses.text: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided."
verses.translation: In fact, they say, “We found our forefathers following a ˹particular˺ way, and we are following in their footsteps.”

verses.text: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."
verses.translation: Similarly, whenever We sent a warner to a society before you ˹O Prophet˺, its ˹spoiled˺ elite would say, “We found our forefathers following a ˹particular˺ way, and we are walking in their footsteps.”

verses.text: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."
verses.translation: Each ˹warner˺ asked, “Even if what I brought you is better guidance than what you found your forefathers practicing?” They replied, “We totally reject whatever you have been sent with.”

verses.text: So we took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.
verses.translation: So We inflicted punishment upon them. See then what was the fate of the deniers

verses.text: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship
verses.translation: ˹Remember, O Prophet˺ when Abraham declared to his father and his people, “I am totally free of whatever ˹gods˺ you worship

verses.text: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."
verses.translation: except the One Who originated me, and He will surely guide me.”

verses.text: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].
verses.translation: And he left this enduring declaration among his descendants, so they may ˹always˺ turn back ˹to Allah˺

verses.text: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.
verses.translation: In fact, I had allowed enjoyment for these ˹Meccans˺ and their forefathers, until the truth came to them along with a messenger making things clear

verses.text: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."
verses.translation: ˹But˺ when the truth came to them, they said, “This is magic, and we totally reject it.”

verses.text: And they said, "Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"
verses.translation: And they exclaimed, “If only this Quran was revealed to a great man from ˹one of˺ the two cities!”

verses.text: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.
verses.translation: Is it they who distribute your Lord’s mercy? We ˹alone˺ have distributed their ˹very˺ livelihood among them in this worldly life and raised some of them in rank above others so that some may employ others in service. ˹But˺ your Lord’s mercy is far better than whatever ˹wealth˺ they amass

verses.text: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount
verses.translation: Were it not that people might ˹be tempted to˺ become one community ˹of disbelievers˺, We would have supplied the homes of ˹only˺ those who disbelieve in the Most Compassionate with silver roofs and ˹silver˺ stairways to ascend

verses.text: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline
verses.translation: as well as ˹silver˺ gates and thrones to recline on

verses.text: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.
verses.translation: and ornaments ˹of gold˺. Yet all this is no more than a ˹fleeting˺ enjoyment in this worldly life. ˹But˺ the Hereafter with your Lord is ˹only˺ for those mindful ˹of Him˺

verses.text: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.
verses.translation: And whoever turns a blind eye to the Reminder of the Most Compassionate, We place at the disposal of each a devilish one as their close associate

verses.text: And indeed, the devils avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided
verses.translation: who will certainly hinder them from the ˹Right˺ Way while they think they are ˹rightly˺ guided

verses.text: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "Oh, I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west - how wretched a companion."
verses.translation: But when such a person comes to Us, one will say ˹to their associate˺, “I wish you were as distant from me as the east is from the west! What an evil associate ˹you were˺!”

verses.text: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment.
verses.translation: ˹It will be said to both,˺ “Since you all did wrong, sharing in the punishment will be of no benefit to you this Day.”

verses.text: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muhammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error?
verses.translation: Can you make the deaf hear, or guide the blind or those clearly astray

verses.text: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.
verses.translation: Even if We take you away ˹from this world˺, We will surely inflict punishment upon them

verses.text: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability.
verses.translation: Or if We show you what We threaten them with, We certainly have full power over them

verses.text: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.
verses.translation: So hold firmly to what has been revealed to you ˹O Prophet˺. You are truly on the Straight Path

verses.text: And indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.
verses.translation: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a glory for you and your people. And you will ˹all˺ be questioned ˹about it˺

verses.text: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped?
verses.translation: Ask ˹the followers of˺ the messengers that We already sent before you if We ˹ever˺ appointed ˹other˺ gods to be worshipped besides the Most Compassionate

verses.text: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds."
verses.translation: Indeed, We sent Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his chiefs, and he said: “I am a messenger of the Lord of all worlds.”

verses.text: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them.
verses.translation: But as soon as he came to them with Our signs, they laughed at them

verses.text: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith].
verses.translation: although every sign We showed them was greater than the one before. Ultimately, We seized them with torments so that they might return ˹to the Right Path˺

verses.text: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."
verses.translation: ˹Then˺ they pleaded, “O ˹mighty˺ magician! Pray to your Lord on our behalf, by virtue of the covenant He made with you. We will certainly accept guidance.”

verses.text: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.
verses.translation: But as soon as We removed the torments from them, they broke their promise

verses.text: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see?
verses.translation: And Pharaoh called out to his people, boasting, “O my people! Am I not sovereign over Egypt as well as ˹all˺ these streams flowing at my feet? Can you not see

verses.text: Or am I [not] better than this one who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?
verses.translation: Am I not better than this nobody who can hardly express himself

verses.text: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"
verses.translation: Why then have no golden bracelets ˹of kingship˺ been granted to him or angels come with him as escorts!”

verses.text: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allah ].
verses.translation: And so he fooled his people, and they obeyed him. They were truly a rebellious people

verses.text: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.
verses.translation: So when they enraged Us, We inflicted punishment upon them, drowning them all

verses.text: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.
verses.translation: And We made them an example and a lesson for those after them

verses.text: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud.
verses.translation: When the son of Mary was cited as an example ˹in argument˺, your people ˹O Prophet˺ broke into ˹joyful˺ applause

verses.text: And they said, "Are our gods better, or is he?" They did not present the comparison except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute.
verses.translation: They exclaimed, “Which is better: our gods or Jesus?” They cite him only to argue. In fact, they are a people prone to dispute

verses.text: Jesus was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.
verses.translation: He was only a servant We showed favour to, and made as an example for the Children of Israel

verses.text: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth.
verses.translation: Had We willed, We could have easily replaced you ˹all˺ with angels, succeeding one another on earth

verses.text: And indeed, Jesus will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me. This is a straight path.
verses.translation: And his ˹second˺ coming is truly a sign for the Hour. So have no doubt about it, and follow me. This is the Straight Path

verses.text: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.
verses.translation: And do not let Satan hinder you, ˹for˺ he is certainly your sworn enemy

verses.text: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allah and obey me.
verses.translation: When Jesus came with clear proofs, he declared, “I have come to you with wisdom, and to clarify to you some of what you differ about. So fear Allah, and obey me

verses.text: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."
verses.translation: Surely Allah ˹alone˺ is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him ˹alone˺. This is the Straight Path.”

verses.text: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.
verses.translation: Yet their ˹various˺ groups have differed among themselves ˹about him˺, so woe to the wrongdoers when they face the torment of a painful Day

verses.text: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?
verses.translation: Are they waiting for the Hour to take them by surprise when they least expect ˹it˺

verses.text: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous
verses.translation: Close friends will be enemies to one another on that Day, except the righteous

verses.text: [To whom Allah will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,
verses.translation: ˹who will be told,˺ “O My servants! There is no fear for you Today, nor will you grieve—

verses.text: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.
verses.translation: ˹those˺ who believed in Our signs and ˹fully˺ submitted ˹to Us˺

verses.text: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted."
verses.translation: Enter Paradise, you and your spouses, rejoicing.”

verses.text: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally.
verses.translation: Golden trays and cups will be passed around to them. There will be whatever the souls desire and the eyes delight in. And you will be there forever

verses.text: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.
verses.translation: That is the Paradise which you will be awarded for what you used to do

verses.text: For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat.
verses.translation: There you will have abundant fruit to eat from

verses.text: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.
verses.translation: Indeed, the wicked will be in the torment of Hell forever

verses.text: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair.
verses.translation: It will never be lightened for them, and there they will be overwhelmed with despair

verses.text: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.
verses.translation: We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers

verses.text: And they will call, "O Malik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."
verses.translation: They will cry, “O Mâlik! Let your Lord finish us off.” He will answer, “You are definitely here to stay.”

verses.text: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.
verses.translation: We certainly brought the truth to you, but most of you were resentful of the truth

verses.text: Or have they devised [some] affair? But indeed, We are devising [a plan].
verses.translation: Or have they mastered some ˹evil˺ plan? Then We ˹too˺ are surely planning

verses.text: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers are with them recording.
verses.translation: Or do they think that We do not hear their ˹evil˺ thoughts and secret talks? Yes ˹We do˺! And Our messenger-angels are in their presence, recording ˹it all˺

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers."
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “If the Most Compassionate ˹really˺ had offspring, I would be the first worshipper.”

verses.text: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
verses.translation: Glorified is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, far above what they claim

verses.text: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.
verses.translation: So let them indulge ˹in falsehood˺ and amuse ˹themselves˺ until they face their Day, which they have been warned of

verses.text: And it is Allah who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.
verses.translation: It is He Who is ˹the only˺ God in the heavens and ˹the only˺ God on the earth. For He is the All-Wise, All-Knowing

verses.text: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.
verses.translation: And Blessed is the One to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and everything in between! With Him ˹alone˺ is the knowledge of the Hour. And to Him you will ˹all˺ be returned

verses.text: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.
verses.translation: ˹But˺ those ˹objects of worship˺ they invoke besides Him have no power to intercede, except those who testify to the truth knowingly

verses.text: And if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, " Allah ." So how are they deluded?
verses.translation: If you ask them ˹O Prophet˺ who created them, they will certainly say, “Allah!” How can they then be deluded ˹from the truth˺

verses.text: And [ Allah acknowledges] his saying, "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe."
verses.translation: ˹Allah is Aware of˺ the Prophet’s cry: “O my Lord! Indeed, these are a people who persist in disbelief.”

verses.text: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace." But they are going to know.
verses.translation: So bear with them and respond with peace. They will soon come to know

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Ha, Meem.
verses.translation: Ḥâ-Mĩm

verses.text: By the clear Book,
verses.translation: By the clear Book

verses.text: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].
verses.translation: Indeed, We sent it down on a blessed night, for We always warn ˹against evil˺

verses.text: On that night is made distinct every precise matter -
verses.translation: On that night every matter of wisdom is ordained

verses.text: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]
verses.translation: by a command from Us, for We have always sent ˹messengers˺

verses.text: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
verses.translation: as a mercy from your Lord. He ˹alone˺ is truly the All-Hearing, All-Knowing—

verses.text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.
verses.translation: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, if only you had sure faith

verses.text: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.
verses.translation: There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. He ˹alone˺ gives life and causes death. ˹He is˺ your Lord, and the Lord of your forefathers

verses.text: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.
verses.translation: In fact, they are in doubt, amusing themselves

verses.text: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke.
verses.translation: Wait then ˹O Prophet˺ for the day ˹when˺ the sky will be veiled in haze, clearly visible

verses.text: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.
verses.translation: overwhelming the people. ˹They will cry,˺ “This is a painful torment

verses.text: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."
verses.translation: Our Lord! Remove ˹this˺ torment from us, ˹and˺ we will certainly believe.”

verses.text: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.
verses.translation: How can they be reminded when a messenger has already come to them, making things clear

verses.text: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."
verses.translation: then they turned away from him, saying, “A madman, taught by others!”

verses.text: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].
verses.translation: Indeed, We will remove ˹that˺ torment for a while, and you ˹Meccans˺ will return ˹to disbelief˺

verses.text: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.
verses.translation: ˹Then˺ on the Day We will deal ˹you˺ the fiercest blow, We will surely inflict punishment

verses.text: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger,
verses.translation: Indeed, before them We tested Pharaoh’s people: a noble messenger came to them

verses.text: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allah . Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"
verses.translation: ˹proclaiming,˺ “Hand over the servants of Allah to me. I am truly a trustworthy messenger to you

verses.text: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allah . Indeed, I have come to you with clear authority.
verses.translation: And do not be arrogant with Allah. I have certainly come to you with a compelling proof

verses.text: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.
verses.translation: And indeed, I seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord so you do not stone me ˹to death˺

verses.text: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."
verses.translation: ˹But˺ if you do not believe me, then let me be.”

verses.text: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.
verses.translation: Ultimately, he cried out to his Lord, “These are a wicked people!”

verses.text: [ Allah said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.
verses.translation: ˹Allah responded,˺ “Leave with My servants at night, for you will surely be pursued

verses.text: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."
verses.translation: And leave the sea parted, for they are certainly an army bound to drown.”

verses.text: How much they left behind of gardens and springs
verses.translation: ˹Imagine˺ how many gardens and springs the tyrants left behind

verses.text: And crops and noble sites
verses.translation: as well as ˹various˺ crops and splendid residences

verses.text: And comfort wherein they were amused.
verses.translation: and luxuries which they fully enjoyed

verses.text: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.
verses.translation: So it was. And We awarded it ˹all˺ to another people

verses.text: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
verses.translation: Neither heaven nor earth wept over them, nor was their fate delayed

verses.text: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -
verses.translation: And We certainly delivered the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment

verses.text: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.
verses.translation: of Pharaoh. He was truly a tyrant, a transgressor

verses.text: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.
verses.translation: And indeed, We chose the Israelites knowingly above the others

verses.text: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.
verses.translation: And We showed them signs in which there was a clear test

verses.text: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,
verses.translation: Indeed, these ˹Meccans˺ say

verses.text: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.
verses.translation: “There is nothing beyond our first death, and we will never be resurrected

verses.text: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
verses.translation: Bring ˹back˺ our forefathers, if what you say is true.”

verses.text: Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.
verses.translation: Are they superior to the people of Tubba’ and those before them? We destroyed them ˹all˺, ˹for˺ they were truly wicked

verses.text: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.
verses.translation: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything in between for sport

verses.text: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.
verses.translation: We only created them for a purpose, but most of these ˹pagans˺ do not know

verses.text: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -
verses.translation: Surely the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision is the time appointed for all—

verses.text: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -
verses.translation: the Day no kith or kin will be of benefit to another whatsoever, nor will they be helped

verses.text: Except those [believers] on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
verses.translation: except those shown mercy by Allah. He is truly the Almighty, Most Merciful

verses.text: Indeed, the tree of zaqqum
verses.translation: Surely ˹the fruit of˺ the tree of Zaqqûm

verses.text: Is food for the sinful.
verses.translation: will be the food of the evildoer

verses.text: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies
verses.translation: Like molten metal, it will boil in the bellies

verses.text: Like the boiling of scalding water.
verses.translation: like the boiling of hot water

verses.text: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,
verses.translation: ˹It will be said,˺ “Seize them and drag them into the depths of the Hellfire

verses.text: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."
verses.translation: Then pour over their heads the torment of boiling water.”

verses.text: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!
verses.translation: ˹The wicked will be told,˺ “Taste this. You mighty, noble one

verses.text: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."
verses.translation: This is truly what you ˹all˺ used to doubt.”

verses.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place;
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place

verses.text: Within gardens and springs,
verses.translation: amid Gardens and springs

verses.text: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.
verses.translation: dressed in fine silk and rich brocade, facing one another

verses.text: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
verses.translation: So it will be. And We will pair them to maidens with gorgeous eyes

verses.text: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.
verses.translation: There they will call for every fruit in serenity

verses.text: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
verses.translation: There they will never taste death, beyond the first death. And He will protect them from the punishment of the Hellfire—

verses.text: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.
verses.translation: as ˹an act of˺ grace from your Lord. That is ˹truly˺ the ultimate triumph

verses.text: And indeed, We have eased the Qur'an in your tongue that they might be reminded.
verses.translation: Indeed, We have made this ˹Quran˺ easy in your own language ˹O Prophet˺ so perhaps they will be mindful

verses.text: So watch, [O Muhammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
verses.translation: Wait then! They too are certainly waiting

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Ha, Meem.
verses.translation: Ḥâ-Mĩm

verses.text: The revelation of the Book is from Allah , the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.translation: The revelation of this Book is from Allah—the Almighty, All-Wise

verses.text: Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers.
verses.translation: Surely in ˹the creation of˺ the heavens and the earth are signs for the believers

verses.text: And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith].
verses.translation: And in your own creation, and whatever living beings He dispersed, are signs for people of sure faith

verses.text: And [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what Allah sends down from the sky of provision and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in His] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason.
verses.translation: And ˹in˺ the alternation of the day and the night, the provision sent down from the skies by Allah—reviving the earth after its death—and the shifting of the winds, are signs for people of understanding

verses.text: These are the verses of Allah which We recite to you in truth. Then in what statement after Allah and His verses will they believe?
verses.translation: These are Allah’s revelations which We recite to you ˹O Prophet˺ in truth. So what message will they believe in after ˹denying˺ Allah and His revelations

verses.text: Woe to every sinful liar
verses.translation: Woe to every sinful liar

verses.text: Who hears the verses of Allah recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.
verses.translation: They hear Allah’s revelations recited to them, then persist ˹in denial˺ arrogantly as if they did not hear them. So give them good news of a painful punishment

verses.text: And when he knows anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.
verses.translation: And whenever they learn anything of Our revelations, they make a mockery of it. It is they who will suffer a humiliating punishment

verses.text: Before them is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allah as allies. And they will have a great punishment.
verses.translation: Awaiting them is Hell. Their ˹worldly˺ gains will not be of any benefit to them whatsoever, nor will those protectors they have taken besides Allah. And they will suffer a tremendous punishment

verses.text: This [Qur'an] is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature.
verses.translation: This ˹Quran˺ is ˹true˺ guidance. And those who deny their Lord’s revelations will suffer the ˹worst˺ torment of agonizing pain

verses.text: It is Allah who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by His command and that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
verses.translation: Allah is the One Who has subjected the sea for you so that ships may sail upon it by His command, and that you may seek His bounty, and that perhaps you will be grateful

verses.text: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
verses.translation: He ˹also˺ subjected for you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth—all by His grace. Surely in this are signs for people who reflect

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of Allah so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.
verses.translation: ˹O Prophet!˺ Tell the believers to forgive those who do not fear Allah’s days ˹of torment˺, so that He will reward each group for what they used to commit

verses.text: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against the self. Then to your Lord you will be returned.
verses.translation: Whoever does good, it is to their own benefit. And whoever does evil, it is to their own loss. Then to your Lord you will ˹all˺ be returned

verses.text: And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds.
verses.translation: Indeed, We gave the Children of Israel the Scripture, wisdom, and prophethood; granted them good, lawful provisions; and favoured them above the others

verses.text: And We gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
verses.translation: We ˹also˺ gave them clear commandments regarding ˹their˺ faith. But it was not until knowledge came to them that they differed out of mutual envy. Surely your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Judgment regarding their differences

verses.text: Then We put you, [O Muhammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.
verses.translation: Now We have set you ˹O Prophet˺ on the ˹clear˺ Way of faith. So follow it, and do not follow the desires of those who do not know ˹the truth˺

verses.text: Indeed, they will never avail you against Allah at all. And indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but Allah is the protector of the righteous.
verses.translation: They certainly can be of no benefit to you against Allah whatsoever. Surely the wrongdoers are patrons of each other, whereas Allah is the Patron of the righteous

verses.text: This [Qur'an] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].
verses.translation: This ˹Quran˺ is an insight for humanity—a guide and mercy for people of sure faith

verses.text: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge.
verses.translation: Or do those who commit evil deeds ˹simply˺ think that We will make them equal—in their life and after their death—to those who believe and do good? How wrong is their judgment

verses.text: And Allah created the heavens and earth in truth and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.
verses.translation: For Allah created the heavens and the earth for a purpose, so that every soul may be paid back for what it has committed. And none will be wronged

verses.text: Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and Allah has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? So who will guide him after Allah ? Then will you not be reminded?
verses.translation: Have you seen ˹O Prophet˺ those who have taken their own desires as their god? ˹And so˺ Allah left them to stray knowingly, sealed their hearing and hearts, and placed a cover on their sight. Who then can guide them after Allah? Will you ˹all˺ not then be mindful

verses.text: And they say, "There is not but our worldly life; we die and live, and nothing destroys us except time." And they have of that no knowledge; they are only assuming.
verses.translation: And they argue, “There is nothing beyond our worldly life. We die; others are born. And nothing destroys us but ˹the passage of˺ time.” Yet they have no knowledge ˹in support˺ of this ˹claim˺. They only speculate

verses.text: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, "Bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
verses.translation: And whenever Our clear revelations are recited to them, their only argument is to say: “Bring our forefathers back, if what you say is true!”

verses.text: Say, " Allah causes you to live, then causes you to die; then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know."
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “˹It is˺ Allah ˹Who˺ gives you life, then causes you to die, then will gather you ˹all˺ on the Day of Judgment, about which there is no doubt. But most people do not know.”

verses.text: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And the Day the Hour appears - that Day the falsifiers will lose.
verses.translation: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. On the Day the Hour will be established, the people of falsehood will then be in ˹total˺ loss

verses.text: And you will see every nation kneeling [from fear]. Every nation will be called to its record [and told], "Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.
verses.translation: And you will see every faith-community on its knees. Every community will be summoned to its record ˹of deeds˺. ˹They all will be told,˺ “This Day you will be rewarded for what you used to do

verses.text: This, Our record, speaks about you in truth. Indeed, We were having transcribed whatever you used to do."
verses.translation: This record of Ours speaks the truth about you. Indeed, We always had your deeds recorded ˹by the angels˺.”

verses.text: So as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is what is the clear attainment.
verses.translation: As for those who believed and did good, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is ˹truly˺ the absolute triumph

verses.text: But as for those who disbelieved, [it will be said], "Were not Our verses recited to you, but you were arrogant and became a people of criminals?
verses.translation: And as for those who disbelieved, ˹they will be told,˺ “Were My revelations not recited to you, yet you acted arrogantly and were a wicked people

verses.text: And when it was said, 'Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth and the Hour [is coming] - no doubt about it,' you said, 'We know not what is the Hour. We assume only assumption, and we are not convinced.' "
verses.translation: And whenever it was said ˹to you˺, ‘Surely Allah’s promise ˹of judgment˺ is true and there is no doubt about the Hour,’ you said ˹mockingly˺, ‘We do not know what the Hour is! We think it is no more than speculation, and we are not convinced ˹that it will ever come˺.’”

verses.text: And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
verses.translation: And the evil ˹consequences˺ of their deeds will unfold before them, and they will be overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule

verses.text: And it will be said, "Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers.
verses.translation: It will be said, “This Day We will neglect you as you neglected the meeting of this Day of yours! Your home will be the Fire, and you will have no helpers

verses.text: That is because you took the verses of Allah in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [ Allah ].
verses.translation: This is because you made a mockery of Allah’s revelations, and were deluded by ˹your˺ worldly life.” So ˹from˺ that Day ˹on˺ they will not be taken out of the Fire, nor will they be allowed to appease ˹their Lord˺

verses.text: Then, to Allah belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: So all praise is for Allah—Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of all worlds

verses.text: And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.translation: To Him belongs ˹all˺ Majesty in the heavens and the earth. And He is the Almighty, All-Wise

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Ha, Meem.
verses.translation: Ḥâ-Mĩm

verses.text: The revelation of the Book is from Allah , the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.translation: The revelation of this Book is from Allah—the Almighty, All-Wise

verses.text: We did not create the heavens and earth and what is between them except in truth and [for] a specified term. But those who disbelieve, from that of which they are warned, are turning away.
verses.translation: We only created the heavens and the earth and everything in between for a purpose and an appointed term. Yet the disbelievers are turning away from what they have been warned about

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered that which you invoke besides Allah ? Show me what they have created of the earth; or did they have partnership in [creation of] the heavens? Bring me a scripture [revealed] before this or a [remaining] trace of knowledge, if you should be truthful."
verses.translation: Ask ˹them, O Prophet˺, “Have you considered whatever ˹idols˺ you invoke besides Allah? Show me what they have created on earth! Or do they have a share in ˹the creation of˺ the heavens? Bring me a scripture ˹revealed˺ before this ˹Quran˺ or a shred of knowledge, if what you say is true.”

verses.text: And who is more astray than he who invokes besides Allah those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection, and they, of their invocation, are unaware.
verses.translation: And who could be more astray than those who call upon others besides Allah—˹others˺ that cannot respond to them until the Day of Judgment, and are ˹even˺ unaware of their calls

verses.text: And when the people are gathered [that Day], they [who were invoked] will be enemies to them, and they will be deniers of their worship.
verses.translation: And when ˹such˺ people will be gathered together, those ˹gods˺ will be their enemies and will disown their worship

verses.text: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, "This is obvious magic."
verses.translation: Whenever Our clear revelations are recited to them, the disbelievers say of the truth when it has come to them, “This is pure magic.”

verses.text: Or do they say, "He has invented it?" Say, "If I have invented it, you will not possess for me [the power of protection] from Allah at all. He is most knowing of that in which you are involved. Sufficient is He as Witness between me and you, and He is the Forgiving the Merciful."
verses.translation: Or do they say, “He has fabricated this ˹Quran˺!”? Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “If I have done so, then there is nothing whatsoever you can do to save me from Allah. He knows best what ˹slurs˺ you indulge about it. Sufficient is He as a Witness between you and me. And He is the All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.”

verses.text: Say, "I am not something original among the messengers, nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow that which is revealed to me, and I am not but a clear warner."
verses.translation: Say, “I am not the first messenger ever sent, nor do I know what will happen to me or you. I only follow what is revealed to me. And I am only sent with a clear warning.”

verses.text: Say, "Have you considered: if the Qur'an was from Allah , and you disbelieved in it while a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to something similar and believed while you were arrogant... ?" Indeed, Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.
verses.translation: Ask ˹them, O Prophet˺, “Consider if this ˹Quran˺ is ˹truly˺ from Allah and you deny it, and a witness from the Children of Israel attests to it and then believes, whereas you act arrogantly. Surely Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.”

verses.text: And those who disbelieve say of those who believe, "If it had [truly] been good, they would not have preceded us to it." And when they are not guided by it, they will say, "This is an ancient falsehood."
verses.translation: The disbelievers say of the believers, “Had it been ˹something˺ good, they would not have beaten us to it.” Now since they reject its guidance, they will say, “˹This is˺ an ancient fabrication!”

verses.text: And before it was the scripture of Moses to lead and as a mercy. And this is a confirming Book in an Arabic tongue to warn those who have wronged and as good tidings to the doers of good.
verses.translation: And before this ˹Quran˺ the Book of Moses was ˹revealed as˺ a guide and mercy. And this Book is a confirmation, in the Arabic tongue, to warn those who do wrong, and as good news to those who do good

verses.text: Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allah ," and then remained on a right course - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
verses.translation: Surely those who say, “Our Lord is Allah,” and then remain steadfast—there will be no fear for them, nor will they grieve

verses.text: Those are the companions of Paradise, abiding eternally therein as reward for what they used to do.
verses.translation: It is they who will be the residents of Paradise, staying there forever, as a reward for what they used to do

verses.text: And We have enjoined upon man, to his parents, good treatment. His mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship, and his gestation and weaning [period] is thirty months. [He grows] until, when he reaches maturity and reaches [the age of] forty years, he says, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims."
verses.translation: We have commanded people to honour their parents. Their mothers bore them in hardship and delivered them in hardship. Their ˹period of˺ bearing and weaning is thirty months. In time, when the child reaches their prime at the age of forty, they pray, “My Lord! Inspire me to ˹always˺ be thankful for Your favours which You blessed me and my parents with, and to do good deeds that please You. And instil righteousness in my offspring. I truly repent to You, and I truly submit ˹to Your Will˺.”

verses.text: Those are the ones from whom We will accept the best of what they did and overlook their misdeeds, [their being] among the companions of Paradise. [That is] the promise of truth which they had been promised.
verses.translation: It is from these ˹people˺ that We will accept the good they did, and overlook their misdeeds—along with the residents of Paradise, ˹in fulfilment of˺ the true promise they have been given

verses.text: But one who says to his parents, "Uff to you; do you promise me that I will be brought forth [from the earth] when generations before me have already passed on [into oblivion]?" while they call to Allah for help [and to their son], "Woe to you! Believe! Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth." But he says, "This is not but legends of the former people" -
verses.translation: But some scold their parents, “Enough with you! Are you warning me that I will be brought forth ˹from the grave˺, while many generations had already perished before me ˹for good˺?” The parents cry to Allah for help, ˹and warn their child,˺ “Pity you. Have faith! Surely Allah’s promise is true.” But the deniers insist, “This is nothing but ancient fables.”

verses.text: Those are the ones upon whom the word has come into effect, [who will be] among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers.
verses.translation: These are the ones against whom the fate of earlier communities of jinn and humans has been justified, ˹for˺ they were truly losers

verses.text: And for all there are degrees [of reward and punishment] for what they have done, and [it is] so that He may fully compensate them for their deeds, and they will not be wronged.
verses.translation: Each ˹of the two groups˺ will be ranked according to what they have done so He may fully reward all. And none will be wronged

verses.text: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "You exhausted your pleasures during your worldly life and enjoyed them, so this Day you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation because you were arrogant upon the earth without right and because you were defiantly disobedient."
verses.translation: ˹Watch for˺ the Day ˹when˺ the disbelievers will be exposed to the Fire. ˹They will be told,˺ “You ˹already˺ exhausted your ˹share of˺ pleasures during your worldly life, and ˹fully˺ enjoyed them. So Today you will be rewarded with the torment of disgrace for your arrogance throughout the land with no right, and for your rebelliousness.”

verses.text: And mention, [O Muhammad], the brother of 'Aad, when he warned his people in the [region of] al-Ahqaf - and warners had already passed on before him and after him - [saying], "Do not worship except Allah . Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
verses.translation: And remember the brother of ’Ȃd, when he warned his people, who inhabited the sand-hills—there were certainly warners before and after him—˹saying,˺ “Worship none but Allah. I truly fear for you the torment of a tremendous day.”

verses.text: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful."
verses.translation: They argued, “Have you come to turn us away from our gods? Bring us then whatever you threaten us with, if what you say is true.”

verses.text: He said, "Knowledge [of its time] is only with Allah , and I convey to you that with which I was sent; but I see you [to be] a people behaving ignorantly."
verses.translation: He responded, “The knowledge ˹of its time˺ is only with Allah. I only convey to you what I have been sent with. But I can see that you are a people acting ignorantly.”

verses.text: And when they saw it as a cloud approaching their valleys, they said, "This is a cloud bringing us rain!" Rather, it is that for which you were impatient: a wind, within it a painful punishment,
verses.translation: Then when they saw the torment as a ˹dense˺ cloud approaching their valleys, they said ˹happily˺, “This is a cloud bringing us rain.” ˹But Hûd replied,˺ “No, it is what you sought to hasten: a ˹fierce˺ wind carrying a painful punishment!”

verses.text: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people.
verses.translation: It destroyed everything by the command of its Lord, leaving nothing visible except their ruins. This is how We reward the wicked people

verses.text: And We had certainly established them in such as We have not established you, and We made for them hearing and vision and hearts. But their hearing and vision and hearts availed them not from anything [of the punishment] when they were [continually] rejecting the signs of Allah ; and they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
verses.translation: Indeed, We had established them in a way We have not established you ˹Meccans˺. And We gave them hearing, sight, and intellect. But neither their hearing, sight, nor intellect were of any benefit to them whatsoever, since they persisted in denying Allah’s signs. And ˹so˺ they were overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule

verses.text: And We have already destroyed what surrounds you of [those] cities, and We have diversified the signs [or verses] that perhaps they might return [from disbelief].
verses.translation: We certainly destroyed the societies around you after having varied the signs so perhaps they would return ˹to the Right Path˺

verses.text: Then why did those they took besides Allah as deities by which to approach [Him] not aid them? But they had strayed from them. And that was their falsehood and what they were inventing.
verses.translation: Why then did those ˹idols˺ they took as gods—hoping to get closer ˹to Him˺—not come to their aid? Instead, they failed them. That is ˹the result of˺ their lies and their fabrications

verses.text: And [mention, O Muhammad], when We directed to you a few of the jinn, listening to the Qur'an. And when they attended it, they said, "Listen quietly." And when it was concluded, they went back to their people as warners.
verses.translation: ˹Remember, O Prophet,˺ when We sent a group of jinn your way to listen to the Quran. Then, upon hearing it, they said ˹to one another˺, “Listen quietly!” Then when it was over, they returned to their fellow jinn as warners

verses.text: They said, "O our people, indeed we have heard a [recited] Book revealed after Moses confirming what was before it which guides to the truth and to a straight path.
verses.translation: They declared, “O our fellow jinn! We have truly heard a scripture revealed after Moses, confirming what came before it. It guides to the truth and the Straight Way

verses.text: O our people, respond to the Messenger of Allah and believe in him; Allah will forgive for you your sins and protect you from a painful punishment.
verses.translation: O our fellow jinn! Respond to the caller of Allah and believe in him, He will forgive your sins and protect you from a painful punishment

verses.text: But he who does not respond to the Caller of Allah will not cause failure [to Him] upon earth, and he will not have besides Him any protectors. Those are in manifest error."
verses.translation: And whoever does not respond to the caller of Allah will have no escape on earth, nor will they have any protectors against Him. It is they who are clearly astray.”

verses.text: Do they not see that Allah , who created the heavens and earth and did not fail in their creation, is able to give life to the dead? Yes. Indeed, He is over all things competent.
verses.translation: Do they not realize that Allah, Who created the heavens and the earth and did not tire in creating them, is able to give life to the dead? Yes ˹indeed˺! He is certainly Most Capable of everything

verses.text: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], "Is this not the truth?" They will say, "Yes, by our Lord." He will say, "Then taste the punishment because you used to disbelieve."
verses.translation: And on the Day the disbelievers will be exposed to the Fire, ˹they will be asked,˺ “Is this ˹Hereafter˺ not the truth?” They will cry, “Absolutely, by our Lord!” It will be said, “Then taste the punishment for your disbelief.”

verses.text: So be patient, [O Muhammad], as were those of determination among the messengers and do not be impatient for them. It will be - on the Day they see that which they are promised - as though they had not remained [in the world] except an hour of a day. [This is] notification. And will [any] be destroyed except the defiantly disobedient people?
verses.translation: So endure patiently, as did the Messengers of Firm Resolve. And do not ˹seek to˺ hasten ˹the torment˺ for the deniers. On the Day they see what they have been threatened with, it will be as if they had only stayed ˹in this world˺ for an hour of a day. ˹This is˺ a ˹sufficient˺ warning! Then, will anyone be destroyed except the rebellious people

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Those who disbelieve and avert [people] from the way of Allah - He will waste their deeds.
verses.translation: Those who disbelieve and hinder ˹others˺ from the Way of Allah, He will render their deeds void

verses.text: And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muhammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition.
verses.translation: As for those who believe, do good, and have faith in what has been revealed to Muḥammad—which is the truth from their Lord—He will absolve them of their sins and improve their condition

verses.text: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood, and those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Thus does Allah present to the people their comparisons.
verses.translation: This is because the disbelievers follow falsehood, while the believers follow the truth from their Lord. This is how Allah shows people their true state ˹of faith˺

verses.text: So when you meet those who disbelieve [in battle], strike [their] necks until, when you have inflicted slaughter upon them, then secure their bonds, and either [confer] favor afterwards or ransom [them] until the war lays down its burdens. That [is the command]. And if Allah had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them [Himself], but [He ordered armed struggle] to test some of you by means of others. And those who are killed in the cause of Allah - never will He waste their deeds.
verses.translation: So when you meet the disbelievers ˹in battle˺, strike ˹their˺ necks until you have thoroughly subdued them, then bind them firmly. Later ˹free them either as˺ an act of grace or by ransom until the war comes to an end. So will it be. Had Allah willed, He ˹Himself˺ could have inflicted punishment on them. But He does ˹this only to˺ test some of you by means of others. And those who are martyred in the cause of Allah, He will never render their deeds void

verses.text: He will guide them and amend their condition
verses.translation: He will guide them ˹to their reward˺, improve their condition

verses.text: And admit them to Paradise, which He has made known to them.
verses.translation: and admit them into Paradise, having made it known to them

verses.text: O you who have believed, if you support Allah , He will support you and plant firmly your feet.
verses.translation: O believers! If you stand up for Allah, He will help you and make your steps firm

verses.text: But those who disbelieve - for them is misery, and He will waste their deeds.
verses.translation: As for the disbelievers, may they be doomed and may He render their deeds void

verses.text: That is because they disliked what Allah revealed, so He rendered worthless their deeds.
verses.translation: That is because they detest what Allah has revealed, so He has rendered their deeds void

verses.text: Have they not traveled through the land and seen how was the end of those before them? Allah destroyed [everything] over them, and for the disbelievers is something comparable.
verses.translation: Have they not travelled throughout the land to see what was the end of those before them? Allah annihilated them, and a similar fate awaits the disbelievers

verses.text: That is because Allah is the protector of those who have believed and because the disbelievers have no protector.
verses.translation: This is because Allah is the Patron of the believers while the disbelievers have no patron

verses.text: Indeed, Allah will admit those who have believed and done righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow, but those who disbelieve enjoy themselves and eat as grazing livestock eat, and the Fire will be a residence for them.
verses.translation: Surely Allah will admit those who believe and do good into Gardens under which rivers flow. As for the disbelievers, they enjoy themselves and feed like cattle. But the Fire will be their home

verses.text: And how many a city was stronger than your city [Makkah] which drove you out? We destroyed them; and there was no helper for them.
verses.translation: ˹Imagine, O Prophet,˺ how many societies We destroyed that were far superior in might than your society—which drove you out—and there was none to help them

verses.text: So is he who is on clear evidence from his Lord like him to whom the evil of his work has been made attractive and they follow their [own] desires?
verses.translation: Can those ˹believers˺ who stand on clear proof from their Lord be like those whose evil deeds are made appealing to them and ˹only˺ follow their desires

verses.text: Is the description of Paradise, which the righteous are promised, wherein are rivers of water unaltered, rivers of milk the taste of which never changes, rivers of wine delicious to those who drink, and rivers of purified honey, in which they will have from all [kinds of] fruits and forgiveness from their Lord, like [that of] those who abide eternally in the Fire and are given to drink scalding water that will sever their intestines?
verses.translation: The description of the Paradise promised to the righteous is that in it are rivers of fresh water, rivers of milk that never changes in taste, rivers of wine delicious to drink, and rivers of pure honey. There they will ˹also˺ have all kinds of fruit, and forgiveness from their Lord. ˹Can they be˺ like those who will stay in the Fire forever, left to drink boiling water that will tear apart their insides

verses.text: And among them, [O Muhammad], are those who listen to you, until when they depart from you, they say to those who were given knowledge, "What has he said just now?" Those are the ones of whom Allah has sealed over their hearts and who have followed their [own] desires.
verses.translation: There are some of them who listen to you ˹O Prophet˺, but when they depart from you, they say ˹mockingly˺ to those ˹believers˺ gifted with knowledge, “What did he just say?” These are the ones whose hearts Allah has sealed and who ˹only˺ follow their desires

verses.text: And those who are guided - He increases them in guidance and gives them their righteousness.
verses.translation: As for those who are ˹rightly˺ guided, He increases them in guidance and blesses them with righteousness

verses.text: Then do they await except that the Hour should come upon them unexpectedly? But already there have come [some of] its indications. Then what good to them, when it has come, will be their remembrance?
verses.translation: Are they only waiting for the Hour to take them by surprise? Yet ˹some of˺ its signs have already come. Once it actually befalls them, will it not be too late to be mindful

verses.text: So know, [O Muhammad], that there is no deity except Allah and ask forgiveness for your sin and for the believing men and believing women. And Allah knows of your movement and your resting place.
verses.translation: So, know ˹well, O Prophet,˺ that there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Allah. And seek forgiveness for your shortcomings and for ˹the sins of˺ the believing men and women. For Allah ˹fully˺ knows your movements and places of rest ˹O people˺

verses.text: Those who believe say, "Why has a surah not been sent down? But when a precise surah is revealed and fighting is mentioned therein, you see those in whose hearts is hypocrisy looking at you with a look of one overcome by death. And more appropriate for them [would have been]
verses.translation: And the believers say, “If only a sûrah was revealed ˹allowing self-defence˺!” Yet when a precise sûrah is revealed, in which fighting is ˹explicitly˺ mentioned, you see those with sickness in their hearts staring at you like someone in the throes of death. It would have been better for them

verses.text: Obedience and good words. And when the matter [of fighting] was determined, if they had been true to Allah , it would have been better for them.
verses.translation: to obey and speak rightly. Then when fighting was ordained, it surely would have been better for them if they were true to Allah

verses.text: So would you perhaps, if you turned away, cause corruption on earth and sever your [ties of] relationship?
verses.translation: Now if you ˹hypocrites˺ turn away, perhaps you would then spread corruption throughout the land and sever your ˹ties of˺ kinship

verses.text: Those [who do so] are the ones that Allah has cursed, so He deafened them and blinded their vision.
verses.translation: These are the ones who Allah has condemned, deafening them and blinding their eyes

verses.text: Then do they not reflect upon the Qur'an, or are there locks upon [their] hearts?
verses.translation: Do they not then reflect on the Quran? Or are there locks upon their hearts

verses.text: Indeed, those who reverted back [to disbelief] after guidance had become clear to them - Satan enticed them and prolonged hope for them.
verses.translation: Indeed, those who relapse ˹into disbelief˺ after ˹true˺ guidance has become clear to them, ˹it is˺ Satan ˹that˺ has tempted them, luring them with false hopes

verses.text: That is because they said to those who disliked what Allah sent down, "We will obey you in part of the matter." And Allah knows what they conceal.
verses.translation: That is because they said ˹privately˺ to those who ˹also˺ detest what Allah has revealed, “We will obey you in some matters.” But Allah ˹fully˺ knows what they are hiding

verses.text: Then how [will it be] when the angels take them in death, striking their faces and their backs?
verses.translation: Then how ˹horrible˺ will it be when the angels take their souls, beating their faces and backs

verses.text: That is because they followed what angered Allah and disliked [what earns] His pleasure, so He rendered worthless their deeds.
verses.translation: This is because they follow whatever displeases Allah and hate whatever pleases Him, so He has rendered their deeds void

verses.text: Or do those in whose hearts is disease think that Allah would never expose their [feelings of] hatred?
verses.translation: Or do those with sickness in their hearts think that Allah will not ˹be able to˺ expose their malice

verses.text: And if We willed, We could show them to you, and you would know them by their mark; but you will surely know them by the tone of [their] speech. And Allah knows your deeds.
verses.translation: Had We willed, We could have truly shown them to you ˹O Prophet˺, and you would have certainly recognized them by their appearance. But you will surely recognize them by their tone of speech. And Allah ˹fully˺ knows your doings ˹O people˺

verses.text: And We will surely test you until We make evident those who strive among you [for the cause of Allah ] and the patient, and We will test your affairs.
verses.translation: We will certainly test you ˹believers˺ until We prove those of you who ˹truly˺ struggle ˹in Allah’s cause˺ and remain steadfast, and reveal how you conduct yourselves

verses.text: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allah and opposed the Messenger after guidance had become clear to them - never will they harm Allah at all, and He will render worthless their deeds.
verses.translation: Indeed, those who disbelieve, hinder ˹others˺ from the Way of Allah, and defy the Messenger after ˹true˺ guidance has become clear to them; they will not harm Allah in the least, but He will render their deeds void

verses.text: O you who have believed, obey Allah and obey the Messenger and do not invalidate your deeds.
