verses.translation: O believers! Obey Allah and obey the Messenger, and do not let your deeds be in vain

verses.text: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allah and then died while they were disbelievers - never will Allah forgive them.
verses.translation: Surely those who disbelieve, hinder ˹others˺ from the Way of Allah, and then die as disbelievers; Allah will never forgive them

verses.text: So do not weaken and call for peace while you are superior; and Allah is with you and will never deprive you of [the reward of] your deeds.
verses.translation: So do not falter or cry for peace, for you will have the upper hand and Allah is with you. And He will never let your deeds go to waste

verses.text: [This] worldly life is only amusement and diversion. And if you believe and fear Allah , He will give you your rewards and not ask you for your properties.
verses.translation: This worldly life is no more than play and amusement. But if you are faithful and mindful ˹of Allah˺, He will grant you your ˹full˺ reward, and will not ask you ˹to donate all˺ your wealth

verses.text: If He should ask you for them and press you, you would withhold, and He would expose your unwillingness.
verses.translation: If He were to do so and pressure you, you would withhold and He would bring out your resentment

verses.text: Here you are - those invited to spend in the cause of Allah - but among you are those who withhold [out of greed]. And whoever withholds only withholds [benefit] from himself; and Allah is the Free of need, while you are the needy. And if you turn away, He will replace you with another people; then they will not be the likes of you.
verses.translation: Here you are, being invited to donate ˹a little˺ in the cause of Allah. Still some of you withhold. And whoever does so, it is only to their own loss. For Allah is the Self-Sufficient, whereas you stand in need ˹of Him˺. If you ˹still˺ turn away, He will replace you with another people. And they will not be like you

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Indeed, We have given you, [O Muhammad], a clear conquest
verses.translation: Indeed, We have granted you a clear triumph ˹O Prophet˺

verses.text: That Allah may forgive for you what preceded of your sin and what will follow and complete His favor upon you and guide you to a straight path
verses.translation: so that Allah may forgive you for your past and future shortcomings, perfect His favour upon you, guide you along the Straight Path

verses.text: And [that] Allah may aid you with a mighty victory.
verses.translation: and so that Allah will help you tremendously

verses.text: It is He who sent down tranquillity into the hearts of the believers that they would increase in faith along with their [present] faith. And to Allah belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth, and ever is Allah Knowing and Wise.
verses.translation: He is the One Who sent down serenity upon the hearts of the believers so that they may increase even more in their faith. To Allah ˹alone˺ belong the forces of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise

verses.text: [And] that He may admit the believing men and the believing women to gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein eternally and remove from them their misdeeds - and ever is that, in the sight of Allah , a great attainment -
verses.translation: So He may admit believing men and women into Gardens under which rivers flow—to stay there forever—and absolve them of their sins. And that is a supreme achievement in the sight of Allah

verses.text: And [that] He may punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women, and the polytheist men and polytheist women - those who assume about Allah an assumption of evil nature. Upon them is a misfortune of evil nature; and Allah has become angry with them and has cursed them and prepared for them Hell, and evil it is as a destination.
verses.translation: Also ˹so that˺ He may punish hypocrite men and women and polytheistic men and women, who harbour evil thoughts of Allah. May ill-fate befall them! Allah is displeased with them. He has condemned them and prepared for them Hell. What an evil destination

verses.text: And to Allah belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth. And ever is Allah Exalted in Might and Wise.
verses.translation: To Allah ˹alone˺ belong the forces of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Almighty, All-Wise

verses.text: Indeed, We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner
verses.translation: Indeed, ˹O Prophet,˺ We have sent you as a witness, a deliverer of good news, and a warner

verses.text: That you [people] may believe in Allah and His Messenger and honor him and respect the Prophet and exalt Allah morning and afternoon.
verses.translation: so that you ˹believers˺ may have faith in Allah and His Messenger, support and honour him, and glorify Allah morning and evening

verses.text: Indeed, those who pledge allegiance to you, [O Muhammad] - they are actually pledging allegiance to Allah . The hand of Allah is over their hands. So he who breaks his word only breaks it to the detriment of himself. And he who fulfills that which he has promised Allah - He will give him a great reward.
verses.translation: Surely those who pledge allegiance to you ˹O Prophet˺ are actually pledging allegiance to Allah. Allah’s Hand is over theirs. Whoever breaks their pledge, it will only be to their own loss. And whoever fulfils their pledge to Allah, He will grant them a great reward

verses.text: Those who remained behind of the bedouins will say to you, "Our properties and our families occupied us, so ask forgiveness for us." They say with their tongues what is not within their hearts. Say, "Then who could prevent Allah at all if He intended for you harm or intended for you benefit? Rather, ever is Allah , with what you do, Acquainted.
verses.translation: The nomadic Arabs, who stayed behind, will say to you ˹O Prophet˺, “We were preoccupied with our wealth and families, so ask for forgiveness for us.” They say with their tongues what is not in their hearts. Say, “Who then can stand between you and Allah in any way, if He intends harm or benefit for you? In fact, Allah is All-Aware of what you do

verses.text: But you thought that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families, ever, and that was made pleasing in your hearts. And you assumed an assumption of evil and became a people ruined."
verses.translation: The truth is: you thought that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families again. And that was made appealing in your hearts. You harboured evil thoughts ˹about Allah˺, and ˹so˺ became a doomed people.”

verses.text: And whoever has not believed in Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers a Blaze.
verses.translation: And whoever does not believe in Allah and His Messenger, then We surely have prepared for the disbelievers a blazing Fire

verses.text: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.translation: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whoever He wills, and punishes whoever He wills. And Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful

verses.text: Those who remained behind will say when you set out toward the war booty to take it, "Let us follow you." They wish to change the words of Allah . Say, "Never will you follow us. Thus did Allah say before." So they will say, "Rather, you envy us." But [in fact] they were not understanding except a little.
verses.translation: Those who stayed behind will say, when you ˹believers˺ set out to take the spoils of war, “Let us accompany you.” They wish to change Allah’s promise. Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “You will not accompany us. This is what Allah has said before.” They will then say, “In fact, you are driven by jealousy against us!” The truth is: they can hardly comprehend

verses.text: Say to those who remained behind of the bedouins, "You will be called to [face] a people of great military might; you may fight them, or they will submit. So if you obey, Allah will give you a good reward; but if you turn away as you turned away before, He will punish you with a painful punishment."
verses.translation: Say to nomadic Arabs, who stayed behind, “You will be called ˹to fight˺ against a people of great might, who you will fight unless they submit. If you then obey, Allah will grant you a fine reward. But if you turn away as you did before, He will inflict upon you a painful punishment.”

verses.text: There is not upon the blind any guilt or upon the lame any guilt or upon the ill any guilt [for remaining behind]. And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger - He will admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow; but whoever turns away - He will punish him with a painful punishment.
verses.translation: There is no blame on the blind, or the disabled, or the sick ˹for staying behind˺. And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger will be admitted by Him into Gardens under which rivers flow. But whoever turns away will be subjected by Him to a painful punishment

verses.text: Certainly was Allah pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you, [O Muhammad], under the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down tranquillity upon them and rewarded them with an imminent conquest
verses.translation: Indeed, Allah was pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you ˹O Prophet˺ under the tree. He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down serenity upon them and rewarded them with a victory at hand

verses.text: And much war booty which they will take. And ever is Allah Exalted in Might and Wise.
verses.translation: and many spoils of war they will gain. For Allah is Almighty, All-Wise

verses.text: Allah has promised you much booty that you will take [in the future] and has hastened for you this [victory] and withheld the hands of people from you - that it may be a sign for the believers and [that] He may guide you to a straight path.
verses.translation: Allah has promised you ˹believers˺ abundant spoils, which you will gain, so He hastened this ˹truce˺ for you. And He has held people’s hands back from ˹harming˺ you, so it may be a sign for the believers, and so He may guide you along the Straight Path

verses.text: And [He promises] other [victories] that you were [so far] unable to [realize] which Allah has already encompassed. And ever is Allah , over all things, competent.
verses.translation: And ˹there are˺ other gains which are beyond your reach that Allah is keeping in store ˹for you˺. For Allah is Most Capable of everything

verses.text: And if those [Makkans] who disbelieve had fought you, they would have turned their backs [in flight]. Then they would not find a protector or a helper.
verses.translation: If the disbelievers were to fight you, they would certainly flee. Then they would never find any protector or helper

verses.text: [This is] the established way of Allah which has occurred before. And never will you find in the way of Allah any change.
verses.translation: ˹This is˺ Allah’s way, already long established ˹in the past˺. And you will find no change in Allah’s way

verses.text: And it is He who withheld their hands from you and your hands from them within [the area of] Makkah after He caused you to overcome them. And ever is Allah of what you do, Seeing.
verses.translation: He is the One Who held back their hands from you and your hands from them in the valley of ˹Ḥudaibiyah, near˺ Mecca, after giving you the upper hand over ˹a group of˺ them. And Allah is All-Seeing of what you do

verses.text: They are the ones who disbelieved and obstructed you from al-Masjid al-Haram while the offering was prevented from reaching its place of sacrifice. And if not for believing men and believing women whom you did not know - that you might trample them and there would befall you because of them dishonor without [your] knowledge - [you would have been permitted to enter Makkah]. [This was so] that Allah might admit to His mercy whom He willed. If they had been apart [from them], We would have punished those who disbelieved among them with painful punishment
verses.translation: They are the ones who persisted in disbelief and hindered you from the Sacred Mosque, preventing the sacrificial animals from reaching their destination. ˹We would have let you march through Mecca,˺ had there not been believing men and women, unknown to you. You might have trampled them underfoot, incurring guilt for ˹what you did to˺ them unknowingly. That was so Allah may admit into His mercy whoever He wills. Had those ˹unknown˺ believers stood apart, We would have certainly inflicted a painful punishment on the disbelievers

verses.text: When those who disbelieved had put into their hearts chauvinism - the chauvinism of the time of ignorance. But Allah sent down His tranquillity upon His Messenger and upon the believers and imposed upon them the word of righteousness, and they were more deserving of it and worthy of it. And ever is Allah , of all things, Knowing.
verses.translation: ˹Remember˺ when the disbelievers had filled their hearts with pride—the pride of ˹pre-Islamic˺ ignorance—then Allah sent down His serenity upon His Messenger and the believers, inspiring them to uphold the declaration of faith, for they were better entitled and more worthy of it. And Allah has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of all things

verses.text: Certainly has Allah showed to His Messenger the vision in truth. You will surely enter al-Masjid al-Haram, if Allah wills, in safety, with your heads shaved and [hair] shortened, not fearing [anyone]. He knew what you did not know and has arranged before that a conquest near [at hand].
verses.translation: Indeed, Allah will fulfil His Messenger’s vision in all truth: Allah willing, you will surely enter the Sacred Mosque, in security—˹some with˺ heads shaved and ˹others with˺ hair shortened—without fear. He knew what you did not know, so He first granted you the triumph at hand

verses.text: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion. And sufficient is Allah as Witness.
verses.translation: He is the One Who has sent His Messenger with ˹right˺ guidance and the religion of truth, making it prevail over all others. And sufficient is Allah as a Witness

verses.text: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah ; and those with him are forceful against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating [in prayer], seeking bounty from Allah and [His] pleasure. Their mark is on their faces from the trace of prostration. That is their description in the Torah. And their description in the Gospel is as a plant which produces its offshoots and strengthens them so they grow firm and stand upon their stalks, delighting the sowers - so that Allah may enrage by them the disbelievers. Allah has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds among them forgiveness and a great reward.
verses.translation: Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allah. And those with him are firm with the disbelievers and compassionate with one another. You see them bowing and prostrating ˹in prayer˺, seeking Allah’s bounty and pleasure. The sign ˹of brightness can be seen˺ on their faces from the trace of prostrating ˹in prayer˺. This is their description in the Torah. And their parable in the Gospel is that of a seed that sprouts its ˹tiny˺ branches, making it strong. Then it becomes thick, standing firmly on its stem, to the delight of the planters—in this way Allah makes the believers a source of dismay for the disbelievers. To those of them who believe and do good, Allah has promised forgiveness and a great reward

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: O you who have believed, do not put [yourselves] before Allah and His Messenger but fear Allah . Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing.
verses.translation: O believers! Do not proceed ˹in any matter˺ before ˹a decree from˺ Allah and His Messenger. And fear Allah. Surely Allah is All-Hearing, All-Knowing

verses.text: O you who have believed, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet or be loud to him in speech like the loudness of some of you to others, lest your deeds become worthless while you perceive not.
verses.translation: O believers! Do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet, nor speak loudly to him as you do to one another, or your deeds will become void while you are unaware

verses.text: Indeed, those who lower their voices before the Messenger of Allah - they are the ones whose hearts Allah has tested for righteousness. For them is forgiveness and great reward.
verses.translation: Indeed, those who lower their voices in the presence of Allah’s Messenger are the ones whose hearts Allah has refined for righteousness. They will have forgiveness and a great reward

verses.text: Indeed, those who call you, [O Muhammad], from behind the chambers - most of them do not use reason.
verses.translation: Indeed, most of those who call out to you ˹O Prophet˺ from outside ˹your˺ private quarters have no understanding ˹of manners˺

verses.text: And if they had been patient until you [could] come out to them, it would have been better for them. But Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.translation: Had they been patient until you could come out to them, it would have certainly been better for them. And Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful

verses.text: O you who have believed, if there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful.
verses.translation: O believers, if an evildoer brings you any news, verify ˹it˺ so you do not harm people unknowingly, becoming regretful for what you have done

verses.text: And know that among you is the Messenger of Allah . If he were to obey you in much of the matter, you would be in difficulty, but Allah has endeared to you the faith and has made it pleasing in your hearts and has made hateful to you disbelief, defiance and disobedience. Those are the [rightly] guided.
verses.translation: And keep in mind that Allah’s Messenger is ˹still˺ in your midst. If he were to yield to you in many matters, you would surely suffer ˹the consequences˺. But Allah has endeared faith to you, making it appealing in your hearts. And He has made disbelief, rebelliousness, and disobedience detestable to you. Those are the ones rightly guided

verses.text: [It is] as bounty from Allah and favor. And Allah is Knowing and Wise.
verses.translation: ˹This is˺ a bounty and a blessing from Allah. And Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise

verses.text: And if two factions among the believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of Allah . And if it returns, then make settlement between them in justice and act justly. Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly.
verses.translation: And if two groups of believers fight each other, then make peace between them. But if one of them transgresses against the other, then fight against the transgressing group until they ˹are willing to˺ submit to the rule of Allah. If they do so, then make peace between both ˹groups˺ in all fairness and act justly. Surely Allah loves those who uphold justice

verses.text: The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear Allah that you may receive mercy.
verses.translation: The believers are but one brotherhood, so make peace between your brothers. And be mindful of Allah so you may be shown mercy

verses.text: O you who have believed, let not a people ridicule [another] people; perhaps they may be better than them; nor let women ridicule [other] women; perhaps they may be better than them. And do not insult one another and do not call each other by [offensive] nicknames. Wretched is the name of disobedience after [one's] faith. And whoever does not repent - then it is those who are the wrongdoers.
verses.translation: O believers! Do not let some ˹men˺ ridicule others, they may be better than them, nor let ˹some˺ women ridicule other women, they may be better than them. Do not defame one another, nor call each other by offensive nicknames. How evil it is to act rebelliously after having faith! And whoever does not repent, it is they who are the ˹true˺ wrongdoers

verses.text: O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? You would detest it. And fear Allah ; indeed, Allah is Accepting of repentance and Merciful.
verses.translation: O believers! Avoid many suspicions, ˹for˺ indeed, some suspicions are sinful. And do not spy, nor backbite one another. Would any of you like to eat the flesh of their dead brother? You would despise that! And fear Allah. Surely Allah is ˹the˺ Accepter of Repentance, Most Merciful

verses.text: O mankind, indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another. Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Acquainted.
verses.translation: O humanity! Indeed, We created you from a male and a female, and made you into peoples and tribes so that you may ˹get to˺ know one another. Surely the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous among you. Allah is truly All-Knowing, All-Aware

verses.text: The bedouins say, "We have believed." Say, "You have not [yet] believed; but say [instead], 'We have submitted,' for faith has not yet entered your hearts. And if you obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not deprive you from your deeds of anything. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful."
verses.translation: ˹Some of˺ the nomadic Arabs say, “We believe.” Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “You have not believed. But say, ‘We have submitted,’ for faith has not yet entered your hearts. But if you obey Allah and His Messenger ˹wholeheartedly˺, He will not discount anything from ˹the reward of˺ your deeds. Allah is truly All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.”

verses.text: The believers are only the ones who have believed in Allah and His Messenger and then doubt not but strive with their properties and their lives in the cause of Allah . It is those who are the truthful.
verses.translation: The ˹true˺ believers are only those who believe in Allah and His Messenger—never doubting—and strive with their wealth and their lives in the cause of Allah. They are the ones true in faith

verses.text: Say, "Would you acquaint Allah with your religion while Allah knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and Allah is Knowing of all things?"
verses.translation: Say, “Do you inform Allah of your faith, when Allah ˹already˺ knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth? And Allah has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of all things.”

verses.text: They consider it a favor to you that they have accepted Islam. Say, "Do not consider your Islam a favor to me. Rather, Allah has conferred favor upon you that He has guided you to the faith, if you should be truthful."
verses.translation: They regard their acceptance of Islam as a favour to you. Tell ˹them, O Prophet˺, “Do not regard your Islam as a favour to me. Rather, it is Allah Who has done you a favour by guiding you to the faith, if ˹indeed˺ you are faithful

verses.text: Indeed, Allah knows the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Seeing of what you do.
verses.translation: Surely Allah knows the unseen of the heavens and earth. And Allah is All-Seeing of what you do.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Qaf. By the honored Qur'an...
verses.translation: Qãf. By the glorious Quran

verses.text: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.
verses.translation: ˹All will be resurrected,˺ yet the deniers are astonished that a warner has come to them from among themselves ˹warning of resurrection˺. So the disbelievers say, “This is an astonishing thing

verses.text: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant return."
verses.translation: ˹Will we be returned to life,˺ when we are dead and reduced to dust? Such a return is impossible.”

verses.text: We know what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a retaining record.
verses.translation: We certainly know what the earth consumes of them ˹after their death˺, and with us is a well-preserved Record

verses.text: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.
verses.translation: In fact, they reject the truth when it has come to them, so they are in a confused state

verses.text: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?
verses.translation: Have they not then looked at the sky above them: how We built it and adorned it ˹with stars˺, leaving it flawless

verses.text: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,
verses.translation: As for the earth, We spread it out and placed upon it firm mountains, and produced in it every type of pleasant plant—

verses.text: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allah ].
verses.translation: ˹all as˺ an insight and a reminder to every servant who turns ˹to Allah˺

verses.text: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
verses.translation: And We send down blessed rain from the sky, bringing forth gardens and grains for harvest

verses.text: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -
verses.translation: and towering palm trees ˹loaded˺ with clustered fruit

verses.text: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the resurrection.
verses.translation: ˹as˺ a provision for ˹Our˺ servants. And with this ˹rain˺ We revive a lifeless land. Similar is the emergence ˹from the graves˺

verses.text: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamud
verses.translation: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth,˺ as did the people of the Water-pit, Thamûd

verses.text: And 'Aad and Pharaoh and the brothers of Lot
verses.translation: ’Ȃd, Pharaoh, the kinfolk of Lot

verses.text: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubba'. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.
verses.translation: the residents of the Forest, and the people of Tubba’. Each rejected ˹their˺ messenger, so My warning was fulfilled

verses.text: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
verses.translation: Were We incapable of creating ˹them˺ the first time? In fact, they are in doubt about ˹their˺ re-creation

verses.text: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein
verses.translation: Indeed, ˹it is˺ We ˹Who˺ created humankind and ˹fully˺ know what their souls whisper to them, and We are closer to them than ˹their˺ jugular vein

verses.text: When the two receivers receive, seated on the right and on the left.
verses.translation: As the two recording-angels—˹one˺ sitting to the right, and ˹the other to˺ the left—note ˹everything˺

verses.text: Man does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].
verses.translation: not a word does a person utter without having a ˹vigilant˺ observer ready ˹to write it down˺

verses.text: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
verses.translation: ˹Ultimately,˺ with the throes of death will come the truth. This is what you were trying to escape

verses.text: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.
verses.translation: And the Trumpet will be blown. This is the Day ˹you were˺ warned of

verses.text: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.
verses.translation: Each soul will come forth with an angel to drive it and another to testify

verses.text: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
verses.translation: ˹It will be said to the denier,˺ “You were totally heedless of this. Now We have lifted this veil of yours, so Today your sight is sharp!”

verses.text: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."
verses.translation: And one’s accompanying-angel will say, “Here is the record ready with me.”

verses.text: [ Allah will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,
verses.translation: ˹It will be said to both angels,˺ “Throw into Hell every stubborn disbeliever

verses.text: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,
verses.translation: withholder of good, transgressor, and doubter

verses.text: Who made [as equal] with Allah another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."
verses.translation: who set up another god with Allah. So cast them into the severe punishment.”

verses.text: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."
verses.translation: One’s ˹devilish˺ associate will say, “Our Lord! I did not make them transgress. Rather, they were far astray ˹on their own˺.”

verses.text: [ Allah ] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the warning.
verses.translation: Allah will respond, “Do not dispute in My presence, since I had already given you a warning

verses.text: The word will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."
verses.translation: My Word cannot be changed, nor am I unjust to ˹My˺ creation.”

verses.text: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"
verses.translation: ˹Beware of˺ the Day We will ask Hell, “Are you full ˹yet˺?” And it will respond, “Are there any more?”

verses.text: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,
verses.translation: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far off

verses.text: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allah ] and keeper [of His covenant]
verses.translation: ˹And it will be said to them,˺ “This is what you were promised, for whoever ˹constantly˺ turned ˹to Allah˺ and kept up ˹His commandments˺—

verses.text: Who feared the Most Merciful unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].
verses.translation: who were in awe of the Most Compassionate without seeing ˹Him˺, and have come with a heart turning ˹only to Him˺

verses.text: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."
verses.translation: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of eternal life!”

verses.text: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.
verses.translation: There they will have whatever they desire, and with Us is ˹even˺ more

verses.text: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?
verses.translation: ˹Imagine˺ how many peoples We destroyed before them, who were far mightier than them. Then ˹when the torment came,˺ they ˹desperately˺ sought refuge in the land. ˹But˺ was there any escape

verses.text: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].
verses.translation: Surely in this is a reminder for whoever has a ˹mindful˺ heart and lends an attentive ear

verses.text: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.
verses.translation: Indeed, We created the heavens and the earth and everything in between in six Days, and We were not ˹even˺ touched with fatigue

verses.text: So be patient, [O Muhammad], over what they say and exalt [ Allah ] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,
verses.translation: So be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say. And glorify the praises of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset

verses.text: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration.
verses.translation: And glorify Him during part of the night and after the prayers

verses.text: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -
verses.translation: And listen! On the Day the caller will call out from a near place

verses.text: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
verses.translation: the Day all will hear the ˹mighty˺ Blast in ˹all˺ truth, that will be the Day of emergence ˹from the graves˺

verses.text: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
verses.translation: It is certainly We Who give life and cause death. And to Us is the final return

verses.text: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.
verses.translation: ˹Beware of˺ the Day the earth will split open, letting them rush forth. That will be an easy gathering for Us

verses.text: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur'an whoever fears My threat.
verses.translation: We know best what they say. And you ˹O Prophet˺ are not ˹there˺ to compel them ˹to believe˺. So remind with the Quran ˹only˺ those who fear My warning

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: By those [winds] scattering [dust] dispersing
verses.translation: By the winds scattering ˹dust˺

verses.text: And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]
verses.translation: and ˹the clouds˺ loaded with rain

verses.text: And those [ships] sailing with ease
verses.translation: and ˹the ships˺ gliding with ease

verses.text: And those [angels] apportioning [each] matter,
verses.translation: and ˹the angels˺ administering affairs by ˹Allah’s˺ command

verses.text: Indeed, what you are promised is true.
verses.translation: Indeed, what you are promised is true

verses.text: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.
verses.translation: And the Judgment will certainly come to pass

verses.text: By the heaven containing pathways,
verses.translation: ˹And˺ by the heavens in their marvellous design

verses.text: Indeed, you are in differing speech.
verses.translation: Surely you are ˹lost˺ in conflicting views ˹regarding the truth˺

verses.text: Deluded away from the Qur'an is he who is deluded.
verses.translation: Only those ˹destined to be˺ deluded are turned away from it

verses.text: Destroyed are the falsifiers
verses.translation: Condemned are the liars—

verses.text: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.
verses.translation: those who are ˹steeped˺ in ignorance, totally heedless

verses.text: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"
verses.translation: They ask ˹mockingly˺, “When is this Day of Judgment?”

verses.text: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire
verses.translation: ˹It is˺ the Day they will be tormented over the Fire

verses.text: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."
verses.translation: ˹They will be told,˺ “Taste your torment! This is what you sought to hasten.”

verses.text: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and springs

verses.text: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
verses.translation: ˹joyfully˺ receiving what their Lord will grant them. Before this ˹reward˺ they were truly good-doers ˹in the world˺

verses.text: They used to sleep but little of the night,
verses.translation: they used to sleep only little in the night

verses.text: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,
verses.translation: and pray for forgiveness before dawn

verses.text: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.
verses.translation: And in their wealth there was a rightful share ˹fulfilled˺ for the beggar and the poor

verses.text: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
verses.translation: There are ˹countless˺ signs on earth for those with sure faith

verses.text: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?
verses.translation: as there are within yourselves. Can you not see

verses.text: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
verses.translation: In heaven is your sustenance and whatever you are promised

verses.text: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
verses.translation: Then by the Lord of heaven and earth! ˹All˺ this is certainly as true as ˹the fact that˺ you can speak

verses.text: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -
verses.translation: Has the story of Abraham’s honoured guests reached you ˹O Prophet˺

verses.text: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace, [you are] a people unknown.
verses.translation: ˹Remember˺ when they entered his presence and greeted ˹him with˺, “Peace!” He replied, “Peace ˹be upon you˺!” ˹Then he said to himself,˺ “˹These are˺ an unfamiliar people.”

verses.text: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf
verses.translation: Then he slipped off to his family and brought a fat ˹roasted˺ calf

verses.text: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"
verses.translation: and placed it before them, asking, “Will you not eat?”

verses.text: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.
verses.translation: ˹They did not eat,˺ so he grew fearful of them. They reassured ˹him˺, “Do not be afraid,” and gave him good news of a knowledgeable son

verses.text: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"
verses.translation: Then his wife came forward with a cry, clasping her forehead ˹in astonishment˺, exclaiming, “˹A baby from˺ a barren, old woman!”

verses.text: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."
verses.translation: They replied, “Such has your Lord decreed. He is truly the All-Wise, All-Knowing.”

verses.text: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
verses.translation: ˹Later,˺ Abraham asked, “What is your mission, O messengers?”

verses.text: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals
verses.translation: They replied, “We have actually been sent to a wicked people

verses.text: To send down upon them stones of clay,
verses.translation: to send upon them stones of ˹baked˺ clay

verses.text: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."
verses.translation: marked by your Lord for the transgressors.”

verses.text: So We brought out whoever was in the cities of the believers.
verses.translation: Then ˹before the torment˺ We evacuated the believers from the city

verses.text: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.
verses.translation: But We only found one family that had submitted ˹to Allah˺

verses.text: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
verses.translation: And We have left a sign there ˹as a lesson˺ for those who fear the painful punishment

verses.text: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
verses.translation: And in ˹the story of˺ Moses ˹was another lesson,˺ when We sent him to Pharaoh with compelling proof

verses.text: But he turned away with his supporters and said," A magician or a madman."
verses.translation: but Pharaoh was carried away by his power, saying ˹of Moses˺, “A magician or a madman!”

verses.text: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.
verses.translation: So We seized him and his soldiers, casting them into the sea while he was blameworthy

verses.text: And in 'Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.
verses.translation: And in ˹the story of˺ ’Âd ˹was another lesson,˺ when We sent against them the devastating wind

verses.text: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.
verses.translation: There was nothing it came upon that it did not reduce to ashes

verses.text: And in Thamud, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."
verses.translation: And in ˹the story of˺ Thamûd ˹was another lesson,˺ when they were told, “Enjoy yourselves ˹only˺ for a ˹short˺ while.”

verses.text: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
verses.translation: Still they persisted in defying the commands of their Lord, so they were overtaken by a ˹mighty˺ blast while they were looking on

verses.text: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.
verses.translation: Then they were not able to rise up, nor were they helped

verses.text: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.
verses.translation: And the people of Noah ˹had also been destroyed˺ earlier. They were truly a rebellious people

verses.text: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.
verses.translation: We built the universe with ˹great˺ might, and We are certainly expanding ˹it˺

verses.text: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.
verses.translation: As for the earth, We spread it out. How superbly did We smooth it out

verses.text: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember.
verses.translation: And We created pairs of all things so perhaps you would be mindful

verses.text: So flee to Allah . Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
verses.translation: So ˹proclaim, O Prophet˺: “Flee to Allah! I am truly sent by Him with a clear warning to you

verses.text: And do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
verses.translation: And do not set up another god with Allah. I am truly sent by Him with a clear warning to you.”

verses.text: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."
verses.translation: Similarly, no messenger came to those before them without being told: “A magician or a madman!”

verses.text: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
verses.translation: Have they passed this ˹cliché˺ down to one another? In fact, they have ˹all˺ been a transgressing people

verses.text: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed.
verses.translation: So ˹now˺ turn away from them ˹O Prophet˺, for you will not be blamed

verses.text: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.
verses.translation: But ˹continue to˺ remind. For certainly reminders benefit the believers

verses.text: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
verses.translation: I did not create jinn and humans except to worship Me

verses.text: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
verses.translation: I seek no provision from them, nor do I need them to feed Me

verses.text: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.
verses.translation: Indeed, Allah ˹alone˺ is the Supreme Provider—Lord of all Power, Ever Mighty

verses.text: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me.
verses.translation: The wrongdoers will certainly have a share ˹of the torment˺ like that of their predecessors. So do not let them ask Me to hasten ˹it˺

verses.text: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
verses.translation: Woe then to the disbelievers when they face their Day which they are warned of

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: By the mount
verses.translation: By Mount Ṭûr

verses.text: And [by] a Book inscribed
verses.translation: And by the Book written

verses.text: In parchment spread open
verses.translation: on open pages ˹for all to read˺

verses.text: And [by] the frequented House
verses.translation: And by the ˹Sacred˺ House frequently visited

verses.text: And [by] the heaven raised high
verses.translation: And by the canopy raised ˹high˺

verses.text: And [by] the sea filled [with fire],
verses.translation: And by the seas set on fire

verses.text: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.
verses.translation: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will come to pass—

verses.text: Of it there is no preventer.
verses.translation: none will avert it—

verses.text: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
verses.translation: on the Day the heavens will be shaken violently

verses.text: And the mountains will pass on, departing -
verses.translation: and the mountains will be blown away entirely

verses.text: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
verses.translation: Then woe on that Day to the deniers—

verses.text: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.
verses.translation: those who amuse themselves with falsehood

verses.text: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],
verses.translation: ˹It is˺ the Day they will be fiercely shoved into the Fire of Hell

verses.text: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.
verses.translation: ˹They will be told,˺ “This is the Fire which you used to deny

verses.text: Then is this magic, or do you not see?
verses.translation: Is this magic, or do you not see

verses.text: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."
verses.translation: Burn in it! It is the same whether you endure ˹it˺ patiently or not. You are only rewarded for what you used to do.”

verses.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in Gardens and bliss

verses.text: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
verses.translation: enjoying whatever their Lord will have granted them. And their Lord will have protected them from the torment of the Hellfire

verses.text: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
verses.translation: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink happily for what you used to do.”

verses.text: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
verses.translation: They will be reclining on thrones, ˹neatly˺ lined up ˹facing each other˺. And We will pair them to maidens with gorgeous eyes

verses.text: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.
verses.translation: As for those who believe and whose descendants follow them in faith, We will elevate their descendants to their rank, never discounting anything ˹of the reward˺ of their deeds. Every person will reap only what they sowed

verses.text: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.
verses.translation: And We will ˹continually˺ provide them with whatever fruit or meat they desire

verses.text: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
verses.translation: They will pass around to each other a drink ˹of pure wine,˺ which leads to no idle talk or sinfulness

verses.text: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
verses.translation: And they will be waited on by their youthful servants like spotless pearls

verses.text: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
verses.translation: They will turn to one another inquisitively

verses.text: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allah ].
verses.translation: They will say, “Before ˹this reward˺ we used to be in awe ˹of Allah˺ in the midst of our people

verses.text: So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
verses.translation: So Allah has graced us and protected us from the torment of ˹Hell’s˺ scorching heat

verses.text: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
verses.translation: Indeed, we used to call upon Him ˹alone˺ before. He is truly the Most Kind, Most Merciful.”

verses.text: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
verses.translation: So ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O Prophet˺. For you, by the grace of your Lord, are not a fortune-teller or a madman

verses.text: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time?"
verses.translation: Or do they say, “˹He is˺ a poet, for whom we ˹eagerly˺ await an ill-fate!”

verses.text: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."
verses.translation: Say, “Keep waiting! I too am waiting with you.”

verses.text: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
verses.translation: Or do their ˹intelligent˺ minds prompt them to this ˹paradox˺? Or are they ˹just˺ a transgressing people

verses.text: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.
verses.translation: Or do they say, “He made this ˹Quran˺ up!”? In fact, they have no faith

verses.text: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.
verses.translation: Let them then produce something like it, if what they say is true

verses.text: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
verses.translation: Or were they created by nothing, or are they ˹their own˺ creators

verses.text: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.
verses.translation: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? In fact, they have no firm belief ˹in Allah˺

verses.text: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?
verses.translation: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord, or are they in control ˹of everything˺

verses.text: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority.
verses.translation: Or do they have a stairway, by which they eavesdrop ˹on the heavens˺? Then let those who do so bring a compelling proof

verses.text: Or has He daughters while you have sons?
verses.translation: Or does He have daughters ˹as you claim˺, while you ˹prefer to˺ have sons

verses.text: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
verses.translation: Or are you ˹O Prophet˺ asking them for a reward ˹for the message˺ so that they are overburdened by debt

verses.text: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
verses.translation: Or do they have access to ˹the Record in˺ the unseen, so they copy it ˹for all to see˺

verses.text: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.
verses.translation: Or do they intend to scheme ˹against the Prophet˺? Then it is the disbelievers who will fall victim to ˹their˺ schemes

verses.text: Or have they a deity other than Allah ? Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.
verses.translation: Or do they have a god other than Allah? Glorified is Allah far above what they associate ˹with Him˺

verses.text: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
verses.translation: If they were to see a ˹deadly˺ piece of the sky fall down ˹upon them˺, still they would say, “˹This is just˺ a pile of clouds.”

verses.text: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -
verses.translation: So leave them until they face their Day in which they will be struck dead—

verses.text: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.
verses.translation: the Day their scheming will be of no benefit to them whatsoever, nor will they be helped

verses.text: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.
verses.translation: Also, the wrongdoers will certainly have another torment before that ˹Day˺, but most of them do not know

verses.text: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [ Allah ] with praise of your Lord when you arise.
verses.translation: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, for you are truly under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes. And glorify the praises of your Lord when you rise

verses.text: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
verses.translation: And glorify Him during part of the night and at the fading of the stars

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: By the star when it descends,
verses.translation: By the stars when they fade away

verses.text: Your companion [Muhammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,
verses.translation: Your fellow man is neither misguided nor astray

verses.text: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.
verses.translation: Nor does he speak of his own whims

verses.text: It is not but a revelation revealed,
verses.translation: It is only a revelation sent down ˹to him˺

verses.text: Taught to him by one intense in strength -
verses.translation: He has been taught by one ˹angel˺ of mighty power

verses.text: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form
verses.translation: and great perfection, who once rose to ˹his˺ true form

verses.text: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.
verses.translation: while on the highest point above the horizon

verses.text: Then he approached and descended
verses.translation: then he approached ˹the Prophet˺, coming so close

verses.text: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.
verses.translation: that he was only two arms-lengths away or even less

verses.text: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed.
verses.translation: Then Allah revealed to His servant what He revealed ˹through Gabriel˺

verses.text: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.
verses.translation: The ˹Prophet’s˺ heart did not doubt what he saw

verses.text: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?
verses.translation: How can you ˹O pagans˺ then dispute with him regarding what he saw

verses.text: And he certainly saw him in another descent
verses.translation: And he certainly saw that ˹angel descend˺ a second time

verses.text: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -
verses.translation: at the Lote Tree of the most extreme limit ˹in the seventh heaven˺—

verses.text: Near it is the Garden of Refuge -
verses.translation: near which is the Garden of ˹Eternal˺ Residence—

verses.text: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].
verses.translation: while the Lote Tree was overwhelmed with ˹heavenly˺ splendours

verses.text: The sight [of the Prophet] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].
verses.translation: The ˹Prophet’s˺ sight never wandered, nor did it overreach

verses.text: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.
verses.translation: He certainly saw some of his Lord’s greatest signs

verses.text: So have you considered al-Lat and al-'Uzza?
verses.translation: Now, have you considered ˹the idols of˺ Lât and ’Uzza

verses.text: And Manat, the third - the other one?
verses.translation: and the third one, Manât, as well

verses.text: Is the male for you and for Him the female?
verses.translation: Do you ˹prefer to˺ have sons while ˹you attribute˺ to Him daughters

verses.text: That, then, is an unjust division.
verses.translation: Then this is ˹truly˺ a biased distribution

verses.text: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allah has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.
verses.translation: These ˹idols˺ are mere names that you and your forefathers have made up—a practice Allah has never authorized. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions and whatever ˹their˺ souls desire, although ˹true˺ guidance has already come to them from their Lord

verses.text: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?
verses.translation: Or should every person ˹simply˺ have whatever ˹intercessors˺ they desire

verses.text: Rather, to Allah belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
verses.translation: In fact, to Allah ˹alone˺ belongs this world and the next

verses.text: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allah has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.
verses.translation: ˹Imagine˺ how many ˹noble˺ angels are in the heavens! ˹Even˺ their intercession would be of no benefit whatsoever, until Allah gives permission to whoever He wills and ˹only for the people He˺ approves

verses.text: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,
verses.translation: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter label angels as female

verses.text: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.
verses.translation: although they have no knowledge ˹in support˺ of this. They follow nothing but ˹inherited˺ assumptions. And surely assumptions can in no way replace the truth

verses.text: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.
verses.translation: So turn away ˹O Prophet˺ from whoever has shunned Our Reminder, only seeking the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world

verses.text: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.
verses.translation: This is the extent of their knowledge. Surely your Lord knows best who has strayed from His Way and who is ˹rightly˺ guided

verses.text: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -
verses.translation: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth so that He may reward the evildoers according to what they did, and reward the good-doers with the finest reward—

verses.text: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.
verses.translation: those who avoid major sins and shameful deeds, despite ˹stumbling on˺ minor sins. Surely your Lord is infinite in forgiveness. He knew well what would become of you as He created you from the earth and while you were ˹still˺ fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not ˹falsely˺ elevate yourselves. He knows best who is ˹truly˺ righteous

verses.text: Have you seen the one who turned away
verses.translation: Have you seen the one who turned away ˹from Islam,˺

verses.text: And gave a little and [then] refrained?
verses.translation: and ˹initially˺ paid a little ˹for his salvation˺, and then stopped

verses.text: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?
verses.translation: Does he have the knowledge of the unseen so that he sees ˹the Hereafter˺

verses.text: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses
verses.translation: Or has he not been informed of what is in the Scripture of Moses

verses.text: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -
verses.translation: and ˹that of˺ Abraham, who ˹perfectly˺ fulfilled ˹his covenant˺

verses.text: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another
verses.translation: ˹They state˺ that no soul burdened with sin will bear the burden of another

verses.text: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives
verses.translation: and that each person will only have what they endeavoured towards

verses.text: And that his effort is going to be seen -
verses.translation: and that ˹the outcome of˺ their endeavours will be seen ˹in their record˺

verses.text: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense
verses.translation: then they will be fully rewarded

verses.text: And that to your Lord is the finality
verses.translation: and that to your Lord ˹alone˺ is the ultimate return ˹of all things˺

verses.text: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep
verses.translation: Moreover, He is the One Who brings about joy and sadness

verses.text: And that it is He who causes death and gives life
verses.translation: And He is the One Who gives life and causes death

verses.text: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -
verses.translation: And He created the pairs—males and females—

verses.text: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted
verses.translation: from a sperm-drop when it is emitted

verses.text: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the next creation
verses.translation: And it is upon Him to bring about re-creation

verses.text: And that it is He who enriches and suffices
verses.translation: And He is the One Who enriches and impoverishes

verses.text: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius
verses.translation: And He alone is the Lord of Sirius

verses.text: And that He destroyed the first [people of] 'Aad
verses.translation: And He destroyed the first ˹people of˺ ’Ȃd

verses.text: And Thamud - and He did not spare [them] -
verses.translation: and ˹then˺ Thamûd, sparing no one

verses.text: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.
verses.translation: And before ˹that He destroyed˺ the people of Noah, who were truly far worse in wrongdoing and transgression

verses.text: And the overturned towns He hurled down
verses.translation: And ˹it was˺ He ˹Who˺ turned the cities ˹of Sodom and Gomorrah˺ upside down

verses.text: And covered them by that which He covered.
verses.translation: How overwhelming was what covered ˹them˺

verses.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?
verses.translation: Now, which of your Lord’s favours will you dispute

verses.text: This [Prophet] is a warner like the former warners.
verses.translation: This ˹Prophet˺ is a warner like earlier ones

verses.text: The Approaching Day has approached.
verses.translation: The approaching ˹Hour˺ has drawn near

verses.text: Of it, [from those] besides Allah , there is no remover.
verses.translation: None but Allah can disclose it

verses.text: Then at this statement do you wonder?
verses.translation: Do you find this revelation astonishing

verses.text: And you laugh and do not weep
verses.translation: laughing ˹at it˺ and not weeping ˹in awe˺

verses.text: While you are proudly sporting?
verses.translation: while persisting in heedlessness

verses.text: So prostrate to Allah and worship [Him].
verses.translation: Instead, prostrate to Allah and worship ˹Him alone˺

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].
verses.translation: The Hour has drawn near and the moon was split ˹in two˺

verses.text: And if they see a miracle, they turn away and say, "Passing magic."
verses.translation: Yet, whenever they see a sign, they turn away, saying, “Same old magic!”

verses.text: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.
verses.translation: They rejected ˹the truth˺ and followed their own desires—and every matter will be settled—

verses.text: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence -
verses.translation: even though the stories ˹of destroyed nations˺ that have already come to them are a sufficient deterrent

verses.text: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].
verses.translation: ˹This Quran is˺ profound ˹in˺ wisdom, but warnings are of no benefit ˹to them˺

verses.text: So leave them, [O Muhammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,
verses.translation: So turn away from them ˹O Prophet˺. ˹And wait for˺ the Day ˹when˺ the caller will summon ˹them˺ for something horrifying

verses.text: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,
verses.translation: With eyes downcast, they will come forth from the graves as if they were swarming locusts

verses.text: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."
verses.translation: rushing towards the caller. The disbelievers will cry, “This is a difficult Day!”

verses.text: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.
verses.translation: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth˺ and rejected Our servant, calling ˹him˺ insane. And he was intimidated

verses.text: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."
verses.translation: So he cried out to his Lord, “I am helpless, so help ˹me˺!”

verses.text: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down
verses.translation: So We opened the gates of the sky with pouring rain

verses.text: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.
verses.translation: and caused the earth to burst with springs, so the waters met for a fate already set

verses.text: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,
verses.translation: We carried him on that ˹Ark made˺ of planks and nails

verses.text: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.
verses.translation: sailing under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes—a ˹fair˺ punishment on behalf of the one ˹they˺ denied

verses.text: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?
verses.translation: We certainly left this as a sign. So is there anyone who will be mindful

verses.text: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
verses.translation: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings

verses.text: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
verses.translation: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful

verses.text: 'Aad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
verses.translation: ’Ȃd ˹also˺ rejected ˹the truth˺. Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings

verses.text: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,
verses.translation: Indeed, We sent against them a furious wind, on a day of unrelenting misery

verses.text: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.
verses.translation: that snatched people up, leaving them like trunks of uprooted palm trees

verses.text: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
verses.translation: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings

verses.text: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
verses.translation: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful

verses.text: Thamud denied the warning
verses.translation: Thamûd rejected the warnings ˹as well˺

verses.text: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.
verses.translation: arguing, “How can we follow one ˹average˺ human being from among us? We would then truly be misguided and insane

verses.text: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."
verses.translation: Has the revelation been sent down ˹only˺ to him out of ˹all of˺ us? In fact, he is a boastful liar.”

verses.text: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.
verses.translation: ˹It was revealed to Ṣâliḥ,˺ “They will soon know who the boastful liar is

verses.text: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.
verses.translation: We are sending the she-camel as a test for them. So watch them ˹closely˺, and have patience

verses.text: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
verses.translation: And tell them that the ˹drinking˺ water must be divided between them ˹and her˺, each taking a turn to drink ˹every other day˺.”

verses.text: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].
verses.translation: But they roused a companion of theirs, so he dared to kill ˹her˺

verses.text: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
verses.translation: Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings

verses.text: Indeed, We sent upon them one blast from the sky, and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.
verses.translation: Indeed, We sent against them ˹only˺ one ˹mighty˺ blast, leaving them like the twigs of fence-builders

verses.text: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
verses.translation: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful

verses.text: The people of Lot denied the warning.
verses.translation: The people of Lot ˹also˺ rejected the warnings

verses.text: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn
verses.translation: We unleashed upon them a storm of stones. As for ˹the believers of˺ Lot’s family, We delivered them before dawn

verses.text: As favor from us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.
verses.translation: as a blessing from Us. This is how We reward whoever gives thanks

verses.text: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.
verses.translation: He had already warned them of Our ˹crushing˺ blow but they disputed the warnings

verses.text: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."
verses.translation: And they even demanded his angel-guests from him, so We blinded their eyes. ˹And they were told,˺ “Taste then My punishment and warnings!”

verses.text: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.
verses.translation: And indeed, by the early morning they were overwhelmed by an unrelenting torment

verses.text: So taste My punishment and warning.
verses.translation: ˹Again they were told,˺ “Taste now My punishment and warnings!”

verses.text: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
verses.translation: And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember. So is there anyone who will be mindful

verses.text: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.
verses.translation: And indeed, the warnings ˹also˺ came to the people of Pharaoh

verses.text: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.
verses.translation: ˹But˺ they rejected all of Our signs, so We seized them with the ˹crushing˺ grip of the Almighty, Most Powerful

verses.text: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scripture?
verses.translation: Now, are you ˹Meccan˺ disbelievers superior to those ˹destroyed peoples˺? Or have you ˹been granted˺ immunity ˹from punishment˺ in divine Books

verses.text: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?
verses.translation: Or do they say, “We are all ˹a˺ united ˹front˺, bound to prevail.”

verses.text: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].
verses.translation: ˹Soon˺ their united front will be defeated and ˹forced to˺ flee

verses.text: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.
verses.translation: Better yet, the Hour is their appointed time—and the Hour will be most catastrophic and most bitter

verses.text: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.
verses.translation: Indeed, the wicked are ˹entrenched˺ in misguidance, and ˹are bound for˺ blazes

verses.text: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."
verses.translation: On the Day they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, ˹they will be told,˺ “Taste the touch of Hell!”

verses.text: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.
verses.translation: Indeed, We have created everything, perfectly preordained

verses.text: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.
verses.translation: Our command is but a single word, done in the blink of an eye

verses.text: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?
verses.translation: We have already destroyed the likes of you. So will any ˹of you˺ be mindful

verses.text: And everything they did is in written records.
verses.translation: Everything they have done is ˹listed˺ in ˹their˺ records

verses.text: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.
verses.translation: Every matter, small and large, is written ˹precisely˺

verses.text: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and rivers

verses.text: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
verses.translation: at the Seat of Honour in the presence of the Most Powerful Sovereign

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: The Most Merciful
verses.translation: The Most Compassionate

verses.text: Taught the Qur'an,
verses.translation: taught the Quran

verses.text: Created man,
verses.translation: created humanity

verses.text: [And] taught him eloquence.
verses.translation: ˹and˺ taught them speech

verses.text: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,
verses.translation: The sun and the moon ˹travel˺ with precision

verses.text: And the stars and trees prostrate.
verses.translation: The stars and the trees bow down ˹in submission˺

verses.text: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
verses.translation: As for the sky, He raised it ˹high˺, and set the balance ˹of justice˺

verses.text: That you not transgress within the balance.
verses.translation: so that you do not defraud the scales

verses.text: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.
verses.translation: Weigh with justice, and do not give short measure

verses.text: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.
verses.translation: He laid out the earth for all beings

verses.text: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]
verses.translation: In it are fruit, palm trees with date stalks

verses.text: And grain having husks and scented plants.
verses.translation: and grain with husks, and aromatic plants

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you ˹humans and jinn˺ both deny

verses.text: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.
verses.translation: He created humankind from ˹sounding˺ clay like pottery

verses.text: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
verses.translation: and created jinn from a ˹smokeless˺ flame of fire

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

verses.text: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.
verses.translation: ˹He is˺ Lord of the two easts and the two wests

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

verses.text: He released the two seas, meeting [side by side];
verses.translation: He merges the two bodies of ˹fresh and salt˺ water

verses.text: Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses.
verses.translation: yet between them is a barrier they never cross

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

verses.text: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.
verses.translation: Out of both ˹waters˺ come forth pearls and coral

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

verses.text: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.
verses.translation: To Him belong the ships with raised sails, sailing through the seas like mountains

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

verses.text: Everyone upon the earth will perish,
verses.translation: Every being on earth is bound to perish

verses.text: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
verses.translation: Only your Lord Himself, full of Majesty and Honour, will remain ˹forever˺

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

verses.text: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter.
verses.translation: All those in the heavens and the earth are dependent on Him. Day in and day out He has something to bring about

verses.text: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
verses.translation: Then which of your Lord’s favours will you both deny

verses.text: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.
