verses.text: Has there not come to you the news of those who disbelieved before? So they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment.
verses.translation: Have the stories of those who disbelieved before not reached you ˹pagans˺? They tasted the evil consequences of their doings, and they will suffer a painful punishment

verses.text: That is because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences, but they said, "Shall human beings guide us?" and disbelieved and turned away. And Allah dispensed [with them]; and Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy.
verses.translation: That was because their messengers used to come to them with clear proofs, but they said ˹mockingly˺, “How can humans be our guides?” So they persisted in disbelief and turned away. And Allah was not in need ˹of their faith˺. For Allah is Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy

verses.text: Those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected. Say, "Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected; then you will surely be informed of what you did. And that, for Allah , is easy."
verses.translation: The disbelievers claim they will not be resurrected. Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected, then you will certainly be informed of what you have done. And that is easy for Allah.”

verses.text: So believe in Allah and His Messenger and the Qur'an which We have sent down. And Allah is Acquainted with what you do.
verses.translation: So believe in Allah and His Messenger and in the Light We have revealed. And Allah is All-Aware of what you do

verses.text: The Day He will assemble you for the Day of Assembly - that is the Day of Deprivation. And whoever believes in Allah and does righteousness - He will remove from him his misdeeds and admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. That is the great attainment.
verses.translation: ˹Consider˺ the Day He will gather you ˹all˺ for the Day of Gathering—that will be the Day of mutual loss and gain. So whoever believes in Allah and does good, He will absolve them of their sins and admit them into Gardens under which rivers flow, to stay there for ever and ever. That is the ultimate triumph

verses.text: But the ones who disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of the Fire, abiding eternally therein; and wretched is the destination.
verses.translation: As for those who disbelieve and reject Our revelations, they will be the residents of the Fire, staying there forever. What an evil destination

verses.text: No disaster strikes except by permission of Allah . And whoever believes in Allah - He will guide his heart. And Allah is Knowing of all things.
verses.translation: No calamity befalls ˹anyone˺ except by Allah’s Will. And whoever has faith in Allah, He will ˹rightly˺ guide their hearts ˹through adversity˺. And Allah has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of all things

verses.text: And obey Allah and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon Our Messenger is only [the duty of] clear notification.
verses.translation: Obey Allah and obey the Messenger! But if you turn away, then Our Messenger’s duty is only to deliver ˹the message˺ clearly

verses.text: Allah - there is no deity except Him. And upon Allah let the believers rely.
verses.translation: Allah—there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. So in Allah let the believers put their trust

verses.text: O you who have believed, indeed, among your wives and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon and overlook and forgive - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.translation: O believers! Indeed, some of your spouses and children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon, overlook, and forgive ˹their faults˺, then Allah is truly All-Forgiving, Most Merciful

verses.text: Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and Allah has with Him a great reward.
verses.translation: Your wealth and children are only a test, but Allah ˹alone˺ has a great reward

verses.text: So fear Allah as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend [in the way of Allah ]; it is better for your selves. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.
verses.translation: So be mindful of Allah to the best of your ability, hear and obey, and spend in charity—that will be best for you. And whoever is saved from the selfishness of their own souls, it is they who are ˹truly˺ successful

verses.text: If you loan Allah a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. And Allah is Most Appreciative and Forbearing.
verses.translation: If you lend to Allah a good loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. For Allah is Most Appreciative, Most Forbearing

verses.text: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.translation: ˹He is the˺ Knower of the seen and unseen—the Almighty, All-Wise

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: O Prophet, when you [Muslims] divorce women, divorce them for [the commencement of] their waiting period and keep count of the waiting period, and fear Allah , your Lord. Do not turn them out of their [husbands'] houses, nor should they [themselves] leave [during that period] unless they are committing a clear immorality. And those are the limits [set by] Allah . And whoever transgresses the limits of Allah has certainly wronged himself. You know not; perhaps Allah will bring about after that a [different] matter.
verses.translation: O Prophet! ˹Instruct the believers:˺ When you ˹intend to˺ divorce women, then divorce them with concern for their waiting period, and count it accurately. And fear Allah, your Lord. Do not force them out of their homes, nor should they leave—unless they commit a blatant misconduct. These are the limits set by Allah. And whoever transgresses Allah’s limits has truly wronged his own soul. You never know, perhaps Allah will bring about a change ˹of heart˺ later

verses.text: And when they have [nearly] fulfilled their term, either retain them according to acceptable terms or part with them according to acceptable terms. And bring to witness two just men from among you and establish the testimony for [the acceptance of] Allah . That is instructed to whoever should believe in Allah and the Last day. And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him a way out
verses.translation: Then when they have ˹almost˺ reached the end of their waiting period, either retain them honourably or separate from them honourably. And call two of your reliable men to witness ˹either way˺—and ˹let the witnesses˺ bear true testimony for ˹the sake of˺ Allah. This is enjoined on whoever has faith in Allah and the Last Day. And whoever is mindful of Allah, He will make a way out for them

verses.text: And will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allah will accomplish His purpose. Allah has already set for everything a [decreed] extent.
verses.translation: and provide for them from sources they could never imagine. And whoever puts their trust in Allah, then He ˹alone˺ is sufficient for them. Certainly Allah achieves His Will. Allah has already set a destiny for everything

verses.text: And those who no longer expect menstruation among your women - if you doubt, then their period is three months, and [also for] those who have not menstruated. And for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth. And whoever fears Allah - He will make for him of his matter ease.
verses.translation: As for your women past the age of menstruation, in case you do not know, their waiting period is three months, and those who have not menstruated as well. As for those who are pregnant, their waiting period ends with delivery. And whoever is mindful of Allah, He will make their matters easy for them

verses.text: That is the command of Allah , which He has sent down to you; and whoever fears Allah - He will remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward.
verses.translation: This is the commandment of Allah, which He has revealed to you. And whoever is mindful of Allah, He will absolve them of their sins and reward them immensely

verses.text: Lodge them [in a section] of where you dwell out of your means and do not harm them in order to oppress them. And if they should be pregnant, then spend on them until they give birth. And if they breastfeed for you, then give them their payment and confer among yourselves in the acceptable way; but if you are in discord, then there may breastfeed for the father another woman.
verses.translation: Let them live where you live ˹during their waiting period˺, according to your means. And do not harass them to make their stay unbearable. If they are pregnant, then maintain them until they deliver. And if they nurse your child, compensate them, and consult together courteously. But if you fail to reach an agreement, then another woman will nurse ˹the child˺ for the father

verses.text: Let a man of wealth spend from his wealth, and he whose provision is restricted - let him spend from what Allah has given him. Allah does not charge a soul except [according to] what He has given it. Allah will bring about, after hardship, ease.
verses.translation: Let the man of wealth provide according to his means. As for the one with limited resources, let him provide according to whatever Allah has given him. Allah does not require of any soul beyond what He has given it. After hardship, Allah will bring about ease

verses.text: And how many a city was insolent toward the command of its Lord and His messengers, so We took it to severe account and punished it with a terrible punishment.
verses.translation: ˹Imagine˺ how many societies rebelled against the commandments of their Lord and His messengers, so We called each ˹society˺ to a severe account and subjected them to a horrible punishment

verses.text: And it tasted the bad consequence of its affair, and the outcome of its affair was loss.
verses.translation: So they tasted the evil consequences of their doings, and the outcome of their doings was ˹total˺ loss

verses.text: Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment; so fear Allah , O you of understanding who have believed. Allah has sent down to you the Qur'an.
verses.translation: Allah has ˹also˺ prepared for them a severe punishment. So fear Allah, O people of reason and faith. Allah has indeed revealed to you a Reminder

verses.text: [He sent] a Messenger [Muhammad] reciting to you the distinct verses of Allah that He may bring out those who believe and do righteous deeds from darknesses into the light. And whoever believes in Allah and does righteousness - He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein forever. Allah will have perfected for him a provision.
verses.translation: ˹and sent˺ a messenger reciting to you Allah’s revelations, making things clear so that He may bring those who believe and do good out of darkness and into light. And whoever believes in Allah and does good will be admitted by Him into Gardens under which rivers flow, to stay there for ever and ever. Allah will have indeed granted them an excellent provision

verses.text: It is Allah who has created seven heavens and of the earth, the like of them. [His] command descends among them so you may know that Allah is over all things competent and that Allah has encompassed all things in knowledge.
verses.translation: Allah is the One Who created seven heavens ˹in layers˺, and likewise for the earth. The ˹divine˺ command descends between them so you may know that Allah is Most Capable of everything and that Allah certainly encompasses all things in ˹His˺ knowledge

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: O Prophet, why do you prohibit [yourself from] what Allah has made lawful for you, seeking the approval of your wives? And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.translation: O Prophet! Why do you prohibit ˹yourself˺ from what Allah has made lawful to you, seeking to please your wives? And Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful

verses.text: Allah has already ordained for you [Muslims] the dissolution of your oaths. And Allah is your protector, and He is the Knowing, the Wise.
verses.translation: Allah has already ordained for you ˹believers˺ the way to absolve yourselves from your oaths. For Allah is your Guardian. And He is the All-Knowing, All-Wise

verses.text: And [remember] when the Prophet confided to one of his wives a statement; and when she informed [another] of it and Allah showed it to him, he made known part of it and ignored a part. And when he informed her about it, she said, "Who told you this?" He said, "I was informed by the Knowing, the Acquainted."
verses.translation: ˹Remember˺ when the Prophet had ˹once˺ confided something to one of his wives, then when she disclosed it ˹to another wife˺ and Allah made it known to him, he presented ˹to her˺ part of what was disclosed and overlooked a part. So when he informed her of it, she exclaimed, “Who told you this?” He replied, “I was informed by the All-Knowing, All-Aware.”

verses.text: If you two [wives] repent to Allah , [it is best], for your hearts have deviated. But if you cooperate against him - then indeed Allah is his protector, and Gabriel and the righteous of the believers and the angels, moreover, are [his] assistants.
verses.translation: ˹It will be better˺ if you ˹wives˺ both turn to Allah in repentance, for your hearts have certainly faltered. But if you ˹continue to˺ collaborate against him, then ˹know that˺ Allah Himself is his Guardian. And Gabriel, the righteous believers, and the angels are ˹all˺ his supporters as well

verses.text: Perhaps his Lord, if he divorced you [all], would substitute for him wives better than you - submitting [to Allah ], believing, devoutly obedient, repentant, worshipping, and traveling - [ones] previously married and virgins.
verses.translation: Perhaps, if he were to divorce you ˹all˺, his Lord would replace you with better wives who are submissive ˹to Allah˺, faithful ˹to Him˺, devout, repentant, dedicated to worship and fasting—previously married or virgins

verses.text: O you who have believed, protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones, over which are [appointed] angels, harsh and severe; they do not disobey Allah in what He commands them but do what they are commanded.
verses.translation: O believers! Protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones, overseen by formidable and severe angels, who never disobey whatever Allah orders—always doing as commanded

verses.text: O you who have disbelieved, make no excuses that Day. You will only be recompensed for what you used to do.
verses.translation: ˹The deniers will then be told,˺ “O disbelievers! Make no excuses this Day! You are only rewarded for what you used to do.”

verses.text: O you who have believed, repent to Allah with sincere repentance. Perhaps your Lord will remove from you your misdeeds and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow [on] the Day when Allah will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will proceed before them and on their right; they will say, "Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent."
verses.translation: O believers! Turn to Allah in sincere repentance, so your Lord may absolve you of your sins and admit you into Gardens, under which rivers flow, on the Day Allah will not disgrace the Prophet or the believers with him. Their light will shine ahead of them and on their right. They will say, “Our Lord! Perfect our light for us, and forgive us. ˹For˺ You are truly Most Capable of everything.”

verses.text: O Prophet, strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be harsh upon them. And their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the destination.
verses.translation: O Prophet! Struggle against the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and be firm with them. Hell will be their home. What an evil destination

verses.text: Allah presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so those prophets did not avail them from Allah at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter."
verses.translation: Allah sets forth an example for the disbelievers: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. Each was married to one of Our righteous servants, yet betrayed them. So their husbands were of no benefit to them against Allah whatsoever. Both were told, “Enter the Fire, along with the others!”

verses.text: And Allah presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people."
verses.translation: And Allah sets forth an example for the believers: the wife of Pharaoh, who prayed, “My Lord! Build me a house in Paradise near You, deliver me from Pharaoh and his ˹evil˺ doing, and save me from the wrongdoing people.”

verses.text: And [the example of] Mary, the daughter of 'Imran, who guarded her chastity, so We blew into [her garment] through Our angel, and she believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures and was of the devoutly obedient.
verses.translation: ˹There is˺ also ˹the example of˺ Mary, the daughter of ’Imrân, who guarded her chastity, so We breathed into her ˹womb˺ through Our angel ˹Gabriel˺. She testified to the words of her Lord and His Scriptures, and was one of the ˹sincerely˺ devout

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -
verses.translation: Blessed is the One in Whose Hands rests all authority. And He is Most Capable of everything

verses.text: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -
verses.translation: ˹He is the One˺ Who created death and life in order to test which of you is best in deeds. And He is the Almighty, All-Forgiving

verses.text: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?
verses.translation: ˹He is the One˺ Who created seven heavens, one above the other. You will never see any imperfection in the creation of the Most Compassionate. So look again: do you see any flaws

verses.text: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.
verses.translation: Then look again and again—your sight will return frustrated and weary

verses.text: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.
verses.translation: And indeed, We adorned the lowest heaven with ˹stars like˺ lamps, and made them ˹as missiles˺ for stoning ˹eavesdropping˺ devils, for whom We have also prepared the torment of the Blaze

verses.text: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.
verses.translation: Those who disbelieve in their Lord will suffer the punishment of Hell. What an evil destination

verses.text: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.
verses.translation: When they are tossed into it, they will hear its roaring as it boils over

verses.text: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"
verses.translation: almost bursting in fury. Every time a group is cast into it, its keepers will ask them, “Did a warner not come to you?”

verses.text: They will say," Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, ' Allah has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.' "
verses.translation: They will reply, “Yes, a warner did come to us, but we denied and said, ‘Allah has revealed nothing. You are extremely astray.’”

verses.text: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."
verses.translation: And they will lament, “If only we had listened and reasoned, we would not be among the residents of the Blaze!”

verses.text: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.
verses.translation: And so they will confess their sins. So away with the residents of the Blaze

verses.text: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.
verses.translation: Indeed, those in awe of their Lord without seeing Him will have forgiveness and a mighty reward

verses.text: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
verses.translation: Whether you speak secretly or openly—He surely knows best what is ˹hidden˺ in the heart

verses.text: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted?
verses.translation: How could He not know His Own creation? For He ˹alone˺ is the Most Subtle, All-Aware

verses.text: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.
verses.translation: He is the One Who smoothed out the earth for you, so move about in its regions and eat from His provisions. And to Him is the resurrection ˹of all˺

verses.text: Do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?
verses.translation: Do you feel secure that the One Who is in heaven will not cause the earth to swallow you up as it quakes violently

verses.text: Or do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.
verses.translation: Or do you feel secure that the One Who is in heaven will not unleash upon you a storm of stones. Only then would you know how ˹serious˺ My warning was

verses.text: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
verses.translation: And certainly those before them denied ˹as well˺, then how severe was My response

verses.text: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.
verses.translation: Have they not seen the birds above them, spreading and folding their wings? None holds them up except the Most Compassionate. Indeed, He is All-Seeing of everything

verses.text: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.
verses.translation: Also, which ˹powerless˺ force will come to your help instead of the Most Compassionate? Indeed, the disbelievers are only ˹lost˺ in delusion

verses.text: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.
verses.translation: Or who is it that will provide for you if He withholds His provision? In fact, they persist in arrogance and aversion ˹to the truth˺

verses.text: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?
verses.translation: Who is ˹rightly˺ guided: the one who crawls facedown or the one who walks upright on the Straight Path

verses.text: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful."
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “He is the One Who brought you into being and gave you hearing, sight, and intellect. ˹Yet˺ you hardly give any thanks.”

verses.text: Say, " It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."
verses.translation: ˹Also˺ say, “He is the One Who has dispersed you ˹all˺ over the earth, and to Him you will ˹all˺ be gathered.”

verses.text: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
verses.translation: ˹Still˺ they ask ˹the believers˺, “When will this threat come to pass, if what you say is true?”

verses.text: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allah , and I am only a clear warner."
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “That knowledge is with Allah alone, and I am only sent with a clear warning.”

verses.text: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."
verses.translation: Then when they see the torment drawing near, the faces of the disbelievers will become gloomy, and it will be said ˹to them˺, “This is what you claimed would never come.”

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered: whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Consider this: whether Allah causes me and those with me to die or shows us mercy, who will save the disbelievers from a painful punishment?”

verses.text: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."
verses.translation: Say, “He is the Most Compassionate—in Him ˹alone˺ we believe, and in Him ˹alone˺ we trust. You will soon know who is clearly astray.”

verses.text: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"
verses.translation: Say, “Consider this: if your water were to sink ˹into the earth˺, then who ˹else˺ could bring you flowing water?”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Nun. By the pen and what they inscribe,
verses.translation: Nũn. By the pen and what everyone writes

verses.text: You are not, [O Muhammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.
verses.translation: By the grace of your Lord, you ˹O Prophet˺ are not insane

verses.text: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted.
verses.translation: You will certainly have a never-ending reward

verses.text: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.
verses.translation: And you are truly ˹a man˺ of outstanding character

verses.text: So you will see and they will see
verses.translation: Soon you and the pagans will see

verses.text: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil].
verses.translation: which of you is mad

verses.text: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
verses.translation: Surely your Lord ˹alone˺ knows best who has strayed from His Way and who is ˹rightly˺ guided

verses.text: Then do not obey the deniers.
verses.translation: So do not give in to the deniers

verses.text: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you].
verses.translation: They wish you would compromise so they would yield ˹to you˺

verses.text: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer
verses.translation: And do not obey the despicable, vain oath-taker

verses.text: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -
verses.translation: slanderer, gossip-monger

verses.text: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,
verses.translation: withholder of good, transgressor, evildoer

verses.text: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender.
verses.translation: brute, and—on top of all that—an illegitimate child

verses.text: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children,
verses.translation: Now, ˹simply˺ because he has been blessed with ˹abundant˺ wealth and children

verses.text: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
verses.translation: whenever Our revelations are recited to him, he says, “Ancient fables!”

verses.text: We will brand him upon the snout.
verses.translation: We will soon mark his snout

verses.text: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning
verses.translation: Indeed, We have tested those ˹Meccans˺ as We tested the owners of the garden—when they swore they would surely harvest ˹all˺ its fruit in the early morning

verses.text: Without making exception.
verses.translation: leaving no thought for Allah’s Will

verses.text: So there came upon the garden an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.
verses.translation: Then it was struck by a torment from your Lord while they slept

verses.text: And it became as though reaped.
verses.translation: so it was reduced to ashes

verses.text: And they called one another at morning,
verses.translation: Then by daybreak they called out to each other

verses.text: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."
verses.translation: ˹saying,˺ “Go early to your harvest, if you want to pick ˹all˺ the fruit.”

verses.text: So they set out, while lowering their voices,
verses.translation: So they went off, whispering to one another

verses.text: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."
verses.translation: “Do not let any poor person enter your garden today.”

verses.text: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.
verses.translation: And they proceeded early, totally fixated on their purpose

verses.text: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;
verses.translation: But when they saw it ˹devastated˺, they cried, “We must have lost ˹our˺ way

verses.text: Rather, we have been deprived."
verses.translation: In fact, we have been deprived ˹of our livelihood˺.”

verses.text: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [ Allah ]?' "
verses.translation: The most sensible of them said, “Did I not urge you to say, ‘Allah willing.’?”

verses.text: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
verses.translation: They replied, “Glory be to our Lord! We have truly been wrongdoers.”

verses.text: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.
verses.translation: Then they turned on each other, throwing blame

verses.text: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.
verses.translation: They said, “Woe to us! We have certainly been transgressors

verses.text: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."
verses.translation: We trust our Lord will give us a better garden than this, ˹for˺ we are indeed turning to our Lord with hope.”

verses.text: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
verses.translation: That is the ˹way of Our˺ punishment ˹in this world˺. But the punishment of the Hereafter is certainly far worse, if only they knew

verses.text: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will have the Gardens of Bliss with their Lord

verses.text: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?
verses.translation: Should We then treat those who have submitted like the wicked

verses.text: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge?
verses.translation: What is the matter with you? How do you judge

verses.text: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn
verses.translation: Or do you have a scripture, in which you read

verses.text: That indeed for you is whatever you choose?
verses.translation: that you will have whatever you choose

verses.text: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?
verses.translation: Or do you have oaths binding on Us until the Day of Judgment that you will have whatever you decide

verses.text: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible.
verses.translation: Ask them ˹O Prophet˺ which of them can guarantee all that

verses.text: Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful.
verses.translation: Or do they have associate-gods ˹supporting this claim˺? Then let them bring forth their associate-gods, if what they say is true

verses.text: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but the disbelievers will not be able,
verses.translation: ˹Beware of˺ the Day the Shin ˹of Allah˺ will be bared, and the wicked will be asked to prostrate, but they will not be able to do so

verses.text: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.
verses.translation: with eyes downcast, totally covered with disgrace. For they were ˹always˺ called to prostrate ˹in the world˺ when they were fully capable ˹but they chose not to˺

verses.text: So leave Me, [O Muhammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies the Qur'an. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.
verses.translation: So leave to Me ˹O Prophet˺ those who reject this message. We will gradually draw them to destruction in ways they cannot comprehend

verses.text: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.
verses.translation: I ˹only˺ delay their end for a while, but My planning is flawless

verses.text: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
verses.translation: Or are you asking them for a reward ˹for the message˺ so that they are overburdened by debt

verses.text: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
verses.translation: Or do they have access to ˹the Record in˺ the unseen, so they copy it ˹for all to see˺

verses.text: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muhammad], and be not like the companion of the fish when he called out while he was distressed.
verses.translation: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not be like ˹Jonah,˺ the Man of the Whale, who cried out ˹to Allah˺, in total distress

verses.text: If not that a favor from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.
verses.translation: Had he not been shown grace by his Lord, he would have certainly been cast onto the open ˹shore˺, still blameworthy

verses.text: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.
verses.translation: Then his Lord chose him, making him one of the righteous

verses.text: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."
verses.translation: The disbelievers would almost cut you down with their eyes when they hear ˹you recite˺ the Reminder, and say, “He is certainly a madman.”

verses.text: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds.
verses.translation: But it is simply a reminder to the whole world

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: The Inevitable Reality -
verses.translation: The Inevitable Hour

verses.text: What is the Inevitable Reality?
verses.translation: What is the Inevitable Hour

verses.text: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?
verses.translation: And what will make you realize what the Inevitable Hour is

verses.text: Thamud and 'Aad denied the Striking Calamity.
verses.translation: ˹Both˺ Thamûd and ’Ȃd denied the Striking Disaster

verses.text: So as for Thamud, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].
verses.translation: As for Thamûd, they were destroyed by an overwhelming blast

verses.text: And as for 'Aad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind
verses.translation: And as for ’Ȃd, they were destroyed by a furious, bitter wind

verses.text: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
verses.translation: which Allah unleashed on them non-stop for seven nights and eight days, so that you would have seen its people lying dead like trunks of uprooted palm trees

verses.text: Then do you see of them any remains?
verses.translation: Do you see any of them left alive

verses.text: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.
verses.translation: Also, Pharaoh and those before him, and ˹the people of˺ the overturned cities ˹of Lot˺ indulged in sin

verses.text: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
verses.translation: each disobeying their Lord’s messenger, so He seized them with a crushing grip

verses.text: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried your ancestors in the sailing ship
verses.translation: Indeed, when the floodwater had overflowed, We carried you in the floating Ark ˹with Noah˺

verses.text: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.
verses.translation: so that We may make this a reminder to you, and that attentive ears may grasp it

verses.text: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast
verses.translation: At last, when the Trumpet will be blown with one blast

verses.text: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow -
verses.translation: and the earth and mountains will be lifted up and crushed with one blow

verses.text: Then on that Day, the Resurrection will occur,
verses.translation: on that Day the Inevitable Event will have come to pass

verses.text: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.
verses.translation: The sky will then be so torn that it will be frail

verses.text: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].
verses.translation: with the angels on its sides. On that Day eight ˹mighty angels˺ will bear the Throne of your Lord above them

verses.text: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.
verses.translation: You will then be presented ˹before Him for judgment˺, and none of your secrets will stay hidden

verses.text: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!
verses.translation: As for those given their records in their right hand, they will cry ˹happily˺, “Here ˹everyone˺! Read my record

verses.text: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."
verses.translation: I surely knew I would face my reckoning.”

verses.text: So he will be in a pleasant life -
verses.translation: They will be in a life of bliss

verses.text: In an elevated garden,
verses.translation: in an elevated Garden

verses.text: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.
verses.translation: whose fruit will hang within reach

verses.text: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."
verses.translation: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink joyfully for what you did in the days gone by.”

verses.text: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
verses.translation: And as for those given their record in their left hand, they will cry ˹bitterly˺, “I wish I had not been given my record

verses.text: And had not known what is my account.
verses.translation: nor known anything of my reckoning

verses.text: I wish my death had been the decisive one.
verses.translation: I wish death was the end

verses.text: My wealth has not availed me.
verses.translation: My wealth has not benefited me

verses.text: Gone from me is my authority."
verses.translation: My authority has been stripped from me.”

verses.text: [ Allah will say], "Seize him and shackle him.
verses.translation: ˹It will be said,˺ “Seize and shackle them

verses.text: Then into Hellfire drive him.
verses.translation: then burn them in Hell

verses.text: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."
verses.translation: then tie them up with chains seventy arms long

verses.text: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allah , the Most Great,
verses.translation: For they never had faith in Allah, the Greatest

verses.text: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.
verses.translation: nor encouraged the feeding of the poor

verses.text: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
verses.translation: So this Day they will have no close friend here

verses.text: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;
verses.translation: nor any food except ˹oozing˺ pus

verses.text: None will eat it except the sinners.
verses.translation: which none will eat except the evildoers.”

verses.text: So I swear by what you see
verses.translation: Now, I do swear by whatever you see

verses.text: And what you do not see
verses.translation: and whatever you cannot see

verses.text: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is the word of a noble Messenger.
verses.translation: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the recitation of a noble Messenger

verses.text: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.
verses.translation: It is not the prose of a poet ˹as you claim˺, ˹yet˺ you hardly have any faith

verses.text: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.
verses.translation: Nor is it the mumbling of a fortune-teller, ˹yet˺ you are hardly mindful

verses.text: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: ˹It is˺ a revelation from the Lord of all worlds

verses.text: And if Muhammad had made up about Us some [false] sayings,
verses.translation: Had the Messenger made up something in Our Name

verses.text: We would have seized him by the right hand;
verses.translation: We would have certainly seized him by his right hand

verses.text: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.
verses.translation: then severed his aorta

verses.text: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.
verses.translation: and none of you could have shielded him ˹from Us˺

verses.text: And indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder for the righteous.
verses.translation: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is a reminder to those mindful ˹of Allah˺

verses.text: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.
verses.translation: And We certainly know that some of you will persist in denial

verses.text: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.
verses.translation: and it will surely be a source of regret for the disbelievers

verses.text: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.
verses.translation: And indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the absolute truth

verses.text: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
verses.translation: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen
verses.translation: A challenger has demanded a punishment bound to come

verses.text: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.
verses.translation: for the disbelievers—to be averted by none—

verses.text: [It is] from Allah , owner of the ways of ascent.
verses.translation: from Allah, Lord of pathways of ˹heavenly˺ ascent

verses.text: The angels and the Spirit will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.
verses.translation: ˹through which˺ the angels and the ˹holy˺ spirit will ascend to Him on a Day fifty thousand years in length

verses.text: So be patient with gracious patience.
verses.translation: So endure ˹this denial, O Prophet,˺ with beautiful patience

verses.text: Indeed, they see it [as] distant,
verses.translation: They truly see this ˹Day˺ as impossible

verses.text: But We see it [as] near.
verses.translation: but We see it as inevitable

verses.text: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,
verses.translation: On that Day the sky will be like molten brass

verses.text: And the mountains will be like wool,
verses.translation: and the mountains like ˹tufts of˺ wool

verses.text: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,
verses.translation: And no close friend will ask ˹about˺ their friends

verses.text: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children
verses.translation: ˹although˺ they will be made to see each other. The wicked will wish to ransom themselves from the punishment of that Day by their children

verses.text: And his wife and his brother
verses.translation: their spouses, their siblings

verses.text: And his nearest kindred who shelter him
verses.translation: their clan that sheltered them

verses.text: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.
verses.translation: and everyone on earth altogether, just to save themselves

verses.text: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],
verses.translation: But no! There will certainly be a raging Flame

verses.text: A remover of exteriors.
verses.translation: ripping off scalps

verses.text: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]
verses.translation: It will summon whoever turned their backs ˹on Allah˺ and turned away ˹from the truth˺

verses.text: And collected [wealth] and hoarded.
verses.translation: and gathered and hoarded ˹wealth˺

verses.text: Indeed, mankind was created anxious:
verses.translation: Indeed, humankind was created impatient

verses.text: When evil touches him, impatient,
verses.translation: distressed when touched with evil

verses.text: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],
verses.translation: and withholding when touched with good—

verses.text: Except the observers of prayer -
verses.translation: except those who pray

verses.text: Those who are constant in their prayer
verses.translation: consistently performing their prayers

verses.text: And those within whose wealth is a known right
verses.translation: and who give the rightful share of their wealth

verses.text: For the petitioner and the deprived -
verses.translation: to the beggar and the poor

verses.text: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense
verses.translation: and who ˹firmly˺ believe in the Day of Judgment

verses.text: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -
verses.translation: and those who fear the punishment of their Lord—

verses.text: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -
verses.translation: ˹knowing that˺ none should feel secure from their Lord’s punishment—

verses.text: And those who guard their private parts
verses.translation: and those who guard their chastity

verses.text: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed -
verses.translation: except with their wives or those ˹bondwomen˺ in their possession, for then they are free from blame

verses.text: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -
verses.translation: but whoever seeks beyond that are the transgressors

verses.text: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive
verses.translation: ˹The faithful are˺ also those who are true to their trusts and covenants

verses.text: And those who are in their testimonies upright
verses.translation: and who are honest in their testimony

verses.text: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:
verses.translation: and who are ˹properly˺ observant of their prayers

verses.text: They will be in gardens, honored.
verses.translation: These will be in Gardens, held in honour

verses.text: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muhammad],
verses.translation: So what is the matter with the disbelievers that they rush ˹head-long˺ towards you ˹O Prophet˺

verses.text: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?
verses.translation: from the right and the left, in groups ˹to mock you˺

verses.text: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?
verses.translation: Does every one of them expect to be admitted into a Garden of Bliss

verses.text: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.
verses.translation: But no! Indeed, they ˹already˺ know what We created them from

verses.text: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able
verses.translation: So, I do swear by the Lord of ˹all˺ the points of sunrise and sunset that We are truly capable

verses.text: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.
verses.translation: of replacing them with ˹others˺ better than them, and We cannot be prevented ˹from doing so˺

verses.text: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -
verses.translation: So let them indulge ˹in falsehood˺ and amuse ˹themselves˺ until they face their Day, which they have been threatened with—

verses.text: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.
verses.translation: the Day they will come forth from the graves swiftly, as if racing to an idol ˹for a blessing˺

verses.text: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.
verses.translation: with eyes downcast, utterly covered with disgrace. That is the Day they have ˹always˺ been warned of

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."
verses.translation: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people ˹saying to him˺, “Warn your people before a painful punishment comes to them.”

verses.text: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner,
verses.translation: Noah proclaimed, “O my people! I am truly sent to you with a clear warning

verses.text: [Saying], 'Worship Allah , fear Him and obey me.
verses.translation: worship Allah ˹alone˺, fear Him, and obey me

verses.text: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allah , when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew.' "
verses.translation: He will forgive your sins, and delay your end until the appointed time. Indeed, when the time set by Allah comes, it cannot be delayed, if only you knew!”

verses.text: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.
verses.translation: He cried, “My Lord! I have surely called my people day and night

verses.text: But my invitation increased them not except in flight.
verses.translation: but my calls only made them run farther away

verses.text: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.
verses.translation: And whenever I invite them to be forgiven by You, they press their fingers into their ears, cover themselves with their clothes, persist ˹in denial˺, and act very arrogantly

verses.text: Then I invited them publicly.
verses.translation: Then I certainly called them openly

verses.text: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly
verses.translation: then I surely preached to them publicly and privately

verses.text: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
verses.translation: saying, ‘Seek your Lord’s forgiveness, ˹for˺ He is truly Most Forgiving

verses.text: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
verses.translation: He will shower you with abundant rain

verses.text: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.
verses.translation: supply you with wealth and children, and give you gardens as well as rivers

verses.text: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur
verses.translation: What is the matter with you that you are not in awe of the Majesty of Allah

verses.text: While He has created you in stages?
verses.translation: when He truly created you in stages ˹of development˺

verses.text: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers
verses.translation: Do you not see how Allah created seven heavens, one above the other

verses.text: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?
verses.translation: placing the moon within them as a ˹reflected˺ light, and the sun as a ˹radiant˺ lamp

verses.text: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.
verses.translation: Allah ˹alone˺ caused you to grow from the earth like a plant

verses.text: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.
verses.translation: Then He will return you to it, and then simply bring you forth ˹again˺

verses.text: And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse
verses.translation: And Allah ˹alone˺ spread out the earth for you

verses.text: That you may follow therein roads of passage.' "
verses.translation: to walk along its spacious pathways.’”

verses.text: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.
verses.translation: ˹Eventually,˺ Noah cried, “My Lord! They have certainly persisted in disobeying me, and followed ˹instead˺ those ˹elite˺ whose ˹abundant˺ wealth and children only increase them in loss

verses.text: And they conspired an immense conspiracy.
verses.translation: and who have devised a tremendous plot

verses.text: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa' or Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.
verses.translation: urging ˹their followers˺, ‘Do not abandon your idols—especially Wadd, Suwâ’, Yaghûth, Ya’ûq, and Nasr.’

verses.text: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."
verses.translation: Those ˹elite˺ have already led many astray. So ˹O Lord˺, only allow the wrongdoers to stray farther away.”

verses.text: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah [any] helpers.
verses.translation: So because of their sins, they were drowned, then admitted into the Fire. And they found none to help them against Allah

verses.text: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.
verses.translation: Noah had prayed, “My Lord! Do not leave a single disbeliever on earth

verses.text: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.
verses.translation: For if You spare ˹any of˺ them, they will certainly mislead Your servants, and give birth only to ˹wicked˺ sinners, staunch disbelievers

verses.text: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
verses.translation: My Lord! Forgive me, my parents, and whoever enters my house in faith, and ˹all˺ believing men and women. And increase the wrongdoers only in destruction.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an.
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn listened ˹to the Quran,˺ and said ˹to their fellow jinn˺: ‘Indeed, we have heard a wondrous recitation

verses.text: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
verses.translation: It leads to Right Guidance so we believed in it, and we will never associate anyone with our Lord ˹in worship˺

verses.text: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
verses.translation: ˹Now, we believe that˺ our Lord—Exalted is His Majesty—has neither taken a mate nor offspring

verses.text: And that our foolish one has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression.
verses.translation: and that the foolish of us used to utter ˹outrageous˺ falsehoods about Allah

verses.text: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie.
verses.translation: We certainly thought that humans and jinn would never speak lies about Allah

verses.text: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden.
verses.translation: And some men used to seek refuge with some jinn—so they increased each other in wickedness

verses.text: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger].
verses.translation: And those ˹humans˺ thought, just like you ˹jinn˺, that Allah would not resurrect anyone ˹for judgment˺

verses.text: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.
verses.translation: ˹Earlier˺ we tried to reach heaven ˹for news˺, only to find it filled with stern guards and shooting stars

verses.text: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.
verses.translation: We used to take up positions there for eavesdropping, but whoever dares eavesdrop now will find a flare lying in wait for them

verses.text: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.
verses.translation: Now, we have no clue whether evil is intended for those on earth, or their Lord intends for them what is right

verses.text: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.
verses.translation: Among us are those who are righteous and those who are less so. We have been of different factions

verses.text: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
verses.translation: ˹Now,˺ we truly know that we cannot frustrate Allah on earth, nor can we escape from Him ˹into heaven˺

verses.text: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.
verses.translation: When we heard the guidance ˹of the Quran˺, we ˹readily˺ believed in it. For whoever believes in their Lord will have no fear of being denied ˹a reward˺ or wronged

verses.text: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah ], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
verses.translation: And among us are those who have submitted ˹to Allah˺ and those who are deviant. So ˹as for˺ those who submitted, it is they who have attained Right Guidance

verses.text: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'
verses.translation: And as for the deviant, they will be fuel for Hell.’”

verses.text: And [ Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision
verses.translation: Had the deniers followed the Right Way, We would have certainly granted them abundant rain to drink—

verses.text: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.
verses.translation: as a test for them. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of their Lord will be admitted by Him into an overwhelming punishment

verses.text: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allah , so do not invoke with Allah anyone.
verses.translation: The places of worship are ˹only˺ for Allah, so do not invoke anyone besides Him

verses.text: And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."
verses.translation: Yet when the servant of Allah stood up calling upon Him ˹alone˺, the pagans almost swarmed over him

verses.text: Say, [O Muhammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I call only upon my Lord, associating none with Him ˹in worship˺.”

verses.text: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
verses.translation: Say, “It is not in my power to harm or benefit you.”

verses.text: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.
verses.translation: Say, “No one can protect me from Allah ˹if I were to disobey Him˺, nor can I find any refuge other than Him

verses.text: But [I have for you] only notification from Allah , and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.
verses.translation: ˹My duty is˺ only to convey ˹the truth˺ from Allah and ˹deliver˺ His messages.” And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger will certainly be in the Fire of Hell, to stay there for ever and ever

verses.text: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.
verses.translation: Only when they see what they have been threatened with will they know who is weaker in helpers and inferior in manpower

verses.text: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."
verses.translation: Say, “I do not know if what you are promised is near or my Lord has set a distant time for it

verses.text: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
verses.translation: ˹He is the˺ Knower of the unseen, disclosing none of it to anyone

verses.text: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before each messenger and behind him observers
verses.translation: except messengers of His choice. Then He appoints angel-guards before and behind them

verses.text: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
verses.translation: to ensure that the messengers fully deliver the messages of their Lord—though He ˹already˺ knows all about them, and keeps account of everything.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: O you who wraps himself [in clothing],
verses.translation: O you wrapped ˹in your clothes˺

verses.text: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -
verses.translation: Stand all night ˹in prayer˺ except a little—

verses.text: Half of it - or subtract from it a little
verses.translation: ˹pray˺ half the night, or a little less

verses.text: Or add to it, and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation.
verses.translation: or a little more—and recite the Quran ˹properly˺ in a measured way

verses.text: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.
verses.translation: ˹For˺ We will soon send upon you a weighty revelation

verses.text: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.
verses.translation: Indeed, worship in the night is more impactful and suitable for recitation

verses.text: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.
verses.translation: For during the day you are over-occupied ˹with worldly duties˺

verses.text: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
verses.translation: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord, and devote yourself to Him wholeheartedly

verses.text: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.
verses.translation: ˹He is the˺ Lord of the east and the west. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him, so take Him ˹alone˺ as a Trustee of Affairs

verses.text: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.
verses.translation: Be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say, and depart from them courteously

verses.text: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
verses.translation: And leave to Me the deniers—the people of luxury—and bear with them for a little while

verses.text: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire
verses.translation: ˹For˺ We certainly have shackles, a ˹raging˺ Fire

verses.text: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -
verses.translation: choking food, and a painful punishment ˹in store for them˺

verses.text: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.
verses.translation: on the Day the earth and mountains will shake ˹violently˺, and mountains will be ˹reduced to˺ dunes of shifting sand

verses.text: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
verses.translation: Indeed, We have sent to you a messenger as a witness over you, just as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh

verses.text: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.
verses.translation: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a stern grip

verses.text: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white- haired?
verses.translation: If you ˹pagans˺ persist in disbelief, then how will you guard yourselves against ˹the horrors of˺ a Day which will turn children’s hair grey

verses.text: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.
verses.translation: It will ˹even˺ cause the sky to split apart. His promise ˹of judgment˺ must be fulfilled

verses.text: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
verses.translation: Surely this is a reminder. So let whoever wills take the ˹Right˺ Way to their Lord

verses.text: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah . So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah . It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah . Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
verses.translation: Surely your Lord knows that you ˹O Prophet˺ stand ˹in prayer˺ for nearly two-thirds of the night, or ˹sometimes˺ half of it, or a third, as do some of those with you. Allah ˹alone˺ keeps a ˹precise˺ measure of the day and night. He knows that you ˹believers˺ are unable to endure this, and has turned to you in mercy. So recite ˹in prayer˺ whatever you can from the Quran. He knows that some of you will be sick, some will be travelling throughout the land seeking Allah’s bounty, and some fighting in the cause of Allah. So recite whatever you can from it. And ˹continue to˺ perform ˹regular˺ prayers, pay alms-tax, and lend to Allah a good loan. Whatever good you send forth for yourselves, you will find it with Allah far better and more rewarding. And seek Allah’s forgiveness. Surely Allah is All-Forgiving, Most Merciful

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: O you who covers himself [with a garment],
verses.translation: O you covered up ˹in your clothes˺

verses.text: Arise and warn
verses.translation: Arise and warn ˹all˺

verses.text: And your Lord glorify
verses.translation: Revere your Lord ˹alone˺

verses.text: And your clothing purify
verses.translation: Purify your garments

verses.text: And uncleanliness avoid
verses.translation: ˹Continue to˺ shun idols

verses.text: And do not confer favor to acquire more
verses.translation: Do not do a favour expecting more ˹in return˺

verses.text: But for your Lord be patient.
verses.translation: And persevere for ˹the sake of˺ your Lord

verses.text: And when the trumpet is blown,
verses.translation: ˹For˺ when the Trumpet will be sounded

verses.text: That Day will be a difficult day
verses.translation: that will ˹truly˺ be a difficult Day—

verses.text: For the disbelievers - not easy.
verses.translation: far from easy for the disbelievers

verses.text: Leave Me with the one I created alone
verses.translation: And leave to me ˹O Prophet˺ the one I created all by Myself

verses.text: And to whom I granted extensive wealth
verses.translation: and granted him abundant wealth

verses.text: And children present [with him]
verses.translation: and children always by his side

verses.text: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].
verses.translation: and made life very easy for him

verses.text: Then he desires that I should add more.
verses.translation: Yet he is hungry for more

verses.text: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.
verses.translation: But no! ˹For˺ he has been truly stubborn with Our revelations

verses.text: I will cover him with arduous torment.
verses.translation: I will make his fate unbearable

verses.text: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.
verses.translation: for he contemplated and determined ˹a degrading label for the Quran˺

verses.text: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
verses.translation: May he be condemned! How evil was what he determined

verses.text: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
verses.translation: May he be condemned even more! How evil was what he determined

verses.text: Then he considered [again];
verses.translation: Then he re-contemplated ˹in frustration˺

verses.text: Then he frowned and scowled;
verses.translation: then frowned and scowled

verses.text: Then he turned back and was arrogant
verses.translation: then turned his back ˹on the truth˺ and acted arrogantly

verses.text: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].
verses.translation: saying, “This ˹Quran˺ is nothing but magic from the ancients

verses.text: This is not but the word of a human being."
verses.translation: This is no more than the word of a man.”

verses.text: I will drive him into Saqar.
verses.translation: Soon I will burn him in Hell

verses.text: And what can make you know what is Saqar?
verses.translation: And what will make you realize what Hell is

verses.text: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],
verses.translation: It does not let anyone live or die

verses.text: Blackening the skins.
verses.translation: scorching the skin

verses.text: Over it are nineteen [angels].
verses.translation: It is overseen by nineteen ˹keepers˺

verses.text: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is hypocrisy and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allah intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allah leave astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And mention of the Fire is not but a reminder to humanity.
verses.translation: We have appointed only ˹stern˺ angels as wardens of the Fire. And We have made their number only as a test for the disbelievers, so that the People of the Book will be certain, and the believers will increase in faith, and neither the People of the Book nor the believers will have any doubts, and so that those ˹hypocrites˺ with sickness in their hearts and the disbelievers will argue, “What does Allah mean by such a number?” In this way Allah leaves whoever He wills to stray and guides whoever He wills. And none knows the forces of your Lord except He. And this ˹description of Hell˺ is only a reminder to humanity

verses.text: No! By the moon
verses.translation: But no! By the moon

verses.text: And [by] the night when it departs
verses.translation: and the night as it retreats

verses.text: And [by] the morning when it brightens,
verses.translation: and the day as it breaks

verses.text: Indeed, the Fire is of the greatest [afflictions]
verses.translation: Surely Hell is one of the mightiest catastrophes—

verses.text: As a warning to humanity -
verses.translation: a warning to humankind

verses.text: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.
verses.translation: to whichever of you chooses to take the lead or lag behind

verses.text: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained
verses.translation: Every soul will be detained for what it has done

verses.text: Except the companions of the right,
verses.translation: except the people of the right

verses.text: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other
verses.translation: who will be in Gardens, asking one another

verses.text: About the criminals,
verses.translation: about the wicked ˹who will then be asked˺

verses.text: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"
verses.translation: “What has landed you in Hell?”

verses.text: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,
verses.translation: They will reply, “We were not of those who prayed

verses.text: Nor did we used to feed the poor.
verses.translation: nor did we feed the poor

verses.text: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],
verses.translation: We used to indulge ˹in falsehood˺ along with others

verses.text: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
verses.translation: and deny the Day of Judgment

verses.text: Until there came to us the certainty."
verses.translation: until the inevitable came to us.”

verses.text: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.
verses.translation: So the pleas of intercessors will be of no benefit to them

verses.text: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away
verses.translation: Now, what is the matter with them that they are turning away from the reminder

verses.text: As if they were alarmed donkeys
verses.translation: as if they were spooked zebras

verses.text: Fleeing from a lion?
verses.translation: fleeing from a lion

verses.text: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.
verses.translation: In fact, each one of them wishes to be given a ˹personal˺ letter ˹from Allah˺ for all ˹to read˺

verses.text: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.
verses.translation: But no! In fact, they do not fear the Hereafter

verses.text: No! Indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder
verses.translation: Enough! Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a reminder

verses.text: Then whoever wills will remember it.
verses.translation: So let whoever wills be mindful of it

verses.text: And they will not remember except that Allah wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.
verses.translation: But they cannot do so unless Allah wills. He ˹alone˺ is worthy to be feared and entitled to forgive

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: I swear by the Day of Resurrection
verses.translation: I do swear by the Day of Judgment

verses.text: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].
verses.translation: And I do swear by the self-reproaching soul

verses.text: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?
verses.translation: Do people think We cannot reassemble their bones

verses.text: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.
verses.translation: Yes ˹indeed˺! We are ˹most˺ capable of restoring ˹even˺ their very fingertips

verses.text: But man desires to continue in sin.
verses.translation: Still people want to deny what is yet to come

verses.text: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
verses.translation: asking ˹mockingly˺, “When is this Day of Judgment?”

verses.text: So when vision is dazzled
verses.translation: But when the sight is stunned

verses.text: And the moon darkens
verses.translation: and the moon is dimmed

verses.text: And the sun and the moon are joined,
verses.translation: and the sun and the moon are brought together

verses.text: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"
verses.translation: on that Day one will cry, “Where is the escape?”

verses.text: No! There is no refuge.
verses.translation: But no! There will be no refuge

verses.text: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.
verses.translation: On that Day all will end up before your Lord

verses.text: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back.
verses.translation: All will then be informed of what they have sent forth and left behind

verses.text: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,
verses.translation: In fact, people will testify against their own souls

verses.text: Even if he presents his excuses.
verses.translation: despite the excuses they come up with

verses.text: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muhammad], to hasten with recitation of the Qur'an.
verses.translation: Do not rush your tongue trying to memorize ˹a revelation of˺ the Quran

verses.text: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.
verses.translation: It is certainly upon Us to ˹make you˺ memorize and recite it

verses.text: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.
verses.translation: So once We have recited a revelation ˹through Gabriel˺, follow its recitation ˹closely˺

verses.text: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].
verses.translation: Then it is surely upon Us to make it clear ˹to you˺

verses.text: No! But you love the immediate
verses.translation: But no! In fact, you love this fleeting world

verses.text: And leave the Hereafter.
verses.translation: and neglect the Hereafter

verses.text: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,
verses.translation: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be bright

verses.text: Looking at their Lord.
verses.translation: looking at their Lord

verses.text: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,
verses.translation: And ˹other˺ faces will be gloomy

verses.text: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.
