verses.translation: anticipating something devastating to befall them

verses.text: No! When the soul has reached the collar bones
verses.translation: But no! ˹Beware of the day˺ when the soul reaches the collar bone ˹as it leaves˺

verses.text: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"
verses.translation: and it will be said, “Is there any healer ˹who can save this life˺?”

verses.text: And the dying one is certain that it is the [time of] separation
verses.translation: And the dying person realizes it is ˹their˺ time to depart

verses.text: And the leg is wound about the leg,
verses.translation: and ˹then˺ their feet are tied together ˹in a shroud˺

verses.text: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.
verses.translation: On that day they will be driven to your Lord ˹alone˺

verses.text: And the disbeliever had not believed, nor had he prayed.
verses.translation: This denier neither believed nor prayed

verses.text: But [instead], he denied and turned away.
verses.translation: but persisted in denial and turned away

verses.text: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].
verses.translation: then went to their own people, walking boastfully

verses.text: Woe to you, and woe!
verses.translation: Woe to you, and more woe

verses.text: Then woe to you, and woe!
verses.translation: Again, woe to you, and even more woe

verses.text: Does man think that he will be left neglected?
verses.translation: Do people think they will be left without purpose

verses.text: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?
verses.translation: Were they not ˹once˺ a sperm-drop emitted

verses.text: Then he was a clinging clot, and [ Allah ] created [his form] and proportioned [him]
verses.translation: Then they became a clinging clot ˹of blood˺, then He developed and perfected their form

verses.text: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.
verses.translation: producing from it both sexes, male and female

verses.text: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?
verses.translation: Is such ˹a Creator˺ unable to bring the dead back to life

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?
verses.translation: Is there not a period of time when each human is nothing yet worth mentioning

verses.text: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
verses.translation: ˹For˺ indeed, We ˹alone˺ created humans from a drop of mixed fluids, ˹in order˺ to test them, so We made them hear and see

verses.text: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.
verses.translation: We already showed them the Way, whether they ˹choose to˺ be grateful or ungrateful

verses.text: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.
verses.translation: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains, shackles, and a blazing Fire

verses.text: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur,
verses.translation: Indeed, the virtuous will have a drink ˹of pure wine˺—flavoured with camphor—

verses.text: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].
verses.translation: ˹from˺ a spring where Allah’s servants will drink, flowing at their will

verses.text: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.
verses.translation: They ˹are those who˺ fulfil ˹their˺ vows and fear a Day of sweeping horror

verses.text: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
verses.translation: and give food—despite their desire for it—to the poor, the orphan, and the captive

verses.text: [Saying], "We feed you only for the countenance of Allah . We wish not from you reward or gratitude.
verses.translation: ˹saying to themselves,˺ “We feed you only for the sake of Allah, seeking neither reward nor thanks from you

verses.text: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."
verses.translation: We fear from our Lord a horribly distressful Day.”

verses.text: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness
verses.translation: So Allah will deliver them from the horror of that Day, and grant them radiance and joy

verses.text: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].
verses.translation: and reward them for their perseverance with a Garden ˹in Paradise˺ and ˹garments of˺ silk

verses.text: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.
verses.translation: There they will be reclining on ˹canopied˺ couches, never seeing scorching heat or bitter cold

verses.text: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.
verses.translation: The Garden’s shade will be right above them, and its fruit will be made very easy to reach

verses.text: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],
verses.translation: They will be waited on with silver vessels and cups of crystal—

verses.text: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.
verses.translation: crystalline silver, filled precisely as desired

verses.text: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger
verses.translation: And they will be given a drink ˹of pure wine˺ flavoured with ginger

verses.text: [From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel.
verses.translation: from a spring there, called Salsabîl

verses.text: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.
verses.translation: They will be waited on by eternal youths. If you saw them, you would think they were scattered pearls

verses.text: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.
verses.translation: And if you looked around, you would see ˹indescribable˺ bliss and a vast kingdom

verses.text: Upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.
verses.translation: The virtuous will be ˹dressed˺ in garments of fine green silk and rich brocade, and adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink

verses.text: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."
verses.translation: ˹And they will be told,˺ “All this is surely a reward for you. Your striving has been appreciated.”

verses.text: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively.
verses.translation: Indeed, it is We Who have revealed the Quran to you ˹O Prophet˺ in stages

verses.text: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].
verses.translation: So be patient with your Lord’s decree, and do not yield to any evildoer or ˹staunch˺ disbeliever from among them

verses.text: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
verses.translation: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord morning and evening

verses.text: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night.
verses.translation: and prostrate before Him during part of the night, and glorify Him long at night

verses.text: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.
verses.translation: Surely those ˹pagans˺ love this fleeting world, ˹totally˺ neglecting a weighty Day ahead of them

verses.text: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.
verses.translation: It is We Who created them and perfected their ˹physical˺ form. But if We will, We can easily replace them with others

verses.text: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.
verses.translation: Surely this is a reminder. So let whoever wills take the ˹Right˺ Way to their Lord

verses.text: And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.
verses.translation: But you cannot will ˹to do so˺ unless Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise

verses.text: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
verses.translation: He admits whoever He wills into His mercy. As for the wrongdoers, He has prepared for them a painful punishment

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts
verses.translation: By those ˹winds˺ sent forth successively

verses.text: And the winds that blow violently
verses.translation: and those blowing violently

verses.text: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]
verses.translation: and those scattering ˹rainclouds˺ widely

verses.text: And those [angels] who bring criterion
verses.translation: And ˹by˺ those ˹angels˺ fully distinguishing ˹truth from falsehood˺

verses.text: And those [angels] who deliver a message
verses.translation: and those delivering revelation

verses.text: As justification or warning,
verses.translation: ending excuses and giving warnings

verses.text: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.
verses.translation: Surely, what you are promised will come to pass

verses.text: So when the stars are obliterated
verses.translation: So when the stars are put out

verses.text: And when the heaven is opened
verses.translation: and the sky is torn apart

verses.text: And when the mountains are blown away
verses.translation: and the mountains are blown away

verses.text: And when the messengers' time has come...
verses.translation: and the messengers’ time ˹to testify˺ comes up—

verses.text: For what Day was it postponed?
verses.translation: for which Day has all this been set

verses.text: For the Day of Judgement.
verses.translation: For the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision

verses.text: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?
verses.translation: And what will make you realize what the Day of Decision is

verses.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.translation: Woe on that Day to the deniers

verses.text: Did We not destroy the former peoples?
verses.translation: Did We not destroy earlier disbelievers

verses.text: Then We will follow them with the later ones.
verses.translation: And We will make the later disbelievers follow them

verses.text: Thus do We deal with the criminals.
verses.translation: This is how We deal with the wicked

verses.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.translation: Woe on that Day to the deniers

verses.text: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?
verses.translation: Did We not create you from a humble fluid

verses.text: And We placed it in a firm lodging
verses.translation: placing it in a secure place

verses.text: For a known extent.
verses.translation: until an appointed time

verses.text: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.
verses.translation: We ˹perfectly˺ ordained ˹its development˺. How excellent are We in doing so

verses.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.translation: Woe on that Day to the deniers

verses.text: Have We not made the earth a container
verses.translation: Have We not made the earth a lodging

verses.text: Of the living and the dead?
verses.translation: for the living and the dead

verses.text: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.
verses.translation: and placed upon it towering, firm mountains, and given you fresh water to drink

verses.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.translation: Woe on that Day to the deniers

verses.text: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.
verses.translation: ˹The disbelievers will be told,˺ “Proceed into that ˹Fire˺ which you used to deny

verses.text: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns
verses.translation: Proceed into the shade ˹of smoke˺ which rises in three columns

verses.text: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."
verses.translation: providing neither coolness nor shelter from the flames

verses.text: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,
verses.translation: Indeed, it hurls sparks ˹as big˺ as huge castles

verses.text: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.
verses.translation: and ˹as dark˺ as black camels.”

verses.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.translation: Woe on that Day to the deniers

verses.text: This is a Day they will not speak,
verses.translation: On that Day they will not ˹be in a position to˺ speak

verses.text: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.
verses.translation: nor will they be permitted to offer excuses

verses.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.translation: Woe on that Day to the deniers

verses.text: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.
verses.translation: ˹They will be told by Allah,˺ “This is the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision: We have gathered you along with earlier disbelievers ˹for punishment˺

verses.text: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.
verses.translation: So if you have a scheme ˹to save yourselves˺, then use it against Me.”

verses.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.translation: Woe on that Day to the deniers

verses.text: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be amid ˹cool˺ shade and springs

verses.text: And fruits from whatever they desire,
verses.translation: and any fruit they desire

verses.text: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
verses.translation: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink happily for what you used to do.”

verses.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
verses.translation: Surely this is how We reward the good-doers

verses.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.translation: ˹But˺ woe on that Day to the deniers

verses.text: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.
verses.translation: “Eat and enjoy yourselves for a little while, ˹for˺ you are truly wicked.”

verses.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.translation: Woe on that Day to the deniers

verses.text: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.
verses.translation: When it is said to them, “Bow down ˹before Allah,” they do not bow

verses.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
verses.translation: Woe on that Day to the deniers

verses.text: Then in what statement after the Qur'an will they believe?
verses.translation: So what message after this ˹Quran˺ would they believe in

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: About what are they asking one another?
verses.translation: What are they asking one another about

verses.text: About the great news -
verses.translation: About the momentous news

verses.text: That over which they are in disagreement.
verses.translation: over which they disagree

verses.text: No! They are going to know.
verses.translation: But no! They will come to know

verses.text: Then, no! They are going to know.
verses.translation: Again, no! They will come to know

verses.text: Have We not made the earth a resting place?
verses.translation: Have We not smoothed out the earth ˹like a bed˺

verses.text: And the mountains as stakes?
verses.translation: and ˹made˺ the mountains as ˹its˺ pegs

verses.text: And We created you in pairs
verses.translation: and created you in pairs

verses.text: And made your sleep [a means for] rest
verses.translation: and made your sleep for rest

verses.text: And made the night as clothing
verses.translation: and made the night as a cover

verses.text: And made the day for livelihood
verses.translation: and made the day for livelihood

verses.text: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
verses.translation: and built above you seven mighty ˹heavens˺

verses.text: And made [therein] a burning lamp
verses.translation: and placed ˹in them˺ a shining lamp

verses.text: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water
verses.translation: and sent down from rainclouds pouring water

verses.text: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
verses.translation: producing by it grain and ˹various˺ plants

verses.text: And gardens of entwined growth.
verses.translation: and dense orchards

verses.text: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -
verses.translation: Indeed, the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision is an appointed time—

verses.text: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
verses.translation: ˹it is˺ the Day the Trumpet will be blown, and you will ˹all˺ come forth in crowds

verses.text: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
verses.translation: The sky will be ˹split˺ open, becoming ˹many˺ gates

verses.text: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.
verses.translation: and the mountains will be blown away, becoming ˹like˺ a mirage

verses.text: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
verses.translation: Indeed, Hell is lying in ambush

verses.text: For the transgressors, a place of return,
verses.translation: as a home for the transgressors

verses.text: In which they will remain for ages [unending].
verses.translation: where they will remain for ˹endless˺ ages

verses.text: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink
verses.translation: There they will not taste any coolness or drink

verses.text: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -
verses.translation: except boiling water and ˹oozing˺ pus—

verses.text: An appropriate recompense.
verses.translation: a fitting reward

verses.text: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
verses.translation: For they never expected any reckoning

verses.text: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.
verses.translation: and totally rejected Our signs

verses.text: But all things We have enumerated in writing.
verses.translation: And We have everything recorded precisely

verses.text: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."
verses.translation: ˹So the deniers will be told,˺ “Taste ˹the punishment˺, for all you will get from Us is more torment.”

verses.text: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will have salvation—

verses.text: Gardens and grapevines
verses.translation: Gardens, vineyards

verses.text: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age
verses.translation: and full-bosomed maidens of equal age

verses.text: And a full cup.
verses.translation: and full cups ˹of pure wine˺

verses.text: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -
verses.translation: never to hear any idle talk or lying therein—

verses.text: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,
verses.translation: a ˹fitting˺ reward as a generous gift from your Lord

verses.text: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.
verses.translation: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, the Most Compassionate. No one will dare speak to Him

verses.text: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.
verses.translation: on the Day the ˹holy˺ spirit and the angels will stand in ranks. None will talk, except those granted permission by the Most Compassionate and whose words are true

verses.text: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.
verses.translation: That Day is the ˹ultimate˺ truth. So let whoever wills take the path leading back to their Lord

verses.text: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
verses.translation: Indeed, We have warned you of an imminent punishment—the Day every person will see ˹the consequences of˺ what their hands have done, and the disbelievers will cry, “I wish I were dust.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: By those [angels] who extract with violence
verses.translation: By those ˹angels˺ stripping out ˹evil souls˺ harshly

verses.text: And [by] those who remove with ease
verses.translation: and those pulling out ˹good souls˺ gently

verses.text: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming
verses.translation: and those gliding ˹through heavens˺ swiftly

verses.text: And those who race each other in a race
verses.translation: and those taking the lead vigorously

verses.text: And those who arrange [each] matter,
verses.translation: and those conducting affairs ˹obediently˺

verses.text: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],
verses.translation: ˹Consider˺ the Day ˹when˺ the quaking Blast will come to pass

verses.text: There will follow it the subsequent [one].
verses.translation: followed by a second Blast

verses.text: Hearts, that Day, will tremble,
verses.translation: ˹The deniers’˺ hearts on that Day will be trembling ˹in horror˺

verses.text: Their eyes humbled.
verses.translation: with their eyes downcast

verses.text: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?
verses.translation: ˹But now˺ they ask ˹mockingly˺, “Will we really be restored to our former state

verses.text: Even if we should be decayed bones?
verses.translation: even after we have been reduced to decayed bones?”

verses.text: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."
verses.translation: Adding, “Then such a return would be a ˹total˺ loss ˹for us˺!”

verses.text: Indeed, it will be but one shout,
verses.translation: But indeed, it will take only one ˹mighty˺ Blast

verses.text: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.
verses.translation: and at once they will be above ground

verses.text: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -
verses.translation: Has the story of Moses reached you ˹O Prophet˺

verses.text: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,
verses.translation: His Lord called him in the sacred valley of Ṭuwa

verses.text: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
verses.translation: ˹commanding,˺ “Go to Pharaoh, for he has truly transgressed ˹all bounds˺

verses.text: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself
verses.translation: And say, ‘Would you ˹be willing to˺ purify yourself

verses.text: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"
verses.translation: and let me guide you to your Lord so that you will be in awe ˹of Him˺?’”

verses.text: And he showed him the greatest sign,
verses.translation: Then Moses showed him the great sign

verses.text: But Pharaoh denied and disobeyed.
verses.translation: but he denied and disobeyed ˹Allah˺

verses.text: Then he turned his back, striving.
verses.translation: then turned his back, striving ˹against the truth˺

verses.text: And he gathered [his people] and called out
verses.translation: Then he summoned ˹his people˺ and called out

verses.text: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."
verses.translation: saying, “I am your lord, the most high!”

verses.text: So Allah seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression].
verses.translation: So Allah overtook him, making him an example in this life and the next

verses.text: Indeed in that is a warning for whoever would fear [ Allah ].
verses.translation: Surely in this is a lesson for whoever stands in awe of ˹Allah˺

verses.text: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it.
verses.translation: Which is harder to create: you or the sky? He built it

verses.text: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.
verses.translation: raising it high and forming it flawlessly

verses.text: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.
verses.translation: He dimmed its night, and brought forth its daylight

verses.text: And after that He spread the earth.
verses.translation: As for the earth, He spread it out as well

verses.text: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,
verses.translation: bringing forth its water and pastures

verses.text: And the mountains He set firmly
verses.translation: and setting the mountains firmly ˹upon it˺—

verses.text: As provision for you and your grazing livestock.
verses.translation: all as ˹a means of˺ sustenance for you and your animals

verses.text: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -
verses.translation: But, when the Supreme Disaster comes to pass—

verses.text: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,
verses.translation: the Day every person will remember all ˹their˺ striving

verses.text: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -
verses.translation: and the Hellfire will be displayed for all to see—

verses.text: So as for he who transgressed
verses.translation: then as for those who transgressed

verses.text: And preferred the life of the world,
verses.translation: and preferred the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world

verses.text: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.
verses.translation: the Hellfire will certainly be ˹their˺ home

verses.text: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,
verses.translation: And as for those who were in awe of standing before their Lord and restrained themselves from ˹evil˺ desires

verses.text: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.
verses.translation: Paradise will certainly be ˹their˺ home

verses.text: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?
verses.translation: They ask you ˹O Prophet˺ regarding the Hour, “When will it be?”

verses.text: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?
verses.translation: But it is not for you to tell its time

verses.text: To your Lord is its finality.
verses.translation: That knowledge rests with your Lord ˹alone˺

verses.text: You are only a warner for those who fear it.
verses.translation: Your duty is only to warn whoever is in awe of it

verses.text: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
verses.translation: On the Day they see it, it will be as if they had stayed ˹in the world˺ no more than one evening or its morning

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: The Prophet frowned and turned away
verses.translation: He frowned and turned ˹his attention˺ away

verses.text: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].
verses.translation: ˹simply˺ because the blind man came to him ˹interrupting˺

verses.text: But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified
verses.translation: You never know ˹O Prophet˺, perhaps he may be purified

verses.text: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?
verses.translation: or he may be mindful, benefitting from the reminder

verses.text: As for he who thinks himself without need,
verses.translation: As for the one who was indifferent

verses.text: To him you give attention.
verses.translation: you gave him your ˹undivided˺ attention

verses.text: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.
verses.translation: even though you are not to blame if he would not be purified

verses.text: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]
verses.translation: But as for the one who came to you, eager ˹to learn˺

verses.text: While he fears [ Allah ],
verses.translation: being in awe ˹of Allah˺

verses.text: From him you are distracted.
verses.translation: you were inattentive to him

verses.text: No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder;
verses.translation: But no! This ˹revelation˺ is truly a reminder

verses.text: So whoever wills may remember it.
verses.translation: So let whoever wills be mindful of it

verses.text: [It is recorded] in honored sheets,
verses.translation: It is ˹written˺ on pages held in honour—

verses.text: Exalted and purified,
verses.translation: highly esteemed, purified—

verses.text: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels,
verses.translation: by the hands of angel-scribes

verses.text: Noble and dutiful.
verses.translation: honourable and virtuous

verses.text: Cursed is man; how disbelieving is he.
verses.translation: Condemned are ˹disbelieving˺ humans! How ungrateful they are ˹to Allah˺

verses.text: From what substance did He create him?
verses.translation: From what substance did He create them

verses.text: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;
verses.translation: He created them from a sperm-drop, and ordained their development

verses.text: Then He eased the way for him;
verses.translation: Then He makes the way easy for them

verses.text: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.
verses.translation: then causes them to die and be buried

verses.text: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.
verses.translation: Then when He wills, He will resurrect them

verses.text: No! Man has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.
verses.translation: But no! They have failed to comply with what He ordered

verses.text: Then let mankind look at his food -
verses.translation: Let people then consider their food

verses.text: How We poured down water in torrents,
verses.translation: how We pour down rain in abundance

verses.text: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],
verses.translation: and meticulously split the earth open ˹for sprouts˺

verses.text: And caused to grow within it grain
verses.translation: causing grain to grow in it

verses.text: And grapes and herbage
verses.translation: as well as grapes and greens

verses.text: And olive and palm trees
verses.translation: and olives and palm trees

verses.text: And gardens of dense shrubbery
verses.translation: and dense orchards

verses.text: And fruit and grass -
verses.translation: and fruit and fodder—

verses.text: [As] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock.
verses.translation: all as ˹a means of˺ sustenance for you and your animals

verses.text: But when there comes the Deafening Blast
verses.translation: Then, when the Deafening Blast comes to pass—

verses.text: On the Day a man will flee from his brother
verses.translation: on that Day every person will flee from their own siblings

verses.text: And his mother and his father
verses.translation: and ˹even˺ their mother and father

verses.text: And his wife and his children,
verses.translation: and ˹even˺ their spouse and children

verses.text: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.
verses.translation: For then everyone will have enough concern of their own

verses.text: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -
verses.translation: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be bright

verses.text: Laughing, rejoicing at good news.
verses.translation: laughing and rejoicing

verses.text: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.
verses.translation: while ˹other˺ faces will be dusty

verses.text: Blackness will cover them.
verses.translation: cast in gloom—

verses.text: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.
verses.translation: those are the disbelievers, the ˹wicked˺ sinners

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]
verses.translation: When the sun is put out

verses.text: And when the stars fall, dispersing,
verses.translation: and when the stars fall down

verses.text: And when the mountains are removed
verses.translation: and when the mountains are blown away

verses.text: And when full-term she-camels are neglected
verses.translation: and when pregnant camels are left untended

verses.text: And when the wild beasts are gathered
verses.translation: and when wild beasts are gathered together

verses.text: And when the seas are filled with flame
verses.translation: and when the seas are set on fire

verses.text: And when the souls are paired
verses.translation: and when the souls ˹and their bodies˺ are paired ˹once more˺

verses.text: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked
verses.translation: and when baby girls, buried alive, are asked

verses.text: For what sin she was killed
verses.translation: for what crime they were put to death

verses.text: And when the pages are made public
verses.translation: and when the records ˹of deeds˺ are laid open

verses.text: And when the sky is stripped away
verses.translation: and when the sky is stripped away

verses.text: And when Hellfire is set ablaze
verses.translation: and when the Hellfire is fiercely flared up

verses.text: And when Paradise is brought near,
verses.translation: and when Paradise is brought near—

verses.text: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].
verses.translation: ˹on that Day˺ each soul will know what ˹deeds˺ it has brought along

verses.text: So I swear by the retreating stars -
verses.translation: I do swear by the receding stars

verses.text: Those that run [their courses] and disappear -
verses.translation: which travel and hide

verses.text: And by the night as it closes in
verses.translation: and the night as it falls

verses.text: And by the dawn when it breathes
verses.translation: and the day as it breaks

verses.text: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger
verses.translation: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the Word of ˹Allah delivered by Gabriel,˺ a noble messenger-angel

verses.text: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],
verses.translation: full of power, held in honour by the Lord of the Throne

verses.text: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.
verses.translation: obeyed there ˹in heaven˺, and trustworthy

verses.text: And your companion is not [at all] mad.
verses.translation: And your fellow man is not insane

verses.text: And he has already seen Gabriel in the clear horizon.
verses.translation: And he did see that ˹angel˺ on the clear horizon

verses.text: And Muhammad is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.
verses.translation: and he does not withhold ˹what is revealed to him of˺ the unseen

verses.text: And the Qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].
verses.translation: And this ˹Quran˺ is not the word of an outcast devil

verses.text: So where are you going?
verses.translation: So what ˹other˺ path would you take

verses.text: It is not except a reminder to the worlds
verses.translation: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is only a reminder to the whole world—

verses.text: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.
verses.translation: to whoever of you wills to take the Straight Way

verses.text: And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds.
verses.translation: But you cannot will ˹to do so˺, except by the Will of Allah, the Lord of all worlds

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: When the sky breaks apart
verses.translation: When the sky splits open

verses.text: And when the stars fall, scattering,
verses.translation: and when the stars fall away

verses.text: And when the seas are erupted
verses.translation: and when the seas burst forth

verses.text: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered,
verses.translation: and when the graves spill out

verses.text: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.
verses.translation: ˹then˺ each soul will know what it has sent forth or left behind

verses.text: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,
verses.translation: O humanity! What has emboldened you against your Lord, the Most Generous

verses.text: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?
verses.translation: Who created you, fashioned you, and perfected your design

verses.text: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.
verses.translation: moulding you in whatever form He willed

verses.text: No! But you deny the Recompense.
verses.translation: But no! In fact, you deny the ˹final˺ Judgment

verses.text: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,
verses.translation: while you are certainly observed by vigilant

verses.text: Noble and recording;
verses.translation: honourable angels, recording ˹everything˺

verses.text: They know whatever you do.
verses.translation: They know whatever you do

verses.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,
verses.translation: Indeed, the virtuous will be in bliss

verses.text: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.
verses.translation: and the wicked will be in Hell

verses.text: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,
verses.translation: burning in it on Judgment Day

verses.text: And never therefrom will they be absent.
verses.translation: and they will have no escape from it

verses.text: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
verses.translation: What will make you realize what Judgment Day is

verses.text: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
verses.translation: Again, what will make you realize what Judgment Day is

verses.text: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah .
verses.translation: ˹It is˺ the Day no soul will be of ˹any˺ benefit to another whatsoever, for all authority on that Day belongs to Allah ˹entirely˺

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Woe to those who give less [than due],
verses.translation: Woe to the defrauders

verses.text: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.
verses.translation: Those who take full measure ˹when they buy˺ from people

verses.text: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.
verses.translation: but give less when they measure or weigh for buyers

verses.text: Do they not think that they will be resurrected
verses.translation: Do such people not think that they will be resurrected

verses.text: For a tremendous Day -
verses.translation: for a tremendous Day—

verses.text: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
verses.translation: the Day ˹all˺ people will stand before the Lord of all worlds

verses.text: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
verses.translation: But no! The wicked are certainly bound for Sijjîn ˹in the depths of Hell˺—

verses.text: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
verses.translation: and what will make you realize what Sijjîn is?—

verses.text: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.
verses.translation: a fate ˹already˺ sealed

verses.text: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,
verses.translation: Woe on that Day to the deniers—

verses.text: Who deny the Day of Recompense.
verses.translation: those who deny Judgment Day

verses.text: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.
verses.translation: None would deny it except every evildoing transgressor

verses.text: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
verses.translation: Whenever Our revelations are recited to them, they say, “Ancient fables!”

verses.text: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.
verses.translation: But no! In fact, their hearts have been stained by all ˹the evil˺ they used to commit

verses.text: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.
verses.translation: Undoubtedly, they will be sealed off from their Lord on that Day

verses.text: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.
verses.translation: Moreover, they will surely burn in Hell

verses.text: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."
verses.translation: and then be told, “This is what you used to deny.”

verses.text: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun.
verses.translation: But no! The virtuous are certainly bound for ’Illiyûn ˹in elevated Gardens˺—

verses.text: And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun?
verses.translation: and what will make you realize what ’Illiyûn is?—

verses.text: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
verses.translation: a fate ˹already˺ sealed

verses.text: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah ].
verses.translation: witnessed by those nearest ˹to Allah˺

verses.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
verses.translation: Surely the virtuous will be in bliss

verses.text: On adorned couches, observing.
verses.translation: ˹seated˺ on ˹canopied˺ couches, gazing around

verses.text: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
verses.translation: You will recognize on their faces the glow of delight

verses.text: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.
verses.translation: They will be given a drink of sealed, pure wine

verses.text: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
verses.translation: whose last sip will smell like musk. So let whoever aspires to this strive ˹diligently˺

verses.text: And its mixture is of Tasneem,
verses.translation: And this drink’s flavour will come from Tasnîm—

verses.text: A spring from which those near [to Allah ] drink.
verses.translation: a spring from which those nearest ˹to Allah˺ will drink

verses.text: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
verses.translation: Indeed, the wicked used to laugh at the believers

verses.text: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.
verses.translation: wink to one another whenever they passed by

verses.text: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.
verses.translation: and muse ˹over these exploits˺ upon returning to their own people

verses.text: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
verses.translation: And when they saw the faithful, they would say, “These ˹people˺ are truly astray,”

verses.text: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.
verses.translation: even though they were not sent as keepers over the believers

verses.text: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
verses.translation: But on that Day the believers will be laughing at the disbelievers

verses.text: On adorned couches, observing.
verses.translation: as they sit on ˹canopied˺ couches, looking on

verses.text: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
verses.translation: ˹The believers will be asked,˺ “Have the disbelievers ˹not˺ been paid back for what they used to do?”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: When the sky has split [open]
verses.translation: When the sky bursts open

verses.text: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
verses.translation: obeying its Lord as it must

verses.text: And when the earth has been extended
verses.translation: and when the earth is flattened out

verses.text: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]
verses.translation: and ejects ˹all˺ its contents and becomes empty

verses.text: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -
verses.translation: obeying its Lord as it must, ˹surely you will all be judged˺

verses.text: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.
verses.translation: O humanity! Indeed, you are labouring restlessly towards your Lord, and will ˹eventually˺ meet the consequences

verses.text: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,
verses.translation: As for those who are given their record in their right hand

verses.text: He will be judged with an easy account
verses.translation: they will have an easy reckoning

verses.text: And return to his people in happiness.
verses.translation: and will return to their people joyfully

verses.text: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,
verses.translation: And as for those who are given their record ˹in their left hand˺ from behind their backs

verses.text: He will cry out for destruction
verses.translation: they will cry for ˹instant˺ destruction

verses.text: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.
verses.translation: and will burn in the blazing Fire

verses.text: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;
verses.translation: For they used to be prideful among their people

verses.text: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah ].
verses.translation: thinking they would never return ˹to Allah˺

verses.text: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing.
verses.translation: Yes ˹they would˺! Surely their Lord has always been All-Seeing of them

verses.text: So I swear by the twilight glow
verses.translation: So, I do swear by the twilight

verses.text: And [by] the night and what it envelops
verses.translation: And by the night and whatever it envelops

verses.text: And [by] the moon when it becomes full
verses.translation: And by the moon when it waxes full

verses.text: [That] you will surely experience state after state.
verses.translation: You will certainly pass from one state to another

verses.text: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,
verses.translation: So what is the matter with them that they do not believe

verses.text: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah ]?
verses.translation: and when the Quran is recited to them, they do not bow down ˹in submission˺

verses.text: But those who have disbelieved deny,
verses.translation: In fact, the disbelievers persist in denial

verses.text: And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.
verses.translation: But Allah knows best whatever they hide

verses.text: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,
verses.translation: So give them good news of a painful punishment

verses.text: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
verses.translation: But those who believe and do good will have a never-ending reward

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: By the sky containing great stars
verses.translation: By the sky full of constellations

verses.text: And [by] the promised Day
verses.translation: and the promised Day ˹of Judgment˺

verses.text: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,
verses.translation: and the witness and what is witnessed

verses.text: Cursed were the companions of the trench
verses.translation: Condemned are the makers of the ditch—

verses.text: [Containing] the fire full of fuel,
verses.translation: the fire ˹pit˺, filled with fuel—

verses.text: When they were sitting near it
verses.translation: when they sat around it

verses.text: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.
verses.translation: watching what they had ˹ordered to be˺ done to the believers

verses.text: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah , the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,
verses.translation: who they resented for no reason other than belief in Allah—the Almighty, the Praiseworthy—

verses.text: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah , over all things, is Witness.
verses.translation: ˹the One˺ to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and earth. And Allah is a Witness over all things

verses.text: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.
verses.translation: Those who persecute the believing men and women and then do not repent will certainly suffer the punishment of Hell and the torment of burning

verses.text: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.
verses.translation: Surely those who believe and do good will have Gardens under which rivers flow. That is the greatest triumph

verses.text: Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe.
verses.translation: Indeed, the ˹crushing˺ grip of your Lord is severe

verses.text: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.
verses.translation: ˹For˺ He is certainly the One Who originates and resurrects ˹all˺

verses.text: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,
verses.translation: And He is the All-Forgiving, All-Loving—

verses.text: Honorable Owner of the Throne,
verses.translation: Lord of the Throne, the All-Glorious

verses.text: Effecter of what He intends.
verses.translation: Doer of whatever He wills

verses.text: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -
verses.translation: Has the story of the ˹destroyed˺ forces reached you ˹O Prophet˺—

verses.text: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamud?
verses.translation: ˹the forces of˺ Pharaoh and Thamûd

verses.text: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,
verses.translation: Yet the disbelievers ˹still˺ persist in denial

verses.text: While Allah encompasses them from behind.
verses.translation: But Allah encompasses them from all sides

verses.text: But this is an honored Qur'an
verses.translation: In fact, this is a glorious Quran

verses.text: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.
verses.translation: ˹recorded˺ in a Preserved Tablet

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: By the sky and the night comer -
verses.translation: By the heaven and the nightly star

verses.text: And what can make you know what is the night comer?
verses.translation: And what will make you realize what the nightly star is

verses.text: It is the piercing star -
verses.translation: ˹It is˺ the star of piercing brightness

verses.text: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.
verses.translation: There is no soul without a vigilant angel ˹recording everything˺

verses.text: So let man observe from what he was created.
verses.translation: Let people then consider what they were created from

verses.text: He was created from a fluid, ejected,
verses.translation: ˹They were˺ created from a spurting fluid

verses.text: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.
verses.translation: stemming from between the backbone and the ribcage

verses.text: Indeed, Allah , to return him [to life], is Able.
verses.translation: Surely He is fully capable of bringing them back ˹to life˺

verses.text: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,
verses.translation: on the Day all secrets will be disclosed

verses.text: Then man will have no power or any helper.
verses.translation: Then one will have neither power nor ˹any˺ helper

verses.text: By the sky which returns [rain]
verses.translation: By the sky with its recurring cycles

verses.text: And [by] the earth which cracks open,
verses.translation: and the earth with its sprouting plants

verses.text: Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement,
verses.translation: Surely this ˹Quran˺ is a decisive word

verses.text: And it is not amusement.
verses.translation: and is not to be taken lightly

verses.text: Indeed, they are planning a plan,
verses.translation: They are certainly devising ˹evil˺ plans

verses.text: But I am planning a plan.
verses.translation: but I too am planning

verses.text: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
verses.translation: So bear with the disbelievers ˹O Prophet˺. Let them be for ˹just˺ a little while

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,
verses.translation: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High

verses.text: Who created and proportioned
verses.translation: Who created and ˹perfectly˺ fashioned ˹all˺

verses.text: And Who destined and [then] guided
verses.translation: and Who ordained precisely and inspired accordingly

verses.text: And who brings out the pasture
verses.translation: and Who brings forth ˹green˺ pasture

verses.text: And [then] makes it black stubble.
verses.translation: then reduces it to withered chaff

verses.text: We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget,
verses.translation: We will have you recite ˹the Quran, O Prophet,˺ so you will not forget ˹any of it˺

verses.text: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.
verses.translation: unless Allah wills otherwise. He surely knows what is open and what is hidden

verses.text: And We will ease you toward ease.
verses.translation: We will facilitate for you the Way of Ease

verses.text: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;
verses.translation: So ˹always˺ remind ˹with the Quran˺—˹even˺ if the reminder is beneficial ˹only to some˺

verses.text: He who fears [ Allah ] will be reminded.
verses.translation: Those in awe ˹of Allah˺ will be mindful ˹of it˺

verses.text: But the wretched one will avoid it -
verses.translation: But it will be shunned by the most wretched

verses.text: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,
verses.translation: who will burn in the greatest Fire

verses.text: Neither dying therein nor living.
verses.translation: where they will not ˹be able to˺ live or die

verses.text: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
verses.translation: Successful indeed are those who purify themselves

verses.text: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
verses.translation: remember the Name of their Lord, and pray

verses.text: But you prefer the worldly life,
verses.translation: But you ˹deniers only˺ prefer the life of this world

verses.text: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
verses.translation: even though the Hereafter is far better and more lasting

verses.text: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,
verses.translation: This is certainly ˹mentioned˺ in the earlier Scriptures—

verses.text: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
verses.translation: the Scriptures of Abraham and Moses

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?
verses.translation: Has the news of the Overwhelming Event reached you ˹O Prophet˺

verses.text: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,
verses.translation: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be downcast

verses.text: Working [hard] and exhausted.
verses.translation: ˹totally˺ overburdened, exhausted

verses.text: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.
verses.translation: burning in a scorching Fire

verses.text: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.
verses.translation: left to drink from a scalding spring

verses.text: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
verses.translation: They will have no food except a foul, thorny shrub

verses.text: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.
verses.translation: neither nourishing nor satisfying hunger

verses.text: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.
verses.translation: On that Day ˹other˺ faces will be glowing with bliss

verses.text: With their effort [they are] satisfied
verses.translation: ˹fully˺ pleased with their striving

verses.text: In an elevated garden,
verses.translation: in an elevated Garden

verses.text: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.
verses.translation: where no idle talk will be heard

verses.text: Within it is a flowing spring.
verses.translation: In it will be a running spring

verses.text: Within it are couches raised high
verses.translation: along with thrones raised high

verses.text: And cups put in place
verses.translation: and cups set at hand

verses.text: And cushions lined up
verses.translation: and ˹fine˺ cushions lined up

verses.text: And carpets spread around.
verses.translation: and ˹splendid˺ carpets spread out

verses.text: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?
verses.translation: Do they not ever reflect on camels—how they were ˹masterfully˺ created

verses.text: And at the sky - how it is raised?
verses.translation: and the sky—how it was raised ˹high˺

verses.text: And at the mountains - how they are erected?
verses.translation: and the mountains—how they were firmly set up

verses.text: And at the earth - how it is spread out?
verses.translation: and the earth—how it was levelled out

verses.text: So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder.
verses.translation: So, ˹continue to˺ remind ˹all, O Prophet˺, for your duty is only to remind

verses.text: You are not over them a controller.
verses.translation: You are not ˹there˺ to compel them ˹to believe˺

verses.text: However, he who turns away and disbelieves -
verses.translation: But whoever turns away, persisting in disbelief

verses.text: Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.
verses.translation: then Allah will inflict upon them the major punishment

verses.text: Indeed, to Us is their return.
verses.translation: Surely to Us is their return

verses.text: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.
verses.translation: then surely with Us is their reckoning

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: By the dawn
verses.translation: By the dawn

verses.text: And [by] ten nights
verses.translation: and the ten nights

verses.text: And [by] the even [number] and the odd
verses.translation: and the even and the odd

verses.text: And [by] the night when it passes,
verses.translation: and the night when it passes

verses.text: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?
verses.translation: Is all this ˹not˺ a sufficient oath for those who have sense

verses.text: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with 'Aad -
verses.translation: Did you not see how your Lord dealt with ’Ȃd—

verses.text: [With] Iram - who had lofty pillars,
verses.translation: ˹the people˺ of Iram—with ˹their˺ great stature

verses.text: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?
verses.translation: unmatched in any other land

verses.text: And [with] Thamud, who carved out the rocks in the valley?
verses.translation: and Thamûd who carved ˹their homes into˺ the rocks in the ˹Stone˺ Valley

verses.text: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes? -
verses.translation: and the Pharaoh of mighty structures

verses.text: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands
verses.translation: They all transgressed throughout the land

verses.text: And increased therein the corruption.
verses.translation: spreading much corruption there

verses.text: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.
verses.translation: So your Lord unleashed on them a scourge of punishment

verses.text: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.
verses.translation: ˹For˺ your Lord is truly vigilant

verses.text: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."
verses.translation: Now, whenever a human being is tested by their Lord through ˹His˺ generosity and blessings, they boast, “My Lord has ˹deservedly˺ honoured me!”

verses.text: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."
verses.translation: But when He tests them by limiting their provision, they protest, “My Lord has ˹undeservedly˺ humiliated me!”

verses.text: No! But you do not honor the orphan
verses.translation: Absolutely not! In fact, you are not ˹even˺ gracious to the orphan

verses.text: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.
verses.translation: nor do you urge one another to feed the poor

verses.text: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,
verses.translation: And you devour ˹others’˺ inheritance greedily

verses.text: And you love wealth with immense love.
verses.translation: and love wealth fervently

verses.text: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed -
verses.translation: Enough! When the earth is entirely crushed over and over

verses.text: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,
verses.translation: and your Lord comes ˹to judge˺ with angels, rank upon rank

verses.text: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance?
verses.translation: and Hell is brought forth on that Day—this is when every ˹disbelieving˺ person will remember ˹their own sins˺. But what is the use of remembering then

verses.text: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."
verses.translation: They will cry, “I wish I had sent forth ˹something good˺ for my ˹true˺ life.”

verses.text: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,
verses.translation: On that Day He will punish ˹them˺ severely, like no other

verses.text: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].
verses.translation: and bind ˹them˺ tightly, like no other

verses.text: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,
verses.translation: ˹Allah will say to the righteous,˺ “O tranquil soul

verses.text: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],
verses.translation: Return to your Lord, well pleased ˹with Him˺ and well pleasing ˹to Him˺

verses.text: And enter among My [righteous] servants
verses.translation: So join My servants

verses.text: And enter My Paradise."
verses.translation: and enter My Paradise.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: I swear by this city, Makkah -
verses.translation: I do swear by this city ˹of Mecca˺—

verses.text: And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city -
verses.translation: even though you ˹O Prophet˺ are subject to abuse in this city—

verses.text: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],
verses.translation: and by every parent and ˹their˺ child

verses.text: We have certainly created man into hardship.
verses.translation: Indeed, We have created humankind in ˹constant˺ struggle

verses.text: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?
verses.translation: Do they think that no one has power over them

verses.text: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."
verses.translation: boasting, “I have wasted enormous wealth!”

verses.text: Does he think that no one has seen him?
verses.translation: Do they think that no one sees them

verses.text: Have We not made for him two eyes?
verses.translation: Have We not given them two eyes

verses.text: And a tongue and two lips?
verses.translation: a tongue, and two lips

verses.text: And have shown him the two ways?
verses.translation: and shown them the two ways ˹of right and wrong˺

verses.text: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.
verses.translation: If only they had attempted the challenging path ˹of goodness instead˺

verses.text: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?
verses.translation: And what will make you realize what ˹attempting˺ the challenging path is

verses.text: It is the freeing of a slave
verses.translation: It is to free a slave

verses.text: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
verses.translation: or to give food in times of famine

verses.text: An orphan of near relationship
verses.translation: to an orphaned relative

verses.text: Or a needy person in misery
verses.translation: or to a poor person in distress

verses.text: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.
verses.translation: and—above all—to be one of those who have faith and urge each other to perseverance and urge each other to compassion

verses.text: Those are the companions of the right.
verses.translation: These are the people of the right

verses.text: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.
verses.translation: As for those who deny Our signs, they are the people of the left

verses.text: Over them will be fire closed in.
verses.translation: The Fire will be sealed over them

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: By the sun and its brightness
verses.translation: By the sun and its brightness

verses.text: And [by] the moon when it follows it
verses.translation: and the moon as it follows it

verses.text: And [by] the day when it displays it
verses.translation: and the day as it unveils it

verses.text: And [by] the night when it covers it
verses.translation: and the night as it conceals it

verses.text: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
verses.translation: And by heaven and ˹the One˺ Who built it

verses.text: And [by] the earth and He who spread it
verses.translation: and the earth and ˹the One˺ Who spread it

verses.text: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it
verses.translation: And by the soul and ˹the One˺ Who fashioned it

verses.text: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,
verses.translation: then with ˹the knowledge of˺ right and wrong inspired it

verses.text: He has succeeded who purifies it,
verses.translation: Successful indeed is the one who purifies their soul

verses.text: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
verses.translation: and doomed is the one who corrupts it

verses.text: Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,
verses.translation: Thamûd rejected ˹the truth˺ out of arrogance

verses.text: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.
verses.translation: when the most wicked of them was roused ˹to kill the she-camel˺

verses.text: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink."
verses.translation: But the messenger of Allah warned them, “˹Do not disturb˺ Allah’s camel and her ˹turn to˺ drink!”

verses.text: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
verses.translation: Still they defied him and slaughtered her. So their Lord crushed them for their crime, levelling all to the ground

verses.text: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.
verses.translation: He has no fear of consequences

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: By the night when it covers
verses.translation: By the night when it covers

verses.text: And [by] the day when it appears
verses.translation: and the day when it shines

verses.text: And [by] He who created the male and female,
verses.translation: And by ˹the One˺ Who created male and female

verses.text: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.
verses.translation: Surely the ends you strive for are diverse

verses.text: As for he who gives and fears Allah
verses.translation: As for the one who is charitable, mindful ˹of Allah˺

verses.text: And believes in the best [reward],
verses.translation: and ˹firmly˺ believes in the finest reward

verses.text: We will ease him toward ease.
verses.translation: We will facilitate for them the Way of Ease

verses.text: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
verses.translation: And as for the one who is stingy, indifferent ˹to Allah˺

verses.text: And denies the best [reward],
verses.translation: and ˹staunchly˺ denies the finest reward

verses.text: We will ease him toward difficulty.
verses.translation: We will facilitate for them the path of hardship

verses.text: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?
verses.translation: And their wealth will be of no benefit to them when they tumble ˹into Hell˺

verses.text: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.
verses.translation: It is certainly upon Us ˹alone˺ to show ˹the way to˺ guidance

verses.text: And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
verses.translation: And surely to Us ˹alone˺ belong this life and the next

verses.text: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.
verses.translation: And so I have warned you of a raging Fire

verses.text: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one.
verses.translation: in which none will burn except the most wretched—

verses.text: Who had denied and turned away.
verses.translation: who deny and turn away

verses.text: But the righteous one will avoid it -
verses.translation: But the righteous will be spared from it—

verses.text: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself
verses.translation: who donate ˹some of˺ their wealth only to purify themselves

verses.text: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
verses.translation: not in return for someone’s favours

verses.text: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.
verses.translation: but seeking the pleasure of their Lord, the Most High

verses.text: And he is going to be satisfied.
verses.translation: They will certainly be pleased

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: By the morning brightness
verses.translation: By the morning sunlight

verses.text: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,
verses.translation: and the night when it falls still

verses.text: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
verses.translation: Your Lord ˹O Prophet˺ has not abandoned you, nor has He become hateful ˹of you˺

verses.text: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
verses.translation: And the next life is certainly far better for you than this one

verses.text: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
verses.translation: And ˹surely˺ your Lord will give so much to you that you will be pleased

verses.text: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
verses.translation: Did He not find you as an orphan then sheltered you

verses.text: And He found you lost and guided [you],
verses.translation: Did He not find you unguided then guided you

verses.text: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
verses.translation: And did He not find you needy then satisfied your needs

verses.text: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
verses.translation: So do not oppress the orphan

verses.text: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].
verses.translation: nor repulse the beggar

verses.text: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
verses.translation: And proclaim the blessings of your Lord

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?
verses.translation: Have We not uplifted your heart for you ˹O Prophet˺

verses.text: And We removed from you your burden
verses.translation: relieved you of the burden

verses.text: Which had weighed upon your back
verses.translation: which weighed so heavily on your back

verses.text: And raised high for you your repute.
verses.translation: and elevated your renown for you

verses.text: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
verses.translation: So, surely with hardship comes ease

verses.text: Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
verses.translation: Surely with ˹that˺ hardship comes ˹more˺ ease

verses.text: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
verses.translation: So once you have fulfilled ˹your duty˺, strive ˹in devotion˺

verses.text: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
verses.translation: turning to your Lord ˹alone˺ with hope

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: By the fig and the olive
verses.translation: By the fig and the olive ˹of Jerusalem˺

verses.text: And [by] Mount Sinai
verses.translation: and Mount Sinai

verses.text: And [by] this secure city [Makkah],
verses.translation: and this secure city ˹of Mecca˺

verses.text: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;
verses.translation: Indeed, We created humans in the best form

verses.text: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,
verses.translation: But We will reduce them to the lowest of the low ˹in Hell˺

verses.text: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.
verses.translation: except those who believe and do good—they will have a never-ending reward

verses.text: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?
verses.translation: Now, what makes you deny the ˹final˺ Judgment

verses.text: Is not Allah the most just of judges?
verses.translation: Is Allah not the most just of all judges

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Recite in the name of your Lord who created -
verses.translation: Read, ˹O Prophet,˺ in the Name of your Lord Who created—

verses.text: Created man from a clinging substance.
verses.translation: created humans from a clinging clot

verses.text: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -
verses.translation: Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous

verses.text: Who taught by the pen -
verses.translation: Who taught by the pen—

verses.text: Taught man that which he knew not.
verses.translation: taught humanity what they knew not

verses.text: No! [But] indeed, man transgresses
verses.translation: Most certainly, one exceeds all bounds

verses.text: Because he sees himself self-sufficient.
verses.translation: once they think they are self-sufficient

verses.text: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.
verses.translation: ˹But˺ surely to your Lord is the return ˹of all˺

verses.text: Have you seen the one who forbids
verses.translation: Have you seen the man who prevents

verses.text: A servant when he prays?
verses.translation: a servant ˹of Ours˺ from praying

verses.text: Have you seen if he is upon guidance
verses.translation: What if this ˹servant˺ is ˹rightly˺ guided

verses.text: Or enjoins righteousness?
verses.translation: or encourages righteousness

verses.text: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -
verses.translation: What if that ˹man˺ persists in denial and turns away

verses.text: Does he not know that Allah sees?
verses.translation: Does he not know that Allah sees ˹all˺

verses.text: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock -
verses.translation: But no! If he does not desist, We will certainly drag him by the forelock—

verses.text: A lying, sinning forelock.
verses.translation: a lying, sinful forelock

verses.text: Then let him call his associates;
verses.translation: So let him call his associates

verses.text: We will call the angels of Hell.
verses.translation: We will call the wardens of Hell

verses.text: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allah ].
verses.translation: Again, no! Never obey him ˹O Prophet˺! Rather, ˹continue to˺ prostrate and draw near ˹to Allah˺

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree.
verses.translation: Indeed, ˹it is˺ We ˹Who˺ sent this ˹Quran˺ down on the Night of Glory

verses.text: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?
verses.translation: And what will make you realize what the Night of Glory is

verses.text: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
verses.translation: The Night of Glory is better than a thousand months

verses.text: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
verses.translation: That night the angels and the ˹holy˺ spirit descend, by the permission of their Lord, for every ˹decreed˺ matter

verses.text: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
verses.translation: It is all peace until the break of dawn

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence -
verses.translation: The disbelievers from the People of the Book and the polytheists were not going to desist ˹from disbelief˺ until the clear proof came to them

verses.text: A Messenger from Allah , reciting purified scriptures
verses.translation: a messenger from Allah, reciting scrolls of ˹utmost˺ purity

verses.text: Within which are correct writings.
verses.translation: containing upright commandments

verses.text: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence.
verses.translation: It was not until this clear proof came to the People of the Book that they became divided ˹about his prophethood˺—

verses.text: And they were not commanded except to worship Allah , [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakah. And that is the correct religion.
verses.translation: even though they were only commanded to worship Allah ˹alone˺ with sincere devotion to Him in all uprightness, establish prayer, and pay alms-tax. That is the upright Way

verses.text: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.
