verses.translation: Indeed, those who disbelieve from the People of the Book and the polytheists will be in the Fire of Hell, to stay there forever. They are the worst of ˹all˺ beings

verses.text: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.
verses.translation: Indeed, those who believe and do good—they are the best of ˹all˺ beings

verses.text: Their reward with Allah will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.
verses.translation: Their reward with their Lord will be Gardens of Eternity, under which rivers flow, to stay there for ever and ever. Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him. This is ˹only˺ for those in awe of their Lord

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
verses.translation: When the earth is shaken ˹in˺ its ultimate quaking

verses.text: And the earth discharges its burdens
verses.translation: and when the earth throws out ˹all˺ its contents

verses.text: And man says, "What is [wrong] with it?" -
verses.translation: and humanity cries, “What is wrong with it?”—

verses.text: That Day, it will report its news
verses.translation: on that Day the earth will recount everything

verses.text: Because your Lord has commanded it.
verses.translation: having been inspired by your Lord ˹to do so˺

verses.text: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
verses.translation: On that Day people will proceed in separate groups to be shown ˹the consequences of˺ their deeds

verses.text: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,
verses.translation: So whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it

verses.text: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
verses.translation: And whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: By the racers, panting,
verses.translation: ’ By the galloping, panting horses

verses.text: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
verses.translation: striking sparks of fire ˹with their hoofs˺

verses.text: And the chargers at dawn,
verses.translation: launching raids at dawn

verses.text: Stirring up thereby [clouds of] dust,
verses.translation: stirring up ˹clouds of˺ dust

verses.text: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
verses.translation: and penetrating into the heart of enemy lines

verses.text: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
verses.translation: Surely humankind is ungrateful to their Lord—

verses.text: And indeed, he is to that a witness.
verses.translation: and they certainly attest to this—

verses.text: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
verses.translation: and they are truly extreme in their love of ˹worldly˺ gains

verses.text: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
verses.translation: Do they not know that when the contents of the graves will be spilled out

verses.text: And that within the breasts is obtained,
verses.translation: and the secrets of the hearts will be laid bare—

verses.text: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.
verses.translation: surely their Lord is All-Aware of them on that Day

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: The Striking Calamity -
verses.translation: The Striking Disaster

verses.text: What is the Striking Calamity?
verses.translation: What is the Striking Disaster

verses.text: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?
verses.translation: And what will make you realize what the Striking Disaster is

verses.text: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,
verses.translation: ˹It is˺ the Day people will be like scattered moths

verses.text: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.
verses.translation: and the mountains will be like carded wool

verses.text: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],
verses.translation: So as for those whose scale is heavy ˹with good deeds˺

verses.text: He will be in a pleasant life.
verses.translation: they will be in a life of bliss

verses.text: But as for one whose scales are light,
verses.translation: And as for those whose scale is light

verses.text: His refuge will be an abyss.
verses.translation: their home will be the abyss

verses.text: And what can make you know what that is?
verses.translation: And what will make you realize what that is

verses.text: It is a Fire, intensely hot.
verses.translation: ˹It is˺ a scorching Fire

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Competition in [worldly] increase diverts you
verses.translation: Competition for more ˹gains˺ diverts you ˹from Allah˺

verses.text: Until you visit the graveyards.
verses.translation: until you end up in ˹your˺ graves

verses.text: No! You are going to know.
verses.translation: But no! You will soon come to know

verses.text: Then no! You are going to know.
verses.translation: Again, no! You will soon come to know

verses.text: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...
verses.translation: Indeed, if you were to know ˹your fate˺ with certainty, ˹you would have acted differently˺

verses.text: You will surely see the Hellfire.
verses.translation: ˹But˺ you will surely see the Hellfire

verses.text: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
verses.translation: Again, you will surely see it with the eye of certainty

verses.text: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.
verses.translation: Then, on that Day, you will definitely be questioned about ˹your worldly˺ pleasures

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: By time,
verses.translation: By the ˹passage of˺ time

verses.text: Indeed, mankind is in loss,
verses.translation: Surely humanity is in ˹grave˺ loss

verses.text: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
verses.translation: except those who have faith, do good, and urge each other to the truth, and urge each other to perseverance

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Woe to every scorner and mocker
verses.translation: Woe to every backbiter, slanderer

verses.text: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.
verses.translation: who amasses wealth ˹greedily˺ and counts it ˹repeatedly˺

verses.text: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.
verses.translation: thinking that their wealth will make them immortal

verses.text: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.
verses.translation: Not at all! Such a person will certainly be tossed into the Crusher

verses.text: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
verses.translation: And what will make you realize what the Crusher is

verses.text: It is the fire of Allah , [eternally] fueled,
verses.translation: ˹It is˺ Allah’s kindled Fire

verses.text: Which mounts directed at the hearts.
verses.translation: which rages over the hearts

verses.text: Indeed, Hellfire will be closed down upon them
verses.translation: It will be sealed over them

verses.text: In extended columns.
verses.translation: ˹tightly secured˺ with long braces

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
verses.translation: Have you not seen ˹O Prophet˺ how your Lord dealt with the Army of the Elephant

verses.text: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?
verses.translation: Did He not frustrate their scheme

verses.text: And He sent against them birds in flocks,
verses.translation: For He sent against them flocks of birds

verses.text: Striking them with stones of hard clay,
verses.translation: that pelted them with stones of baked clay

verses.text: And He made them like eaten straw.
verses.translation: leaving them like chewed up straw

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -
verses.translation: ˹At least˺ for ˹the favour of˺ making Quraysh habitually secure—

verses.text: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -
verses.translation: secure in their trading caravan ˹to Yemen˺ in the winter and ˹Syria˺ in the summer—

verses.text: Let them worship the Lord of this House,
verses.translation: let them worship the Lord of this ˹Sacred˺ House

verses.text: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
verses.translation: Who has fed them against hunger and made them secure against fear

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
verses.translation: Have you seen the one who denies the ˹final˺ Judgment

verses.text: For that is the one who drives away the orphan
verses.translation: That is the one who repulses the orphan

verses.text: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
verses.translation: and does not encourage the feeding of the poor

verses.text: So woe to those who pray
verses.translation: So woe to those ˹hypocrites˺ who pray

verses.text: [But] who are heedless of their prayer -
verses.translation: yet are unmindful of their prayers

verses.text: Those who make show [of their deeds]
verses.translation: those who ˹only˺ show off

verses.text: And withhold [simple] assistance.
verses.translation: and refuse to give ˹even the simplest˺ aid

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.
verses.translation: Indeed, We have granted you ˹O Prophet˺ abundant goodness

verses.text: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].
verses.translation: So pray and sacrifice to your Lord ˹alone˺

verses.text: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.
verses.translation: Only the one who hates you is truly cut off ˹from any goodness˺

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Say, "O disbelievers,
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “O you disbelievers

verses.text: I do not worship what you worship.
verses.translation: I do not worship what you worship

verses.text: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.
verses.translation: nor do you worship what I worship

verses.text: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.
verses.translation: I will never worship what you worship

verses.text: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.
verses.translation: nor will you ever worship what I worship

verses.text: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."
verses.translation: You have your way, and I have my Way.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest,
verses.translation: When Allah’s ˹ultimate˺ help comes and the victory ˹over Mecca is achieved˺

verses.text: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,
verses.translation: and you ˹O Prophet˺ see the people embracing Allah’s Way in crowds

verses.text: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.
verses.translation: then glorify the praises of your Lord and seek His forgiveness, for certainly He is ever Accepting of Repentance

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.
verses.translation: May the hands of Abu Lahab perish, and he ˹himself˺ perish

verses.text: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.
verses.translation: Neither his wealth nor ˹worldly˺ gains will benefit him

verses.text: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
verses.translation: He will burn in a flaming Fire

verses.text: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.
verses.translation: and ˹so will˺ his wife, the carrier of ˹thorny˺ kindling

verses.text: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.
verses.translation: around her neck will be a rope of palm-fibre

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Say, "He is Allah , [who is] One,
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “He is Allah—One ˹and Indivisible˺

verses.text: Allah , the Eternal Refuge.
verses.translation: Allah—the Sustainer ˹needed by all˺

verses.text: He neither begets nor is born,
verses.translation: He has never had offspring, nor was He born

verses.text: Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
verses.translation: And there is none comparable to Him.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak

verses.text: From the evil of that which He created
verses.translation: from the evil of whatever He has created

verses.text: And from the evil of darkness when it settles
verses.translation: and from the evil of the night when it grows dark

verses.text: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
verses.translation: and from the evil of those ˹witches casting spells by˺ blowing onto knots

verses.text: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
verses.translation: and from the evil of an envier when they envy.”

verses.text: In the name of Allah , the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful.
verses.translation: In the Name of Allah—the Most Compassionate, Most Merciful.

verses.text: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I seek refuge in the Lord of humankind

verses.text: The Sovereign of mankind.
verses.translation: the Master of humankind

verses.text: The God of mankind,
verses.translation: the God of humankind

verses.text: From the evil of the retreating whisperer -
verses.translation: from the evil of the lurking whisperer—

verses.text: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -
verses.translation: who whispers into the hearts of humankind—

verses.text: From among the jinn and mankind."
verses.translation: from among jinn and humankind.”
